P.name: Deathbringer Stance
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Aatrox''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|4 to 10}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|100 to 320}} against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Deathbringer Stance's'' damage applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

'''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for the {{tt|post-mitigation '''bonus''' damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|0.25*1.0*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
P.description2: Whenever '''Aatrox''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} with a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or an {{tip|ability}}, ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 2 seconds, doubled to 4 if he hits with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of ''{{ai|The Darkin Blade|Aatrox}}''.

Q.name: The Darkin Blade
Q.description: '''Aatrox''' can activate ''The Darkin Blade'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' performs a strike with his greatsword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit within an area. Enemies hit within a {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of the area take {{ccs|{{#expr:(1.75-1)*100}}% '''bonus''' damage|physical}} and are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Each subsequent cast gains {{ap|0.25*100}}% more damage.
Q.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' first strike affects a 625{{times}}180-unit rectangular area in the target direction, with him centered on the back line and the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge.
Q.leveling3: {{st|First Cast Damage|{{ap|10 to 70}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 90}}% AD)}}|First Sweetspot Damage|{{ap|10*1.75 to 70*1.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*1.75 to 90*1.75}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' second strike affects a trapezoidal area in the target direction, with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge. The hitbox begins 100-units behind '''Aatrox''' and extends 475-units in front of him, measuring between 300 and 500-units wide from behind to in front.
Q.description5: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' third strike affects a 300-radius circular area centered on a target location that is 200 units in front of him, with a 180-radius {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} within.
Q.description6: ''The Darkin Blade'' deals {{pp|55 to 70|key=%|1;6;11;16|formula=55% base + 5% every 5 levels thereafter}} damage against {{tip|minions}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, the first cast deals {{as|25 '''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by the subsequent cast and {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} damage modifiers; and the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration from hitting the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} against them is doubled to {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

W.name: Infernal Chains
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' sends a chain in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 70*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|25 to 35}}%}}
W.description2: If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, a {{tip|tether}} is formed between the target and the ground beneath them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
W.description3: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to the center of the area.

E.name: Umbral Dash
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for 16% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he deals against enemy champions.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction.
E.description3: ''Umbral Dash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Aatrox's''' basic attack timer and can be cast during his other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''

R.name: World Ender
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' unleashes his true form for 10 seconds, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemy {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually {{tip|slow|slowed}} by up to 99% over the duration. He also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays by 10% of the '''current bonus''' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, lasting until ''World Ender'' has ended.
R.description2: Whenever '''Aatrox''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}}, he extends the duration by 5 seconds, up to its original length, and becomes unleashed again.
R.description3: During ''World Ender'', '''Aatrox''' gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, has 5% increased [[size]], is {{tip|ghosted}}, and receives increased {{tip|heal|self-healing}} from all sources.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 40}}% AD}}}}
{{st|Increased Healing|{{ap|50 to 100}}%}}
R.description4: '''''Aatrox''' can move during World Ender's cast time.''

P.name: Essence Theft
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ahri''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Essence Fragment'' whenever she kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to {{tip|heal}} herself for {{pplevel|35 to 95|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}.
P.description2: Additionally, whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for {{pplevel|75 to 165|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.

Q.name: Orb of Deception
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' sends her orb in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through. Upon reaching maximum range, it returns to her to deal the same amount in {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies it passes through.
Q.leveling: {{st|Damage Per Pass|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|35*2 to 135*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

W.name: Fox-Fire
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' gains {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 2 seconds and conjures three flames which orbit her clockwise for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
W.description2: After {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the cast, each flame targets a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy based on priority, or after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, simply targets the closest visible enemy in range. Each flame deals {{as|magic damage}}, with subsequent flames against a target dealing 40% damage.
W.leveling2: {{st|Primary Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Subsequent Magic Damage|{{ap|40*0.4 to 120*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.4}}% AP)}}|Total Single-Target Damage|{{ap|40*(1+0.4*2) to 120*(1+0.4*2)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+0.4*2)}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: Flames prioritize enemy champions hit by ''{{ai|Charm|Ahri}}'', then enemy {{tip|champion|champions}}, then minions that would die to ''Fox-Fire's'' damage, and then the target of '''Ahri's''' last basic attack within 3 seconds.
W.description4: ''Fox-Fire's'' damage is doubled against {{tip|minions}} below {{sti|{{as|20% '''maximum''' health}}}}.
W.leveling4: {{st|Primary Minion Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2}}% AP)}}|Subsequent Minion Damage|{{ap|40*2*0.4 to 120*2*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2*0.4}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: Charm
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' blows forth a kiss in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|charm|charming}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 65% for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 85% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 1.8}} seconds}}

R.name: Spirit Rush
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and then fires essence bolts to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each dealing {{as|magic damage}}.

''Spirit Rush'' can be recast twice more within 15 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. Consuming a champion's essence with ''{{ai|Essence Theft|Ahri}}'' while ''Spirit Rush'' is active extends the recast duration by and up to 10 seconds, and grants an additional recast, storing up to 3 recasts at a time.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ahri''' mimics the first cast's effects.
R.description3: ''Spirit Rush's recast duration will persist even after using all recasts. {{ai|Fox-Fire|Ahri}} can be cast during the dash.''
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|140 to 100}}|Starts after first cast, and refreshes upon gaining recasts}}

P.name: Assassin's Mark
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Akali''' damages an enemy {{tip|champion}} with an {{tip|ability}}, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions. For 2 seconds, she gains {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 to 60 for 4|1 to 16}} {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving away from the center of the ring. Only one ring may be active at a time.
P.description2: When '''Akali''' exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while facing nearby enemy champions and becomes empowered with ''Swinging Kama'' for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.
P.description3: {{sbc|Swinging Kama:}} '''Akali's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|{{tt|'''doubled''' range|Not necessarily increased by 125, check notes}}}} and deal {{pplevel|35 to 53 for 7; then + 9*x for 6; then + 15*x|formula=+3 per level until lvl 7; then +9 until lvl 13, then +15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Five Point Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' unleashes kunai in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Targets beyond a certain range are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

Q.name: Five Point Strike 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' unleashes kunai in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Targets beyond a certain range are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

W.name: Twilight Shroud
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' restores {{sti|{{as|100 energy}}}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 2 seconds. She also detonates a smoke bomb a fixed distance away in the target direction, creating a circular shroud that expands over the next 5 seconds into a ring. The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions. While the shroud is active, '''Akali's''' {{as|'''maximum''' energy}} is increased by {{as|100|energy}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Shroud Duration|{{ap|5 to 7}} seconds}}
W.description2: Entering the shroud renders '''Akali''' {{tip|invisibility|invisible}}, unless she is {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
W.description3: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent '''Akali''' from entering it again for {{pp|changedisplay=true|round=3|1;0.9;0.825;0.725;0.625|1;7;10;13;16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.
W.description4: ''The {{ai|Shuriken Flip|Akali|marked}} section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.''
W.description5: '''''Akali''' can move during Twilight Shroud's cast time.''

E.name: Shuriken Flip
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|flips}} backward after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the cast time, and after the cast time throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
E.description2: The shuriken ''marks'' and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the enemy or the last ''{{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|smoke}}'' section hit for 3 seconds, during which ''Shuriken Flip'' can be recast to consume the mark.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals {{as|magic damage}} upon arrival.
E.description4: '''''Akali''' will not flip backwards if she is {{tip|immobilized}} or {{tip|grounded}} in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the cast time. {{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali}} and {{ai|Perfect Execution|Akali}} can be cast during the recast's dash.''

E.name: Shuriken Flip 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|flips}} backward after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the cast time, and after the cast time throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
E.description2: The shuriken ''marks'' and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the enemy or the last ''{{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|smoke}}'' section hit for 3 seconds, during which ''Shuriken Flip'' can be recast to consume the mark.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals {{as|magic damage}} upon arrival.
E.description4: '''''Akali''' will not flip backwards if she is {{tip|immobilized}} or {{tip|grounded}} in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the cast time. {{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali}} and {{ai|Perfect Execution|Akali}} can be cast during the recast's dash.''

R.name: Perfect Execution
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 750 units in the direction of the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.
R.description2: ''Perfect Execution'' can be recast after a {{fd|2.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} within 10 seconds of the first activation.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} {{tt|800|Estimated}} units in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 70|formula=2.86% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 70% '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 210*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Perfect Execution 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 750 units in the direction of the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.
R.description2: ''Perfect Execution'' can be recast after a {{fd|2.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} within 10 seconds of the first activation.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} {{tt|800|Estimated}} units in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 70|formula=2.86% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 70% '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 210*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}

P.name: Dirty Fighting
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Akshan''' uses a {{tip|basic attack}}, he fires an additional shot after a delay that deals {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minions}}. Issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} on a different target before the additional shot has been launched causes '''Akshan''' to fire it at the new target. If the second shot is cancelled instead, he gains {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 75}}|ms}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 1 second.
P.description2: The additional shot applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dirty Fighting'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal them {{as|{{pp|15;40;80;150|1;6;11;16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' will also gain a {{pplevel|40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds. The shield may be gained only once every few seconds.

Q.name: Avengerang
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' throws a boomerang in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second and extending its range each time it hits a target. If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays over 1 second.
Q.description2: Once the boomerang has passed its original range and has not hit a target in the last 500 units of travelling, it homes back to '''Akshan''' and applies the same effects to enemies hit.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*2 to 165*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Avengerang'' deals reduced damage against non-champions.
Q.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

W.name: Going Rogue
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Akshan''' marks enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions as ''Scoundrels'' for 60 seconds. If '''Akshan''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''Scoundrel'' while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, he receives an additional {{g|100}} and resurrects all {{tip|death|dead}} allied champions that they have slain after 1 second.
W.description2: When '''Akshan''' claims a ''Scoundrel's'' bounty he removes the marks of all other enemies. ''Scoundrels'' refresh their mark duration on subsequent kills, and will have their mark removed when they die by any means. '''Akshan''' cannot mark enemies as ''Scoundrels'' while they are dead. Allies are resurrected at their [[Spawn|summoning platform]].
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' enters {{tip|camouflage}}, which lasts indefinitely while he is near [[terrain]] or inside {{tip|brush}}, and for 2 seconds otherwise. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'', and while facing them if they are within {{tt|5000|Pending for test}} units, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}} equal to {{as|12% of his '''missing''' mana}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description4: ''Going Rogue'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after its duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Going Rogue'' immediately.
W.description5: '''''Akshan''' can move during Going Rogue's cast time.''

E.name: Heroic Swing
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' can activate ''Heroic Swing'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and can use the third cast only after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the second cast. '''Akshan''' may input an attack or movement command to use the second and third casts.
E.description2: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Akshan''' fires a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first [[terrain]] hit, and enters {{tt|preparation|See notes}} for up to {{fd|2.125}} seconds. ''Heroic Swing's'' second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or '''Akshan''' is {{tt|moved|See notes}} or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} within the duration, the preparation will end prematurely, cancelling ''Heroic Swing'' in the process.
E.description3:
{{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|swings}} around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to his {{tt|facing direction|See notes}}, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, he fires at the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy every {{rutngt|0.2}} to deal them {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness.

'''''Akshan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage per Shot|{{ap|8 to 40}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + {{fd|0.3}} per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}
E.description4: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Akshan''' ends the swing by {{tip|dash|jumping}} to the target location, though not through terrain, and fires one last shot at a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy.
E.description5: Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces ''Heroic Swing's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The shots can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}and {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
E.description6: ''{{ai|Avengerang|Akshan}} and {{ai|Going Rogue|Akshan}} can be cast during the third cast's dash. {{ai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} can be cast at all points during Heroic Swing, though '''Akshan''' cannot fire during the swing while it is active. '''Akshan''' prioritizes firing at enemy champions with stacks of {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}, then those damaged by his {{tip|unit-targeted|targeted}} spells in the last 4 seconds, then the nearest enemy. Heroic Swing can be cast during '''Akshan's''' other abilities.''

E.name: Heroic Swing 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' can activate ''Heroic Swing'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and can use the third cast only after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the second cast. '''Akshan''' may input an attack or movement command to use the second and third casts.
E.description2: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Akshan''' fires a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first [[terrain]] hit, and enters {{tt|preparation|See notes}} for up to {{fd|2.125}} seconds. ''Heroic Swing's'' second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or '''Akshan''' is {{tt|moved|See notes}} or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} within the duration, the preparation will end prematurely, cancelling ''Heroic Swing'' in the process.
E.description3:
{{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|swings}} around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to his {{tt|facing direction|See notes}}, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, he fires at the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy every {{rutngt|0.2}} to deal them {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness.

'''''Akshan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage per Shot|{{ap|8 to 40}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + {{fd|0.3}} per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}
E.description4: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Akshan''' ends the swing by {{tip|dash|jumping}} to the target location, though not through terrain, and fires one last shot at a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy.
E.description5: Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces ''Heroic Swing's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The shots can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}and {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
E.description6: ''{{ai|Avengerang|Akshan}} and {{ai|Going Rogue|Akshan}} can be cast during the third cast's dash. {{ai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} can be cast at all points during Heroic Swing, though '''Akshan''' cannot fire during the swing while it is active. '''Akshan''' prioritizes firing at enemy champions with stacks of {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}, then those damaged by his {{tip|unit-targeted|targeted}} spells in the last 4 seconds, then the nearest enemy. Heroic Swing can be cast during '''Akshan's''' other abilities.''

R.name: Comeuppance
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' locks onto the target enemy champion and begins {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself. He gradually stores bullets into his weapon over the duration.
R.leveling:
{{st|Maximum Bullets Stored|{{ap|5 to 7}}}}
{{st|Bullet Storing Interval Time|{{ap|2.5/4 to 2.5/6|round=4}} seconds}}
R.description2: ''Comeuppance'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Comeuppance'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' fires all stored bullets at the target, each briefly granting {{tip|sight}} around their trajectory and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}, as well as by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. The shots can hit {{tip|structures}}.
R.leveling3:
<!--
-->{{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 15% AD)}}<!--
-->|Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|25*3 to 45*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*3}}% AD)}}<!--
-->|Minimum Charged Physical Damage|{{ap|5*25|6*35|7*45}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*5 to 15*7}}% AD)}}<!--
-->|Damage to target on 67% missing hp|{{ap|3*5*25|3*6*35|3*7*45}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*5*15 to 3*7*15}}% AD)}}<!--
-->}}
R.description4: Each bullet's damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}}.
R.description5: '''''Akshan''' can move while channeling Comeuppance.''

P.name: Triumphant Roar
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Alistar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Triumph'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} he {{tip|stuns}} or {{tip|airborne|displaces}} with his {{tip|abilities}}, and each time a nearby enemy {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}} dies. He generates 7 stacks if a nearby enemy champion or epic monster dies.
P.description2: At 7 stacks, '''Alistar''' consumes them all to {{tip|heal}} himself for {{as|5% of his '''maximum''' health}} and nearby allied champions for {{as|7% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description3: ''Triumphant Roar'' can occur only once every few seconds, though '''Alistar''' may still generate stacks before then.

Q.name: Pulverize
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' smashes the ground beneath him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} simultaneously for 1 second.
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Standard cast time}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.15}}|Reduced cast time when buffered during Headbutt's dash}}}}

W.name: Headbutt
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location. If they are within 400 units upon arrival, he deals them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} {{tt|700 units|Reduced to 200 units if Pulverize was buffered during the dash}} over {{fd|0.5 seconds}} while also {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

E.name: Trample
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' tramples the ground around him every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 5 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. Each time this damages at least one enemy champion, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Trample'' that lasts for the remaining duration, stacking up to 5 times.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70/10}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
E.description2: At 5 stacks, '''Alistar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against a {{tip|champion}} within 6 seconds ends ''Trample's'' effects to deal {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 275}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for 1 second.

R.name: Unbreakable Will
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}}. For the next 7 seconds, he reduces incoming damage taken.

P.name: Drakehound's Step
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} During the {{tip|lockout}} of '''Ambessa's''' {{tip|abilities}}, inputting an {{tt|attack or movement command|Default MB2/right click}} causes her to {{tip|dash}} to or {{tt|towards|If inputted outside of the maximum dash range, she will dash the maximum distance towards the target/location}} the target or location, respectively, after the lockout ends. This dash cannot pass through terrain.
'''''Ambessa''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Ambessa''' casts an ability, she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Medarda Maxim'' after the ability's respective lockout for 4 seconds, refreshing with subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. Basic attacks consume one stack each to become empowered.
P.description3: {{sbc|Medarda Maxim:}} '''Ambessa's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|75 '''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 30}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and restore {{sti|energy|{{as|{{pp|40 to 70|1;7;13}} energy}}}}.

Q.name: Cunning Sweep
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}}, at the end of which she slashes with her twin drakehounds in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against enemies hit by the outer edge.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending, and '''Ambessa''' will perform the dash after her slash completes.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|40/2 to 120/2}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2 to 6/2}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 6}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy, '''Ambessa''' can cast ''{{ai|Sundering Slam|Ambessa}}'' within the next 4 seconds.
Q.description3: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Cunning Sweep'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} and the damage based on their health ratio is capped at {{pplevel|100 to 300}}.

Q.name: Sundering Slam
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}}, at the end of which she slams her twin drakehounds in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against the first enemy hit.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending, and '''Ambessa''' will perform the dash after her slam completes.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|50/2 to 150/2}} {{as|(+ 45% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2 to 6/2}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 6}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Sundering Slam'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} and the damage based on their health ratio is capped at {{pplevel|100 to 300}}.

W.name: Repudiation
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' braces herself for up to {{fd|0.5}} seconds, during which in the first {{fd|0.225}} seconds she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. After '''Ambessa''' finishes bracing, she smashes the ground beneath her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the lockout ending.
W.description2: Additionally, '''Ambessa''' {{tip|shield|shields}} herself at the time of cast for {{pplevel|50 to 320}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. If the shield mitigates any amount of damage taken from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}} before '''Ambessa''' smashes the ground, ''Repudiation's'' damage is increased by 50%.
W.description3: '''''Ambessa''' will smash the ground at the end of {{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} dash if she would finish bracing during it, and otherwise always smashes the ground from wherever she is at the end of the bracing time.''

E.name: Lacerate
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}} and spins her twin drakehounds around her to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them by 99% decaying over 1 second.

''{{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}}'' dash may be buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending; in either case, she will spin a second time at the end of the dash to apply the same effects at no additional cost.
E.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Public Execution
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ambessa''' gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}} and {{tip|heals}} herself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} she deals to enemies with her active abilities. The healing effectiveness is reduced to 25% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Armor Penetration|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
{{st|Healing Percentage|{{ap|15 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 50% life steal)}}|Reduced Healing Percentage|{{ap|15*0.25 to 20*0.25}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% life steal)}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ambessa''' prepares a strike in a line in the target direction, then {{tip|blinks}} behind the farthest enemy champion within the area and seizes them. If she {{tt|successfully|See notes}} seizes the target, '''Ambessa''' {{tip|attach|attaches}} them to herself and {{tip|suppression|suppresses}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. While the target is suppressed, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and '''Ambessa''' picks them up off the ground before crashing them back down, afterwards dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.4}} seconds.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: '''''Ambessa''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the cast time and while the target is suppressed. {{ais|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} dash may be buffered during the cast time or lockout, as well as initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending.''

P.name: Cursed Touch
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Amumu's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--on-hit? on-attack? on-damage?--> and ''{{ai|Curse of the Sad Mummy|Amumu}}'' are empowered to mark enemies with ''Curse'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and ''{{ais|Despair|Amumu}}'' per-tick damage.
P.description2: ''Cursed'' targets receive {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' true damage}}}} from all incoming {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|magic damage}}.

Q.name: Bandage Toss
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' throws a bandage in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second and {{tip|dash|pulling}} him to them, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: '''Amumu''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Bandage Toss'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Q.description3: ''{{ai|Despair|Amumu}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Despair
W.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Amumu''' cries a continuous pool of tears, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|5 {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5 to 1}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description2: ''Despair'' is toggled off automatically if '''Amumu''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.

E.name: Tantrum
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Amumu''' reduces every instance of {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} taken, capped at 50% of the damage instance.
E.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Reduction|{{ap|5 to 13}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' releases his anger, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description3: ''Tantrum's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.75}} seconds whenever '''Amumu''' is hit by a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

R.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Amumu''' entangles nearby enemies in bandages, dealing {{as|magic damage}} as well as {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

P.name: Rebirth
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Anivia''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 6 seconds and restores all of her {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
P.description2: While under resurrection, '''Anivia''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains {{pp|-40 to 20 for 5|1;5;8;12;15|changedisplay=true}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
P.description3: If '''Anivia''' remains alive by the end of the duration, she is revived with her {{as|'''current''' health}}.

Q.name: Flash Frost
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' launches a chunk of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|20;20 to 40 for 3|0 to 3|type = [[File:Glacial Storm.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Glacial Storm's'' Rank|formula = 20% + (10% * (''Glacial Storm's'' rank - 1))}} for 3 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Flash Frost'' can be recast while the ice is in flight after its cast time, and does so automatically at maximum range.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Anivia''' shatters the ice, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for a duration, as well as refreshing the {{tip|slow}}.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|50+60 to 130+200}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45+25}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.1 to 1.5}} seconds}}

W.name: Crystallize
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' summons a wall of ice at the target location perpendicular to her facing, {{tip|airborne|knocking}} all units away from it, though not through terrain. The wall lingers as impassable terrain for 5 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|{{tt|Width|Pathfinding}}|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{ap|600 to 1000}} units}}
{{st|Number of ice segments|{{ap|4 to 8}} chunks of ice|Distance between outermost segments|{{ap|400 to 800}} units|Distance between individual segments|{{ap|133.33|125|120|116.67|114.29}} units}}

E.name: Frostbite
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemies hit by ''{{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' or a fully formed ''{{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}}'' become ''Iced'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{ccs|doubled|magic}} if they were ''Iced''.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 155}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|Enhanced Damage|{{ap|55*2 to 155*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Glacial Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' {{tip|slow}} strength is increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Anivia''' calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 1 second, refreshing every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while they remain inside.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|15 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{fd|6.25}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
R.description3: The blizzard increases in size over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. At maximum size, ''Glacial Storm'' is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%, which also instead lasts {{fd|1.5}} seconds and refreshes every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Empowered Damage per Tick|{{ap|15*3 to 30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6.25*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Empowered Slow|{{ap|20*1.5 to 40*1.5}}%}}
R.description4: Toggling ''Glacial Storm'' off triggers a final tick of damage and incurs its full cooldown. ''Glacial Storm'' is toggled off automatically if '''Anivia''' moves too far away from the blizzard or becomes unable to pay the {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.

P.name: Pyromania
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Pyromania:}} '''Annie''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Pyromania'' whenever she hits an enemy with ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'' or casts her other {{tip|abilities}}, stacking up to 4 times, at which she gains ''Energized''.
P.description2: {{sbc|Energized:}} '''Annie''' empowers her next cast of ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'', ''{{ai|Incinerate|Annie}}'', or ''{{ai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie}}'' to consume all ''Pyromania'' stacks to {{tip|stun}} enemies hit for {{pp|1.25;1.5;1.75|1;6;11}} seconds.
P.description3: '''Annie''' gains maximum stacks of ''Pyromania'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]]. She will lose ''Energized'' and all ''Pyromania'' stacks upon [[death]].

Q.name: Disintegrate
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
Q.description2: If this kills the target, ''Disintegrate's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 50% and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.

W.name: Incinerate
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' releases fire in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.

E.name: Molten Shield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' grants herself or the target allied {{tip|champion}} and {{ui|Tibbers}} a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 50|key=%}}|movement speed}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: While ''Molten Shield'' is active, enemies that deal damage to it take {{as|magic damage}}. This may only occur once per enemy per cast for each active ''Molten Shield''.

R.name: Summon: Tibbers
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Annie''' gains {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Tibbers}} is alive.
R.leveling2: {{st|Initial Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 400}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
R.description3: {{ui|Tibbers}} then remains on the field as a controllable {{tip|pet}} for up to 45 seconds.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Annie''' directs {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location.
R.description5: ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Tibbers}}.''

R.name: Summon: Tibbers 2
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Annie''' gains {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Tibbers}} is alive.
R.leveling2: {{st|Initial Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 400}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
R.description3: {{ui|Tibbers}} then remains on the field as a controllable {{tip|pet}} for up to 45 seconds.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Annie''' directs {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location.
R.description5: ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Tibbers}}.''

P.name: The Hitman and the Seer
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aphelios''' has access to an arsenal of 5 ''Moonstone Weapons'', created by his sister '''Alune'''. He equips two weapons at any one time, one as his {{as|main weapon}} and one as his {{as|off-hand}}. Each weapon has a unique {{tip|basic attack}} and effect.
P.description2: '''Aphelios''' begins the game with {{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} as his {{as|main weapon}} and {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} in his {{as|off-hand}}, with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}, {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} queued in reserve. His weapons are initially in this order, but they can be rearranged based on their usage.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Moonlight:}} Weapons granted to '''Aphelios''' have 50 ''Moonlight'' for [[ammunition]], which is consumed upon basic attacking {{tip|on-attack}} and upon casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}}. Any of his abilities that automatically cause him to attack during their effect will not consume additional ''Moonlight''. Once his {{as|main weapon's}} ''Moonlight'' is exhausted, it is moved to the end of the reserve queue; '''Alune''' then assembles his next available weapon from the reserve over 1 second, placing its {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary ability}} on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{sti|cooldown}} from the start of the assembly. '''Aphelios''' cannot cast ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' during the assembly.
P.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Weapon Master:}} '''Aphelios''' cannot improve his abilities via [[Experience (champion)|skill points]]. He starts the game with ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' and automatically gains access to his [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] primary abilities at level 2 and his [[File:R.png|20px|link=]] ultimate ability, ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'', at level 6. ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'' improves automatically at levels 11 and 16. '''Aphelios''' may spend his skill points to gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} or {{sti|{{as|lethality}}}} instead.

P.name: Calibrum
P.description: '''Aphelios''' gains {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} while '''Calibrum''' is his {{as|main weapon}}. Enemies damaged by '''Calibrum''' through an ability are marked for {{fd|4.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''Aphelios' ''' next basic attack against a marked target uses the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon and has {{sti|range|1800 range}}, increased missile speed, and a brief cast time that lasts shorter based on '''Aphelios' ''' proximity to the target.
P.description2: The empowered attack will consume the marks from all targets, dealing {{as|15|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the main target for each mark consumed. If '''Calibrum''' is the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, the {{as|main weapon}} is used for the attack instead.

P.name: Severum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Severum''' are {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. '''Severum's''' attacks {{tip|heal}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|key=%|2 to 7.1|formula=1.7% + 0.3% * level, capped at level 18|color=heal}}<!--stops at 18-->  of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, increased to {{pp|5 to 17.75|key=%|formula=4.25% + 0.75% * level, capped at level 18|color=heal}}<!--stops at 18--> for attacks from abilities.
P.description2: Healing from '''Severum''' in excess of '''Aphelios' ''' {{as|{{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} is converted into a {{tip|shield}} for an amount of up to {{pp|10; then +10*x|1;6 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' health)}}, lingering for up to 30 seconds.

P.name: Gravitum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Gravitum''' {{tip|slow}} enemies by 30% for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, decaying to 10% after {{fd|0.7}} seconds.

P.name: Infernum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Infernum''' shoot a fire bolt that upon arrival splits into a cone of 4 lesser bolts behind the target, dealing damage to enemies they pass through. The fire bolt deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the primary target. Secondary targets hit by any bolt are dealt {{pp|key=%|75;100|1;9|formula=75% + 25% at level 9}} of the triggering {{as|attack's damage}}, reduced to {{pp|key=%|23;30|1;9|formula=23% + 7% at level 9}} against {{tip|minions}}.
P.description2: {{tip|Critical strike|Critical strikes}} instead spray 6 missiles in a 50% wider cone. Secondary targets hit count as being {{tip|critical strike|critically struck}}.

P.name: Crescendum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Crescendum''' hurl the blade at the target, which lingers for {{fd|0.2}} seconds before homing back to '''Aphelios'''. He is unable to declare basic attacks until he retrieves '''Crescendum''', but the attack timer is reset {{tt|once caught|This does not persist when swapping weapons.}}.
P.description2: Whenever '''Aphelios''' casts an ability that would require him to throw '''Crescendum''', he instead fires a spectral ''Chakram'' at the target that similarly returns to him. '''Aphelios''' accumulates the ''Chakrams'' he catches, up to 20, which last for 5 seconds or until '''Crescendum''' is depleted of ''Moonlight''. ''Chakram'' duration is refreshed when '''Aphelios''' catches a new one or attacks a {{tip|champion}} with '''Crescendum'''.
P.description3: Attacks with '''Crescendum''' are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|0;then + 15; then + 13.5; then + 12; then + 10.5; then + 9; then + 7.5; then + 6; then + 5*x|0 to 20 by 1|type=number of Chakrams|key=%|formula=Each Chakram grants less bonus damage than the last, starting at 15% and diminishing to 5% for 10+ Chakrams.}} AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}} and have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|0.159999996423721/1.5*100|round=2}}%, further decreased to {{ap|0.100000001490116/1.5*100|round=2}}% when {{tip|critically strike|critically striking}}. The '''bonus''' damage from ''Chakrams'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

Q.name: Weapons of the Faithful
Q.description: The active effect of '''Aphelios'''' [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] varies based on his current {{as|main weapon}}.
Q.description2: The individual actives do not share a cooldown.

Q.name: Moonshot
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|{{pp|70 to 160 for 7|1 to 13 for 7}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|42 to 60 for 7|1 to 13 for 7|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.

Q.name: Onslaught
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' enters an onslaught for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} and automatically performing up to 6 {{as|(+ 2 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)|attack speed}} attacks over the duration against the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, prioritizing enemy {{tip|champions}}.
Q.description2: Attacks alternate between ''Severum'' and his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, each dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 41 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. '''Aphelios''' cannot perform attacks while affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables basic attacks.
Q.description3: '''''Aphelios''' cannot cast {{ai|Phase|Aphelios}} nor {{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}} during Onslaught, but he is still able to move.''

Q.name: Binding Eclipse
Q.description: {{sbc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}} - Active:}} '''Aphelios''' expunges all enemies with ''Gravitum's'' {{tip|slow}} debuff, dealing {{as|{{pp|50 to 140 for 7|1 to 13}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|32 to 50 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for 1 second.
Q.description2: ''An enemy affected by Gravitum, or an in-flight Gravitum projectile, is required to cast this ability. In-flight projectiles will be empowered to apply Binding Eclipse's effects to their targets.''

Q.name: Duskwave
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction over the cast time, dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 110 for 7|1 to 13}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|15 to 21 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies hit and locking onto each of them. After {{fd|0.25}} seconds, '''Aphelios''' then fires a volley of attacks at each locked-on target from his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.

Q.name: Sentry
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' deploys a lunar sentry at the target location that arms after {{fd|0.35}} seconds, lasting for up to 20 seconds, during which it is inactive and {{tip|untargetable}}. The sentry activates if an enemy is within range of it, reducing its duration to 4 seconds and becoming targetable. Sentries have {{as|6 health}} and take 3 damage per {{tip|ranged}} basic attack and 4 damage per hit by abilities. {{tip|Turret}} attacks destroy sentries instantly.
Q.description2: The sentry grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and autonomously attacks the nearest visible enemy in range with a replica of '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|{{pp|35 to 125 for 7|1 to 13}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|34 to 52 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} per hit. The sentry can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Aphelios|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and benefits from both '''Aphelios'''' {{sti|attack speed|{{as|attack speed}}}} and {{sti|critical chance|{{as|critical strike chance}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
Q.description3: ''See [[Aphelios#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the sentry.''

W.name: Phase
W.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Aphelios''' switches between his {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon over {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

E.name: Weapon Queue System
E.description: The icon of this ability reflects the next weapon that is in reserve.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' receives a text prompt of the weapon '''Alune''' will create next.

R.name: Moonlight Vigil
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' casts forth a lunar spotlight in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path and stops upon illuminating an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}. '''Alune''' smites the area centered on the illuminated target, dealing {{as|{{pp|125 to 225 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemy champions struck and locking-on to each target hit, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds.
R.description2:
After {{fd|0.3}} seconds of the illumination, attacks based on '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|main weapon}} will launch from the sky against each locked-on target, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. These attacks can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{critical damage|100 to 130|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} damage. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.
{{lc|{{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}}}} Applies an empowered mark that deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 110 for 3|6 to 16}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} per ''mark'' consumed.
{{lc|{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}}} {{tip|Heals}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|250 to 450 for 3|6 to 16|color=heal}} if at least one enemy champion is hit.
{{lc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}}} Increases the initial {{tip|slow}} to 99% and empowers ''{{ai|Binding Eclipse|Aphelios}}'' to {{tip|root}} targets affected by the enhanced slow for {{fd|1.35}} seconds.
{{lc|{{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}}} The initial blast deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 150 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.{{ft|The attack instead deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} against locked-on targets, and causes an explosion of bolts in a 400-radius circle that deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|110*0.75*0.9 to 110*0.9 for 2|1 to 9}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to targets hit.|Performs ''Infernum's'' attacks and ''Infernum's'' bolts in a 400-radius circle: primary targets are dealt ''Infernum's'' primary damage; secondary targets are dealt 90% of ''Infernum's'' regular bolt damage; both are modified by ''Moonlight Vigil's'' {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} modifier.}}Enemy champions will take damage from overlapping areas.
{{lc|{{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}}} Generates 5 additional spectral ''Chakrams'' that return to '''Aphelios''' from the first enemy champion hit, for a total of 6, on top of those from other targets hit.

P.name: Frost Shot
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{critical damage|0 to 100|0 to 100|critScaling=true}} of the {{as|attack's damage}}. {{tip|critical strike|Critical strikes}} do not deal any additional damage.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Shot:}} '''Ashe's''' basic attacks and ability hits apply ''Frost'' to enemies for 2 seconds, which {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 30}} for the duration.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Critical Slow:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} double ''Frost's'' slow strength to {{pplevel|key=%|20*2 to 30*2}}, decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.

P.name: Frost Shot 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{critical damage|0 to 100|0 to 100|critScaling=true}} of the {{as|attack's damage}}. {{tip|critical strike|Critical strikes}} do not deal any additional damage.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Shot:}} '''Ashe's''' basic attacks and ability hits apply ''Frost'' to enemies for 2 seconds, which {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 30}} for the duration.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Critical Slow:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} double ''Frost's'' slow strength to {{pplevel|key=%|20*2 to 30*2}}, decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.

Q.name: Ranger's Focus
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Ranger's Focus'' is inactive, '''Ashe's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Focus'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}. The flurries {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}'' per arrow, but apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
{{st|Physical Damage Per Arrow|{{as|{{ap|110/5 to 130/5}}% AD}}|Total Damage Per Flurry|{{as|{{ap|110 to 130}}% AD}}}}
Q.description4: ''Ranger's Focus {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''

Q.name: Ranger's Focus 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Ranger's Focus'' is inactive, '''Ashe's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Focus'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}. The flurries {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}'' per arrow, but apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
{{st|Physical Damage Per Arrow|{{as|{{ap|110/5 to 130/5}}% AD}}|Total Damage Per Flurry|{{as|{{ap|110 to 130}}% AD}}}}
Q.description4: ''Ranger's Focus {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Volley
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' shoots a volley of arrows in a cone in the target direction, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, and applying ''{{ai|Frost Shot 2|Ashe|Critical Slow}}'' to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit.
W.description2: Enemies can intercept multiple arrows but do not take damage from any beyond the first.

E.name: Hawkshot
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' sends a hawk spirit to a location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path{{ft|repeatedly for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after every 100 units traveled|for effectively up-to {{fd|1.8}} seconds at any location}}and at its destination for 5 seconds.
E.description2: '''Ashe''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Hawkshot'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

R.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' fires a massive arrow of ice in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} it flies through. The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|1 to 1 for 5;1 to 3.5 for 10|0 to 2800|formula=1s for the first 800 units traveled; 1+(0.25 per 200 units)s beyond 800 units. ''This is capped at 2800 units traveled.''}} seconds, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them for 1 second.
R.description2: Enemies surrounding the primary target are dealt the same damage and afflicted with ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}''.

P.name: Cosmic Creator
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurelion Sol's''' damaging [[champion ability|abilities]] against enemies generate him permanent stacks of {{as|Stardust}}, which gradually augments his abilities.
* ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'': Bursts deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
* ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}'': Range is increased by {{as|{{fd|7.5}} units per Stardust}}.
* ''{{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}}'': Outer and inner radius increased equal to {{as|15% Stardust}}, and the execution threshold is increased.
* ''{{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'': Impact radius increased equal to {{as|15% Stardust}}.

Q.name: Breath of Light
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|3.25}} seconds to exhale a beam of starfire, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. The beam collides with the first enemy hit to burn them, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and surrounding enemies every {{fd|0.125}} seconds. Secondary targets are dealt 50% damage.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|45/8 to 105/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55/8}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|{{tt|Total Maximum Magic Damage|Ranks 1-4}}|{{ap|(45/8)*26 to ((45+(105-45)*(3/4))/8)*26 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*26}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Secondary Target Damage per Tick|{{ap|(45/8)*0.5 to (105/8)*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*0.5}}% AP)}}|Secondary Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|45*0.5 to 105*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*0.5}}% AP)}}|{{tt|Secondary Target Total Maximum Damage|Ranks 1-4}}|{{ap|(45/8)*26*0.5 to ((45+(105-45)*(3/4))/8)*26*0.5 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*26*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Against the primary target, the beam will deal a burst of {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} for each full second that it burns them, and additionally generates {{as|2 Stardust}} if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 100}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{ai|Cosmic Creator|Aurelion Sol|{{as|(+|hp}} {{as|({{fd|3.1}}% Stardust)}}{{as|%|hp}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|hp}}}}
Q.description3: ''Breath of Light'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' ends ''Breath of Light'' early.
Q.description5: At rank 5, ''Breath of Light's'' channel duration is increased to 160 seconds.
Q.description6: ''If the channel is cancelled within the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds, Breath of Light is placed on a 1-second {{tip|lockout}} but does not go on cooldown.''
Q.costtype: Mana {{tt|(+ {{ap|30*0.25 to 50*0.25}} Mana per {{fd|0.25}} seconds)|Cost for mana per 0.25 seconds starts being paid after 1.25 seconds into the channel.}}

W.name: Astral Flight
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and resets ''{{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}. During flight, he has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} and ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' has no cooldown and maximum channel duration and its non-burst flat damage is increased, but ''Astral Flight's'' dash speed is reduced by 50% during its channel.
W.leveling: {{st|{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} Flat Damage Modifier|{{ap|108 to 112}}%}}
W.description2: '''''Aurelion Sol''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} crowd control during the dash.''
W.description3: ''Astral Flight'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the dash, and does so automatically upon arrival.
W.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' ends ''Astral Flight''.
W.description5: Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them reduces ''Astral Flight's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 90% of its '''total''' cooldown.
W.description6: '''''Aurelion Sol''' will not dash after the cast time if he was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during it. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash. {{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} channel will be interrupted if Astral Flight ends or {{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}} or {{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}} is cast during the flight, but the ability will automatically be cast afterwards.''
W.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Initial cast  (0.375, rounded to the next game tick)}}|{{tt|None|Recast}}}}

E.name: Singularity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' conjures a black hole at the target location after a {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}-second delay|From start of cast time}} that lasts for 5 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2.5 to 7.5}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|2.5*20 to 7.5*20}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*20}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} inward until they reach the center, and {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} also have their {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' to a {{as|static 0|ms}}. Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} below {{as|5%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.6}}% per 100 Stardust)}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}}, excluding epic monsters.
E.description3:
After ''Singularity'' ends, it generates {{as|1 Stardust}} for each full second that enemy champions were inside it, as well as varying amounts for enemy units that were killed while being within the area:
* Champions and epic monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Large minions and monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Small minions and monsters grant {{as|1 Stardust}}.

R.name: Falling Star
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a star that strikes the target location after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. This generates {{as|5 Stardust}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
R.description2: Once ''Falling Star'' has been learned, gathering {{as|75 Stardust}} causes the next cast of ''Falling Star'' to transform into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'', empowering the impact with new effects.

R.name: The Skies Descend
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a giant star that strikes the target location after 2 seconds, dealing {{ccs|25% increased damage|magic}} in a larger area and {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies hit for 1 second.
R.description2: Additionally, the impact sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands from the area over 3 seconds, dealing {{ccs|{{as|magic damage}}|magic}} to enemy champions and epic {{tip|monsters}} hit, {{tip|slow|slowing}} all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second, and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description3: ''Enemies hit by the star are immune to the shockwave.''

P.name: Spirit Abjuration
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurora's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Spirit Abjuration'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|90+10*x}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description2: Upon consuming the stacks from a {{tip|champion}}, '''Aurora''' additionally exorcises them, freeing a {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} from the target that follows her for the same duration. For each active {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, '''Aurora''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} for {{pplevel|2 + x|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 2% AP)}} every second. Subsequent exorcisms free further {{as|Spirits|buzzword}} and refresh all active {{as|Spirits|buzzword}}. '''Aurora''' may have up to 4 {{as|Spirits|buzzword}} at a time, for a maximum heal per tick of {{pplevel|(2 + x)*4|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*4}}% AP)}}.

Q.name: Twofold Hex
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and marks them with a curse for {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: ''Twofold Hex'' can be recast after {{fd|0.1}} seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurora''' expunges the curse from all marked targets, drawing the spiritual energy back to her as bolts that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through, reduced to 40% against {{tip|minions}} and 50% against {{tip|monsters}} and increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100*(1.5-1) for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula={{#expr:1.5-1}}% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal {{ap|0.2*100}}% damage.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45 to 145}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Bolt Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*0.2 to 145*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.2}}% AP)}}|Subsequent Bolt Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5*0.2 to 145*1.5*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5*0.2}}% AP)}}}}

Q.name: Twofold Hex 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and marks them with a curse for {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: ''Twofold Hex'' can be recast after {{fd|0.1}} seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurora''' expunges the curse from all marked targets, drawing the spiritual energy back to her as bolts that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through, reduced to 40% against {{tip|minions}} and 50% against {{tip|monsters}} and increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100*(1.5-1) for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula={{#expr:1.5-1}}% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal {{ap|0.2*100}}% damage.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45 to 145}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Bolt Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*0.2 to 145*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.2}}% AP)}}|Subsequent Bolt Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5*0.2 to 145*1.5*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5*0.2}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Across the Veil
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|hops}} in the target direction inside a portal to the Spirit Realm. Upon {{tt|completing|See notes}} the dash, she becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a duration and gains ''Realm Hopper'' for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Realm Hopper:}} '''Aurora''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration.
W.description3: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reset ''Across the Veil's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

E.name: The Weirding
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' blasts energy in a line in the target direction and {{tip|dash|recoils}} 250 units in the opposite direction. The blast deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for 1 second decaying after the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds.

R.name: Between Worlds
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} in the target direction with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She then gains ''{{ai|Across the Veil|Aurora|Realm Hopper}}'' for a duration and unleashes a shockwave from {{tt|425 units|Estimated}} in front of her, expanding over {{fd|0.75}} seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them by 30% for 2 seconds.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|175 to 375}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|''{{ai|Across the Veil|Aurora|Realm Hopper}}'' Duration|{{ap|3.5 to 5}} seconds}}
R.description2: The shockwave leaves behind a circular rift to the Spirit Realm for a duration, forming borders that interact with '''Aurora''' and enemies. If '''Aurora''' {{tt|collides|See notes}} with the border, she {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the diametrically opposite side of the rift over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the travel. If an enemy {{tt|collides|See notes}} with the border, they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for a duration.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Rift Duration|{{ap|2.5-0.75 to 4-0.75}} seconds<!-- Duration w/o the creation time. See notes -->}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1.5 to 2}} seconds}}
R.description3: ''Between Worlds'' can be recast after 1 second of unleashing the shockwave while the rift is active.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurora''' closes the rift prematurely.
R.description5: ''The rift closes immediately if '''Aurora''' {{tip|death|dies}}, enters {{tip|resurrection}}, leaves the area, or is not within the area upon creation.''

P.name: Shurima's Legacy
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a {{tip|turret}} outside the enemy team's base is destroyed, a marker is placed above its ruins which can be targeted by '''Azir'''.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Disc of the Sun:}} '''Azir''' can select a marker to construct the {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} above the ruins after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]]. The {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} will activate after being assembled over 5 seconds.

'''''Azir''' cannot construct a {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} with the marker while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
P.description3: The {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} functions the same as a standard [[Turret#Inner_turret|inner turret]] but deals {{as|magic damage}}, gains {{as|40% AP}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, and grants its kill credit to '''Azir'''. The {{as|Sun Disc's|buzzword2}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}} decays over 45 seconds and loses {{sti|armor|{{as|100 armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|100 magic resistance}}}} while '''Azir''' is not alive or is too far away.
P.description4: ''See [[Azir#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}}.''

Q.name: Conquering Sands
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' orders all {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}} to dash toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through as well as those in front of them upon arrival, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 25% for 1 second.
Q.description2: Enemies hit by subsequent soldiers take no additional damage or {{tip|slow}}.
Q.description3: ''A summoned {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} is required to cast this ability.''

W.name: Arise!
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' summons a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}}, lasts 10 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. The {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} expires twice as fast while within range of an enemy {{tip|turret}}, and does so instantly if '''Azir''' is too far away.

'''Azir''' periodically [[stock]]s a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}}, up to a maximum of 2.
W.description2: When '''Azir''' declares a basic attack against an enemy in a soldier's {{sti|attack range}}, the {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks in his stead, thrusting their spear in the target's direction to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck in a line. Against the primary target, the {{as|Sand Soldier's|buzzword2}} attack applies both {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, the damage of which is reduced to 50% effectiveness. Targets hit beyond the closest take {{pp|20; then +8*x for 10|1;9 to 18|formula=20% at level 1, then +8% per level starting at level 9 and capped at level 18|key=%}}<!--stops at 18--> damage.
