Subsequent {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks against the same target deal 25% damage without applying {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{pplevel|0; then +8*x|1;10+(x-1)|formula=0 at level 1, then +8 per level starting at level 10}} (+ {{ap|50 to 110}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 65}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}} cannot attack {{tip|turret|structures}}, {{tip|ward|wards}}, nor {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}.
W.description4: ''See [[Azir#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}}.''

E.name: Shifting Sands
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|dashes}} to the {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within his path.
E.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
E.description2: If '''Azir''' dashes into an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he stops and gains a charge of ''{{ai|Arise!|Azir}}''.
E.description3: ''A summoned {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} is required to cast this ability. '''Azir''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

R.name: Emperor's Divide
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' calls forth a phalanx of soldiers from {{tt|175|See notes}} units behind him, catching enemies from up to {{tt|325|See notes}} units behind him and charging forward {{tt|575|See notes}} units in the target direction.
R.leveling: {{st|Width|{{ap|6 to 8}} soldiers|Width (charge)|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{ap|620 to 820}}|Width (impassable wall)|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{ap|750 to 950}}}}
R.description2: Enemies impacted by the charge are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked away}} over 1 second to a line 650 units in front of '''Azir'''.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 600}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
R.description3: Upon finishing their charge, the soldiers stand as a wall for 5 seconds, acting as impassible terrain against enemies and granting {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings. '''Azir''' and his allies can move through these soldiers.

P.name: Traveler's Call
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Ancient Chimes:}} '''Bard's''' presence causes sacred [[File:Traveler's Call Minimap.png|16px|link=]] {{as|Chimes|buzzword2}} to periodically appear at random locations on the battlefield, lingering for up to 10 minutes. Collecting a {{as|Chime|buzzword2}} restores {{sti|mana|{{as|12% '''maximum''' mana}}}} and grants '''Bard''' {{sti|Experience|{{as|20 + (''1 per minute after 5 minutes'') experience}}}}, as well as {{sti|ms|{{as|24% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} [[combat status|out of combat]] for 20 seconds, which stacks up to 10 times. Each {{as|Chime|buzzword2}} collected beyond the first instead grants an additional {{as|14% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, up to a total of {{as|150% '''bonus''' movement speed}}. '''Bard''' empowers his {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} each time he collects {{as|5 Chimes|buzzword2}}.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Meeps:}} '''Bard's''' presence attracts {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} every few seconds, which are small spirits that come to his side. While he has {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}}, his basic attacks are empowered to each consume a {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|30|magic damage}} (''+ {{as|6|magic damage}} per 5 {{as|Chimes|buzzword2}} collected'') {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
* At {{as|5 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} {{tip|slow}} damaged enemies by {{pp|type = number of Chimes|key=%|25 to 75 for 6|5;25;45;60;75;85}} for 1 second.
* At {{as|15 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} deal the damage to enemies within 150 units of the primary target as well as those in a cone behind them.
* At {{as|35 Chimes|buzzword2}}, the cone's radius increases.
P.description3: '''Bard''' can have up to {{pp|type = number of Chimes|1 to 9 for 9|0;10;30;50;65;80;90;95;100}} {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} at a time.
P.static: {{dv|{{tt|50|Chime spawn rate}}|{{tt|{{pp|changedisplay=true|type = number of Chimes|8 to 4 for 5|0;20;40;55;70}}|Meep spawn rate}}}}

P.name: Traveler's Call 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Ancient Chimes:}} '''Bard's''' presence causes sacred [[File:Traveler's Call Minimap.png|16px|link=]] {{as|Chimes|buzzword2}} to periodically appear at random locations on the battlefield, lingering for up to 10 minutes. Collecting a {{as|Chime|buzzword2}} restores {{sti|mana|{{as|12% '''maximum''' mana}}}} and grants '''Bard''' {{sti|Experience|{{as|20 + (''1 per minute after 5 minutes'') experience}}}}, as well as {{sti|ms|{{as|24% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} [[combat status|out of combat]] for 20 seconds, which stacks up to 10 times. Each {{as|Chime|buzzword2}} collected beyond the first instead grants an additional {{as|14% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, up to a total of {{as|150% '''bonus''' movement speed}}. '''Bard''' empowers his {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} each time he collects {{as|5 Chimes|buzzword2}}.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Meeps:}} '''Bard's''' presence attracts {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} every few seconds, which are small spirits that come to his side. While he has {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}}, his basic attacks are empowered to each consume a {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|30|magic damage}} (''+ {{as|6|magic damage}} per 5 {{as|Chimes|buzzword2}} collected'') {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
* At {{as|5 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} {{tip|slow}} damaged enemies by {{pp|type = number of Chimes|key=%|25 to 75 for 6|5;25;45;60;75;85}} for 1 second.
* At {{as|15 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} deal the damage to enemies within 150 units of the primary target as well as those in a cone behind them.
* At {{as|35 Chimes|buzzword2}}, the cone's radius increases.
P.description3: '''Bard''' can have up to {{pp|type = number of Chimes|1 to 9 for 9|0;10;30;50;65;80;90;95;100}} {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} at a time.
P.static: {{dv|{{tt|50|Chime spawn rate}}|{{tt|{{pp|changedisplay=true|type = number of Chimes|8 to 4 for 5|0;20;40;55;70}}|Meep spawn rate}}}}

Q.name: Cosmic Binding
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' fires an energy bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 60% for a duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.8}} seconds}}
Q.description2: After ''Cosmic Binding'' hits an enemy, the bolt continues behind them for {{tt|300 units|Estimated}}. If the bolt hits terrain or a second enemy, it {{tip|stun|stuns}} both targets for the same duration, dealing the same damage to the secondary target.

W.name: Caretaker's Shrine
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' conjures a shrine at the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings for 1 second and gathers power over 5 seconds. Up to 3 shrines may be active at a time. Shrines may last indefinitely until being consumed by a champion moving over them.
W.description2: If the champion is an ally or '''Bard''' himself, they are {{tip|heal|healed}} for an amount based on the shrine's power and gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} can [[stack]] with subsequent shrines triggered. If the champion is an enemy, the shrine is destroyed.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|25 to 125}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|50 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description3: '''Bard''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Caretaker's Shrine'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

E.name: Magical Journey
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' opens a one-way magical corridor through a piece of [[terrain]] in the target direction for 10 seconds.
E.description2: A champion can {{tip|dash|pass}} through the corridor by selecting it while within proximity of it, becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} during the travel. '''Bard''' and allies travel through the portal at 33% increased speed.
E.description3: ''A valid piece of terrain within the target range is required to cast this ability. Magical Journey cannot be taken while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''

R.name: Tempered Fate
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' sends magical energy arcing to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area during travel. Upon impact, it puts all units within into {{tip|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, as well as {{tip|stun|stunning}} all enemy {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|turret|turrets}} struck for the same duration. Enemies hit are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for the duration.
R.description2: ''Epic {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|turrets}} are affected by Tempered Fate despite being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}.''

P.name: Death in Lavender
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth''' is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}}. Her {{as|attack speed}} does not increase through [[Champion statistic#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' {{tip|ability}} casts grant her {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts.
P.description3:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or large {{tip|minion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she generates a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Lavender''. Large minions and monsters generate 1 stack, champions and epic monsters generate 2 stacks.

{{sbc|Lavender:}} For each stack, '''Bel'Veth''' gains {{as|{{pplevel|0.1; then +0.05*x for 4; then +0.1*x for 5; then +0.15*x|1 to 18|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}.

Q.name: Void Surge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} in the designated direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Against the first target, ''Void Surge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Bel'Veth|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
Q.description2: ''Void Surge'' deals {{as|70 '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description3: ''Void Surge'' can be cast only within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown, and incurs a cooldown between casts. {{tt|Each cardinal direction|Total of 4 directions}} has a unique {{sti|cooldown}} that is reduced equivalent to {{fd|0.2}} {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}} per {{tt|{{as|1% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Benefits from all sources of bonus attack speed except the temporary bonus from Death in Lavender}}. These cooldowns reset upon [[death|respawning]].
Q.description4: ''Void Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Above and Below
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' slams her tail down in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for a duration, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% for 2 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 320}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
{{st|Knock Up Duration|{{ap|0.6 to 1}} seconds}}
W.description2: If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, it resets ''{{ais|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' dash {{sti|cooldown}} of the target direction.

E.name: Royal Maelstrom
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' enters a frenzy for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which she is unable to move, but gains damage reduction and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
E.description2: While active, she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest {{as|'''current''' health}} percentage for up to 6 (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Benefits from all sources of bonus attack speed}}) times over the duration. Each slash deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, and applies {{tip|on-hit}}, {{tip|on-attack}}, and {{tip|spell effects|spell}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|12 to 24 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.12% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}} effectiveness. '''Bel'Veth''' cannot perform slashes while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per hit|{{ap|10 to 18}} {{as|(+ 12% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2 to 18*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2}}% AD)}}}}
E.description3: ''Royal Maelstrom'' deals 200% damage to {{tip|monsters}}, {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2 to 18*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2*2 to 18*2*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2*2}}% AD)}}}}
E.description4: ''Royal Maelstrom'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or when '''Bel'Veth''' casts an ability.
E.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Bel'Veth''' ends ''Royal Maelstrom''.
E.description6: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''

R.name: Endless Banquet
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every attack {{tip|on-hit}} against the marked target deals {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} and generates a stack of ''Endless Banquet'' that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 8 stacks against epic {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Bonus True Damage|{{ap|2 to 6}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Monster Damage|{{ap|2*8 to 6*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} When '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} while alive, a ''Void Coral'' is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, the pit {{ui|Rift Herald}}, and {{ui|Voidgrub|Voidgrubs}} (once per spawn group) spawn an ''Enhanced Void Coral''.
R.description3:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target ''Void Coral'' to consume it over the cast time, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by {{pp|type=seconds elapsed|key=%|25;42;69;96|0 to 0.75|changedisplay=true}} for the duration. She then creates an explosion at the location to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies within, capped at {{as|1500|true damage}} versus monsters, and assumes her {{sbc|True Form}} for {{pp|45;90;infinite|0;40;80|type=[[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|link=]] ''Lavender'' stacks}} seconds.
'''Bel'Veth''' consumes all existing ''Void Corals'' at once, generating a stack of ''{{ai|Death in Lavender|Bel'Veth|Lavender}}'' for each one consumed.
R.leveling3: {{st|True Damage|{{ap|150 to 250}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}} {{as|(+ 20% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
R.description4:
{{sbc|True Form:}} '''Bel'Veth''' evolves into a monster, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}}, increased size, as well as increased {{as|'''total''' attack speed}}. ''{{ai|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' can {{tip|dash}} through [[terrain]]. Consuming a ''Void Coral'' {{tt|refreshes|See notes}} the duration of {{sbc|True Form}} and {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Bel'Veth'''.

{{sbc|Enhanced Void Coral Bonus:}} {{sbc|True Form}} is empowered to causes ''Void Remora'' to spawn from allied and enemy {{tip|minions}} that die nearby.
R.description5: ''A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability. The passive {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} is affected by the {{tip|on-hit}} modifier of {{ai|Royal Maelstrom|Bel'Veth}}. See [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Pets]] for details about Void Remora and Void Corals.''

P.name: Mana Barrier
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when damaged to {{as|{{sti|health|30% '''maximum''' health}}}}, '''Blitzcrank''' generates a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{sti|mana|{{as|35% of '''maximum''' mana}}}}, lasting for up to 10 seconds.
P.static: {{tt|90|Starts immediately when the shield is gained}}

P.name: Mana Barrier 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when damaged to {{as|{{sti|health|30% '''maximum''' health}}}}, '''Blitzcrank''' generates a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{sti|mana|{{as|35% of '''maximum''' mana}}}}, lasting for up to 10 seconds.
P.static: {{tt|90|Starts immediately when the shield is gained}}

Q.name: Rocket Grab
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' fires their right hand in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing them {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.65 seconds}}, and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them towards '''Blitzcrank''', during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: '''''Blitzcrank''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Rocket Grab is in flight and for {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Estimated}} seconds after it hits an enemy.''

W.name: Overdrive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' shifts into overdrive, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays to 10% over the first {{fd|2.9}} seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 70}}%}}{{st|Initial Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|60 to 80}}%}}
W.description2: When ''Overdrive'' ends, '''Blitzcrank''' is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

E.name: Power Fist
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' empowers their next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|100% AD}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} the target for 1 second. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.description3: ''Power Fist {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Blitzcrank's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Static Field
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Static Field'' is not on cooldown, '''Blitzcrank's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} apply a {{tip|stack}} to the target {{tip|on-hit}}. While the target is afflicted, one stack is consumed every 1 second to strike them with lightning, dealing {{as|magic damage}} each time.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' detonates a static field that destroys the damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} of all nearby enemies, excluding the shields of {{tip|monsters}}, and then deals them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silences}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|275 to 525}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}

P.name: Blaze
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Brand's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ablaze'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing the duration of all stacks with each application. Subsequent abilities used against a target with ''Ablaze'' are empowered. Killing an enemy afflicted with ''Ablaze'' or any enemy with an ability restores {{as|{{pp|20 to 40 for 5|1;6 to 15|changedisplay=true|formula=20 at level 1, then +5 every 3 levels starting at level 6 and capped at level 15}} {{sti|mana}}}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Ablaze:}} While afflicted with ''Ablaze'', the target is dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|2% of their '''maximum''' health}} over 4 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|2/12|round=3}}% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds.}}Each stack of ''Ablaze'' deals damage to the target individually and applies their damage ticks dependent on the time they were applied, even if the duration of all the stacks are refreshed. ''Ablaze'' deals 270% damage per tick to {{tip|monsters}}; this damage is capped at{{ft|{{pp|50/4 to (50/4)*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} per tick against non-epic monsters and {{pp|80/4 to (80/4)*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} per tick against epic monsters.|a total of {{pp|50*4 to 50*4*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} against non-epic monsters and {{pp|80*4 to 80*4*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} against epic monsters.}}
P.description3: Upon applying 3 stacks of ''Ablaze'' to a large {{tip|monster}} or enemy {{tip|champion}}, the fire becomes unstable, causing it to form a fiery ring around the target that grants {{tip|sight}} within its radius and, after 2 seconds, consumes their stacks to explode. All enemies within the detonation are applied a stack of ''Ablaze'' and dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|6 to 12|key=%}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|270 to 525|1;6;11;16}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description4: '''Brand''' cannot stack ''Ablaze'' more than once on enemies that have had a ring explode from them in the last 4 seconds.
P.description5: ''The ring will form even if the target dies to the ability applying the third stack, and will still trigger the explosion if the target dies before it.''

Q.name: Sear
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' launches a fireball in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.

W.name: Pillar of Flame
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{rutngt|0.625}} delay, '''Brand''' erupts a pillar of flame at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target takes 25% increased damage.

E.name: Conflagration
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' sets the target enemy aflame, which creates a blast that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and causes the flame to spread from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage.
E.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} ''Conflagration's'' spread range is doubled.

R.name: Pyroclasm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' launches a fireball at the target enemy that bounces between nearby enemies and '''Brand''' up to four times, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies each time and having a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay between bounces.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 250}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Single-Target Damage|{{ap|100*3 to 250*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: ''Pyroclasm'' prioritizes ''{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}}'' enemy champions, then other enemy champions, then any valid bounce target, then '''Brand'''.
R.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This can affect the same enemy more than once.
R.description4: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} for the fireball to bounce to them.''

P.name: Concussive Blows
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Braum's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Winter's Bite|Braum}}'' each apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Concussive Blows'' to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times. Once the first stack has been applied, any allied {{tip|champion|champion's}} basic attack applies an additional stack to the target {{tip|on-hit}}.
P.description2: The fourth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|{{pplevel|26 to 196|type=his level|label1=level}}|magic damage}} {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} them for {{pp|changedisplay=true|1.25 to 1.75 for 3|1 to 13|type=his level|label1=level}} seconds.
P.description3: This effect cannot apply to the same target more than once every few seconds. During this immunity period, affected targets take{{ft|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to 40% of the trigger damage|{{as|{{pplevel|26*0.4 to 196*0.4}} '''bonus''' magic damage}}}}from '''Braum's''' basic attacks.

Q.name: Winter's Bite
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' propels ice from his shield in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 70% decaying over 2 seconds.

W.name: Stand Behind Me
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' {{tip|dashes}} to put himself {{tt|between|150 units from his ally towards the closest enemy}} the target ally and the closest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tt|within 1500 units|from the ally's location}}, and upon arrival grants himself and the ally {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for 3 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Ally Bonus Armor|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Ally Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
W.description2: ''Stand Behind Me'' can be [[Self-targeted|self cast]] to instantly grant '''Braum''' the '''bonus''' resistances.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Self Bonus Armor|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 36% '''bonus''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Self Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 36% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
W.description3: ''{{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Unbreakable
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' sets his shield in the target direction for a duration, creating a barrier in front of him that intercepts all incoming hostile {{tip|projectiles}} and reduces the damage '''Braum''' takes through it from enemies in the target direction. The first instance of damage dealt by a {{tip|champion}} from this direction is reduced by 100%. ''Unbreakable'' does not affect {{tip|turret|turrets}}.
E.description2: While his shield is raised, '''Braum''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting}}.

R.name: Glacial Fissure
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' leaps into the air and slams his shield into the ground, creating a fissure from the impact that travels forth in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within its path as well as those around '''Braum'''.
R.description2: The first target hit is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for at least {{fd|0.6}} seconds, increased if they are further away from '''Braum'''. All other enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
R.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Knock up Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
R.description3: A field of ice is created along the fissure's path, lasting for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. The field disappears after the duration ends in the same order and speed it was created with.

P.name: Crimson Curse
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Briar's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} inflict a bleed against enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 5 times and dealing {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage for stacks beyond the first. The bleed deals{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 50}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|(10 to 50)*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration, increased by {{as|{{pplevel|10*0.25 to 50*0.25}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|(10*0.25 to 50*0.25)*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*{{#var:i_maxd}} to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{pplevel|(10*{{#var:i_maxd}} to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}})*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration.|{{as|{{pplevel|10/(5/0.5) to 50/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|(10/(5/0.5) to 50/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(50/(5/0.5)*0.25)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased by {{as|{{pplevel|10*0.25/(5/0.5) to 50*0.25/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|(10*0.25/(5/0.5) to 50*0.25/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(50*0.25/(5/0.5))*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5) to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{pplevel|(10*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5) to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}}  {{as|(+ {{ap|(50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5))*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} per tick.}}If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% <!--pre or post mitigation?--> of the remaining bleed damage.
P.description2: '''Briar''' has no {{sti|health regeneration|{{as|'''base''' health regeneration}}}}, but she increases healing from all sources by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 40 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.4% per 1% missing health}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 2.5 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.025% per 1% missing health}}|health}} per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}.

Q.name: Head Rush
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.85}} seconds, and reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 5 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Head Rush {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.''
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Resistances Reduction|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}

W.name: Blood Frenzy
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. If there is a nearby enemy upon her arrival, she gains ''Blood Frenzy'' for 5 seconds, during which she can cast ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}''.
W.description2: {{sbc|Blood Frenzy:}} '''Briar''' breaks free from her pillory, causing her to become {{tt|forced|See notes}} to basic attack the nearest enemy. She {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} the target and gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, as well as empowering her basic attacks to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies surrounding her target. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
W.description3: '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking {{tip|champions}}, then large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|minions}}, and then any other unit. If she casts ''{{ai|Head Rush|Briar}}'' on a non-champion, she will shift her target priority to large monsters or minions, then champions, and then any other unit.
W.description4: ''Blood Frenzy causes '''Briar''' to become unable to receive movement and attack commands. The frenzy ends early if there are no longer any nearby valid targets or {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} is cast. Blood Frenzy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Head Rush|Briar}} and {{ai|Certain Death|Briar}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Snack Attack
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' empowers her next basic attack within 5 seconds during ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' to take a bite out of the target enemy, gaining {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} her for {{as|5% of her '''maximum''' health}} plus a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 5% AD)}} {{as|(+ 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
{{st|Heal Percentage|{{ap|24 to 40}}%}}
W.description2: ''Snack Attack'' deals 110% damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, with the damage based on the target's health ratio being capped at 400.
W.leveling2: {{st|Non-Champion Bonus Damage|{{ap|5*1.1 to 65*1.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.1}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|9*1.1}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
W.description3: ''Snack Attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Chilling Scream
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' prepares to unleash a scream in the target direction, {{tip|channel|charging}} for up to 1 second, during which she increases ''Chilling Scream's'' damage and range, and gains 35% damage reduction and {{tip|heal|heals}} herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
E.leveling: {{st|Heal Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|10/4 to 16/4}}% '''maximum''' health}}|Maximum Heal|{{as|{{ap|10 to 16}}% '''maximum''' health}}}}
E.description2: ''Chilling Scream'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Chilling Scream's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Briar''' unleashes the scream in the direction she targeted at the time of cast, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
E.description4: If ''Chilling Scream'' was charged for its full duration, enemies hit are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} 575 units. If they collide with terrain, they will rebound to take {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and become {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

R.name: Certain Death
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' kicks her pillory's hemolith in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Can grant sight of area into brush and through terrain}} as it {{tt|travels|creates vision bubbles every 0.25 seconds}} and marking the first enemy champion hit as her prey. The mark's application {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} the target's ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}. While the target is marked, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
R.description2: If a target is hit, '''Briar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} herself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and becomes {{tip|cc-immune|immune to them}} over a cast time, afterwards {{tip|dash|dashing}} to them with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|flee|fears}} all non-marked targets for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%. She then enters a state of ''Hematomania''.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Hematomania:}} '''Briar''' gains all effects of ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}, {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''additional bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Life Steal|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}
{{st|Additional Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
R.description4: While in the empowered frenzy, '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking the marked target over all other units and regardless of range. If that target becomes invalid, she will shift back to her {{tt|normal targeting priority|nearest non-marked champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit}} until the marked target can be attacked again. ''Hematomania'' lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including '''Briar's''' or the target's death.
R.description5: ''Casting {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} removes the target's mark and ends Hematomania early. {{ais|Head Rush|Briar}} cast does not shift her targeting priority during Hematomania.''
R.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|1|Time before kicking hemolith}}|{{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Time before dashing to target}}}}

R.name: Certain Death 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' kicks her pillory's hemolith in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Can grant sight of area into brush and through terrain}} as it {{tt|travels|creates vision bubbles every 0.25 seconds}} and marking the first enemy champion hit as her prey. The mark's application {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} the target's ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}. While the target is marked, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
R.description2: If a target is hit, '''Briar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} herself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and becomes {{tip|cc-immune|immune to them}} over a cast time, afterwards {{tip|dash|dashing}} to them with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|flee|fears}} all non-marked targets for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%. She then enters a state of ''Hematomania''.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Hematomania:}} '''Briar''' gains all effects of ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}, {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''additional bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Life Steal|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}
{{st|Additional Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
R.description4: While in the empowered frenzy, '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking the marked target over all other units and regardless of range. If that target becomes invalid, she will shift back to her {{tt|normal targeting priority|nearest non-marked champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit}} until the marked target can be attacked again. ''Hematomania'' lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including '''Briar's''' or the target's death.
R.description5: ''Casting {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} removes the target's mark and ends Hematomania early. {{ais|Head Rush|Briar}} cast does not shift her targeting priority during Hematomania.''
R.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|1|Time before kicking hemolith}}|{{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Time before dashing to target}}}}

P.name: Headshot
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Caitlyn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Count'' {{tip|on-attack}}, doubled if she is within {{tip|brush}}. At 5 stacks, or 4 while in ''brush'', her next basic attack consumes all stacks {{tip|on-attack}} to become a ''Headshot''.
P.description2: {{sbc|Headshot:}} '''Caitlyn's''' basic attack is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|60 to 100 for 3|1 to 13}}|ad}} {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased to {{as|110% (+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} against non-champions.
P.description3: Enemies that step over a ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' or are hit by ''{{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}}'' can grant an additional ''Headshot'' against them at {{sti|range|1300 range}} within {{fd|1.8}} seconds, without consuming stacks. Each method grants only one ''Headshot'' at a time.

Q.name: Piltover Peacemaker
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter.
Q.description2: Enemies {{tip|true sight|revealed}} by ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' always take {{ccs|full damage|physical}} from ''Piltover Peacemaker''.

W.name: Yordle Snap Trap
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' sets a visible trap at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}} and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second after being placed.
W.description2: '''Caitlyn''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Yordle Snap Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.
W.description3: The next enemy champion that springs the trap is {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for 3 seconds, as well as takes additional damage from the ''{{ai|Headshot|Caitlyn}}'' granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further ''Yordle Snap Traps'' for 3 seconds, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.

E.name: 90 Caliber Net
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' fires a net in the target direction and {{tip|dash|recoils}} 390 units in the opposite direction. The net deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 50% for 1 second.
E.description2: '''''Caitlyn''' will not recoil after the cast time if she was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during it. She can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the recoil dash.''

R.name: Ace in the Hole
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' locks onto the target enemy champion and {{tip|channel|channels}} for 1 second, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself.
R.description2: ''Ace in the Hole'' is placed on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}} if canceled.
R.description3: Once '''Caitlyn''' completes the channel, she fires a homing bullet toward the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy champion it hits, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}.

P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Camille's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against an enemy champion grants her a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|10 to 25 for 4|1 to 19}} of her '''maximum''' health}}}}, lasting for 2 seconds and absorbing damage from either exclusively {{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}} or {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}}, based on which type the target has previously dealt most of against champions as well as on '''Camille's''' '''current''' {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|magic resistance}}}}.

{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}

R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Camille''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} towards the target enemy {{tip|champion|champion}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for the duration and {{tip|disrupt|disrupting}} their ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}.

W.name: Crippling Strike
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 90% for 1 second. P.name: Moonsilver Blade

''Moonsilver Blade'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Pale Cascade
