W.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 11% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage per Orb|{{ap|20 to 68}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 68*3}} {{as|(+ 54% AP)}}}}
W.description2: If all three spheres detonate, ''Pale Cascade's'' shield is reapplied, stacking with its original shield and refreshing the duration.

E.name: Lunar Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them {{as|magic damage}} and consumes ''{{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana|Moonlight}}'' from all enemies. If the target is within 400 range, '''Diana''' will dash through their location.
E.description2: If ''Moonlight'' is consumed from the target, ''Lunar Rush's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
E.description3: '''''Diana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Moonfall
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} all nearby enemies towards her, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
R.description2: If an enemy {{tip|champion}} is pulled, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area around her after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased for each champion pulled beyond the first.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Champion|{{ap|35 to 85}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Total Damage Vs. 5 Champions|{{ap|200+35*4 to 400+85*4}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}

P.name: Goes Where He Pleases
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|0.4; then +0.05*x for 5; then +0.1*x for 6; then +0.15*x for 3; then +0.2*x|formula=0.4% + 0.05% per level at level 1, then + 0.1% per level starting at level 7, then + 0.15% per level starting at level 13, then + 0.2% per level starting at level 16|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pp|0.4/10 to 0.65/10 for 6;0.75/10 to 1.25/10 for 6;1.4/10;1.55/10;1.7/10;1.9/10;2.1/10;2.3/10|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
P.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a {{as|health cost}} equal to {{as|4% of his '''current''' health}} and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.
P.description3: '''Dr. Mundo''' can move near the canister to consume it, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for {{as|4% of his '''maximum''' health}} and reducing the {{sti|cooldown}} of ''Goes Where He Pleases'' by 15 seconds. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move near it to destroy it.
P.description4: ''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].
P.static: {{pp|60 to 15 for 6|1;3 to 15 for 5|formula=60 at level 1, then -9 every 3 levels, starting at level 3 and capped at level 15}}

Q.name: Infected Bonesaw
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Infected Bonesaw'' has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|250 to 550}}}}
Q.description3: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, '''Dr. Mundo''' {{tip|heals}} for 50% of the {{as|health cost}}, increased to 100% against {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Heart Zapper
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies and storing {{pplevel|80 to 95|key=%}} of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], reduced to 25% after the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|5 to 20}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|5*16 to 20*16}}}}
W.description2: ''Heart Zapper'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' detonates the defibrillator, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} for 50% of [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], increased to 100% if at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} is hit.

E.name: Blunt Force Trauma
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''Dr. Mundo's missing''' health|0 to {{#expr:1.4*100-100}} for 11|0 to 70|formula=0.57% per missing health %, up to a cap of 70%.|color=health}}. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} plus ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' minimum '''bonus''' damage.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 45}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
E.description3: ''Blunt Force Trauma'' as well as the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} is increased to {{#expr:1.4*100}}% against {{tip|minions}} and {{#expr:1.4*100}}% against {{tip|monsters}}.
E.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4*1.4 to 45*1.4*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4*1.4 to 45*1.4*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
E.description4: ''Blunt Force Trauma {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Dr. Mundo's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Maximum Dosage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased {{sti|health|{{as|'''base''' health}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}}}}.
R.description2: At rank 3, ''Maximum Dosage's'' increased {{as|'''base''' health}} and {{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}} are both increased by 5% for each enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1200 units at the time of cast.

P.name: League of Draven
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Draven''' catches a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a {{tip|turret}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Adoration''.
P.description2: When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains {{g|25 + (2{{times}}stacks) '''bonus''' gold}}.
P.description3: '''Draven''' loses 50% of his ''Adoration'' stacks upon {{tip|death}}.

Q.name: Spinning Axe
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' starts spinning his axe, empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|5.8}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
Q.description2: Upon hitting the target, the axe then ricochets off of them to land after roughly 1.4 seconds, with the location being determined by '''Draven's''' {{tt|current movement|See notes}}. If '''Draven''' catches the axe, he gains ''Spinning Axe's'' empowered attack again.
Q.description3: '''Draven''' can hold up to two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.

W.name: Blood Rush
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' enters an adrenaline rush, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds as well as decaying {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|50 to 70}}%}}
W.description2: Catching a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'' resets ''Blood Rush's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

E.name: Stand Aside
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' throws a fan of axes in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them aside}}, though not through terrain, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds.

R.name: Whirling Death
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.
R.description2: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110 to 150}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*2 to 150*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
R.description4: ''Whirling Death'' deals {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|100*0.95^(x-1);50|x-1 for 15|formula=(100%-5%)^(1 per enemy hit). ''This is capped at 50% damage.''}} damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
R.description5: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

R.name: Whirling Death 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.
R.description2: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110 to 150}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*2 to 150*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
R.description4: ''Whirling Death'' deals {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|100*0.95^(x-1);50|x-1 for 15|formula=(100%-5%)^(1 per enemy hit). ''This is capped at 50% damage.''}} damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
R.description5: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

P.name: Z-Drive Resonance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Resonance:}} '''Ekko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{pp|30 to 70 by 10; 80 + (140-80)/12*(x-1) for 15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. ''Z-Drive Resonance'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description2: ''Resonance'' cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Stolen Time:}} Triggering ''Resonance'' against a {{tip|champion}} grants '''Ekko''' {{pp|key=%|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|color=movement speed}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{pp|2 to 3 for 3|1 to 11}} seconds.

Q.name: Timewinder
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' throws a temporal grenade in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.description2: At 700 units or upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, the grenade slows down for {{fd|1.75}} seconds to gradually expand into a ''Temporal Sickness'' field that {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies, travelling for another 190 units.
Q.description3: Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to '''Ekko''' at an increased speed, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Return Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80+40 to 140+140}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30+70}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

W.name: Parallel Convergence
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ekko's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}} against enemies below {{sti|health|{{as|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}. The damage has a minimum threshold of 15 and is capped at 150 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' creates an afterimage of himself that, after 2 seconds, bats a device to the target location and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. After travelling over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, the device expands into a chronosphere that lasts for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and which {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 40%.
W.description3: If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|stun}} enemies within for {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.''

E.name: Phase Dive
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' range}}, cause him to {{tip|blink}} within {{tt|125|Estimated}} range of the target, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
E.description2: ''Phase Dive {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ekko's''' basic attack timer. '''Ekko''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Chronobreak
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon learning ''Chronobreak'' or if its '''current''' cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, '''Ekko''' reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} at the start of the cast time, and afterwards {{tip|heals}} himself, increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=health lost|key=%|key1=%|type=health lost in the last 4 seconds|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of health lost in the last 4 seconds}}|health}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to his ''afterimage's'' location at the time of cast over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 175% AP)}}}}{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|400 to 800}} {{as|(+ 240% AP)}}}}
R.description3: '''''Ekko''' is immune to all {{tip|airborne|displacements}} during Chronobreak.''

P.name: Spider Queen
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Human Form:}} '''Elise''' gains one dormant ''Spiderling'' whenever she hits an enemy with an {{tip|ability}}, storing once per cast and up to {{pp|type = [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=]] ''Human Form's'' Rank|2 to 5 for 4}} at a time. She stores the maximum number of ''Spiderlings'' when the game starts and upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Spider Form:}} '''Elise's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{pp|type = [[File:Spider Form.png|20px|link=]] Spider Form's Rank|12 to 42 for 4|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|type=[[File:Spider Form.png|20px|link=]] ''Spider Form's'' Rank|6 to 12 for 4|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
P.description3: ''See [[Elise#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Spiderlings.''

Q.name: Neurotoxin
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' fires a toxin at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, with the damage based on the target's health ratio being capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 160}} {{as|(+ 4% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}

Q.name: Venomous Bite
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' {{tip|dash|pounces}} at the target enemy with her fangs and bites them, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{rutngt|0.5}} from the start of the cast time. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.description2: If there are active ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' or ''{{ai|Volatile Spiderling|Elise|Volatile Spiderlings}}'' nearby, they will {{tip|dash}} alongside '''Elise''' to the target upon ''Venomous Bite's'' cast and reprioritize them.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ 8% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''missing''' health)|health}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}

W.name: Volatile Spiderling
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' summons an {{tip|untargetable}} venom-gorged spider that lasts for 3 seconds. The spider searches for nearby targets and crawls to them after a delay of {{fd|0.75}} seconds and otherwise crawls to the target location before doing so without incurring a delay, navigating its path upon encountering terrain.
W.description2: The spider gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} based on its proximity to the detected target. When the spider comes into contact with an enemy, or upon expiring otherwise, it instantly explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description3: The spider prioritizes the nearest enemy if it detects one before reaching the target location, and {{tip|champion|champions}} always if it detects one after doing so.

W.name: Skittering Frenzy
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Elise's''' ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' gain {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} for 3 seconds.
W.description3: ''Skittering Frenzy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Elise's''' [[basic attack]] timer. '''Elise''' loses Skittering Frenzy immediately when she switches to [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|Human Form|20px|link=Elise#Human Form|border]] [[Elise#Spider Form / Human Form|Human Form]].''

E.name: Cocoon
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' fires a web in the target direction, {{tip|stun|stunning}} the first enemy hit for a few seconds, during which they are also {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

E.name: Rappel
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' lift up into the air over {{fd|0.6}} seconds, immediately becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, and afterwards {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} for up to {{tt|{{fd|1.95}} seconds|Estimated}} and granting {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding {{tt|900 units|Pending for test}} for the duration.
E.description2: ''Rappel'' can be recast instantly on a target enemy within the duration, or without a target after {{tt|a delay|See notes}} for the duration, and does the latter automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' reappear and descend onto the ground over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, becoming targetable and able to act again afterwards. Additionally, ''{{ais|Spider Queen|Elise}}'' bonuses are increased for 5 seconds.
E.description4: If the recast was used on a target enemy, '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' {{tip|blink|descend}} behind the target's location. Otherwise, she and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' will descend onto their current position without a target.
E.description5: ''Rappel's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

R.name: Spider Form
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Spider Queen|Elise}}'' bonuses are increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Elise''' switches between her [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Human Form}} and [[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Spider Form}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|[[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] Spider Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a spider, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25 '''base''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|melee}} basic attacks with {{sti|125 range}}, and access to her arachnid abilities. Additionally, she summons all stored ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' and {{tip|heals}} them to full health.
R.description4: {{sbc|[[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} basic attacks, and access to her human abilities. Additionally, she stores all active ''Spiderlings''.
R.description5: '''Elise''' begins with one rank in ''Spider Form / Human Form'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16.

R.name: Human Form
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Spider Queen|Elise}}'' bonuses are increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Elise''' switches between her [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Human Form}} and [[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Spider Form}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|[[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] Spider Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a spider, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25 '''base''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|melee}} basic attacks with {{sti|125 range}}, and access to her arachnid abilities. Additionally, she summons all stored ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' and {{tip|heals}} them to full health.
R.description4: {{sbc|[[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} basic attacks, and access to her human abilities. Additionally, she stores all active ''Spiderlings''.
R.description5: '''Elise''' begins with one rank in ''Spider Form / Human Form'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16.

P.name: Demon Shade
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Evelynn''' shrouds herself in ''Demon Shade'' after not performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}} for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Demon Shade'' immediately and places it on a 4-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}, reduced to {{fd|1.25}} seconds from casting ''{{ai|Last Caress|Evelynn}}''. Taking damage from {{tip|champion|champions}} or {{tip|turret|turrets}} interrupts ''Demon Shade'' and places it on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Demon Shade:}} While below {{as|{{sti|health|{{pplevel|250 to 590}} {{as|(+ 250% AP)}} health}}}}, '''Evelynn''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for {{pplevel|15 to 150|color=heal}} every second. From [[Experience (champion)|level]] 6 onward, ''Demon Shade'' also grants {{tip|camouflage}}.

Q.name: Hate Spike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' launches a dart in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and marking them for 4 seconds.
Q.description2: '''Evelynn's''' next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} or {{tip|abilities}} against the marked target deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|15 to 55}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Bonus Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 55*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*3}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Hate Spike'' may be recast up to 3 times at no cost until the ability comes off cooldown.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Evelynn''' unleashes a line of deadly spikes in the direction of the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies struck.
Q.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|25*3 to 45*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*3}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|25*4+15*3 to 45*4+55*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*4+25*3}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description5: ''Hate Spike's'' recast prioritizes targeting '''Evelynn's''' attack target, then the nearest enemy champion, then the nearest non-champion.
Q.description6: ''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to recast this ability.''

W.name: Allure
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' marks the target enemy {{tip|champion}} or medium or large {{tip|monster}} with a curse for 5 seconds.
W.description2: '''Evelynn's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} hit against the target consumes the mark, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and refunding ''Allure's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}}. If the target was marked for at least {{fd|2.5}} seconds, the consumption is empowered.
W.description3:
{{sbc|Empowered Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|charm|charmed}} for a few seconds and the {{tip|slow}} duration is increased to the same period. Additional effects are also applied based on the target type:
* Against champions, inflicts a {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
* Against monsters, the triggering effect deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and the duration of the {{tip|charm}} is increased by {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Casting Allure does not break {{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}} nor its fade into it.''

E.name: Whiplash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' whips the target enemy with her lashers, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 3% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description2: '''Evelynn''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
E.description3: Gaining ''{{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}'' resets ''Whiplash's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowers}}'' its next cast. The damage based on the target's health ratio for both ''Whiplash'' and its ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowered}}'' cast deals a minimum of 25 and is capped at 450 against {{tip|monsters}}.

E.name: Empowered Whiplash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward the target enemy with her lashers, dealing {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} to them upon completion as well as to all enemies within her path.
E.leveling: {{st|Empowered Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 4% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description2: ''Empowered Whiplash'' only applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target.

R.name: Last Caress
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' reveals her true form, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck within. After {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|From end of cast time}}, she {{tip|blink|blinks}} 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again.
R.description2: ''Last Caress'' is empowered to deal {{ccs|240% damage|magic}} against enemies below {{as|{{sti|health|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.

P.name: Rising Spell Force
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ezreal''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rising Spell Force'' for each enemy hit by his {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 5 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Rising Spell Force:}} For each stack, '''Ezreal''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|10% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|50%|attack speed}}.

Q.name: Mystic Shot
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
Q.description2: If ''Mystic Shot'' successfully hits an enemy, the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Ezreal's''' abilities, including ''Mystic Shot's'', are reduced by {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

W.name: Essence Flux
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|structure}} hit for 4 seconds.
W.description2: His next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--on-hit? on-damage?--> or {{tip|ability}} against the target detonates the mark to deal them {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
W.description3: If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability.

E.name: Arcane Shift
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' {{tip|blinks}} from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 1 second.
E.description2: ''Arcane Shift'' prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by ''{{ai|Essence Flux|Ezreal}}''.
E.description3: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''

R.name: Trueshot Barrage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a powerful arc of energy in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
R.description2: {{tip|Minion|Minions}} and non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}} take modified damage.
R.leveling2: {{st|Modified Damage|{{ap|150 to 300}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}}}}

P.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Scarecrow Effigy:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' begins the game with an exclusive {{ii|Scarecrow Effigy}}, which permanently occupies the [[Trinket item|trinket]] slot. '''Fiddlesticks''' can pretend to be an ''Effigy'' by standing still and not acting nor being acted upon for 2 seconds, during which it hides its [[health bar]], adjusts its body into a scarecrow and extends its arm out to expose its lantern.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - A Harmless Scarecrow:}} From {{stil|experience|level}} 6 onward, placing an {{tip|Effigy}} also summons a {{tip|Sweeper Drone}} at the location for 6 seconds.

Q.name: Terrify
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Fiddlesticks''' has been [[combat status|out of combat]] for at least {{tt|{{fd|2.25}} seconds|Estimated}} and is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to the enemy team, or is impersonating an ''{{ai|A Harmless Scarecrow|Fiddlesticks|Effigy}}'', its damaging ability will additionally {{tip|fear}} targets hit for a duration.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' launches a crow at the target enemy which arrives after {{tt|{{fd|0.35}} seconds|Fixed travel time from the start of the cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|fear|fearing}} them for a duration. ''Terrify'' has a minimum damage threshold and is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description3: Targets feared by '''Fiddlesticks''' by any means cannot be affected by it again for a duration equal to ''Terrify's'' cooldown. Against these targets, ''Terrify's'' {{ccs|damage|magic}} and minimum threshold are doubled.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Increased Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4*2 to 6*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3*2}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Increased Minimum Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}}}}
Q.description4: ''Terrify'' {{tip|slow|slows}} affected targets by 90%.

W.name: Bountiful Harvest
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' forms a {{tip|tether}} between itself and each nearby enemy over the cast time, then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 2 seconds to harvest their souls, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in the process.
W.description2: While '''Fiddlesticks''' is channeling, the tethered enemies are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. The final tick at the end of the channel deals additional {{as|magic damage}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Bountiful Harvest'' deals {{ap|1.35*100}}% damage against {{tip|monsters}} and {{ap|0.50*100}}% damage against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Damage per second|{{ap|120/2 to 360/2}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/2}}}}% AP)}}|Damage per Instance|{{ap|120/{{#var:total_ticks}} to 360/{{#var:total_ticks}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/{{#var:total_ticks}}}}}}% AP)}}}}{{st|Last Tick of Damage|{{ap|120/{{#var:total_ticks}} to 360/{{#var:total_ticks}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/{{#var:total_ticks}}}}}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 22}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|120 to 360}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 22}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
W.description3: '''Fiddlesticks''' {{tip|heals}} itself for a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage dealt before modifiers}} dealt, modified to {{ap|0.45*100}}% against {{tip|monsters}} and {{ap|0.15*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.description4: ''Bountiful Harvest'' ends if all targets have died or broken their tethers. If the channel was not {{tt|interrupted|e.g. by Fiddlesticks or crowd control effects}}, 60% of the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is refunded.
W.description5: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be tethered by this ability.''

E.name: Reap
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' slashes the target location with its scythe, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
E.description2: Enemies hit in the center of the area are also {{tip|silence|silenced}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

R.name: Crowstorm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location upon completion with a murder of crows flying wildly around it for 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|150*0.25 to 350*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{fd|12.5}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|150*5 to 350*5}} {{as|(+ 250% AP)}}}}

P.name: Duelist's Dance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Fiora''' identifies the {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} take {{fd|1.75}} seconds to become targetable and linger for {{fd|13.25}} seconds afterwards while '''Fiora''' remains near the target, otherwise the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will disappear. After a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} expires, '''Fiora''' identifies a new one on her target.
P.description2: Dealing damage in the direction of a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will trigger it to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heal}} '''Fiora''' for {{pplevel|35 to 100|color=heal}}, and grant her {{pp|type=[[File:Grand Challenge.png|20px|link=]] ''Grand Challenge's'' Rank|key=%|20 to 50 for 4|0 to 3|formula=20%+(10%*Grand Challenge's Rank)|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.85}} seconds.

P.name: Duelist's Dance 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Fiora''' identifies the {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} take {{fd|1.75}} seconds to become targetable and linger for {{fd|13.25}} seconds afterwards while '''Fiora''' remains near the target, otherwise the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will disappear. After a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} expires, '''Fiora''' identifies a new one on her target.
P.description2: Dealing damage in the direction of a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will trigger it to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heal}} '''Fiora''' for {{pplevel|35 to 100|color=heal}}, and grant her {{pp|type=[[File:Grand Challenge.png|20px|link=]] ''Grand Challenge's'' Rank|key=%|20 to 50 for 4|0 to 3|formula=20%+(10%*Grand Challenge's Rank)|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.85}} seconds.

Q.name: Lunge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy based on {{tt|a priority|See notes}}. ''Lunge'' can hit {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|ward|wards}}. Stabbing a target reduces ''Lunge's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 50%.
Q.description2: The stab deals {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 110}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90 to 110}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: '''''Fiora''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability, unless it is a ward.''

W.name: Riposte
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' enters a defensive stance for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, prevents all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} damage, and gains {{tip|debuff}} immunity.
W.description2: Additionally, over the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the duration, '''Fiora''' poises to strike, after which she sends a shock with her sword in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit until colliding with an enemy champion.
W.description3: The enemy champion struck is also {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|cripple|crippled}} by 25% for 2 seconds. If ''Riposte'' negates at least one {{tt|hostile|Belonging to an enemy source}} {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, '''Fiora''' {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for the same duration instead.

E.name: Bladework
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' empowers her next two [[basic attack]]s {{tip|on-attack}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
E.description2: The first attack {{tip|slow|slows}} the target by 30% for 1 second but cannot {{tip|critically strike}}. The second attack will {{tip|critically strike}} for {{sti|critical damage modifiers|{{as|'''modified''' critical damage}}}}, including to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.
E.description3: ''Bladework {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Fiora's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Grand Challenge
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} is increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. While in effect, ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' does not identify new {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} on ''Grand Challenge's'' target, and unlike ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'', ''Grand Challenge's'' {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} will linger regardless of range.
R.description3: While near the target, '''Fiora''' gains ''{{ais|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description4: If '''Fiora''' triggers at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} before the target {{tip|death|dies}}, or triggers all four otherwise, a ''{{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}}'' is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Fiora''' and all allies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling4: {{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|75/4 to 125/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Heal per Second|{{ap|75 to 125}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|75*5 to 125*5}} {{as|(+ 300% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Grand Challenge 2
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} is increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. While in effect, ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' does not identify new {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} on ''Grand Challenge's'' target, and unlike ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'', ''Grand Challenge's'' {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} will linger regardless of range.
R.description3: While near the target, '''Fiora''' gains ''{{ais|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description4: If '''Fiora''' triggers at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} before the target {{tip|death|dies}}, or triggers all four otherwise, a ''{{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}}'' is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Fiora''' and all allies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling4: {{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|75/4 to 125/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Heal per Second|{{ap|75 to 125}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|75*5 to 125*5}} {{as|(+ 300% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

P.name: Nimble Fighter
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Fizz''' is permanently {{tip|ghosted}} and reduces every instance of {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage taken by 4 {{as|(+ 1% AP)}}, up to a maximum of 50% reduction. The damage reduction is increased to 14 {{as|(+ 1% AP)}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Urchin Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} plus {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description2: ''{{ai|Seastone Trident|Fizz}} and {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Seastone Trident
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Fizz's''' basic attacks rend enemies {{tip|on-hit}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
W.leveling: {{st|Total Passive Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Passive Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|30/6 to 90/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25/6|round=2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
W.description3: If ''Seastone Trident'' kills its target, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 1 second and the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded. Otherwise, if the target is not killed, '''Fizz's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds.
W.description4: ''Seastone Trident's'' active damage can be applied against {{tip|structures}} at 50% effectiveness. Active and on-hit damage deal an additional {{as|90 '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description5: ''Seastone Trident {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Fizz's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Playful
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location while becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, balancing on his trident for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which he can cast ''{{ai|Trickster|Fizz}}'' after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the duration.
E.description2: He then begins to hop off of his trident over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and afterwards becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
E.description3: ''While hopping off of the trident, '''Fizz''' may input movement commands to direct his landing.''

E.name: Trickster
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, hopping down and splashing onto the ground prematurely upon arrival to deal the same {{as|magic damage}} in a smaller radius but not applying the slow.

R.name: Chum the Waters
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' throws down a lure at the target location that attracts a shark, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before it emerges to chomp at the lure after 2 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, though not through terrain, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The further the lure travels in its initial flight, the larger the shark that is attracted; increasing ''Chum the Waters' '' damage, slow, eruption radius and knock back distance.
R.description2: {{sbc|Guppy (<455):}} 40% slow, 200 eruption radius and 150 unit knock back distance.
R.leveling2: {{st|Guppy Damage|{{ap|180 to 420}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Chomper (455-910):}} {{ap|(1+(1.5-1)*(1/2))*100}}% damage, 60% slow, 325 eruption radius and 250 unit knock back distance.
R.description4: {{sbc|Gigalodon (>910):}} {{ap|1.5*100}}% damage, 80% slow, 450 eruption radius and 350 unit knock back distance.
R.description5: Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can intercept the lure while it is in flight, which attaches to them upon contact and causes the shark to emerge at their position after the same delay. The lure's holder is {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for the duration and afterwards is impacted by the eruption but is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second instead of knocked back.

P.name: Colossal Smash
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Galio's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and deal {{pplevel|15 to 115|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} to the target and all enemies near them.
P.description2: Whenever '''Galio''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} with an {{tip|ability}}, ''Colossal Smash's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds. This may occur only once per cast.
P.description3: ''Colossal Smash's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Galio|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage to all targets hit.

Q.name: Winds of War
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' creates two windblasts 250 units to either side of him that arc out before converging to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through.
Q.description2: When the blasts meet, the gusts form a tornado that persists for 2 seconds, slowly moving forward and dealing {{as|magic damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|2% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds|{{as|8% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}} over the duration}}to enemies within the area, capped at{{ft|150 per tick|600 total}}against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Shield of Durand
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Galio''' gains ''Anti-Magic Bulwark'', and restores it after {{pp|12 to 8 for 3|1;6;11}} seconds without taking damage.

{{sbc|Anti-Magic Bulwark:}} Gain a {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{as|magic damage}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to 2 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} himself by 15%, and gaining {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage reduction; charging increases ''Shield of Durand's'' radius, damage and {{tip|taunt}} duration over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Physical Damage Reduction|{{ap|25/2 to 45/2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8/2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1/2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage Reduction|{{ap|25 to 45}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 8% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description4: ''Shield of Durand'' can be recast within the duration and does so automatically afterwards or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Galio''' refreshes the [[damage modifier|damage reduction]] for 2 seconds and deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemy champions, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=100%+(25% per 0.16 seconds channeled).}}, as well as {{tip|taunt|taunts}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|0.5 to 1.5 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=0.5+(0.125 per 0.16 seconds channeled).}} seconds and, after a brief delay, sets their {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} to a {{as|static 60|ms}} for the same duration but slightly longer.
W.leveling5: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 60*3}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
W.description6: '''''Galio''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to basic attack or cast abilities for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after the recast.''

W.name: Shield of Durand 2
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Galio''' gains ''Anti-Magic Bulwark'', and restores it after {{pp|12 to 8 for 3|1;6;11}} seconds without taking damage.

{{sbc|Anti-Magic Bulwark:}} Gain a {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{as|magic damage}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to 2 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} himself by 15%, and gaining {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage reduction; charging increases ''Shield of Durand's'' radius, damage and {{tip|taunt}} duration over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Physical Damage Reduction|{{ap|25/2 to 45/2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8/2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1/2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage Reduction|{{ap|25 to 45}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 8% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description4: ''Shield of Durand'' can be recast within the duration and does so automatically afterwards or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Galio''' refreshes the [[damage modifier|damage reduction]] for 2 seconds and deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemy champions, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=100%+(25% per 0.16 seconds channeled).}}, as well as {{tip|taunt|taunts}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|0.5 to 1.5 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=0.5+(0.125 per 0.16 seconds channeled).}} seconds and, after a brief delay, sets their {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} to a {{as|static 60|ms}} for the same duration but slightly longer.
W.leveling5: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 60*3}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
W.description6: '''''Galio''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to basic attack or cast abilities for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after the recast.''

E.name: Justice Punch
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' {{tip|lunge|steps back}} in the opposite direction over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or [[terrain]].
E.description2: '''Galio''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 80% against non-champions, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds as well as {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for the same duration.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100*0.8 to 240*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.8}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Hero's Entrance
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' prepares to make an entrance, {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.75}} seconds and designating the target allied {{tip|champion|champion's}} location at the time of cast as his landing spot. Additionally, he resets ''{{ais|Shield of Durand 2|Galio|Shield of Durand}}'' passive shield for himself and grants it to all allied champions within the area for 5 seconds.
R.description2: After channeling for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, he gains {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} for the remaining duration, becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, and leaps into the air for {{tt|{{fd|0.8 seconds}}|Estimated}} before {{tip|dash|dashing}} to his destination over {{tt|{{fd|0.2 seconds}}|Estimated}}. Afterwards, he lands and becomes targetable again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon impact, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 100 units over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, and remaining in place for {{tt|{{fd|0.5 seconds}}|Estimated}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}

P.name: Trial by Fire
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Gangplank''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to set the target on fire, dealing them{{ft|{{pplevel|50 to 250|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.|{{pplevel|50/10 to 250/10|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.}}{{tip|turret|Turrets}} are dealt 50% damage.
P.description2: If '''Gangplank''' successfully hits a target with ''Trial by Fire'', he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pplevel|15 to 30|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds. Every time a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explodes, the {{sti|cooldown}} for ''Trial by Fire'' resets and '''Gangplank''' gains its {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
P.description3: ''Trial by Fire cannot be applied with {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}} nor {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}.''

P.name: Trial by Fire 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Gangplank''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to set the target on fire, dealing them{{ft|{{pplevel|50 to 250|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.|{{pplevel|50/10 to 250/10|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.}}{{tip|turret|Turrets}} are dealt 50% damage.
P.description2: If '''Gangplank''' successfully hits a target with ''Trial by Fire'', he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pplevel|15 to 30|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds. Every time a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explodes, the {{sti|cooldown}} for ''Trial by Fire'' resets and '''Gangplank''' gains its {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
P.description3: ''Trial by Fire cannot be applied with {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}} nor {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}.''

Q.name: Parrrley
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects as a {{tip|ranged}} attack, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.description2: If ''Parrrley'' kills the target, '''Gangplank''' plunders {{g|gold}} and [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents''. Each enemy killed by a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explosion that was originally set off by ''Parrrley'' also counts for the plunder.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Gold Plunder|{{g|{{ap|3 to 7}}}}}}
{{st|Silver Serpent Plunder|[[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] {{ap|4 to 8}}}}
Q.description3: [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents'' can be spent while at the [[shop]] to upgrade ''{{ai|Cannon Barrage|Gangplank}}''.

Q.name: Silver Serpents
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects as a {{tip|ranged}} attack, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.description2: If ''Parrrley'' kills the target, '''Gangplank''' plunders {{g|gold}} and [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents''. Each enemy killed by a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explosion that was originally set off by ''Parrrley'' also counts for the plunder.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Gold Plunder|{{g|{{ap|3 to 7}}}}}}
{{st|Silver Serpent Plunder|[[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] {{ap|4 to 8}}}}
Q.description3: [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents'' can be spent while at the [[shop]] to upgrade ''{{ai|Cannon Barrage|Gangplank}}''.

W.name: Remove Scurvy
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' consumes a large quantity of citrus fruit, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself.

E.name: Powder Keg
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' consumes a charge to place a powder keg at the target location that lasts for 25 seconds and will connect to other kegs with overlapping connection radius through a trail of black powder. The keg starts with {{as|3 health}} and loses {{as|1|health}} every {{pp|2;1;0.5|1;7;13}} seconds until it is left with {{as|1 health}}.
E.description2: '''Gangplank''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Powder Keg'' charge, up to a maximum.
E.description3: Kegs can be {{tip|basic attack|attacked}} by enemies or '''Gangplank''' (including his ''{{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}''), dealing 1 damage to it. When an enemy destroys it, it is safely defused. When '''Gangplank''' destroys it, it explodes and also triggers a chain reaction that explodes other nearby connected kegs with a {{rutngt|0.3}}-delay between explosions. The explosions also grant {{tip|sight}} of their radiuses for 2 seconds.
E.description4: Enemies caught in an explosion are dealt the triggering {{tt|{{as|attack's damage}}|see notes}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 2 seconds. Against champions, the explosion also deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. Each enemy can only be hit once per chain and the damage dealt ignores {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|40% of the target's armor}}}}.
E.description5: ''The triggering attack on the keg can {{tip|critically strike}}, causing the explosion to deal the attack's critical damage.''

R.name: Cannon Barrage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' shoots a flare into the air, signaling his ship off-shore to fire upon the target location, calling down 12 waves of cannonballs in clusters of 3 every 2 seconds, each wave in a cluster hitting {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the other, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for the duration. Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Wave|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Cluster|{{ap|40*3 to 100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40*12 to 100*12}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*12}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: While within the [[shop]] area, '''Gangplank''' can purchase upgrades for his ship at the cost of 500 ''{{ai|Silver Serpents|Gangplank}}'' each, which improve ''Cannon Barrage'' with new effects:
R.description3: {{sbc|{{ii|Death's Daughter}}:}} A large cannonball lands in the center of the barrage after the first cluster of waves occur, dealing a cluster's worth of {{as|true damage}} to enemies within the impact and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% for 1 second.
R.leveling3:
{{st|True Damage with {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*3 to 100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Mixed Damage with {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*12+40*3 to 100*12+100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*12+10*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ii|Fire at Will}}:}} ''Cannon Barrage'' fires{{ft|6 additional waves|2 additional clusters}}over its duration; 18 waves of cannonballs are called down in clusters of 3 every {{fd|1.3{{recurring|3}}}} seconds.
R.leveling4:
{{st|Total Magic Damage with {{ii|Fire at Will}}|{{ap|40*18 to 100*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*18}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Mixed Total Damage with {{ii|Fire at Will}} and {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*18+40*3 to 100*18+100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*18+10*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description5: {{sbc|{{ii|Raise Morale}}:}} ''Cannon Barrage'' grants '''Gangplank''' and all allies within the area {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, lingering for 2 seconds.

P.name: Perseverance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Garen''' {{sti|health regeneration|link=true|regenerates}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|1.5+0.2*(x-1) for 6;then + 0.8*x for 7; then + 0.4*x|formula=1.3%+0.2% per level up to level 6, then+0.8% up to level 13, then+0.4%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|(1.5+0.2*(x-1))/10 for 6;then + 0.8/10*x for 7; then + 0.4/10*x|formula=0.13%+0.02% per level up to level 6, then+0.08% up to level 13, then+0.04%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
P.description2: ''Perseverance'' is lost for {{tt|8 seconds|Not a cooldown, unaffected by ability haste}} if '''Garen''' takes damage from {{tip|champion|champions}}, epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}}, or if he is hit by an enemy {{tip|ability}} or affected by an enemy [[summoner spell]], refreshing on subsequent damage and hits taken from them.

Q.name: Decisive Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself of all {{tip|slow|slows}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|35% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
Q.description2: Additionally, '''Garen''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|4.5}} seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, {{tip|lunge}} at the target, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and {{tip|silence}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 150}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Decisive Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Courage
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Garen''' kills an enemy, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Courage'', stacking up to 150 times.
W.description2: {{sbc|Courage:}} For each stack, '''Garen''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, up to a maximum of 30 '''bonus''' resistances each.
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' reduces incoming damage for 4 seconds. For the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds, '''Garen''' additionally grants himself a {{tip|shield}} and 60% {{tip|tenacity}}.

E.name: Judgment
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' rapidly spins his sword around himself 7 (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|25% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Only bonus attack speed from item stats and growth (per level)}}) times over 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies {{tt|periodically|Spin rate is 3 ÷ number of spins}}. ''Judgment'' can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.
E.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40 to 52}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+0.3) to 16*(1+0.3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+0.3) to 52*(1+0.3)}}% AD)}}|{{ii|Infinity Edge|IE}} Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3) to 16*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3) to 52*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3)}}% AD)}}}}
E.description2: Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.
E.description3: ''Judgment'' deals {{ap|(1.25-1)*100}}% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.
E.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Garen''' ends ''Judgment''.
E.description5: ''Judgment'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{#expr:100+0.3*100}}|{{#expr:0.3*100}}}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|{{#expr:0.3*100}}% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}

R.name: Demacian Justice
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' calls upon the might of ''Demacia'' onto the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 1 second at the start of the cast time.
R.leveling: {{st|True Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}

P.name: Rage Gene
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Rage Gene:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} generates {{pp|4;7;11|1 to 11}} ''{{ai|Rage Gene|Gnar|Rage}}'' over 2 seconds upon dealing or receiving damage, up to 100. Against non-champions, {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.125;7*0.125;11*0.125|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage''.|{{fd|12.5%}} of the amount.}} Against champions, ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generates{{ft|{{pp|4*0.25;7*0.25;11*0.25|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage'',|25% of the amount,}}and basic attacks ''on-hit'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.5;7*0.5;11*0.5|1 to 11|round=false}}.|50% of the amount.}}''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' can only generate ''Rage'' once per cast, and grants ''Rage'' based on the first enemy hit. '''Gnar's''' ''Rage'' decays after being [[combat status|out of combat]] for 13 seconds.
P.description2: At maximum ''Rage'', '''Gnar's''' {{tip|abilities}} switch to {{cis|Mega Gnar}} abilities, for 4 seconds and until transforming back to his ''Mini Gnar'' form, with the exception of ''{{ai|Hop and Crunch|Gnar|Hop}}'', which switches after the transformation. Casting any of them during this time also causes '''Gnar''' to transform into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed.
P.description3: '''Gnar's''' {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form lasts for 15 seconds, with his ''Rage'' bar depleting as an indication of remaining time. ''Rage cannot be generated while in this form.'' Afterwards, '''Gnar''' returns to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, retaining his {{sti|health|{{as|'''current''' percentage health}}}} and becoming too [[File:Rage Gene 4.png|20px]] ''tired'' to generate ''Rage'' for 15 seconds.
P.description4: '''Gnar''' gains different stat bonuses based on whether he is in ''{{ai|Mini Gnar|Gnar|Mini}}'' or ''{{ai|Mega Gnar|Gnar|Mega}}'' form. Both of '''Gnar's''' forms share their ability cooldowns.

Q.name: Boomerang Throw
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' throws a boomerang in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies in its path and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.

After reaching its maximum range or hitting an enemy, the boomerang flies back toward '''Gnar''' based on his current movement, dealing 50% damage to subsequent targets.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 165}} {{as|(+ 125% AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|5/2 to 165/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|125/2}}% AD)}}}}{{st|Slow|{{ap|15 to 35}}%}}
Q.description2: Catching the boomerang while it is returning back refunds 40% of the ability's {{sti|'''total''' cooldown}}.
Q.description3: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

Q.name: Boulder Toss
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The boulder then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
Q.description2: After {{fd|0.3}} seconds, '''Gnar''' can pick up the boulder by moving within 90 units of it, refunding 70% of the ability's {{sti|cooldown|'''total''' cooldown}}.

W.name: Hyper
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Gnar's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Hyper'' to enemies for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
W.description2: The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}, and grant '''Gnar''' {{pp|type = [[File:GNAR!.png|20px|border]] ''GNAR!'s'' rank|key=%|20 to 80 for 4|0 to 3|formula = 20% + 20% per GNAR!'s rank|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|0 to 40}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6 to 14}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
W.description3: '''Gnar''' gains ''Hyper's'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} when he leaves {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form.

W.name: Wallop
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' slams his arm down in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies struck within the area and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

E.name: Hop
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, then gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.
E.description2: If '''Gnar''' lands on a unit he will {{tip|dash|bounce}} 500 units further in the same direction. Landing on an enemy deals them {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
E.description3: If ''Hop'' is used to transform, it will not grant {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. Instead, after {{tip|dash|bouncing}} '''Gnar''' will send out a shockwave as per ''{{ai|Crunch|Gnar}}'' {{tt|where he lands|Only after bouncing. This is not intended. See details section.}}.
E.description4: '''Gnar''' will not bounce if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} during the first leap.
E.description5: ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Crunch
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location and deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Gnar''' sends out a shockwave, dealing the same damage to additional enemies in a larger radius.

E.name: Hop and Crunch
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location and deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Gnar''' sends out a shockwave, dealing the same damage to additional enemies in a larger radius.

R.name: GNAR!
R.description: {{sbc|{{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} - Passive:}} ''{{ais|Hyper|Gnar}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} is increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|{{ci|Mega Gnar}} - Active:}} '''Gnar''' thrusts in the target direction, {{tip|airborne|knocking away}} nearby enemies up to 590 units in that direction, though not through terrain, and afterwards dealing them {{as|physical damage}}, as well as {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay for a duration.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 1.75}}}}
R.description3: Enemies that collide with terrain take {{ccs|50% increased damage|physical}} immediately and are {{tip|stun|stunned}} instantly instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}} after a delay.

Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' rolls a cask to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. Upon arrival, the cask starts to ferment over the first 2 seconds of its duration to increase its {{ccs|damage|magic}} and the effectiveness of its {{tip|slow}}, up to a maximum of 150% of their initial values. ''Barrel Roll'' can be recast at any time within its duration after the cask has fully travelled, and does so automatically after its duration ends.

He will reload over {{tt|a few seconds|See notes}} immediately after expending all {{as|shells|buzzword3}}, or after withholding a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}} {{tt|for a while|See notes}}. The reload time is {{tt|reduced|See notes}} by '''Graves'''' level and {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and is cancelled if '''Graves''' reloads a {{as|shell|buzzword3}} with ''{{ai|Quickdraw|Graves}}'' or expends a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}}. P.description5: {{sbc|Innate - Buckshot:}} Non-champion units hit by more than one {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}, though not through terrain.

Q.name: End of the Line
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' fires a round in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through and leaves behind a powder trail.

Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion damage|{{ap|60*0.6 to 180*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

Stacks expire one by one every 1 second when the duration ends.
