W.description2: Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets. {{tip|Champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} receive less damage from the second to fifth rockets that hit them, which is reduced by {{ap|0.5*100}}% for rockets beyond the fifth. {{tip|Minions}} instead always receive 100% of the initial damage from every single rocket.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Rockets 2–5 Magic Damage|{{ap|32 to 58 3}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Rockets 6–20 Magic Damage|{{ap|32*0.5 to 58*0.5 3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*0.5}}% AP)}}|Combined Total Non-Minion Damage|{{ap|135+4*32+15*32*0.5 to 225+4*58+15*58*0.5 3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45+4*12+15*12*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage per Rocket|{{ap|135 to 225 3}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Combined Total Minion Damage|{{ap|20*135 to 20*225 3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*45}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' hurls a grenade at the target location that detonates upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35% for 2 seconds. If the grenade hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, all ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=yes}} {{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}}'' within 1000 range of the impact gain 100% beam charge.
E.description2: Enemies hit at the center of the grenade's impact are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

E.name: CH-3X Lightning Grenade
E.description: {{sbc|{{ai|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}} - Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' hurls a massive grenade at the target location that bounces {{tt|a fixed distance|300 range per bounce, 600 in total}} 3 times in the cast direction. The grenade explodes upon landing each time to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit at the center of the grenade's impact are additionally {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|CH-3X Lightning Grenade|Heimerdinger}}'' scales with ''{{ais|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}}'' rank}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 300 3}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
E.description2: Enemy champions can only be damaged once per cast, but can be {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} multiple times if circumstances permit.

R.name: UPGRADE!!!
R.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Heimerdinger''' empowers his next [[champion ability|basic ability]] for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing ''UPGRADE!!!'' on full cooldown. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
R.description2: ''UPGRADE!!!'' incurs its static cooldown on-cast, and can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description3: ''UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

P.name: Signature of the Visionary
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Hwei's''' damaging {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent damaging abilities against marked targets consume the mark to create an explosion beneath them, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|40 to 285}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to enemies in the area after a {{fd|0.85}}-second delay.

Q.name: Subject: Disaster
Q.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a disastrous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

Q.name: Devastating Fire
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - QQ:}} '''Hwei''' slings a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 250 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3 to 7}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}

Q.name: Severing Bolt
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - QW:}} '''Hwei''' calls upon a lightning bolt to strike at the target location after {{tt|1 second|From start of cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
Q.description2: If ''Severing Bolt'' hits only one enemy or {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} enemies, it deals {{ccs|increased|magic}} damage based on the {{tt|{{as|target's '''missing''' health}}|See notes}}. This '''bonus''' damage is capped at 300 against monsters.
Q.description3: ''Severing Bolt'' deals 50% damage to {{tip|minions}} and non-epic {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Molten Fissure
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - QE:}} '''Hwei''' marks a blazing path in the target direction. After {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|From start of cast time}}, the path erupts into volcanic explosions every {{tt|{{fd|0.2}} seconds|Estimated}} from the point of cast, for a total of 7 explosions. Each explosion creates a shockwave that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.description2: Each explosion also leaves a lava fissure in its wake. A fissure lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35%. Enemies may be damaged by multiple fissures at once.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|50/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/10}}% AP)}}|Total Fissure Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Molten Fissure's'' damage is reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}} and increased to 135% against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description4: ''Molten Fissure's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''

W.name: Subject: Serenity
W.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a serene mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

W.name: Fleeting Current
W.description: {{sbc|Active - WQ:}} '''Hwei''' forms a current of water in the target direction, creating a path for a duration that grants him and allied {{tip|champions}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, with the bonus refreshing every {{fd|0.125}} seconds while they remain in the area.
W.leveling:
{{st|Path Duration|{{ap|4 to 6}} seconds}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 40}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description2: '''''Hwei''' can move during Fleeting Current's cast time.''

W.name: Pool of Reflection
W.description: {{sbc|Active - WW:}} '''Hwei''' summons a pool of water at the target location, creating a protective zone for 3 seconds that grants him and allied {{tip|champions}} a {{tip|shield}} at the start of the cast time and for {{fd|0.5}} seconds while within the area. The shield refreshes and increases in strength by an amount every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration while they remain in the area.
W.leveling:
{{st|Initial Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 130}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Shield per Tick|{{ap|50/6 to 130/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/6|round=2}}% AP)}}|Total Maximum Shield|{{ap|50*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: ''Pool of Reflection's'' shield strength is reduced to 85% for allies.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Ally Initial Shield|{{ap|50*0.85 to 130*0.85}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.85}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Ally Bonus Shield per Tick|{{ap|50*0.85/6 to 130*0.85/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.85/6|round=2}}% AP)}}|Ally Total Maximum Shield|{{ap|50*2*0.85 to 130*2*0.85}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2*0.85}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Stirring Lights
W.description: {{sbc|Active - WE:}} '''Hwei''' surrounds himself in swirling flares that empower his next 3 [[basic attacks]] or [[champion ability|ability]] hits within 9 seconds to each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 60*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Mana Restore|{{ap|135/3 to 195/3}}|Total Mana Restore|{{ap|135 to 195}}}}
W.description2: ''Stirring Lights' '' '''bonus''' damage is reduced to 50% against {{tip|minions}} or {{tip|monsters}} if applied by his area of effect abilities.

E.name: Subject: Torment
E.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a tumultuous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

E.name: Grim Visage
E.description: {{sbc|Active - EQ:}} '''Hwei''' launches a terrifying grin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|knockdown|knocks them down}}, and {{tip|fear|fears}} them for a duration, as well as {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|type=distance from '''Hwei'''|70;78;86;94;99|0;300;600;900;1100|key=%|changedisplay=true|formula=70% + 1% for every 38 units the target is away from Hwei at the time of being hit}} for the same duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
E.description2: ''Grim Visage's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''

E.name: Gaze of the Abyss
E.description: {{sbc|Active - EW:}} '''Hwei''' tosses an eyeball to the target location. Upon arrival, it expands over {{fd|0.2}} seconds into a dark gaze that lasts 3 seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can see into brush and terrain}}. After {{fd|0.7}} seconds of being placed, the eye locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion or otherwise remains there until an enemy champion is in range. Once locked on, the eye launches itself at the target after a {{fd|0.3}}-second delay and collides with the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and {{tip|root}} them for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 2}} seconds}}

E.name: Crushing Maw
E.description: {{sbc|Active - EE:}} '''Hwei''' conjures a jaw at the target location that snaps after {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|From start of cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.25}} seconds. Enemies that are not standing at the center when the jaw snaps are {{tip|airborne|pulled}} there.
E.description2: ''Crushing Maw's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''

R.name: Spiraling Despair
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hwei''' launches a globule of pure despair in the target direction that collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit, afflicting them with an [[aura]] that grows over 3 seconds, {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target, and grants {{tip|sight}} within its radius. Enemies within are both dealt {{as|magic damage}} and applied a {{tip|stack}} of ''Despair'' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|10/4 to 30/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5/4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Despair:}} For each stack, the target is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, stacking up to 12 times.
R.description3: At the end of the duration or when the target dies, the aura explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and remove all ''Despair'' stacks from affected enemies.
R.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|200+10*3 to 450+30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80+5*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4:
''Spiraling Despair can only be cast if '''Hwei''' has not entered a mood.
Spiraling Despair's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}.''

R.name: Wash Brush
R.description: {{sbc|Toggle - QR, WR, ER:}} '''Hwei''' exits his current ''mood'' without incurring its ability cost or cooldown, toggling it off.
R.description2: ''Wash Brush can only be cast if '''Hwei''' has entered a mood, and can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

P.name: Prophet of an Elder God
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Illaoi''' spawns a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} on the nearest terrain, if no other Tentacle is around it. Tentacles fully spawn after a 2 second delay and are {{tip|untargetable}} in the meantime.
P.description2:
{{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} are commanded to attack by '''Illaoi's''' {{tip|abilities}}, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|9 to 180}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to all enemies struck, increased by {{pp|0;10 to 30|0 to 5 for 6|key=%|formula=100% + 10% at rank 1, then 5% per rank|type = [[File:Tentacle Smash.png|20px|link=]] Tentacle Smash's rank}}.
Each enemy individually reduces the slam damage by 50% for every slam they were hit by in the last {{fd|0.66}} seconds, capped at 75% less damage.
P.description3: Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} also {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Illaoi''' for {{as|5% of her '''missing''' health}} if it hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}.
P.description4: ''See [[Illaoi#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}}.''

Q.name: Tentacle Smash
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} damage is increased.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' slams down a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} in the target direction.
Q.description3: '''''Illaoi''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself during the cast if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}''.

W.name: Harsh Lesson
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to gain {{sti|range|225 '''bonus''' range}} and cause her to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond her normal basic attack range.
W.description2: The attack deals {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, with a minimum threshold, and capped at 300 against non-champions, and commands all {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} in range to attack the target. The minimum '''additional''' damage can also be applied against {{tip|turrets}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}}}}
W.description3: ''Harsh Lesson {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Illaoi's''' basic attack timer.''
W.description4: ''Harsh Lesson can be activated during '''Illaoi's''' other abilities.''

E.name: Test of Spirit
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' launches a tendril in the target direction that stops at the first enemy hit, pulling their {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} out in front of '''Illaoi''' over {{fd|0.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The target is {{tip|tether|tethered}} to the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} for {{tt|7 seconds|Timer starts when the target is hit}}, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in addition to granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them while the tether remains.
E.description2: The {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} spawns with the target's '''current''' {{sti|health|{{as|health}}}}, {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and echoes a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} received to the tethered champion.
E.description3: When the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is killed or the target leaves tether range, the tether is severed, marking the target as a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once the tether returns back to them. Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} autonomously attacks the closest {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} or {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, prioritizing the latter, once every {{pp|4.5 to 3.5 for 3|1 to 13|formula=4-0.5 every 6 levels, with an up to 0.5-second delay. Cooldown starts upon starting the slam.}} seconds.
E.description4: Enemies made a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} continuously spawn a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} near themselves, when possible. {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} can spawn 300 units closer to each other than when spawned by '''Illaoi'''.
E.description5: '''''Illaoi''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while firing the projectile and while the target's {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is being pulled. She also {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself while firing the projectile if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}. {{as|Vessels|buzzword3}} can dispel their mark by scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against '''Illaoi'''. Test of Spirit cannot be cast again until the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} dies.''

E.name: Vessel
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' launches a tendril in the target direction that stops at the first enemy hit, pulling their {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} out in front of '''Illaoi''' over {{fd|0.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The target is {{tip|tether|tethered}} to the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} for {{tt|7 seconds|Timer starts when the target is hit}}, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in addition to granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them while the tether remains.
E.description2: The {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} spawns with the target's '''current''' {{sti|health|{{as|health}}}}, {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and echoes a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} received to the tethered champion.
E.description3: When the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is killed or the target leaves tether range, the tether is severed, marking the target as a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once the tether returns back to them. Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} autonomously attacks the closest {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} or {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, prioritizing the latter, once every {{pp|4.5 to 3.5 for 3|1 to 13|formula=4-0.5 every 6 levels, with an up to 0.5-second delay. Cooldown starts upon starting the slam.}} seconds.
E.description4: Enemies made a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} continuously spawn a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} near themselves, when possible. {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} can spawn 300 units closer to each other than when spawned by '''Illaoi'''.
E.description5: '''''Illaoi''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while firing the projectile and while the target's {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is being pulled. She also {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself while firing the projectile if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}. {{as|Vessels|buzzword3}} can dispel their mark by scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against '''Illaoi'''. Test of Spirit cannot be cast again until the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} dies.''

R.name: Leap of Faith
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} and leaps into the air for the cast time. She then slams her idol into the ground, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. For each enemy champion hit, a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} is summoned for 8 seconds (up to a maximum of 6 summons).
R.description2: For the duration, ''{{ais|Harsh Lesson|Illaoi}}'' {{sti|cooldown}} is halved, all {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} awakened by '''Illaoi''' are {{tip|untargetable}}, will not show their hitboxes, nor go dormant, and will take {{fd|0.5}} seconds to make an attack; however they will then incur a lockout of {{fd|0.5}} seconds before being able to start a new attack.
R.description3: ''This does not affect the {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} attack from {{ai|Tentacle Smash|Illaoi}}.''

P.name: Ionian Fervor
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Irelia''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ionian Fervor'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by her {{tip|abilities}}, or if she hits at least one non-champion, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} and ability hits against enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monster|monsters}}, and {{tip|structures}}, and stacking up to 4 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Ionian Fervor:}} For each stack, '''Irelia''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 25|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*4 to 25*4|key=%}}|attack speed}}. At maximum stacks, '''Irelia's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|{{pplevel|10 to 61}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pplevel|10*0.5 to 61*0.5}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}against structures.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Unsteady:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit by ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}}'' or ''{{ais|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}'' initial barrage are {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''Unsteady'' for 5 seconds. The mark can be consumed by ''{{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}''.

Q.name: Bladesurge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' {{tip|dashes}} 100 units through the target enemy's location, and upon collision or dash completion, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and {{tip|heal|heals}} herself. ''Bladesurge'' deals {{as|{{pplevel|50 to 237}} '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description2: ''Bladesurge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.2}} seconds upon collision of targets {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''{{cci|Bladesurge 2.png|Irelia/LoL#Ionian Fervor|Unsteady}}'', and is {{tt|reset|The check's cadence is 0.0625 seconds, or a bit less than 2 game ticks}} if the target dies to or during ''Bladesurge's'' dash.
Q.description3: ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Defiant Dance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' assumes a defensive stance with her blades to {{tip|channel|charge}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which she reduces incoming {{as|physical damage}} by {{pp|40 to 70|key=%}} {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}} and incoming {{as|magic damage}} by {{pp|40*0.5 to 70*0.5|key=%}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.5}}% per 100 AP)}}. Additionally, ''Defiant Dance's'' damage increases over the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds of the channel.
W.description2: ''Defiant Dance'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Defiant Dance's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' swipes her blades in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies around her and within a line, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 0.75|formula=20% per 0.075 seconds. ''This is capped at 0.75 seconds.''}}. She also retains the damage reduction for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
W.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 50*3}} {{as|(+ 120% AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
W.description4: ''Defiant Dance's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. {{ais|Ionian Fervor|Irelia}} duration is paused during the charge; if {{ai|Ionian Fervor|Irelia}} has less than 1 second remaining when the charge starts, it is set to 1 second when the charge ends.''

E.name: Flawless Duet
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' sends a blade to the target location for {{fd|3.5}} seconds. ''Flawless Duet'' can be recast after {{fd|0.15}} seconds while the blade is active, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if ''Flawless Duet'' was recast automatically.
E.description3: Once both blades have been placed, they fly toward each other regardless of distance and converge over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, afterwards dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within a line between them and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
E.description4: ''Flawless Duet's recast can be used during {{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}} and the cast time of {{ai|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}, but is not used automatically while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities. Each of the blades' travel times are {{rutngt|0.25}}.''

R.name: Vanguard's Edge
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' launches a barrage of blades in the target direction, expanding outward upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second.
R.description2: After expanding, the blades drop on the ground, knocking all enemy units away from them, though not rendering them {{tip|airborne}}, and forming a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for {{fd|2.5}} seconds that grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description3: ''The perimeter will point at the same angle '''Irelia''' cast it from, but based on the target's center.''

P.name: Friend of the Forest
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ivern''' cannot attack nor damage non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}. Instead, targeting a jungle camp initiates a {{fd|2.5}} second {{tip|channel}} that will plant a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} upon the camp. Placing a {{as|grove|buzzword2}} costs {{sti|health|{{as|{{pplevel|(15-(x-1)*0.882)/100*({{ccd|Ivern|hp_base}}+{{ccd|Ivern|hp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))|formula = (15% - 0.882% per level after 1) of base health}} health}}}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|{{pplevel|(20-(x-1)*1.175)/100*({{ccd|Ivern|mp_base}}+{{ccd|Ivern|mp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)))|formula = (20% - 1.175% per level after 1) of base mana}} mana}}}}. The channel cannot be cancelled in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds and in the last {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
P.description2: '''''Ivern''' cannot place a grove while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
P.description3: The {{as|grove|buzzword2}} matures over {{pp|40;38;36;34;32;30;27;24;21;18;15;11;7;3;1|formula = 42 - 2 per level until level 6, then 3 until level 11, then 4 until level 15. ''This is capped at 1 second at level 15.''}} seconds. When fully matured, '''Ivern''' can target the camp again to ''free'' it after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]], clearing the camp and receiving the {{tt|{{g|full gold}} and {{sti|experience|{{as|full experience}}}}|Not full when freeing Krug camp, see notes}} [[bounty|bounties]]. Using {{si|Smite}} on a monster within the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will instantly ''free'' the camp regardless of maturity.
P.description4: If the camp's large monster has already been slain prior to planting a {{as|grove|buzzword2}}, '''Ivern''' will ''free'' the camp upon completing the channel at no cost. Similarly, the {{as|grove|buzzword2}} will instantly mature if the large monster is slain.

Q.name: Rootcaller
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' throws a vine in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. ''Rootcaller'' can be recast while the target is {{tip|root|rooted}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}
Q.description2: '''Ivern''' and allied champions can issue an {{tt|attack order|Default: MB2 / right-click}} against the target {{tip|root|rooted}} by ''Rootcaller'' to {{tip|dash}} to their location, stopping at {{sti|their attack range}}.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ivern''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the rooted target.
Q.description4: Hitting a non-epic monster reduces ''Rootcaller's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 50%.

W.name: Brushmaker
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Ivern''' is in {{tip|brush}}, his basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}. This bonus persists for 3 seconds after leaving brush.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' grows a patch of {{tip|brush}} at the target location for 45 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area within and around it for 8 seconds. Brushes despawn instantly after allied {{tip|sight|vision}} within them is lost. Spawning brush near [[terrain]] or other brush increases its radius.
W.description3: While allied champions are in any {{tip|brush}} when '''Ivern''' is within {{tt|1000|Estimated}} units, their basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}. This bonus persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds after leaving brush.
W.leveling3: {{st|Ally Additional Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% of '''Ivern's''' AP)}}}}<!--not on-hit-->
W.description4: '''Ivern''' periodically [[stocks]] a ''Brushmaker'' charge, up to a maximum of 3.

E.name: Triggerseed
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' places a seed on the target allied champion, {{ui|Daisy}}, or himself, granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
E.description2: After 2 seconds, the seed explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
E.description3: If the seed does not damage an enemy champion and the shield persists by the end of the duration, the shield is reapplied for the same strength and duration without the explosion effect.

R.name: Daisy!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' summons his sentinel friend {{ui|Daisy}} to his side, who lands 350 units away from him in the target direction and remains on the field for up to 45 seconds as a controllable {{tip|pet}}.
R.description2: ''Daisy!'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Daisy}} is alive.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Daisy, wait!:}} '''Ivern''' commands {{ui|Daisy}} to move to the target location. If cast on '''Ivern''', {{ui|Daisy}} will follow him.
R.description4: ''The recast of Daisy! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Ivern#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Daisy}}.''

R.name: Daisy, wait!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ivern''' summons his sentinel friend {{ui|Daisy}} to his side, who lands 350 units away from him in the target direction and remains on the field for up to 45 seconds as a controllable {{tip|pet}}.
R.description2: ''Daisy!'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Daisy}} is alive.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Daisy, wait!:}} '''Ivern''' commands {{ui|Daisy}} to move to the target location. If cast on '''Ivern''', {{ui|Daisy}} will follow him.
R.description4: ''The recast of Daisy! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Ivern#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Daisy}}.''

P.name: Tailwind
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Janna''' grants {{sti|ms|{{as|6% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that are facing in the direction of her location.
P.description2: '''Janna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Zephyr|Janna}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|30% of her '''bonus''' movement speed}}.

Q.name: Howling Gale
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration every second over the duration. ''Howling Gale's'' direction is determined by this cast.
Q.description2: ''Howling Gale'' can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Second|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|55+10*3 to 195+30*3}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Janna''' launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=seconds charged|0.5 to 1.25|0 to 1.5 by 0.1}} seconds.

W.name: Zephyr
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Janna''' is {{tip|ghosting|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 175}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' movement speed)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 36}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}}}

E.name: Eye of the Storm
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Janna's''' abilities {{tip|slow}} or {{tip|airborne|knock up}} at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, 20% of ''Eye of the Storm's'' cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' grants the target allied champion or {{tip|turret}}, or herself, a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
E.description3: While the shield holds, the target gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.

R.name: Monsoon
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' unleashes a blast that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain.
R.description2: '''Janna''' also {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and nearby allies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

P.name: Martial Cadence
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jarvan IV's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|8% of the target's '''current''' health}}, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non-{{tip|champion}} targets.
P.description2: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

Q.name: Dragon Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' extends his lance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicting them with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|90 to 250}} {{as|(+ 145% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|10 to 26}}% of target's armor}}}}
Q.description2: If the lance connects with a deployed ''{{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}}'', '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dashes}} to its location, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies around him and along his path for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description3: '''''Jarvan IV''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

W.name: Golden Aegis
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|slow|slows}} all nearby enemies for 2 seconds.
W.description2: '''Jarvan IV''' also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds, increased by {{as|{{fd|1.3}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by ''Golden Aegis''.

E.name: Demacian Standard
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Jarvan IV''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' throws a Demacian flag to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
E.description3: The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and providing an {{tip|aura}} that grants ''Demacian Standard's'' passive {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} to all nearby allied champions as well as '''Jarvan IV''' {{tt|himself|See notes}}.

R.name: Cataclysm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion's location over {{fd|0.35}} seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
R.description2: Upon impact, he creates a circle of impassable terrain that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies within the perimeter over {{fd|0.15}} seconds, knocking them out of the circle if they are on the outer edge and pulling them in otherwise. The terrain lasts for {{fd|3.5}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Cataclysm'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds while the terrain is present.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jarvan IV''' destroys the terrain created by ''Cataclysm''.

P.name: Relentless Assault
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Relentless Assault'' {{tip|on-attack}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.25}} seconds when the duration ends.
P.description2: {{sbc|Relentless Assault:}} For each stack, '''Jax''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|5 to 14 for 7|1 to 19}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|40 to 112 for 7|1 to 19}}|attack speed}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Grandmaster at Angling:}} While out-of-combat with champions and idle in the river for 10 seconds, '''Jax''' will occasionally catch a fish, granting him {{g|1}} and {{as|1 ability power}} for 5 seconds. He catches a fish at an average rate of one every 15 seconds. He also has a 5% chance to catch a [[File:Jax Grandmaster at Angling 2.png|link=|20 px]] rare fish that grants {{g|10}} and {{as|10 ability power}} for 5 seconds.

Q.name: Leap Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target unit's location.
Q.description2: If the target is an enemy and they are in range <!--how many units? center or edge?--> upon arrival, '''Jax''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to them.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|65 to 225}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: '''''Jax''' can cast any of his {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''

W.name: Empower
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Leap Strike|Jax}}'' against an enemy within 10 seconds to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced to 50% against {{tip|structures}}. If ''Empower'' is used on a basic attack, it will gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}.
W.description2: ''Empower {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Jax's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Counter Strike
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' enters ''Evasion'' for 2 seconds: a defensive stance that causes him to {{tip|dodge}} all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all {{tip|area of effect}} {{tip|abilities}} sourced from {{tip|champions}}.

''Counter Strike'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jax''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, with the '''total''' damage increased by 20% for each attack dodged, up to a 100% increase, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 160}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 160*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}

R.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' {{tip|on-hit}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and consume all stacks to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced to 50% against {{tip|structures}}. While ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' is active, the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' swings his lantern around, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits a champion, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, increased for each champion hit beyond the first, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to 60% of that amount as well as 10% increased {{tip|size}} for 8 seconds.
R.description3: '''''Jax''' can move during Grandmaster-at-Arms' cast time.''

P.name: Hextech Capacitor
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jayce''' switches between either {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Hammer|Jayce|Hammer Stance}}}} or {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Cannon|Jayce|Cannon Stance}}}}, he gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|30 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

P.name: Hextech Capacitor 2
P.description: {{Data Jayce/Hextech Capacitor|pst2|description}}

Q.name: To the Skies!
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target enemy's location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, he smashes his hammer to the ground to deal {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies within an area and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
Q.description2: ''To the Skies!'' deals {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description3: ''{{ai|Lightning Field|Jayce}} can be cast during the dash.''

Q.name: Shock Blast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' fires an electric bolt in the target direction that detonates upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
Q.description2: If the bolt passes through ''{{ai|Acceleration Gate|Jayce}}'', it becomes supercharged: increasing its {{ccs|damage by 40%|physical}} as well as its speed, range and explosion radius.
Q.description3: ''Shock Blast'' deals {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Lightning Field
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Jayce's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' surrounds himself with an electric field for 4 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|35 to 110 6}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|35*4 to 110*4 6}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}

W.name: Hyper Charge
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' empowers his next 3 [[basic attack]]s within 4 seconds to deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and gain {{sti|attack speed|{{as|360% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.

''Hyper Charge's'' '''total''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|70 to 110 6}}% AD}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|70*3 to 110*3 6}}% AD}}}}
W.description2: ''Hyper Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Jayce's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Thundering Blow
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy over the cast time, then swings his hammer at them to deal {{as|magic damage}}, capped against {{tip|monsters}}, and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 600 units.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 22 6}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|200 to 700 6}}}}
E.description3: '''''Jayce''' is unable to cast {{ai|To the Skies!|Jayce}} or {{ai|Shock Blast|Jayce}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Thundering Blow's cast time.''

E.name: Acceleration Gate
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' deploys an energy gate centered at the target location, lasting for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. '''Jayce''' and allied champions can move through the gate to gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing continuously while within the gate.

R.name: Transform Mercury Cannon
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|500 attack range}}, and empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} to reduce the target's {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by {{pp|key=%|20 to 35 for 4|1 to 16}} for 5 seconds.
R.description2: {{Data Jayce/Transform Mercury Hammer|pst2|description2}}

R.name: Transform Mercury Hammer
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Hammer.png||{{sbc|Hammer Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|melee}} with {{sti|125 attack range}}, gaining {{pp|5 to 26 for 4|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{fd|7.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, and empowering his next basic attack to deal {{as|{{pp|25 to 130 for 4|1 to 16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
R.description2: '''Jayce''' begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic {{tip|abilities}} each have 6 ranks.

P.name: Whisper
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Death In 4 Acts:}} '''Jhin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} consume [[ammunition]] within 4 rounds. He will reload over {{fd|2.5}} seconds immediately after expending all rounds or withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being [[out of combat]] and not being affected by {{tip|crowd control}}. The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability. '''Jhin''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time.
P.description2: '''Jhin's''' final round attack has an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, always {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, including against {{tip|turrets|structures}}, and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|15 to 25 for 3|1 to 11}} of the target's {{sti|'''missing''' health}}}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 800 against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|4;5;6;7;8;9;10;11;12;14;16;20;24;28;32;36;40;44|formula = 4% at + 1% per level up to 9, then + 2% up to 11, then + 4%, capped at level 18}}|attack damage}}<!--stops at 18-->{{ft|{{as|(+ {{fd|0.35}}% per 1% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.3}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}|{{as|(+ 35% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}{{as|AD}}.
P.description4: Additionally, {{tip|critical strikes}} against enemies grant '''Jhin''' {{as|14%|movement speed}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.44}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.

Q.name: Dancing Grenade
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' throws a grenade at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, prioritizing the closest enemy that has not been hit.
Q.description2: The grenade's damage is increased by 35% any time an enemy dies by any means after being hit by the grenade before it strikes its next target.

W.name: Deadly Flourish
W.description: {{Anchor|Caught Out}}{{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.75 to 210*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|37.5}}% AD)}}}}
W.description3: Hitting a ''marked'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' {{ais|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.

W.name: Caught Out
W.description: {{Anchor|Caught Out}}{{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.75 to 210*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|37.5}}% AD)}}}}
W.description3: Hitting a ''marked'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' {{ais|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.

E.name: Captive Audience
E.description: {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 4 seconds.
E.description3: '''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description4: ''Blooming Lotus Traps'' {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
E.description5: ''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''

R.name: Curtain Call
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}. The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.
R.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64 to 192}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64*4 to 192*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*4}}% AD)}}}}
R.description3: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
R.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|64*2 to 192*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|(64*2)*4 to (192*2)*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25*2)*4}}% AD)}}}}

R.name: Curtain Call 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}. The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.

R.description3: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.

P.name: Get Excited!
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jinx''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, {{tip|turret}}, or [[inhibitor]] within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|175% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 6 seconds.
P.description2: Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} and gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Get Excited!'' for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can grant stacks beyond the first.
P.description3: {{sbc|Get Excited!:}} For each stack, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|{{as|25% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{ap|25*5}}%|as}}.

Q.name: Switcheroo!
Q.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Jinx''' switches between ''{{cci|Pow-Pow.png|Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow}}'', her minigun, and ''{{cci|Fishbones.png|Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones}}'', her rocket launcher.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Pow-Pow:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} with ''Pow-Pow'' generate a {{tip|stack}} of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with ''Pow-Pow'' and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of ''Rev'd up'' grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30/2 to 130/2}}%|Attack Speed per Subsequent Stack|{{ap|30/4 to 130/4}}%|Maximum Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 130}}%}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Fishbones:}} Basic attacks with ''Fishbones'' cost {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|110% AD}} {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. While ''Fishbones'' is equipped, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} but loses {{sti|{{as|10% of her '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
Q.description4: ''Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up''.
