W.name: Zap!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a shock blast in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it hits and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
W.cast time: {{pp|0.6 to 0.4 for 11|0 to 250|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|color=attack speed}}

E.name: Flame Chompers!
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.

E.name: Flame Chompers! 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.

R.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight into brush nor through terrain}} and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals {{as|physical damage}} to {{tt|nearby|centered on the initial target}} enemies and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can grant sight into brush and through terrain}} for 2 seconds.
R.description2: ''Super Mega Death Rocket!'' deals {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|10 to 100 for 16|0 to 1500}} damage. This does not affect the '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
R.description3: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage. The '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}} is capped at 1200 against {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}

P.name: Dauntless Instinct
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''K'Sante's''' {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. His {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark, dealing {{as|12|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|1 to 2|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio deals a minimum of {{pplevel|10 + 5*x}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and is capped at {{pplevel|15 + 5*x}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attacks and {{tip|ability damage}}, as well as ''Dauntless Instinct's'' mark consumption, are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Ntofo Strikes
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' slams his ntofo down in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy, '''K'Sante''' generates a {{tip|stack}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Ntofo Strikes'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Empowered Active:}} '''K'Sante''' fires a shockwave in the target direction that applies the same effects to enemies hit, but also {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them towards him over {{fd|0.65}} seconds and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} ''Ntofo Strikes' '' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 33%<!--, with a minimum total cooldown of {{fd|1.33}} seconds (hard coded, make visible if the % reduction would otherwise put it below 1.33)-->. Upon entering ''All Out'', ''Ntofo Strikes' '' stacks are reset. ''Ntofo Strikes' '' {{sti|cooldown}} is reset if '''K'Sante''' had 2 stacks before entering ''All Out''.
Q.description5: ''Ntofo Strikes {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attack timer.''
Q.cast time: {{pp|0.45 to 0.35 by 0.01|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cast time|label1=bonus resistances|formula= 0.45 - (1/1200) × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.}}
Q.static: {{dv|{{pp|3.5 to 2 by 0.05|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cooldown|label1=bonus resistances|formula= 3.5 - 0.0125 × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.}}|{{pp|3.5*2/3 to 2*2/3 by 0.3/9|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cooldown|label1=bonus resistances|formula= During All Out. 3.5 * 2 / 3 - (0.0125 * 2 / 3) × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.|showtype=false}}}}

W.name: Path Maker
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' raises his ntofos defensively and prepares to {{tip|dash}} in the target direction, {{tip|channel|charging}} for a minimum of {{fd|0.4}} seconds and up to 1 second. During this time, he gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} and 30% damage reduction; additionally, ''Path Maker's'' range, {{tip|stun}} duration, and ''{{ai|All Out|K'Sante}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} modifier increase over the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds of the channel.
W.description2: ''Path Maker'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Path Maker's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the direction he targeted at the time of cast, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through, {{tip|airborne|carrying}} them alongside him, and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|label1=Channel duration|0.5 to 1.75 for 11|0.4 to 0.9|formula=0.5 + 0.125 for every 0.05 seconds channeling, capped at 0.9 seconds.}} seconds. This damage is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ 8%|hp}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}{{st|Monster Damage Cap|{{ap|180 to 500}}}}
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} ''Path Maker'' no longer applies its {{tip|airborne|knock back}} and {{tip|stun}}, but its damage reduction is increased to 75%, the dash deals {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|key=%|type=channel time|label1=Channel duration|10 to 80|0.4 to 0.9 by 0.05|formula=10% + 7% for every 0.05 seconds channeling, capped at 0.9 seconds.}} '''bonus''' true damage}}}}, and the dash speed is increased by 20%. Upon entering ''All Out'', ''Path Maker's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is refreshed.
W.leveling4: {{st|Minimum Bonus True Damage|{{ap|45*0.1 to 165*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.1}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Maximum Bonus True Damage|{{ap|45*0.8 to 165*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.8}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Maximum Mixed Damage|{{ap|45*1.8 to 165*1.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*1.8}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*1.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*1.8}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description5: ''{{ai|Ntofo Strikes|K'Sante}} and {{ai|All Out|K'Sante}} can be cast during the dash. Path Maker's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

E.name: Footwork
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, though not through terrain, and grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
E.description2: ''Footwork'' can also be cast on allies with increased range and speed, and the ability to {{tip|dash}} through terrain. If the target ally is a {{tip|champion}}, they receive the {{tip|shield}} as well.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} ''Footwork's'' dash speed is increased, and its cooldown is reduced by 50%.
E.description4: '''''K'Sante''' can cast any of his {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''

R.name: All Out
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Duration unaffected by tenacity}} and gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time. He then shatters his ntofos, {{tip|airborne|pulling}} the target to a location that is 300 units in the cast direction from their location at the time of cast, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and {{tip|blink|blinking}} {{tt|175 units|Beyond the target's hitbox's edge}} behind that location. The target is dealt {{as|physical damage}} near the end of the displacement and is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.3}} seconds once it ends.
R.description2: If there is {{tt|valid map-generated terrain|Terrain that has an opposite side (non-border) and is not player-generated.}} 350 units in the cast direction from the target's location at the time of cast, the target is instead {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to a location that is directly 450 units away from the edge of the other side of the terrain and '''K'Sante''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} 100 units behind that location, dealing them the {{as|physical damage}} near their emergence from the terrain. At the end of the displacement, they remain {{tip|airborne}} for {{rutngt|0.25}}, after which they are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. '''K'Sante''' strikes them after {{rutngt|0.125}} into the airborne duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Strike Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 150}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|80*2 to 150*2}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: After '''K'Sante''' {{tip|blink|blinks}}, he enters ''All Out'' for 15 seconds.
R.description4:
{{sbc|All Out:}} '''K'Sante''' gains a [[Health#Health_threshold|health threshold]] equal to {{sti|{{as|65% '''maximum''' health}}}} which cannot be {{tt|modified|By increases or decreases to maximum health}} nor {{tt|exceeded|By healing and health regeneration}} by any means. Upon entering ''All Out'', his {{as|'''current''' health}} is reduced to this threshold if it is above it. Additionally, his {{sti|armor|{{as|'''base''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''base''' magic resistance}}}} are reduced by {{as|85% '''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|85% '''bonus''' magic resistance}}, respectively. In return, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|lethality|{{as|50% {{tt|'''bonus'''-armor penetration|Affects bonus armor only}}}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|20% omnivamp}}}}, and modifies his {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} which can be cast at no cost.

Upon entering ''All Out'', '''K'Sante''' is restored to {{as|100% '''maximum''' mana}}. His {{as|mana}} then decays to {{as|0|mana}} over the duration of the buff, after which the {{tt|amount of {{as|mana}}|Preserves the exact amount of mana, not his mana percentage at the time}} he had {{tt|prior to entering ''All Out''|After paying All Out's mana cost}} is restored.
R.leveling4: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}
R.description5: '''''K'Sante''' retains his {{as|'''maximum''' health}} and '''bonus''' resistances during All Out. Health lost from gaining the health threshold is '''not''' restored after the effect ends. If the target is pulled over terrain, '''K'Sante''' will {{tip|vanish}} during their displacement and reappear near the end of it.''

P.name: Second Skin
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Weapon:}} '''Kai'Sa''' can evolve each of her {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} by gaining a set amount of permanent [[Champion statistic|stats]] from [[item]]s and {{tt|stat growth|Includes all stats gained when leveling (including base AD gained), but does not include stats at level 1.}}, granting them additional effects. Evolving an ability causes her to enter a 2-second [[cast time]]. The upgrade is lost if the stat requirement is no longer met.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Plasma:}} '''Kai'Sa's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' apply {{tip|stacks}} of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times. Basic attacks each apply 1 stack and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' applies 2 stacks, increased to 3 if it is {{ai|Void Seeker 2|Kai'Sa|evolved}}. Her and nearby allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects and {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} will also apply a stack of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Caustic Wounds:}} {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} stacks applied by '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attacks or ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' deal {{as|{{pplevel|4 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} plus {{as|{{pplevel|1 to 8}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{as|per Plasma stack before application|buzzword}}, up to a total of {{as|{{pplevel|(4+1*4) to (30+8*4)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12+3*4}}% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} at {{as|4 Plasma stacks before application|buzzword}}. The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

Q.name: Icathian Rain
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' releases a swarm of 6 missiles that evenly distributes among nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each one hitting their target after {{fd|0.4}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}}. {{tip|Minions}} below {{sti|health|{{as|35% health}}}} take double damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Missile|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Non-minions take {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage from missiles beyond their first.
Q.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|dam_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack damage}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100 attack damage}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Icathian Rain'' instead fires 12 missiles.
Q.description4: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability.''

Q.name: Icathian Rain 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' releases a swarm of 6 missiles that evenly distributes among nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each one hitting their target after {{fd|0.4}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}}. {{tip|Minions}} below {{sti|health|{{as|35% health}}}} take double damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Missile|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Non-minions take {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage from missiles beyond their first.
Q.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|dam_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack damage}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100 attack damage}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Icathian Rain'' instead fires 12 missiles.
Q.description4: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability.''

W.name: Void Seeker
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' fires a void bolt in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels, deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, applies {{as|2 Plasma|buzzword}}, and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires {{sti|{{as|100 ability power}}}} from [[items]] to upgrade – ''Void Seeker'' applies {{as|3 Plasma|buzzword}} instead and refunds 75% of its {{sti|cooldown}} if it hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.

W.name: Void Seeker 2
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' fires a void bolt in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels, deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, applies {{as|2 Plasma|buzzword}}, and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires {{sti|{{as|100 ability power}}}} from [[items]] to upgrade – ''Void Seeker'' applies {{as|3 Plasma|buzzword}} instead and refunds 75% of its {{sti|cooldown}} if it hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.

E.name: Supercharge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed.}}|as}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Minimum Movement Speed|{{ap|55 to 75}}%|Maximum Movement Speed|{{ap|55*2 to 75*2}}%}}
E.description2: After completing the charge, she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed.
E.description3: ''Supercharge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds {{tip|on-attack}}.
E.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|as|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|key=%|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|as_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack speed}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100% attack speed}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Supercharge'' grants {{tip|invisibility}} at the start of the cast time for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

E.name: Supercharge 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed.}}|as}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Minimum Movement Speed|{{ap|55 to 75}}%|Maximum Movement Speed|{{ap|55*2 to 75*2}}%}}
E.description2: After completing the charge, she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed.
E.description3: ''Supercharge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds {{tip|on-attack}}.
E.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|as|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|key=%|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|as_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack speed}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100% attack speed}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Supercharge'' grants {{tip|invisibility}} at the start of the cast time for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

R.name: Killer Instinct
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a target location near a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion that was {{tt|affected|Stack application or consumption}} by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} within the last 4 seconds. The shield's duration is refreshed when the dash ends.
R.description2: ''An enemy champion within range and affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Killer Instinct {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attack timer. '''Kai'Sa''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''

P.name: Martial Poise
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Kalista''' inputs a {{tt|movement command|Default MB2/right click}} during her {{tip|attack windup|basic attack windup}} or shortly after it completes, or while in cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'', she will {{tip|dash}} in that direction.

'''''Kalista''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, and she will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
P.description2:
''Martial Poise'''s dash range and speed details:
* Dash range of basic attacks is modified by the tier of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]] and the angle of the dash.
** At a 0° angle towards the target, the minimum dash range is {{pp|140;153;166;175|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units.
** At a 90° angle, the maximum dash range is {{pp|240;263;280;300|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units.
* Dash range of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' is 300 units when dashing anywhere in the direction of the point of cast.
** If the dash is inputted to a location that is ''away'' from ''{{ais|Pierce|Kalista}}'' point of cast, the dash range is reduced based on the angle, with a minimum distance of 150 units if the inputted location is {{tt|directly opposite|Backwards dash}}.
* Dash speed is increased based on the {{tt|tier|+75 for Boots and +135 for finished Boots}} of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]], and is affected by her {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} modifiers she is under the effect of (including {{tip|slow|slows}}).
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Oathsworn Bond:}} '''Kalista''' begins the game with an exclusive ''{{ii|Black Spear}}'' that she can activate on an allied champion to deem them ''Oathsworn'', forming a {{tip|tether}} together. While she and the ally bound as the ''Oathsworn'' are within tether range of each other, they can both interact with ''{{ai|Sentinel 3|Kalista|Soul-Mark}}'' and ''{{ai|Fate's Call|Kalista}}''.
P.description4: '''''Kalista''' can purchase the {{ii|Black Spear}} from the [[shop]] at no cost to obtain it again and, before 3 minutes of game time, may activate the item again on a different target to designate a new Oathsworn. See {{ii|Black Spear}} for more details.''

Q.name: Pierce
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' launches a spear in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: If ''Pierce'' kills the target, the spear continues onward to transfer all of the target's ''{{ai|Rend|Kalista}}'' stacks to the next enemy it hits.

W.name: Sentinel
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Soul-Marked:}} While '''Kalista''' and her ''{{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}}'' are {{tip|tether|tethered}}, their basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a ''Soul-Mark'' to the target hit for 4 seconds.
W.description2: If both '''Kalista's''' and the ''Oathsworn's'' ''Soul-Mark'' are applied to the same enemy, the marks are consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target, capped against non-champions. ''Soul-Mark'' cannot affect an enemy more than once every few seconds.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 18}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Maximum Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' summons a ''Sentinel'' that patrols back and forth on a path along the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings as it travels.
W.description4: '''Kalista''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Sentinel'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
W.description5: ''See [[Kalista#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Sentinels.''

E.name: Rend
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kalista's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rend'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 254 times per enemy.
E.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' rips out the lodged spears from all nearby enemies afflicted with ''Rend'' stacks, consuming the stacks on each target to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds. For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional {{as|physical damage}}. ''Rend'' deals 50% damage against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

''Rend's'' cast also empowers the in-flight missiles of '''Kalista's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' to apply ''Rend's'' effects to their targets immediately upon hitting them.
E.description3: If ''Rend'' kills at least one target, its {{sti|cooldown}} is reset and '''Kalista''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
E.description4: ''A nearby enemy with a Rend stack is required to cast this ability.''

R.name: Fate's Call
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' invokes her {{ii|The Black Spear|tether}} to retrieve and hold her ''Oathsworn'' for 4 seconds. '''Kalista''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} the ''Oathsworn'' from all {{tip|crowd control}} and renders them {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for the duration, and {{tip|dash|pulls}} them to her over 1 second.
R.description2: While held, the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|vanish|vanished}} and may {{tt|select|Default MB1 / left-click}} a target location to {{tip|dash}} to with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, ending ''Fate's Call's'' invocation and reappearing at the location. If the invocation ends without the ''Oathsworn'' selecting a target location, they will automatically do so at maximum range from '''Kalista's''' facing direction.
R.description3: The ''Oathsworn's'' dash stops upon colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Upon the dash ending by collision or arriving to the targeted location, the ''Oathsworn'' {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies and keeps them {{tip|airborne}} for a set duration, while simultaneously {{tip|lunge|landing}} to their {{sti|attack range|'''base''' attack range}} {{tt|from the closest target hit|See notes}}.
R.description4: ''The Oathsworn must be within tether range to cast this ability, and is also {{tip|silence|silenced}} and unable to perform movement or attack commands while Fate's Call is in effect.''

P.name: Gathering Fire
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} ''{{ais|Mantra|Karma}}'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds for each enemy champion hit by '''Karma's''' damaging {{tip|abilities}}.

Q.name: Inner Flame
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' fires a bolt in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

Q.name: Soulflare
Q.description: {{sbc|{{ai|Mantra|Karma}} Bonus:}} ''Inner Flame'' deals increased damage, and fires a larger bolt that also explodes at maximum range.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40 to 220 4}}}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 260 5}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40 to 220 4}}}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|70+30}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: The explosion creates a field for {{fd|1.5}} seconds that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 50%, which then ruptures to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40 to 310 4}}}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Bonus Damage|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40+40 to 220+310 4}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+30}}% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|60 to 260}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40+40 to 220+310 4}}}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|70+50+30}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Soulflare'' scales with ''{{ais|Mantra|Karma}}'' rank.

W.name: Focused Resolve
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|pet}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and them for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
W.description2: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and is {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 140*2}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}

W.name: Renewal
W.description:
{{sbc|{{ai|Mantra|Karma}} Bonus:}} ''Focused Resolve's'' {{tip|root}} duration is increased.

'''Karma''' {{tip|heal|heals}} for {{sti|health|{{as|17% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of her '''missing''' health}}}} once on-cast, and again once the tether lasts its full duration or the target dies while tethered.
W.leveling: {{st|Root Duration Increase|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|0.5 to 1.25 4}}}} seconds|Total Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|0.5 to 1.25 4}}}}) seconds}}
W.description2: ''Renewal'' scales with ''{{ais|Mantra|Karma}}'' rank.

E.name: Inspire
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to herself or the target allied champion for {{fd|2.5}} seconds as well as {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.

E.name: Defiance
E.description:
{{sbc|{{ai|Mantra|Karma}} - Active:}} ''Inspire'' grants a bonus amount of shielding.

''Inspire'' spreads to surrounding allied champions, granting them a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and {{sti|ms|{{as|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Primary Target Shield|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|45 to 165 4}}}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Primary Target Shield|{{ap|80 to 280}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|45 to 165 4}}}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|60+45}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Secondary Target Shield|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|45*1.0 to 165*1.0 4}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45*1.0}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: ''Defiance'' scales with ''{{ais|Mantra|Karma}}'' rank.

R.name: Mantra
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' empowers her next basic ability within 8 seconds for an additional effect.
R.description2:
'''Karma''' begins the game with one rank in ''Mantra''. Her empowered abilities scale based on ''Mantra's'' rank.

''Mantra can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

P.name: Death Defied
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Karthus''' enters a '''{{tip|zombie state}}''' for 7 seconds, during which he can cast his abilities at no cost. If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration. ''{{ai|Requiem|Karthus}}'' becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.
P.description2: While under this state, '''Karthus''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[Active ability items|activate items]].

Q.name: Lay Waste
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karthus''' conjures a blast at the target location that detonates after {{tt|{{rutngt|0.5}}{{minus}}{{rutngt|0.75}}|See notes}}, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within, {{ccs|doubled|magic}} when only one target is struck.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 116}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Enhanced Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 116*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Wall of Pain
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karthus''' erects a wall of pain at the target location perpendicular to his facing that lasts 5 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} around its pillars and center.
W.description2: Enemies that touch the wall are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|25% magic resistance reduction}}}} and become {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 5 seconds, decaying over the duration. This can affect enemies only once per cast.

E.name: Defile
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Karthus''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} whenever he kills an enemy.
E.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Karthus''' surrounds himself in a necrotic [[aura]] that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all nearby enemies.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30/4 to 110/4}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Damage Per Second|{{ap|30 to 110}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
E.description3: Toggling ''Defile'' off triggers a final tick of damage. ''Defile'' is toggled off automatically if '''Karthus''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
E.description4: ''Defile cannot be toggled off during {{ai|Death Defied|Karthus}}.''

R.name: Requiem
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karthus''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 3 seconds, then deals {{as|magic damage}} to all targetable enemy champions upon completion.

P.name: Void Stone
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kassadin''' is permanently {{tip|ghosted}} and takes 10% reduced {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}}.

Q.name: Null Sphere
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' fires an orb of void energy at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} their ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}.
Q.description2: He also gains a {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{as|magic damage}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Shield Strength|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}

W.name: Nether Blade
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kassadin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|25|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' empowers his next basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal increased {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}, with the restoration amount quintupled against {{tip|champion|champions}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|4 to 6}}% of '''missing''' mana}}|Mana Restored Against Champions|{{as|{{ap|4*5 to 6*5}}% of '''missing''' mana}}}}
W.description3: ''Nether Blade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kassadin's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Force Pulse
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Each time '''Kassadin''' or a nearby {{tip|champion}} casts an [[champion ability|ability]], ''Force Pulse's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' emits a pulse of void energy in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 1 second.

R.name: Riftwalk
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' {{tip|blinks}} toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival. He then gains a stack of ''Riftwalk'' for 15 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 4 times.
R.description2: {{sbc|Riftwalk:}} For each stack, ''Riftwalk'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} at an increased {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Damage Per Stack|{{ap|35 to 55}} {{as|(+ 7% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% '''maximum''' mana)}}|Maximum Bonus Damage|{{ap|35*4 to 55*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7*4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% '''maximum''' mana)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|80+35*4 to 110+55*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+7*4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' mana)}}}}

P.name: Voracity
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she slashes around herself to deal {{pplevel|68;72;77;82;89;96;103;112;121;131;142;154;166;180;194;208;224;240;257;275<!--|formula=???-->|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|key=%|70 to 100 for 4|1 to 16}} AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''current''' cooldown by {{pp|key=%|78 to 96 for 4|1 to 16}} of its '''total''' cooldown.
P.description4: {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} grant {{tip|sight}} of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.

P.name: Sinister Steel
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she slashes around herself to deal {{pplevel|68;72;77;82;89;96;103;112;121;131;142;154;166;180;194;208;224;240;257;275<!--|formula=???-->|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|key=%|70 to 100 for 4|1 to 16}} AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''current''' cooldown by {{pp|key=%|78 to 96 for 4|1 to 16}} of its '''total''' cooldown.
P.description4: {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} grant {{tip|sight}} of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.

Q.name: Bouncing Blade
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' throws a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. Upon arrival, the {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} also bounces to up to two additional {{tip|sight|visible}} nearby enemies, dealing the same damage and travelling to bounce targets over {{fd|0.15}} seconds each time.
Q.description2: The {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} lands {{rutngt|1}} after striking the first target, {{tt|about 350 units|slightly random location}} opposite from their position when it struck them.

W.name: Preparation
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' tosses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} into the air above her current location and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays until it lands after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} for the same duration.

E.name: Shunpo
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|blinks}} to a target location near the unit or {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy in range and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
E.description2: '''Katarina''' prioritizes blinking to the location near {{as|Daggers|buzzword}}, then enemy champions, then enemy non-champions, and then any other unit.
E.description3: ''Shunpo {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Katarina's''' basic attack timer.

R.name: Death Lotus
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, rapidly throwing a dagger every {{fd|0.166}} seconds to up to 3 of the closest nearby enemy champions, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process.

Each dagger deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced in effectiveness, and inflicts {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} on the target for 3 seconds.
R.description2: ''An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 500 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''

P.name: Divine Ascent
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayle''' ascends through four forms that each grant additional bonuses. She ascends upon spending a skill point at {{stil|experience|levels}} 1, 6, 11, and 16.
P.description2: {{sbc|Level 1 - Zealous:}} '''Kayle's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zeal'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 5 times. For each stack, she gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|6%|attack speed}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{sti|attack speed|{{as|30%|attack speed}}}}. At max stacks, she becomes ''Exalted'', gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Level 6 - Arisen:}} '''Kayle''' becomes {{tip|ranged}} and gains {{sti|range|350 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|525}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Level 11 - Aflame:}} '''Kayle''' gains 10% bonus {{tip|size}}. While '''Kayle''' is ''Exalted'', her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} also launch a ''wave'' of fire forward that deals {{pplevel|20+3*(x-1)|11+x-1|formula=20 + 3 for every  level starting from level 11|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies it passes through. The ''wave'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description5: {{sbc|Level 16 - Transcendent:}} '''Kayle''' gains an additional {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|625}}, and permanently gains the full effects of ''Zealous''.

P.name: Divine Ascent 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayle''' ascends through four forms that each grant additional bonuses. She ascends upon spending a skill point at {{stil|experience|levels}} 1, 6, 11, and 16.
P.description2: {{sbc|Level 1 - Zealous:}} '''Kayle's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zeal'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 5 times. For each stack, she gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|6%|attack speed}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{sti|attack speed|{{as|30%|attack speed}}}}. At max stacks, she becomes ''Exalted'', gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Level 6 - Arisen:}} '''Kayle''' becomes {{tip|ranged}} and gains {{sti|range|350 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|525}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Level 11 - Aflame:}} '''Kayle''' gains 10% bonus {{tip|size}}. While '''Kayle''' is ''Exalted'', her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} also launch a ''wave'' of fire forward that deals {{pplevel|20+3*(x-1)|11+x-1|formula=20 + 3 for every  level starting from level 11|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies it passes through. The ''wave'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description5: {{sbc|Level 16 - Transcendent:}} '''Kayle''' gains an additional {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} for a total of {{sti|range|625}}, and permanently gains the full effects of ''Zealous''.

Q.name: Radiant Blast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' conjures a portal in front of her that faces the target direction, from which, after 0.25 seconds, a celestial sword launches forward.
Q.description2: The sword expands upon hitting an enemy, with targets struck in the area dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 2 seconds, and inflicted with 15% '''reduced''' {{sti|armor|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds. <!-- Changed the lethality and magic pen icons to armor and magic resistance icons. Shred is not the same as penetration: The former interacts with a stat, while the latter IS a stat. This change should be applied in general, I think. -->
Q.cast time: {{tt|Attack Windup Time|Cast time is equal to this period.}}

W.name: Celestial Blessing
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' and the target allied champion are {{tip|heal|healed}} and gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds from the start of the cast time.
W.leveling:
{{st|Heal|{{ap|55 to 155}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|24 to 40}}% {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description2: If cast without a valid target, or [[self-targeted|self-cast]], ''Celestial Blessing'' will automatically target the closest allied champion in range, prioritizing the one with the lowest {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
W.description3: '''''Kayle''' can move during Celestial Blessing's cast time.''

E.name: Starfire Spellblade
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kayle''' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' kindles her blade, empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal additional {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} that is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}. If '''Kayle''' is not yet ''{{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Arisen}}'', this attack becomes {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|range|525 range}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 10}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Divine Ascent|Kayle|Aflame}} Bonus:}} The attack explodes upon the target, dealing its damage to surrounding enemies and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. This is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.description4: ''Starfire Spellblade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kayle's''' basic attack timer. Starfire Spellblade does not deal bonus damage against [[structure|structures]].''

R.name: Divine Judgment
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' grants herself or a target allied champion {{tip|invulnerable|invulnerability}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds from the start of the cast time, and conjures flaming swords around herself.
R.description2: After {{fd|2.5}} seconds, she rains the swords down around the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
R.description3: '''''Kayle''' can move during Divine Judgment's cast time.''
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|160 to 80}}|Begins at the start of cast time}}

P.name: The Darkin Scythe
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayn''' has a secondary {{tt|experience bar|Additional info in the notes below}} that tracks progress toward his {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}} forms. He gathers orbs from champion {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} and each instance of damage (excluding {{tip|damage over time}}) dealt against champions. Once he has earned enough orbs, he unlocks a form based on whether he earned more from {{tip|melee}} or {{tip|ranged}} champions (for {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}}, respectively), with the other form unlocked later.
P.description2:
While near his team's [[Spawn|summoning platform]], '''Kayn''' {{tt|can choose a form|By clicking on the portrait in the HUD}} to enter transformation over 6 seconds, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. At the end of the transformation he is restored to full {{as|health}} and {{as|mana}}. The transformation will grant a passive bonus and permanently empower some of '''Kayn's''' abilities based on the form chosen. He gains a one-time [[Homeguard]] once the transformation is complete.

'''''Kayn''' cannot activate the transformation while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
P.description3: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} Upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions, '''Kayn''' becomes empowered for 3 seconds to deal {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 40}} of {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage dealt against enemy champions as {{tip|magic damage|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}}}. This effect cannot trigger again until '''Kayn''' has been out of combat with champions for over 8 seconds, with the timer being reset if he recasts ''{{ai|Umbral Trespass|Kayn}}''.
P.description4: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} '''Rhaast''' {{tip|heals}} for 25% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}} that he deals to enemy champions with his {{tip|abilities}}.

Q.name: Reaping Slash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through. He then swings his scythe, dealing the same damage to nearby enemies.

Q.description3: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Reaping Slash's'' damage is modified to deal {{as|65% AD}} {{as|(+ 6% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} with each hit, for a total of {{as|{{ap|65*2}}% AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5*2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}. E.name: Shadow Step
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus total''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|ghosting}} and the ability to ignore terrain collision for a duration. If he has been [[combat status|in combat]] with enemy champions within the last 3 seconds, ''Shadow Step'' will instead last {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: '''Kayn''' {{tip|heals}} himself upon entering terrain for the first time from casting ''Shadow Step'' and he gains {{tip|unobstructed vision}} while inside.
E.description3: Receiving damage from or dealing damage to an enemy {{tip|champion}} while ''Shadow Step'' is active reduces its remaining duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds. This effect also cannot remain active out of terrain for longer than {{fd|1.5}} seconds and will cancel immediately if '''Kayn''' performs a [[basic attack]] or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}.
E.description4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Shadow Step's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 10 seconds at all ranks. '''Kayn''' gains 100% {{tip|slow resist}} while active and, upon entering terrain, the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} is increased to {{as|70%|ms}} for the remaining duration.

R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kayn''' ''marks'' enemy champions he damaged in the last {{fd|3.15}} seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a ''marked'' enemy champion over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|attach|attaching}} himself to them at the end of the dash. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his arrival, he {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 2 seconds, during which the target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Umbral Trespass'' can be recast during the channel after {{fd|0.1}} seconds have elapsed, and does so automatically after the duration or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} After a delay of {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds to {{fd|0.75}} seconds|See notes}}, '''Kayn''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to the target and {{tip|dash|dashes}} out from their body in the target direction, detaching himself from them and becoming targetable again at the end of the dash.
R.description4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' gains 200 '''bonus''' cast range and emerge range. Additionally, emerging will reset ''{{ai|The Darkin Scythe A|Kayn|The Darkin Scythe's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description5: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' is modified to deal {{as|physical damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 10% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, and also {{tip|heals}} '''Rhaast''' for {{as|{{ap|15*0.75}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.75}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} after the recast's delay.

R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a ''marked'' enemy champion over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|attach|attaching}} himself to them at the end of the dash. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his arrival, he {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 2 seconds, during which the target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Umbral Trespass'' can be recast during the channel after {{fd|0.1}} seconds have elapsed, and does so automatically after the duration or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.

R.description5: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' is modified to deal {{as|physical damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 10% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, and also {{tip|heals}} '''Rhaast''' for {{as|{{ap|15*0.75}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.75}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} after the recast's delay.

P.name: Mark of the Storm
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: The third stack against a target consumes them all to {{tip|stun}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and restore {{sti|{{as|25 energy}}}}. The stun duration is reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds if this occurs on the same target again within 6 seconds.
P.description3: ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} can apply only up to 3 stacks on a target.''

Q.name: Thundering Shuriken
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.

W.name: Electrical Surge
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a stack of ''Electrical Surge'', stacking up to 4 times. At 4 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes all stacks to both deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a stack of ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|140|40}}|critical damage}} damage.
'''Kennen''' gains maximum stacks of ''Electrical Surge'' upon [[death|respawning]].
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' sends out a surge of electricity that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies afflicted by ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' or within ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}}''.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80 to 120}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
W.description3: ''An enemy within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 775 units with {{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}} or inside {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be targeted by this ability.''

E.name: Lightning Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' turns into lightning for 2 seconds, becoming unable to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|100% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. He deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 65% against non-champions, and restores {{sti|{{as|40 energy}}}} upon damaging at least one enemy.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|80*0.65 to 240*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*0.65}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: ''Lightning Rush'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Kennen''' ends ''Lightning Rush'' to gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and be allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} by the amount gained for 4 seconds. {{tip|Critical strikes}} extend the {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed's}} duration by 1 second, up to the original duration.
E.description4: ''Lightning Rush's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

R.name: Slicing Maelstrom
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kennen''' summons a storm around himself for 3 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for the duration.
R.description2: The storm strikes lightning bolts down on nearby enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, each one dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Bolt|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
R.description3: ''Slicing Maelstrom'' gains 10% additional damage for each subsequent strike a target has received, up to a combined total of 150% of the initial strike's damage.
R.description4: '''''Kennen''' can move during Slicing Maelstrom's cast time.''

P.name: Unseen Threat
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kha'Zix''' gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him or he activates ''{{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}}''.

{{sbc|Unseen Threat:}} '''Kha'Zix''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion to deal {{pplevel|17 to 136|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them by 25% for 2 seconds.

Q.name: Taste Their Fear
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kha'Zix''' considers any enemy unit to be {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} if they are not nearby to one of their allies. ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}}'', ''{{ai|Evolved Reaper Claws|Kha'Zix}}'', and ''{{ai|Evolved Spike Racks|Kha'Zix}}'' have special interactions against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' slashes the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, increased to 210% against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 180}} {{as|(+ 105% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Target Physical Damage|{{ap|80*2.1 to 180*2.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|105*2.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

Q.name: Evolved Reaper Claws
Q.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kha'Zix''' gains {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} on his {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''Taste Their Fear''.

{{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} If the target is {{as|Isolated|buzzword}}, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 45%.

W.name: Void Spike
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' fires a bolt of spikes in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description2: '''Kha'Zix''' {{tip|heals}} himself if he is within the explosion.

W.name: Evolved Spike Racks
W.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} ''Void Spike'' now fires three clusters in a cone, {{tip|slow|slows}} by 40% and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. Multiple explosions do not deal additional damage against the same target nor provide '''Kha'Zix''' with extra healing.
W.description2: {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets hit by ''Evolved Spike Racks'' are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 60% instead.

E.name: Leap
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
E.description2: ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Evolved Wings
E.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} ''Leap'' gains 200 '''bonus''' cast range, and the {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}}.

R.name: Void Assault
R.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Each rank in ''Void Assault'' allows '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve one of his {{tip|abilities}}, granting it additional effects. Evolving an ability causes him to enter a 2-second [[cast time]].

'''''Kha'Zix''' cannot evolve while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for {{ap|1.25}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description3: After 2 seconds of leaving {{tip|invisibility}}, and for the next 12 seconds, ''Void Assault'' can be recast at no additional cost.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast}}: '''Kha'Zix''' mimics the first cast's effects.

R.name: Evolved Adaptive Cloaking
R.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} The {{tip|invisibility}} now lasts 2 seconds, and ''Void Assault'' can be recast twice.

P.name: Mark of the Kindred
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Both '''Lamb''' and '''Wolf''' mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''.

{{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{pp|type=marks|75;100;125;150;175;200;225;250|4;7;10;13;16;19;22;25|formula=+75 at 4 stacks, and +25 every 3 stacks thereafter, up to 250 bonus range at 25 stacks.}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Lamb:}} '''Lamb''' is offered a selection of enemy {{tip|champions}} to ''hunt'' if she has not been [[combat status|in combat]] with them in the last 6 seconds. Once selected, the mark is applied after an 8-second delay and thereafter it can be collected by '''Kindred'''. '''Lamb''' gains the ability to select a new target every 75 seconds. ''Targets successfully hunted cannot be marked again for 4 minutes.''

Q.name: Dance of Arrows
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' {{tip|dashes}} toward the target location, gaining {{sti|attack speed|{{as|35%|attack speed}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} for 4 seconds and firing an arrow at up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies that deals {{as|physical damage}}. Her current attack target within any proximity will be prioritized by one of the arrows.
Q.description2: ''Dance of Arrows' '' {{sti|'''total''' cooldown}} is reduced to an amount while '''Lamb''' is within the area of ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}''. Casting ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}'' reduces ''Dance of Arrows' '' '''current''' cooldown to the same amount.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Static Cooldown|{{ap|4 to 2}} seconds}}
Q.description3: ''Dance of Arrows {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lamb's''' basic attack timer. '''Lamb''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

W.name: Wolf's Frenzy
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Lamb''' generates 1 stack of ''Hunter's Vigor'' for every {{tt|27 units|Estimated}} she travels by any means and 5 stacks {{tip|on-attack}}, up to a maximum of 100 stacks. At maximum stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|heals}} her for {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 25|0 to 80|formula= 1.25% per 1% of '''Kindred's missing''' health. ''This is capped at 80% '''missing''' health.''|label1='''Missing''' health|type='''Kindred's''' '''missing''' health|label=Percent of level-scaling value|key=%|key1=%|changedisplay = true}}}} of {{pplevel|47 to 81|color=heal}}. The heal is not triggered if '''Kindred''' is at full health.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wolf''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, then claims the surrounding area as his territory for the next {{fd|8.5}} seconds, separating from '''Lamb'''. He automatically attacks the closest nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within the area, prioritizing the last enemy '''Lamb''' has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions.
W.description3: '''Wolf's''' attacks deal {{as|magic damage}} and the rate at which he attacks scale with {{as|25% of '''Kindred's bonus''' attack speed}}. Against monsters, his attacks deal 150% damage and {{tip|slow}} the target by 50% for 2 seconds. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{fd|112.5}} {{as|(+ 15 per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} against monsters.
W.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% {{as|(+ 1% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}|Monster Damage|{{ap|25*1.5 to 45*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*1.5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*1.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
W.description4: ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.

E.name: Mounting Dread
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' fires a shot at the target enemy that {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} for 1 second and marks them for 4 seconds. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} against the marked target each apply a {{tip|stack}}, refreshing the duration and stacking up to 3 times.
E.description2: The third stack directs '''Wolf''' to pounce on the target, consuming all stacks to deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 50|critScaling=true}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|Mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
E.description3: The damage based on the {{as|'''missing''' health}} ratio is capped at 200 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

R.name: Lamb's Respite
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' blesses the ground underneath herself, creating a sacred zone at the location that lasts for 4 seconds. {{tt|'''All''' units|Ally, enemy, and neutral}} inside the zone gain a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} equal to {{as|{{sti|health|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}, and will also become {{tip|invulnerable}} while remaining in the area when they reach or are at the threshold, during which they also cannot be {{tip|heal|healed}}, but can still {{sti|health regeneration|regenerate health|link=health regeneration}}.
R.description3: All targetable units within the zone are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|160 to 120}}|Begins at start of cast time}}

P.name: Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kled''' rides his semi-trusty mount, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}'''. While {{sbc|Mounted}}, all damage dealt to the duo is suffered by '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''', who has {{pplevel|color=health|{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_base}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}}}+{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_lvl}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}}}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|formula={{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_base}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}}}+{{#expr:({{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_lvl}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}})*17 round 1}}/17*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|'''base''' health}}; additional sources of health are applied to '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}. Effects based on percentage health consider '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' combined {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2: Being reduced below {{as|{{sti|health|0 health}}}} causes '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' to flee, forcing '''Kled''' to be {{sbc|Dismounted}}, with all damage in excess of '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health being ignored. Upon dismounting, '''Kled''' {{tip|lunge|lunges}} in the direction of the allied [[Nexus]], though {{tt|not through terrain|see notes}}, while {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. {{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|''Dismounting''}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}} and charges of ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}''.
P.description3: While '''Kled''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, his {{as|'''base''' health}} and {{as|movement speed}} are reduced; however, he gains {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while moving toward enemy champions. Additionally, he gains {{sti|attack range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and his attacks deal {{pp|85 to 100 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} damage to champions. ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}}'' is replaced with ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}'', while ''{{ai|Jousting|Kled}}'' and ''{{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}}'' become unusable.
P.description4: While {{sbc|Mounted}}, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} will first replenish '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health and will only apply to '''Kled's''' health while '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' is at ''full'' health.
P.description5: ''For more details, check the {{sbc|Dismounted}} part of the ability.''

Q.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased to 150% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, small {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}. The bear trap collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, large pet, or large monster hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Kled''' and the target for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion and Small Monster Damage|{{ap|30*1.5 to 130*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:60*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: The tether's radius shrinks over its duration, and if it is not broken before then, '''Kled''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the target {{tt|150|Estimated}} units toward him, deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:60*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|30*3 to 130*3}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:60*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
Q.description3: ''Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while {{ai|Jousting|Kled}}.''

W.name: Violent Tendencies
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kled''' periodically gains ''Violent Tendencies'', which starts expiring upon his next {{tip|basic attack}}.
W.description2:
{{sbc|Violent Tendencies:}} '''Kled''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|150% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next 4 basic attacks within 4 seconds. The fourth attack is empowered to deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 200 against {{tip|monsters}}.

''Violent Tendencies' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds {{tip|on-hit}}, increased to {{fd|1.5}} against champions.
W.leveling2: {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4.5 to 6.5}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description3: Against {{tip|structures}}, the fourth attack deals modified {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Structure Additional Damage|{{pplevel|62+1.75*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|formula=62 + 1.75 * (level - 1) * (0.7025 + 0.0175 * (level - 1)) (aka growth formula)}} (+ {{ap|0 to 60}})}}<!--
Not affected by bonus AD, not dependent on tower HP (unless there's a cap but it's really low), ranking up adds 15 damage flat, leveling up the champion adds damage similar to the stat gain per level formula (still works for level 19, 20) -->
W.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|13 to 9}}|Starts after the attacks time out or are consumed}}

E.name: Jousting
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} {{tip|minion|minions}}, {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monster|monsters}} hit towards her.
E.description2: Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large monster, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed 350 units through them, marking them for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. After the dash ends, the duo gain {{sti|ms|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. ''Jousting'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the first dash ending while the target is marked.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' consumes the mark to {{tip|dash}} through the marked target, applying the same effects as the first cast though being able to dash through terrain.
E.description4: The mark will remain even if the target dies, and ends prematurely if the duo are too far away or '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}''.
E.description5: ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}} and {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''

E.name: Jousting 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} {{tip|minion|minions}}, {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monster|monsters}} hit towards her.
E.description2: Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large monster, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed 350 units through them, marking them for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. After the dash ends, the duo gain {{sti|ms|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. ''Jousting'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the first dash ending while the target is marked.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' consumes the mark to {{tip|dash}} through the marked target, applying the same effects as the first cast though being able to dash through terrain.
E.description4: The mark will remain even if the target dies, and ends prematurely if the duo are too far away or '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}''.
E.description5: ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}} and {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''

R.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' & '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' charge toward the target location, automatically navigating terrain along the way, during which they are {{tip|ghosted}}, {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} to enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} in a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1250|estimated}} radius. If the charge does not complete within 15 seconds, it will end prematurely. The charge is interrupted instantly if '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}'' during it.
R.description2: While charging, the duo gain an initial {{tip|shield}}, plus an additional amount for every {{fd|0.25}} seconds of traveling, up to a cap at 2 seconds. Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kog'Maw''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.

P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when '''LeBlanc''' is damaged to {{sti|health|{{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}}}, she creates a {{tip|clone}} of herself, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisibility|invisible}} for 1 second.
