W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to 150 units in front of the target location over {{rutngt|0.75}}, though not through terrain, and deals {{as|magic damage}} in an area around the target spot. Enemies hit within the epicenter are dealt {{ccs|200% increased damage|magic}}.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Increased Damage|{{ap|80*3 to 160*3}} {{as|(+ 105% AP)}}}}
W.description2: ''Watch Out! Eep!'' deals 50% damage to {{tip|minions}}.
W.cast time: {{tt|None|Dash starts immediately before a 0.25 cast time, but actual delay is 0.6 to 0.75 seconds}}

E.name: Swirlseed
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' lobs a seed at the target location that rolls forward indefinitely. The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain while on the ground, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for 3 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds.

R.name: Lilting Lullaby
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' casts a magical lullaby over all enemy {{tip|champions}} affected by ''{{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}}'', which {{tt|arrives after {{fd|0.3}} seconds|fixed travel time missile}} and renders them {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 10%. After the duration, they fall {{tip|asleep}} for 2 seconds.
R.description2: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage that a {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target takes from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} consumes the debuff to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
R.description3: ''An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} is required to cast this ability. '''Lillia''' can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.''

P.name: Iceborn Subjugation
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby enemy champion dies, '''Lissandra''' spawns a ''Frozen Thrall'' from their corpse.

''Frozen Thralls'' are ice spirits that have {{as|{{pp|325*.103;325*.242;325*.361;325*.461;325*.547;325*.619;325*.681;325*.733;325*.778;325*.812;325*.848;325*.876;325*.899;325*.919;325*.935;325*.95;325|0 to 4|type=seconds alive}} movement speed}} and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies by 25%. They will chase nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies for 4 seconds, prioritizing {{tip|champion|champions}}, after which they shatter to deal {{as|{{pplevel|120; then +20*x for 11; then +30*x|formula=100 + 20 per level until level 12, then +30 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.

Q.name: Ice Shard
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' launches a shard of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: If ''Ice Shard'' hits an enemy, it will shatter, increasing its width and maximum range.

W.name: Ring of Frost
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' freezes nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 1.65}} seconds}}

E.name: Glacial Path
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through, decelerating over {{fd|1.25}} seconds. ''Glacial Path'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the claw is active.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lissandra''' {{tip|blinks}} to the claw's current location, ending its trajectory.

R.name: Frozen Tomb
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' can cast ''Frozen Tomb'' on herself or an enemy champion.
R.description2: {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' freezes the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description3: {{sbc|Self Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' instantly entombs herself in ice, entering {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and {{tip|healing}} herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration. The healing is increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''missing''' health at the time of cast|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of '''missing''' health}}}}.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Heal per Tick|{{ap|100/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55/10}}% AP)}}|Maximum Heal per Tick|{{ap|100*2/10 to 200*2/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2/10}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|Maximum Total Heal|{{ap|100*2 to 200*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: ''Frozen Tomb'' creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over {{fd|1.5}} seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, refreshing every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while they remain.
R.leveling4:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|45 to 75}}%}}

P.name: Silver Stake
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Locke's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{pplevel|5 to 40|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100|0 to 70 by 5|key1=%|formula=7.14% for every 5% target's missing health, with the maximum at 70% target's missing health|color=health}}, up to {{pplevel|5*2 to 40*2|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}.

Q.name: Ritual Nails
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' hurls a nail in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|slows}} them by 25% for 1 second, and applies a {{tip|stack}} of ''Soul Nails'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. Against targets with at least 2 stacks, the {{tip|slow}} is increased to 60% and lasts for 2 seconds.

''Ritual Nails'' can be recast twice more within 4 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a {{fd|0.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage per Nail|{{ap|40 to 72}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}
|Maximum Nail Damage|{{ap|40*3 to 72*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*3}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Locke''' mimics the first cast's effects. For each recast not used when ''Ritual Nails'' ends, {{pp|20 to 35|key=%}} of the ability's {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost is refunded, up to a {{pp|20*2 to 35*2|key=%}} refund for two remaining recasts.
Q.description3: '''Locke's''' next damaging {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Ashen Pursuit|Locke}}'' against an enemy with ''Soul Nails'' stacks consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the amount of stacks.

W.name: Soul Ignition
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' ignites his soul for 6 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{as|{{pplevel|40 to 70|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}} and {{as|40% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}, with the latter decaying to {{as|20%|ms}} over 1 second after {{fd|1.5}} seconds have elapsed.
W.description2: Additionally, during the effect he stores an amount of [[grey health]] on his [[health bar]] equal to 100% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}}, up to a cap, plus the total amount of health expended from ''Soul Ignition's'' {{tip|health resource|health cost}}. '''Locke''' additionally stores up to {{pplevel|40 to 200}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} grey health for himself, based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}} and ''Soul Ignition's'' elapsed duration. The {{as|'''missing''' health}} portion of this additional grey health stored reaches its maximum when his {{as|'''current''' health}} is at or below {{pplevel|150 to 450|color=health}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Damage taken grey health cap|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
W.description3: After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, ''Soul Ignition'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
W.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Locke''' ends ''Soul Ignition'' and consumes his [[grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
W.description5: ''Soul Ignition's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

E.name: Ashen Pursuit
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' {{tip|blinks}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
E.description2: After a {{fd|0.1}}-second delay, he empowers his next {{tip|basic attack|icononly=true}} {{tt|attack command|Technically not a basic attack, see notes. This dash ability is performed as soon as his declared attack target is within attack range (normally 400 units).}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|275 '''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies along the way, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target hit.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Dash Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40+40 to 80+120}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+40}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}}.
E.description4: '''''Locke''' {{tt|cannot perform|See notes}} the dash while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''

R.name: Purgatory
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' throws a totem artifact that travels to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. After landing for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, the totem fires latching nails at nearby enemies: dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% decaying over 2 seconds, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second, and marking enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for 5 seconds. Marked enemies are {{tip|execute|executed}} below a portion of their {{as|health}}. Successful executions refresh the mark duration on all affected targets.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 300}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Execute Threshold|{{as|{{ap|10 to 12}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per Sealed Champion stack)|buzzword}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
R.description2: Once all marks expire, and if at least one {{tip|champion}} was executed, the totem seals the souls of all executed champions and drops to the ground both over {{fd|2.25}} seconds. It then lingers for a duration equal to ''Purgatory's'' {{tt|{{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}}|Remaining CD at the time that the totem initialized the sealing process.}}, but for no less than 10 seconds. '''Locke''' can move near the totem to collect it, and for each soul sealed it will both reduce ''Purgatory's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 20% of its '''total''' cooldown and grant him a permanent {{as|Sealed Champion|buzzword}} stack.

P.name: Lightslinger
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Lucian's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|3.5}} seconds fires an additional shot {{tip|on-attack}} after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 60|1;7;13}} AD {{as|physical damage}}}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}. He will shoot the same target, else another target within 50 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}} automatically.
P.description2: The second shot {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Vigilance:}} Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}} by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.

Q.name: Piercing Light
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.

W.name: Ardent Blaze
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
W.description2: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.
W.description3: '''Lucian''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.

W.name: Ardent Blaze 2
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
W.description2: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.
W.description3: '''Lucian''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.

W.name: Ardent Blaze 3
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
W.description2: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.
W.description3: '''Lucian''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.

E.name: Relentless Pursuit
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Relentless Pursuit's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second for each ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian}}'' shot hit, doubled to 2 seconds against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction.
E.description3: ''Relentless Pursuit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lucian's''' basic attack timer. '''Lucian''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash. Relentless Pursuit can be cast during {{ais|W|Lucian}} cast time and during {{ais|R|Lucian}} channel.''

R.name: The Culling
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' {{tip|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, rapidly firing up to 22 {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 22.222|flat=true|round=floor|critScaling=true}})|crit chance}} shots in the target direction over the duration. Each shot deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}. ''The Culling'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|15 to 45}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage Per Shot|{{ap|(15 to 45)*2.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*2.0}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*2.0}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: While channeling, '''Lucian''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and may still move.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lucian''' ends ''The Culling''.

P.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lulu''' is assisted by ''Pix'', an {{tip|untargetable}} faerie, who follows her around and fires a barrage of 3 bolts towards her target whenever she uses a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}}. Each bolt deals {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 39}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it collides with, for a total of {{as|{{pplevel|5*3 to 39*3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} on hitting a single target with all three bolts.
P.description2: Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers ''Pix's'' help to them, causing him to fire the bolts dependent on their basic attacks.
P.description3: ''Pix snaps back to '''Lulu''' if she is too far away.''

Q.name: Glitterlance
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' and ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' each fire a magic bolt towards the target point, each one dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% decaying over 2 seconds.
Q.description2: Enemies take {{ccs|50% damage|magic}} from a second bolt.

W.name: Whimsy
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' can cast ''Whimsy'' on herself or a champion.
W.description2: {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lulu''' launches a spell onto the target enemy champion that {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} them into a harmless critter for a duration, during which their {{as|movement speed}} is reduced by {{as|60|ms}}, and {{tip|disarm|disarms}} them for the same duration.
W.description3: {{sbc|Self / Ally Cast:}} '''Lulu''' instantly casts erratic magic upon the target allied champion or herself, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|25%|ms}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
{{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|3 to 4}} seconds}}

E.name: Help, Pix!
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' can cast ''Help, Pix!'' on herself or an ally or enemy.
E.description2: {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the far side of the target enemy for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the same duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Self / Ally Cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the target ally for {{fd|6.25}} seconds. If the target is a {{tip|champion}}, they are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

R.name: Wild Growth
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' enlarges herself or the target allied champion, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, the target gains {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}} and 40% increased [[size]] and {{tip|slow|slows}} nearby enemies, which lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

P.name: Illumination
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lux's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

'''Lux's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' consume the mark to deal {{as|{{pplevel|30 to 200}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Light Binding
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' shoots a sphere of light in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first two enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 2 seconds.

W.name: Prismatic Barrier
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' throws her wand in the target direction that homes back to her after reaching maximum range. Allied champions hit by the wand gain a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, which can stack up to 2 times, stacking with the previous shield and refreshing its duration.
W.leveling: {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Shield|{{ap|40*2 to 100*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: '''Lux''' gains the shield upon throwing and upon retrieving the wand.
W.cast time: {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Effect starts at beginning of cast time}}

E.name: Lucent Singularity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' sends a lucent singularity to the target location, remaining there for 5 seconds to grant {{tip|sight}} of the area and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies.
E.description2: ''Lucent Singularity'' can be recast at any time while it is in flight or within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lux''' detonates the singularity, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within. If ''Lucent Singularity'' was recast while in flight, it will detonate upon arrival.
E.description4: The slow lingers for 1 second after leaving the area. Enemies hit by ''Lucent Singularity's'' detonation are also slowed by the same amount for 1 second.

R.name: Final Spark
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' fires a massive light beam in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as grants {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area.

P.name: Granite Shield
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Shard of the Monolith:}} '''Malphite''' gains increased percentage [[size]] equal to {{as|8% of his '''total''' armor}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|{{#expr:35/0.08}}}} armor}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Granite Shield:}} '''Malphite''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}}. The shield lasts until it is broken, and replenishes to full strength after a few seconds of not taking damage.

Q.name: Seismic Shard
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' sends a shard to the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 3 seconds upon impact.
Q.description2: '''Malphite''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} equal to the {{tt|raw|before movement speed soft caps}} amount of {{as|movement speed}} the target lost from the slow for the duration.

W.name: Thunderclap
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Malphite''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, tripled while ''{{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}}'' is active.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Armor|{{as|{{ap|10 to 30}}% armor}}|Increased Bonus Armor|{{as|{{ap|10*3 to 30*3}}% armor}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' empowers his next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{ccs|{{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}|physical}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
W.description3: Additionally, '''Malphite's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds are empowered to trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description4: ''Thunderclap'' deals 180% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description5: ''Thunderclap {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Malphite's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Ground Slam
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' slams the ground beneath him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|cripple|crippling}} them for 3 seconds.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 40% armor)}}}}{{st|Cripple Strength|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}

R.name: Unstoppable Force
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' {{tip|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

P.name: Void Shift
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Malzahar''' gains ''Void Shift'' until he takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or negates a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, to which it then lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds before expiring.

{{sbc|Void Shift:}} '''Malzahar''' gains {{tip|Cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and 90% damage reduction.
P.description2: ''Void Shift's'' {{sti|cooldown}} refreshes whenever '''Malzahar''' takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, and resets upon [[death|respawning]].

Q.name: Call of the Void
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' opens two portals to the void centered at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area in between. After {{fd|0.4}} seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silenced}} for a duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
{{st|Silence Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}

W.name: Void Swarm
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Malzahar''' generates a stack of ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' when he casts another {{tip|ability}}, up to a maximum of 2.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' consumes all ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks and, after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay, summons a {{ui|Voidling}} at the target location. Additional ''Voidlings'' are then summoned for each ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack consumed, with each ''Voidling'' being summoned {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the previous one.
W.description3: ''Voidlings'' deal {{as|magic damage}} with their attacks, reduced by 50% against epic {{tip|monsters}} and increased by 200% to enemy {{tip|minions}} infected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}''.
W.description4: ''See [[Malzahar#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Voidlings.''

E.name: Malefic Visions
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' infects the target enemy's mind, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with ''{{ai|Call of the Void|Malzahar}}'' or ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''. ''Malefic Visions'' executes {{tip|minions}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|10 to 30 for 11}} health}}}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 220}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/16 to 220/16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/16}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|2% of his '''maximum''' mana}}}}.

R.name: Nether Grasp
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}. He then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target and dealing them {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process.
R.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|125/10 to 275/10}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}}}}
R.description2: '''''Malzahar''' will continue to channel as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.''
R.description3: Additionally, a ''Null Zone'' is opened beneath the target's location at the time of cast that lasts 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within, capped at 120 per tick against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|10/10 to 20/10}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
R.description4: ''Null Zone will persist even if the channel is interrupted.

P.name: Sap Magic
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Maokai''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{pplevel|4; then +0.2*x for 5;then +0.65*x|formula=3.8 + 0.2 per level until level 6, then +0.65 per level|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}} after a {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Reduced by attack speed.}}-second delay.
P.description2: Each time '''Maokai''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, hits at least one enemy champion or epic monster with ''{{ai|Sapling Toss|Maokai}}'', or is struck by an enemy's ability, ''Sap Magic's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds, modified to {{fd|1.5}} if he is hit by a large {{tip|monster|monster's}} basic attack or ability.
P.description3: ''Sap Magic {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Maokai's''' basic attack timer, and will not trigger if he is above {{sti|{{as|95% '''maximum''' health}}}}.''

P.name: Sap Magic 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Maokai''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{pplevel|4; then +0.2*x for 5;then +0.65*x|formula=3.8 + 0.2 per level until level 6, then +0.65 per level|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}} after a {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Reduced by attack speed.}}-second delay.
P.description2: Each time '''Maokai''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, hits at least one enemy champion or epic monster with ''{{ai|Sapling Toss|Maokai}}'', or is struck by an enemy's ability, ''Sap Magic's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds, modified to {{fd|1.5}} if he is hit by a large {{tip|monster|monster's}} basic attack or ability.
P.description3: ''Sap Magic {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Maokai's''' basic attack timer, and will not trigger if he is above {{sti|{{as|95% '''maximum''' health}}}}.''

Q.name: Bramble Smash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' sends a shockwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ''Bramble Smash'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 255}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|150 to 190}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|75+150 to 255+190}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Enemies near '''Maokai''' are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 300 units based on their proximity to him.

W.name: Twisted Advance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy while being {{tip|untargetable}}. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.4}} seconds}}

E.name: Sapling Toss
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' flings a ''Sapling'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can see across terrain from the center, but not into brush}} while it is in-flight.
E.description2: Once landed, the ''Sapling'' grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and remains stationary for 30 seconds or until it reacts to the first nearby visible enemy, chasing them for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds. The ''Sapling'' explodes upon colliding with an enemy or when it expires, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% for 2 seconds.
E.description3:
A ''Sapling'' placed in a {{tip|brush}} becomes empowered: lasting 30 {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} seconds and causing its explosion to deal {{fd|66.7}}% damage to non-{{tip|minion}} targets struck and attach two ''Saplings'' to them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 45% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} them for 3 seconds. The attached ''Saplings'' explode on the afflicted target every {{fd|0.75}} seconds over the duration, dealing them the same damage each time.

Targets can only be attached to two ''Saplings'' at a time; subsequent empowered ''Sapling'' explosions on a target will refresh the duration and only attach a ''Sapling'' if one has exploded on them already. Against minions, the explosion deals 100% damage. The '''total''' damage is capped at 600 against non-champions.
E.description4: ''See [[Maokai#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Saplings.''

R.name: Nature's Grasp
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' summons a colossal wall of five thorny brambles that slowly advances in the target direction, accelerating over time, each stopping when they collide with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Hitting at least one enemy champion grants '''Maokai''' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds.
R.description2: Each bramble deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|0.75 to 2.25|0 to 1000 by 100|formula=Starts at 0.75 seconds and increases up to 2.25 seconds over 1000 units traveled}} seconds.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 300}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}

P.name: Double Strike
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Master Yi's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Double Strike'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, '''Master Yi's''' next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} and strike twice, the second strike dealing {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
P.description2: The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description3: If '''Master Yi's''' primary target is killed before the second strike, he will automatically target another nearby enemy.
P.description4: ''The second strike can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} against {{tip|turrets|structures}}.''

Q.name: Alpha Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. After {{rutngt|0.2}}, he marks the target enemy and then proceeds to mark the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} un-marked enemy within 600 units, recurring every {{rutngt|0.2}}{{ft|up to 3 times.|for a total of 4 marks.}}If there are no other un-marked targets before then, '''Master Yi''' can mark the same enemies again. During ''Alpha Strike'', '''Master Yi''' can select a direction from the primary target.
Q.description2: Upon finishing marking, '''Master Yi''' {{tip|blinks|reappears}} 75 units in the targeted direction, or in front of the target otherwise, and then becomes able to act again{{ft|after {{rutngt|0.15}}.|{{tt|{{fd|1.087}} seconds total|Effective time due to game ticks}} after the start of the cast with 4 bounces.}}If the primary target {{tip|death|dies}} or is too far away during the delay, '''Master Yi''' will reappear at the initial cast location instead.
Q.description3: '''Master Yi''' then detonates the marks to deal {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 75% effectiveness. Marks after the first on the same target instead detonate instantly upon application to deal {{fd|{{#expr:0.25*100}}}}% damage and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to {{ap|75*0.25}}% effectiveness. ''Alpha Strike'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monster|monsters}} per hit.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Primary Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 100}} {{as|(+ {{fd|70}}% AD)}}|Reduced Damage per hit|{{ap|20*0.25 to 100*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.25}}% AD)}}|Maximum Single-Target Damage|{{ap|20*(1+0.25*3) to 100*(1+0.25*3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*(1+0.25*3)}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Primary Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}}|Combined Primary Monster Damage|{{ap|20+60 to 100+160}} {{as|(+ {{fd|70}}% AD)}}|Reduced Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|(20+60)*0.25 to (100+160)*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.25}}% AD)}}|Max Single-Target Monster Damage|{{ap|(20+60)*(1+0.25*3) to (100+160)*(1+0.25*3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*(1+0.25*3)}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description4: ''Alpha Strike's'' primary and lesser damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|({{ccd|Master Yi|crit_base}}-100)*1+100|1*100}}|critical damage}} damage.<!--and {{as|{{critical damage|(({{ccd|Master Yi|crit_base}}-100)*1+100)*0.25|1*100*0.25}}|critical damage}} damage respectively.-->|100% + {{sti|critical damage|{{as|{{ap|1*100}}% of {{as|'''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}<!--, reduced to {{ap|0.25*100}}% for the lesser damage.-->}}<!--V26.01 - Lesser damage is now bugged and can critically strike for full damage (x1.0, same crit damage value as primary damage), when the crit damage modifier should be getting modified to x0.25 like it's supposed to. Will probably be fixed in a patch or two.-->
Q.description5: {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} reduce ''Alpha Strike's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 1 second, {{tt|affected by {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}}|Cooldown reduction on-hit is reduced with ability haste}}.
Q.description6: ''{{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} can be cast during Alpha Strike. Each time Alpha Strike hits a target, the '''current''' durations of {{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} are refreshed. Alpha Strike does not trigger its cooldown reduction nor grant a stack of {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} when applying on-hit effects.''

W.name: Meditate
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|channels}} for up to 4 seconds, {{tip|healing}} himself every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% missing health}}|health}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Minimum Heal Per Tick|{{ap|15 to 55}} {{as|(+ {{fd|12.5}}% AP)}}|Maximum Heal Per Tick|{{ap|15*2 to 55*2}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Heal|{{ap|15*8 to 55*8}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Maximum Total Heal|{{ap|15*8*2 to 55*8*2}} {{as|(+ 200% AP)}}}}
W.description2: While channeling, '''Master Yi''' gains 70% damage reduction for the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds, which is then modified to a reduced amount for the remaining duration of the channel. ''Meditate's'' damage reduction is halved against {{tip|turret|turrets}} and lingers for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the channel ends.
W.leveling2: {{st|Modified Damage Reduction|{{ap|45 to 55}}%|Turret Modified Damage Reduction|{{ap|45/2 to 55/2}}%}}
W.description3: ''Meditate {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Master Yi's''' basic attack timer, pauses {{ais|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ais|Highlander|Master Yi}} duration, and grants one stack of {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} per second during the channel.''

E.name: Wuju Style
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' empowers his basic attacks within the next 5 seconds to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

R.name: Highlander
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Master Yi's''' basic [[Champion ability|abilities]] by 70%.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|slow|slows}} and {{tip|cripple|cripples}}. For the next 7 seconds, he gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}}, and {{tip|cripple-immune|cripple immunity}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|25 to 65}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
R.description3: While active, scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} extends ''Highlander's'' duration by 7 seconds.

P.name: Searing Brilliance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mel's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' for each instance of damage they deal to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on {{tt|subsequent damage instances|From her attacks/abilities}} and stacking infinitely.
P.description2: {{sbc|Overwhelm:}} Store {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50;60;70;80|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the affected enemy with the first stack, reduced{{ft|to 50%|to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50*0.5;60*0.5;70*0.5;80*0.5|0 to 3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.5}}% AP)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}. For each stack, store an additional {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|2;3;4;5|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the target. If the total {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} stored exceeds the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} and {{tip|shields}}, the next stack applied against them will consume them all to deal the stored damage.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Searing Brilliance:}} '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate 3 stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals {{as|{{pplevel|8 to 30}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, for a total possible damage of {{as|{{pplevel|8*9 to 30*9}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*9}}% AP)}} at maximum stacks.

Q.name: Radiant Volley
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' launches a barrage of luminous bolts at the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Time between first and last explosion}} which distribute evenly in the area. Each bolt explodes upon landing to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, with all explosions after the first dealing reduced damage.
Q.description2: The bolts momentarily grant {{tip|sight}} during their travel, while the explosions grant {{tip|sight}} over their target area. Both can see through {{tip|brush}} and [[terrain]].

W.name: Rebuttal
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' forms a protective barrier around herself for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for the duration, and gaining {{as|{{sti|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Additionally, all hostile {{tip|projectiles}} sourced from enemy {{tip|champions}} that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before '''Mel''' fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the {{tt|original sources|See notes}}, or {{tt|toward herself|See notes}}.
W.description2: Replicated projectiles have the {{tt|same features|See notes}} that the original ones do, but they retain a ratio of the damage that the original ones would deal. Additionally, all of their damage is converted to {{as|magic damage}}, with {{as|physical damage}} instances being reduced to 70% before conversion.
W.leveling2: {{st|Replicated Projectile Magic Damage Modifier|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage|Replicated Projectile Physical Damage Modifier|{{ap|40*.7 to 60*.7}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|5*.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage}}

E.name: Solar Snare
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' fires an orb in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Can see through brush and terrain.}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds as it travels. Enemies hit by the orb are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: The orb emanates a field of solar radiation that additionally expands after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. Enemies within the field are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% every {{fd|0.125}} seconds, lingering for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after exiting.
E.leveling2: {{st|Field Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2 to 8}} {{as|(+ 1% AP)}}|Field Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|2*8 to 8*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*8}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: Both the orb and the field of ''Solar Snare'' deal {{#expr:0.5*100}}% damage against {{tip|minions}}.
E.leveling3:
{{st|Orb Minion Magic Damage|{{ap|60*0.5 to 240*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Field Minion Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2*0.5 to 8*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*0.5}}% AP)}}|Field Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|2*0.5*8 to 8*0.5*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*0.5*8}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Golden Eclipse
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}}'' stacks store more damage.
R.leveling:
{{st|Increased Stored Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}}}}
{{st|Stored Damage Increase per Stack|{{ap|1 to 3}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' unleashes a radiant blast on all enemies affected by ''{{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}}'', dealing {{as|magic damage}} to each of them. Enemies are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 1 second from the start of the cast time.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} (+ {{ap|4 to 10}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} per [[File:Searing Brilliance.png|20px|link=]] ''Overwhelm'' stack on the target)}}
R.description3: ''An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}} is required to cast this ability.''

P.name: Fired Up!
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Milio's''' {{tip|ability}} hits on himself and allied {{tip|champions}} grant an enchantment for 4 seconds, which causes the next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> or ability hit against enemies to deal {{as|{{pp|7;11;15|1;6;9|key=%}} of enchanted target's AD}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and apply a burn that deals{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 50}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% of '''Milio's''' AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}|{{as|{{pplevel|10/6 to 50/6|round=2}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20/6|round=2}}% of '''Milio's''' AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds}}over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

Q.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Milio''' kicks a fireball in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of its path and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the first enemy it hits over 1 second.
Q.description2: Upon collision, the ball bounces once in the {{tt|same|parallel to original cast direction}} direction from the target's location, granting sight of the area before exploding in the same radius after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 320}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}}}}
Q.description3: If the primary target is a non-champion, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion. ''Ultra Mega Fire Kick'' refunds 50% of its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if it hits at least one champion with the fireball or explosion.
Q.description4: '''''Milio''' cannot cast other abilities during Ultra Mega Fire Kick's delay.''

W.name: Cozy Campfire
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Milio''' summons a fuemigo at the target location or upon the target allied champion for 6 seconds that follows the nearest allied champion and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Allied champions near the fuemigo gain {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} equal to a percentage of their '''base''' attack range and {{tip|heal}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Base Attack Range Scaling|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}
{{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|70/25 to 150/25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15/25}}% AP)}}|Total Heal|{{ap|70 to 150}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
W.description2: ''Cozy Campfire'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Milio''' commands the fuemigo to follow the target allied champion to within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 150-units, placing the recast on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}}}-second {{tt|static|Unaffected by ability haste}} cooldown.
W.description4: '''''Milio''' counts as an allied champion for this ability. Cozy Campfire may grant {{ai|Fired Up!|Milio}} upon being summoned and at most once every 3 seconds thereafter.''

E.name: Warm Hugs
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Milio''' envelops himself or the target allied champion in protective flames, granting the target a {{tip|shield}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|12 to 20}}%}}
E.description2: '''Milio''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Warm Hugs'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: ''Warm Hugs' effects can stack up to 2 times.''

R.name: Breath of Life
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Milio''' explodes in soothing flames, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself and nearby allied champions of non-{{tip|airborne}} {{tip|crowd control}}, and granting them 65% {{tip|tenacity}} for 3 seconds.
R.description2: '''''Milio''' cannot cast his other abilities for {{fd|0.75}} seconds after Breath of Life's activation. Breath of Life cannot be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

P.name: Love Tap
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Miss Fortune's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 100 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=50% + 10% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 10% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, halved to {{as|{{pp|key=%|50/2 to 100/2 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=25% + 5% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 5% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}.

Q.name: Double Up
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
Q.description2: ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.
Q.description3: ''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the bounce.''

W.name: Strut
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 4 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|periodic}} damage. This bonus is increased after another 3 seconds, and is granted instantly whenever ''Strut'' is cast.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}}}
{{st|Increased Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|60 to 100}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds.
W.description3: Marking a new target with ''{{ai|Love Tap|Miss Fortune}}'' reduces ''Strut's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{tt|2 seconds|Affected by ability haste}}.

{{st|Increased Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|60 to 100}}}}

W.description3: Marking a new target with ''{{ai|Love Tap|Miss Fortune}}'' reduces ''Strut's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{tt|2 seconds|Affected by ability haste}}.

W.name: Impure Shots
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 4 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|periodic}} damage. This bonus is increased after another 3 seconds, and is granted instantly whenever ''Strut'' is cast.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}}}
{{st|Increased Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|60 to 100}}}}

W.description3: Marking a new target with ''{{ai|Love Tap|Miss Fortune}}'' reduces ''Strut's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{tt|2 seconds|Affected by ability haste}}.

E.name: Make It Rain
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' casts a storm of bullets at the target location for 2 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|70/8 to 190/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120/8}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}

R.name: Bullet Time
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, firing a number of waves of bullets in the target direction. Each wave is in a spread of 6 projectiles that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage per Wave|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 60% AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Waves|{{ap|14 to 18}}|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*14 to 40*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*14 to 60*18}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*14 to 25*18}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Wave Interval Time|{{ap|2.85/(14 to 18)|round=4}} seconds}}
R.description2: Each of the waves can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|130|30}}|critical damage}} damage.

P.name: Darkness Rise
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mordekaiser's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|40% AP}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mordekaiser''' generates a {{tip|stack}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} damaged by his {{tip|basic attacks}} or hit by his basic {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, he gains ''Darkness Rise''.
P.description3: {{sbc|Darkness Rise:}} '''Mordekaiser''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pplevel|3 to 18|1;6;11;19;24;30|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and deals{{ft|{{as|5|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|key=%|1 to 5}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}} every second|{{as|{{ap|5*0.125}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.125}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|key=%|1*0.125 to 5*0.125}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds}}to nearby enemies. Against monsters, the damage is capped at{{ft|{{pplevel|40 to 200}} per second.|{{pp|40*0.125 to 200*0.125}} per {{fd|0.125}} seconds.}}

Q.name: Obliterate
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' strikes his mace down in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within, {{ccs|increased|magic}} if only one enemy is hit.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{pp|0 + (45-0)/9*(x-1) for 12|1;10 to 20|formula=0 at level 1, then +5 every level starting at level 10}} (+ {{ap|80 to 220}}) {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Damage Increase|{{ap|{{#expr:(1.3-1)*100}} to {{#expr:(1.5-1)*100}}}}%}}

W.name: Indestructible
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Mordekaiser''' stores {{fd|45}}% of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} damage he deals and {{fd|7.5}}% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage he takes,{{ft|reduced by {{ap|(1-0.25)*100}}% for non-champion sources,|reduced to {{ap|45*0.25}}% of damage dealt and {{ap|7.5*0.25}}% of damage taken for non-champion sources,}}as ''Potential Shield'' on his secondary resource bar, up to {{sti|health|{{as|{{fd|30}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}. The ''Potential Shield'' decays by {{pp|8 to 25}} every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While ''Indestructible'' is not on cooldown, the ''Potential Shield'' will not decay below a minimum of {{as|{{fd|5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' consumes his ''Potential Shield'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. ''Indestructible'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the shield is active.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Mordekaiser''' consumes the remaining shield, {{tip|healing}} for a portion of the amount.

W.name: Indestructible 2
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Mordekaiser''' stores {{fd|45}}% of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} damage he deals and {{fd|7.5}}% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage he takes,{{ft|reduced by {{ap|(1-0.25)*100}}% for non-champion sources,|reduced to {{ap|45*0.25}}% of damage dealt and {{ap|7.5*0.25}}% of damage taken for non-champion sources,}}as ''Potential Shield'' on his secondary resource bar, up to {{sti|health|{{as|{{fd|30}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}. The ''Potential Shield'' decays by {{pp|8 to 25}} every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While ''Indestructible'' is not on cooldown, the ''Potential Shield'' will not decay below a minimum of {{as|{{fd|5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' consumes his ''Potential Shield'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. ''Indestructible'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the shield is active.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Mordekaiser''' consumes the remaining shield, {{tip|healing}} for a portion of the amount.

E.name: Death's Grasp
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Mordekaiser''' gains {{sti|mpen|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' summons a claw in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, it deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them over 250 units.

R.name: Realm of Death
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' aims his mace towards the target enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them over the cast time, and then [[File:Mordekaiser Realm of Death banished icon.png|20px|link=]] {{tt|banishing|See notes}} them with him to the ''Death Realm'' for 7 seconds.

'''Mordekaiser''' also consumes the target's soul for 7 seconds, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}} and reducing their '''current''' {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''total''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|magic resistance}}}}, and {{tip|size}} by 10% for the duration. Additionally, the target's {{sti|{{as|'''base''' attack damage}}}} is reduced by {{as|10% of their '''current total''' AD}} for the same duration. '''Mordekaiser''' gains the reduced stats of the target for himself for the same duration, and if the target dies while inside the ''Death Realm'', he keeps their partial stats until they [[death|respawn]].
R.description3: Units between realms see each other as spirits, considering each other dead and negating any {{tt|interactions|See notes}} between each other. Only '''Mordekaiser''' and the target will enter the realm; other champions cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the ''Death Realm'' is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa. {{tt|Most|See notes for exceptions}} {{tip|pets}} still inside the realm are killed at its end.
R.description4: ''When the Realm of Death ends, all affected champions are returned to the normal realm. The Realm of Death ends prematurely if either affected champion dies or is {{tt|forced out of the realm|See Map-Specific Differences}}.''

P.name: Soul Siphon
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Morgana''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for 18% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by her {{tip|abilities}} against {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}}, and medium and large {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Dark Binding
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' throws a sphere of dark magic in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.

W.name: Tormented Shadow
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Tormented Shadow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 5% of its '''total''' cooldown whenever ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' torments the soil at the target location, causing the area to become desecrated for 5 seconds. Enemies within take {{as|magic damage}} on-cast and every {{fd|0.5}} seconds thereafter, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}. ''Tormented Shadow'' deals 170% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9 to 35}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9*2 to 35*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Damage|{{ap|9*10 to 35*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*10}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|9*10*2 to 35*10*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*10*2}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: Black Shield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied {{tip|champion}} or herself for 5 seconds, which absorbs incoming {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while it holds.

R.name: Soul Shackles
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions over the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and forming a {{tip|tether}} between herself and each target for 3 seconds, during which she gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and the targets are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20%.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 350}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 350*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
R.description2: If a target does not break their tether by the end of its duration, they are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.5 to 2}} seconds}}
R.description3: ''An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 575 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be tethered by this ability.''

P.name: We Are More
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Naafiri''' summons a ''Packmate'' that fights alongside her. She may have up to {{pp|2 to 5 for 4|1;9;12;15|formula=2 at level 1, then +1 at level 9, then +1 every 3 levels until 15}} ''Packmates'' at a time. '''Naafiri''' summons the maximum number of ''Packmates'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]].
P.description2: Hitting {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} with {{tip|abilities}} reduces the {{sti|cooldown}} by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 second.
P.description3: ''See [[Naafiri#Pets|Pets]] for full details on Packmates.''

Q.name: Darkin Daggers
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' hurls a dagger in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicts them with a {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 5 seconds. The {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}} and non-epic {{tip|monsters}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|30 to 70 for 11}} health}}}}. ''Darkin Daggers'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds and within 4 seconds at no additional cost.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Initial Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 55}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bleed Physical Damage per Tick|{{ap|35/10 to 135/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/10}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Bleed Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|35+35 to 55+135}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20+80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: If the dagger hits a target that is already {{as|bleeding|buzzword3}}, they are instead {{ccs|dealt|physical}} the remaining {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} damage plus {{as|'''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}, with the '''base bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}} and the ''scaling'' for the '''bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 250 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. If that target is also a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, '''Naafiri''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Naafiri''' mimics the first cast's effects.

W.name: The Call of the Pack
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' goes on the hunt for the next {{tt|5 seconds|Hunt begins from the start of the cast time}}, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for the first 1 second and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} all of her active ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' in the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds. Her active ''Packmates'' will {{tip|blink|reappear}} near her after their vanish.
W.description2: After {{fd|1.25}} seconds into the hunt, '''Naafiri''' summons 2 additional ''Packmates'' that last for the remaining duration and can exceed ''{{ais|We Are More|Naafiri}}'' summon cap.
W.description3: While on the hunt, '''Naafiri''' gains {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and grants herself and all ''Packmates'' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description4: ''Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration by {{fd|1.75}} seconds, up to its original duration.''
W.description5: '''''Naafiri''' can move during The Call of the Pack's cast time.''

E.name: Eviscerate
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

R.name: Hounds' Pursuit
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' and her ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds to single out the target enemy champion, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in the duration. Upon completion of the channel, they {{tip|dash}} to the target; upon arrival '''Naafiri''' deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slows}} the target by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, whereas each ''Packmate'' deals {{ap|0.1*100}}% of that damage. ''Packmates'' become {{tip|untargetable}} during their channel and dash.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Physical Damage per ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|link=*none*|Packmate}}''|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}} to {{#var:rp_b3}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description2: If '''Naafiri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 7 seconds of cast, she triggers a pulse that grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|surrounding area|Can see through terrain}} for 1 second and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions within for 4 seconds. She can also recast ''Hounds' Pursuit'' once from triggering this effect within 12 seconds at no cost.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Naafiri''' immediately grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds before mimicking the {{tt|first cast's effects|Excluding the takedown effects, which can trigger only once}}.

P.name: Surging Tides
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nami's''' {{tip|abilities}} grant {{sti|ms|{{as|100|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} to allied {{tip|champions}} hit, decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The bonus is{{ft|doubled|increased to {{as|200|ms}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}from ''{{ai|Tidal Wave|Nami}}''.

Q.name: Aqua Prison
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' launches a bubble at the target location that lands {{tt|after {{rutngt|0.7}}|after the cast time ends}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|suspension|suspending}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: ''Allied champions are granted {{ai|Surging Tides|Nami}} in a slightly larger area.''

W.name: Ebb and Flow
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' unleashes a stream of water onto the target champion or herself, which then bounces to nearby unaffected champions up to twice, alternating between enemies and allies and '''Nami'''.
W.description2: ''Ebb and Flow'' {{tip|Heal|heals}} allies and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies, with each bounce modifying the effectiveness of the next by -20% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}.

E.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' blesses herself or an allied champion for 6 seconds, empowering their next 3 [[basic attack]]s or [[champion ability|abilities]] to each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} enemies for 1 second.
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage Per Hit|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 80*3}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|15 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}}}}
E.description2: Empowered abilities that apply {{tip|area damage}} only deal {{pp|key=%|33 to 66}} of the '''bonus''' damage to non-champions.

R.name: Tidal Wave
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nami''' surges a tidal wave in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Estimated}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 70% for {{pp|type=distance traveled|2 to 4 by 0.2|0 to 2750|formula = ''Capped at 2750 range.''}} seconds.

P.name: Soul Eater
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nasus''' gains {{as|{{sti|life steal|{{pp|key=%|10 to 20 for 3|1 to 13}} life steal}}}}.

Q.name: Siphoning Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. ''Siphoning Strike's'' flat '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% of ''Siphoning Strike'' stacks)|buzzword}}}}
Q.description2: If ''Siphoning Strike'' kills the target, '''Nasus''' permanently gains {{as|4 stacks|buzzword}}, increased to {{as|10|buzzword}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|minion}}, or large {{tip|monster}}.
Q.description3: ''Siphoning Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nasus'''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Wither
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' ages the target enemy champion for 5 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35% and {{tip|cripple|crippling}} them by{{ft|75% of that amount,|{{ap|35*0.75}}%,}}both increasing every second over the duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Maximum Slow|{{ap|35+3*4 to 35+15*4}}%|Additional Slow Per Second|{{ap|3 to 15}}%}}
{{st|Maximum Cripple|{{ap|(35+3*4)*0.75 to (35+15*4)*0.75}}%|Additional Cripple Per Second|{{ap|3*0.75 to 15*0.75}}%}}

E.name: Spirit Fire
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' unleashes a spirit fire at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|centered at the location}} for {{tt|{{fd|2.5}} seconds|Estimated}} and, after a {{rutngt|0.25}} delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
E.description2: The fire then remains for 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} each second to enemies within and inflicting them with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}}, lingering for 1 second.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|10 to 34}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*10 to 34*10}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|30 to 50}}% of target's armor}}}}

R.name: Fury of the Sands
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, increased [[size]], and {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' attack range}} for the duration.
R.description2: While '''Nasus''' is empowered, he deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies, capped at 240 per second, and ''{{ais|Siphoning Strike|Nasus}}'' {{sti|cooldown}} is halved.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|1.5 to 2.5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|1.5*30 to 2.5*30}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5*30}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}

P.name: Staggering Blow
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nautilus' '''{{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|14 + (116-14)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|root}} the target for {{pp|changedisplay=true|0.75 to 1.5 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds.

Q.name: Dredge Line
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' hurls his anchor in the target direction that stops on the first enemy or terrain hit.
Q.description2: If the anchor hits an enemy, it deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for {{fd|1.15}} seconds, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second, and {{tip|airborne|drags}} them toward '''Nautilus''' while he also {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward them, both over {{fd|0.9}} seconds.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|85 to 245}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: If the anchor hits terrain, '''Nautilus''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to that location and 50% of ''Dredge Line's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}} are refunded.
Q.description4: '''''Nautilus''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Dredge Line is in flight. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

W.name: Titan's Wrath
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 6 seconds, and while it holds, his {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply ''Pain of Wrath'' to the target and enemies near them.
W.description2: {{sbc|Pain of Wrath:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} over time, half dealt immediately and the other half dealt after {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Instance|{{ap|30/2 to 70/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40/2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: ''Titan's Wrath {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nautilus' ''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Riptide
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' sends three waves of explosions that radiate from him {{tt|over {{fd|0.561}} seconds|See notes}}. Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 50% against those hit by subsequent waves beyond the first, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|55*0.5 to 195*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.5}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|55*2 to 195*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
E.description2: The first hit against {{tip|monsters}} deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

R.name: Depth Charge
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' sends out a [[File:Depth Charge 2.png|20px|link=]] ''Depth Charge'' that chases the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, accelerating over time and creating eruptions every {{rutngt|0.25}} in its wake that also briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of the area. Enemies hit by the eruptions are dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration.

{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 225}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
