R.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Damage|{{ap|150 to 400}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Knock Up Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}

R.name: Depth Charge 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' sends out a [[File:Depth Charge 2.png|20px|link=]] ''Depth Charge'' that chases the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, accelerating over time and creating eruptions every {{rutngt|0.25}} in its wake that also briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of the area. Enemies hit by the eruptions are dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 225}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
R.description2: Upon reaching the primary target, the ''Depth Charge'' erupts a final time at their location. The primary target takes increased damage, is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration, and {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for a modified duration.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Damage|{{ap|150 to 400}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Knock Up Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}

P.name: Inherent Glamour
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Neeko''' has a collection of disguises to take on the appearance of allied {{tip|champions}}, displayed on her ''Disguise Menu''. She can use the menu to activate a disguise, switch her current disguise to a different one, or deactivate the current disguise by selecting herself, all of which place ''Inherent Glamour'' on a {{fd|0.5}}-second cooldown. Taking damage from a champion or {{tip|turret}} while not disguised puts ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 2-second cooldown.
P.description4: Breaking the disguise via dying, being immobilized or taking damage from a turret puts ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 2-second cooldown, entering the enemy spawn platform does not put it on cooldown, and all other methods of breaking the disguise put ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 1-second cooldown.
P.description5: ''Inherent Glamour's disguise is not deactivated from {{ai|Pop Blossom|Neeko}} until after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of its cast. '''Neeko''' cannot activate Inherent Glamour while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables casting abilities.''

Q.name: Blooming Burst
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' tosses a seed that bursts upon landing at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.description2: If the burst kills an enemy or hits a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, the seed blooms after {{fd|0.75}} seconds to burst again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the same area. This may occur up to 2 times per cast.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Subsequent Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|60+35*2 to 260+135*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60+25*2}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: Each bloom deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Shapesplitter
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Neeko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Shapesplitter'',  which refreshes on subsequent attacks and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes them all to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. This attack deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 170}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 40}}%}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' creates a {{tip|clone}} of her {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|current form}}, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisible}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and gain {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. ''Shapesplitter'' can be recast at any time while the clone is active.
W.description3:
The clone lasts for 3 seconds, moves a fixed distance in the target direction, and is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and for the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of its lifespan to enemies. If the clone takes [[damage]], it will disappear prematurely after {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

Casting an ability, summoner spell, item active, or starting a {{tip|channel}} causes the clone to stop moving. Additionally, the clone plays the {{tt|casting animations|See notes}} for ''{{ai|Blooming Burst|Neeko}}'' and ''{{ai|Tangle-Barbs|Neeko}}'' as well as ''{{ais|Pop Blossom|Neeko}}'' {{tt|visual effects|See notes, only visible from the enemy's perspective}} whenever '''Neeko''' casts them. The clone will also play the animation of her next [[Emoting|expression]] or {{si|Recall}} for a {{tt|set duration|See notes}} that overrides its original duration and will become unable to move while doing so.
W.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Neeko''' sends her clone to the target location if it is not playing an expression or {{si|Recall}} animation.

E.name: Tangle-Barbs
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' slings a magical spiral in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|0.7 to 1.5}} seconds}}
E.description2: If the spiral hits at least one enemy, it grows in size and its speed and root duration is increased.

R.name: Pop Blossom
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' winds up spiritual essence over {{fd|1.25}} seconds and highlights an area around herself, which is visible to enemies unless she is ''{{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}}''. If '''Neeko''' is in a ''{{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguise}}'', it will break after {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the duration.
R.description2: After winding up, the cast time begins and '''Neeko''' leaps upward, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies for {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
R.description3: When the cast time ends, she lands to emit a burst of energy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

P.name: Prowl
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Prowl:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Nidalee''' gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1400 range. The bonuses persist for 2 seconds after leaving brush.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Hunt:}} Hitting enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}} with ''{{ai|Javelin Toss|Nidalee}}'' or ''{{ai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}'' applies a ''Hunted'' mark to the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} as well as grant {{tip|sight}} of a 300-unit radius around them. If '''Nidalee''' is nearby when the target is hit, she gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for 4 seconds, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while she is facing a ''Hunted'' target. Additionally, the first cast of both ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against a ''Hunted'' target is enhanced.
P.description3: The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from ''Prowl'' and ''Hunt'' can stack, but cannot exceed {{as|30%|ms}}.

Q.name: Javelin Toss
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 225 for 6|525 to 1300}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 150}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3.25 to 150*3.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*3.25}}% AP)}}}}

Q.name: Takedown
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} that is increased by an amount for every {{as|1% of the target's '''missing''' health}}.

''Takedown'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nidalee|crit_base}}|100|base = 100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
Q.description2: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunt}}'' Bonus:}} Hitting a ''Hunted'' target {{ccs|increases|magic}} ''Takedown's'' damage by 30%.
Q.description3: ''Takedown {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nidalee's''' basic attack timer. Other damage converted to {{as|magic damage}} by Takedown are not increased by Takedown's respective effects. '''Nidalee''' loses Takedown's empowered attack immediately when she switches to {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee|Human Form}}.''

W.name: Bushwhack
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' lays a trap at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over {{fd|1.5}} seconds, lasting for up to 120 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The trap will spring upon contact with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*4 to 50*4}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
W.description2: Traps have {{as|{{sti|health|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by champion [[basic attacks]] (2 hit points from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 hit points from {{tip|melee}}). Up to a maximum of {{pp|4 to 10 for 4|1 to 16}} traps may be active at once.
W.description3: ''See [[Nidalee#Pets|Pets]] for more details about traps.''

W.name: Pounce
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Killing an enemy while in ''Cougar Form'' or using ''Pounce's Hunt'' bonus reduces ''Pounce's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to a minimum value.
W.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}}
{{st|Reduced Cooldown|{{tt|{{ap|3 to 1.5 4}} seconds|Affected by ability haste}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} a fixed distance in the target direction. Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description3: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' Bonus:}} '''Nidalee''' can perform ''Pounce'' from an increased range on a ''Hunted'' enemy closest to the cursor. She will leap to the front of the target.
W.description4: ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}} and {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Primal Surge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' revitalizes herself or the target allied champion, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 7 seconds and {{tip|healing}} them for an amount that is increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=target's '''missing''' health|label=Heal increase|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 95|formula=1% per 0.95% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 70}}%}}
{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|50*2 to 150*2}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

E.name: Swipe
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' slashes in an arc in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
E.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Swipe|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 250 4}} {{as|(+ 70% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}

R.name: Aspect of the Cougar
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Cougar Form}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks with {{sti|range|125 range}} and access to her cougar abilities.
R.description3: {{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks with {{sti|range|525 range}} and access to her human abilities. While in this form, applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description5: '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16. {{sbc|Cougar Form's}} abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.

R.name: Aspect of the Cougar 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Cougar Form}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks with {{sti|range|125 range}} and access to her cougar abilities.
R.description3: {{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks with {{sti|range|525 range}} and access to her human abilities. While in this form, applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description5: '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16. {{sbc|Cougar Form's}} abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.

P.name: Joy Unending
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Nilah''' [[kill]]s a {{tip|minion}}, she and the nearest allied {{tip|champion}} gain an additional {{sti|{{as|50% of the experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby allied champion uses an {{tip|ability}} to {{tip|heal}} or {{tip|shield}} either '''Nilah''' or themselves, both they and '''Nilah''' receive a '''bonus''' amount equal to {{fd|7.5}}% of the healing or 15% of the shielding after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. '''Bonus''' shielding lasts as long as the shield that triggered the effect, up to a maximum duration of 4 seconds.

Q.name: Formless Blade
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nilah''' gains {{sti|lethality|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 30 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.3% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}}}} {{as|armor penetration}}. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''Formless Blade'' {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 20 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.2% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to {{tip|champions}}, converting each heal instance beyond {{as|'''maximum''' health}} into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts 6 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' cracks her whip-blade in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}. ''Formless Blade'' can hit {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness to one target.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|0 to 40}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|0*1.91 to 40*1.91}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*1.91}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description3: If ''Formless Blade'' is cast during ''{{ai|Slipstream|Nilah}}'', '''Nilah''' leaves behind a wave that is sent towards her location at the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
Q.description4: If ''Formless Blade'' hits an enemy, '''Nilah''' empowers herself for 4 seconds: gaining {{sti|range|125 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{pp|10 to 60|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and causing her basic attacks to strike in a cone that deals {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Against secondary non-champion targets, this is reduced to {{as|{{ap|100*0.33}}% AD}} for {{tip|minions}}, and additionally executes minions left below {{sti|{{as|20 health}}}}. {{tip|On-hit}} effects are applied only to the primary target.
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.35;0.33;0.297;0.28|key1=%|0;13.72;36.358;48|changedisplay=true|formula=0.35-0.035 per 24% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 20% reduction at 48% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}}}|{{tt|None|When cast during Slipstream}}}}

W.name: Jubilant Veil
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' envelops herself in mist for {{fd|2.25}} seconds, during which she becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, reduces all incoming {{as|magic damage}} taken by 25%, and {{tip|dodge|dodges}} all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks.
W.description2: Allied champions {{tt|she touches|Being within collision range of them}} will also be enveloped for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, gaining the same effects.

E.name: Slipstream
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target unit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through.
E.description2: '''Nilah''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Slipstream'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: ''Slipstream {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nilah's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Formless Blade|Nilah}} and {{ai|Apotheosis|Nilah}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Apotheosis
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' whirls her whip-blade over 1 second, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. She then unleashes a burst that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them 250 units towards her. Each hit also {{tip|slows}} targets by 10% for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
R.description2: '''Nilah''' {{tip|heals}} herself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|20 to 50 for 11|0 to 100|formula=20% + 0.3% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to {{tip|champions}}, reduced to 10% against non-champions, converting each heal instance beyond {{as|'''maximum''' health}} into a {{tip|shield}} that last 6 seconds.
R.description3: '''''Nilah''' is unable to basic attack and cast her other [[champion ability|abilities]] during Apotheosis, but she is able to move.''

P.name: Umbra Blades
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Nocturne''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to slash in a circle, dealing {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies and {{tip|healing}} himself for {{pp|13 + (30-13)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} per enemy hit. Against {{tip|minions}}, ''Umbra Blades' '' damage to secondary targets and healing are reduced by 50% and it applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to all targets{{bug|2}} at 100% effectiveness.
P.description2: ''Umbra Blades'' can {{tip|critically strike}} against the primary target, modifying the {{as|physical damage}} dealt to{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nocturne|crit_base}}|100|mod=1.1}} AD.|AD}}|{{as|110% AD}}{{times}}{{sti|{{as|'''total''' critical damage}}}}.}}
P.description3: Basic attacks reduce ''Umbra Blades' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Duskbringer
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' casts out a shadow blade in the target direction that leaves a ''Dusk Trail'' in its wake, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit will leave a ''Dusk Trail'' behind while moving. ''Dusk Trails'' last 5 seconds and will slowly disappear afterwards.
Q.description2: While on the ''Dusk Trail'', '''Nocturne''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}}}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|15 to 55}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}

W.name: Shroud of Darkness
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nocturne''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, ''Shroud of Darkness' ''{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} is doubled for 5 seconds.

E.name: Unspeakable Horror
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nocturne''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|90% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby {{tip|fear|feared}} targets.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a {{tip|tether}} between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration.
E.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|80/4 to 260/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100/4}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is {{tip|fear|feared}} for a duration while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90%.

R.name: Paranoia
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' terrorizes all enemy champions, {{tip|nearsight|nearsighting}} them for 6 seconds, during which their {{tip|sight}} radius is reduced by {{tt|300 units|Total sight radius of enemy champions after reduction is 1050 units.}}. He can recast ''Paranoia'' for the same duration after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nocturne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|physical damage}} upon arrival.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|150|275|400}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: '''''Nocturne''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] and [[Active_ability_items|item actives]] during the dash.''
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|140 to 90}}|Starts after recast times out or is used}}

P.name: Call of the Freljord
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' deal damage against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|turrets|structure}}, they and a nearby allied champion gain ''Call of the Freljord'' for 4 seconds, prioritizing the ally with {{sti|{{as|'''highest''' attack speed}}}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Call of the Freljord:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. '''Willump's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} additionally deal {{as|30% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to secondary targets in a cone in front of him.
P.description3: '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' cannot trigger ''Call of the Freljord'' from the same enemy again for a time. Successive triggers of ''Call of the Freljord'' while it is active will extend the duration by 4 seconds.

Q.name: Consume
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Willump''' takes a bite out of the target enemy, dealing damage and {{tip|healing}} himself. The heal is increased by {{ap|(1.5-1)*100}}% while he is {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}}.
Q.description2: Against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, he deals {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. Additionally, if ''Consume'' would kill the target minion or small or medium monster, '''Willump''' devours the target, {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them towards him over the cast time.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Non-Champion True Damage|{{ap|400 to 1200}}}}
{{st|Base Non-Champion Heal|{{ap|65 to 185}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' health)}}|Empowered Non-Champion Heal|{{ap|65*1.5 to 185*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.description3: Against {{tip|champions}}, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and the heal is reduced to {{ap|0.6*100}}%.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Champion Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 220}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Base Champion Heal|{{ap|65*0.6 to 185*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.6}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Empowered Champion Heal|{{ap|65*0.6*1.5 to 185*0.6*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.6*1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}

W.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Willump''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|slow|slows}} and {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|slow-immune}} and creating a rolling {{ccib|Biggest Snowball Ever! Minimap.png||snowball}}. '''Willump''' automatically navigates his movement in the direction of the cursor and can steer the snowball at an increasing speed over time, which resets upon changing direction. The duo have their {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} reduced by {{as|50%|ms}} for the first 1 second, but after a delay they start gaining {{tt|{{as|14 movement speed}}|Estimated}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tt|up to a cap|See notes.}}.
W.description2: The snowball increases in size and power linearly over the duration. Its size changes from ''small'' to ''medium'' after {{fd|2.5}} seconds, then to ''large'' after 5 seconds into the charge. ''Biggest Snowball Ever!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically after the channel or if {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
W.description3: The snowball explodes upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|pet|large pet}}, medium or large {{tip|monster}}, or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, increased by {{pp|type=charge time|key=%|0;0 to 400 for 5|0 to 5|formula=Increases linearly after 1 second into the duration.}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=charge time|0.5;0.5 to 0.75 for 5|0 to 5|formula=Increases linearly after 1 second into the duration.}} seconds and subsequently {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=charge time|0;0;0;0 to 0.75 for 9|0;1;2;2.33 to 5|formula=Increases linearly after 2.33 seconds into the duration.}} seconds. If the snowball exploded while it was being steered, '''Willump''' becomes {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{tt|{{rutngt|0.1}}|estimated; 0.1 seconds, but rounded up to the next game tick}}.
W.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|36 to 72}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|36*5 to 72*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AP)}}}}
W.description4: The snowball rolls over enemy {{tip|minion|minions}} and small monsters hit, dealing {{fd|33.3}}% of the damage as {{as|magic damage}}.
W.leveling4: {{st|Minimum Minion/Monster Roll Damage|{{ap|36*0.333 to 72*0.333}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.333}}% AP)}}|Maximum Minion/Monster Roll Damage|{{ap|36*0.333*5 to 72*0.333*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.333*5}}% AP)}}}}
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Willump''' releases the snowball, sending it rolling forward up to a maximum distance during which it will not grow any larger and will explode upon hitting any enemy.

E.name: Snowball Barrage
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nunu''' throws a volley of 3 snowballs in the target direction over {{fd|0.4}} seconds that each shatter upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Hit|{{ap|15 to 45}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 45*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*3}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: Enemies hit 3 times are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit once are marked ''Snowbound'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. ''Snowball Barrage'' can be recast twice within 3 seconds at no additional cost and with a {{tt|1-second cooldown|Affected by ability haste}} between casts.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nunu''' hurls another volley of snowballs, mimicking the first cast's effects. An enemy may be {{tip|slow|slowed}} only once for being hit by snowballs.
E.description4: After 3 seconds from the first cast, ''Snowbound'' enemies near '''Willump''' take {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{pp|0.5 + (1.5-0.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}} seconds.

R.name: Absolute Zero
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' {{tip|channel}} a blizzard for up to 3 seconds, granting themselves a {{tip|shield}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0;50 to 95 for 11;95|0 to 3|formula=Increases by 4.5% every 0.25 seconds. ''Starts at 0.25 seconds and finishes at 2.75 seconds''}}.
R.description2: ''Absolute Zero'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends by any means.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' cause the blizzard to explode, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, modified to {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|changedisplay=true|0 to 100|0 to 3 by 1|formula=Increases the damage by 1% of its maximum damage value every 0.03 seconds.}}. Affected enemies will remain {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{pp|type=channel time|0 to 3 for 13|0 to 3}} seconds and any of the duo's remaining shield will decay over 3 seconds.

P.name: Berserker Rage
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Olaf''' gains {{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 70|formula= 1% per 0.7% '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 70% '''missing''' health.''|label1='''missing''' health|label=Percent of level-scaling value|key=%|key1=%|color=hp}} of {{sti|{{as|{{pp|50+(50/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|{{pp|8+(17/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} life steal}}}}.

Q.name: Undertow
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' throws an axe to the target location that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slows}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|1 to 3 for 9|400 to 1000|formula=1+(0.25 per 75 units traveled)}} seconds. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Undertow'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Monster Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|70+20 to 270+120}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: The axe remains in place for a duration equal to ''Undertow's'' cooldown, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. '''Olaf''' can pick up the axe to reduce ''Undertow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{pp|2.5 to 0 for 6|0 to 2.5|type=seconds elapsed since axe landed|formula=2.5 (affected by ability haste) - seconds}}.
Q.description4: ''{{tt|Nearby monsters|100 range estimated}} are granted {{tip|ghosting}} for 5 seconds upon Undertow's cast.''

W.name: Tough It Out
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
W.description2: He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds for an amount that is capped at {{as|70% '''missing''' health}}.
W.description3: ''Tough It Out {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Olaf's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Reckless Swing
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' strikes thunder onto the target enemy, dealing {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}.
E.description2: If ''Reckless Swing'' kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heals}} himself equal to the {{as|{{sti|health|health cost}}}}.
E.description3: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.

R.name: Ragnarok
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Olaf''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for 3 seconds, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to them}}, as well as gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and 10% increased [[size]]. For the first second of ''Ragnarok'', he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20|45|70}}%}}
R.description3: ''Ragnarok's'' duration is increased by and up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds for each basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or cast of ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.

P.name: Clockwork Windup
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - The Ball:}} '''Orianna''' is accompanied by ''The Ball'', which she commands with her {{tip|abilities}}. ''The Ball'' incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.01}}-second}} global cooldown on all of her abilities when she casts any ability. Additionally, ''The Ball'' attaches to '''Orianna''' if she is near it, and snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.75}}-second}} cooldown on ''{{ai|Command: Shockwave|Orianna}}''.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Orianna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Clockwork Winding'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.

{{sbc|Clockwork Winding:}} '''Orianna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{pp|10 + (50-10)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, increased by{{ft|15%|{{pp|10*0.15 + (50*0.15-10*0.15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*0.15}}% AP)}}}}per stack, up to {{pp|10*(1+0.15*2) + (50*(1+0.15*2)-10*(1+0.15*2))/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*(1+0.15*2)}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total bonus''' magic damage}}.
P.description3: ''See [[Orianna#Pets|Pets]] for more details about The Ball.''

P.name: Clockwork Winding
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - The Ball:}} '''Orianna''' is accompanied by ''The Ball'', which she commands with her {{tip|abilities}}. ''The Ball'' incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.01}}-second}} global cooldown on all of her abilities when she casts any ability. Additionally, ''The Ball'' attaches to '''Orianna''' if she is near it, and snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.75}}-second}} cooldown on ''{{ai|Command: Shockwave|Orianna}}''.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Orianna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Clockwork Winding'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.

{{sbc|Clockwork Winding:}} '''Orianna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{pp|10 + (50-10)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, increased by{{ft|15%|{{pp|10*0.15 + (50*0.15-10*0.15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*0.15}}% AP)}}}}per stack, up to {{pp|10*(1+0.15*2) + (50*(1+0.15*2)-10*(1+0.15*2))/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*(1+0.15*2)}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total bonus''' magic damage}}.
P.description3: ''See [[Orianna#Pets|Pets]] for more details about The Ball.''

Q.name: Command: Attack
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' to fly to the target location and remain there, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and nearby enemies upon arrival, reduced to 70% against those hit beyond the first.

W.name: Command: Dissonance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' to emit an electric pulse that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description2: The pulse leaves behind an electric field that last 3 seconds, granting {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to '''Orianna''' and her allies when they move within. Enemies that move within the field are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by the same amount, decaying over 2 seconds after leaving.

E.name: Command: Protect
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' grants {{sti|armor|{{as| '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} to the unit it is attached to.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''The Ball'' to fly to herself or the target allied {{tip|champion}} and attach itself to the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon arrival.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}

R.name: Command: Shockwave
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Orianna''' commands ''{{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}}'' to unleash a shockwave that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them over 325 units, though not through terrain.

P.name: Living Forge
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Forge:}} '''Ornn''' can purchase [[item]]s from the [[shop]] even while outside of its range and from anywhere on the battlefield, by ''forging'' them. He is able to forge any non-[[consumable item|consumable]] item, and is also presented a ''Forge Menu'' to quickly forge his recommended items. Once '''Ornn''' attempts to purchase an item, he starts forging it, causing him to {{tip|channel}} for 4 seconds. Upon completion of the channel, he builds the item and pays its {{g|gold}} cost. The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} if '''Ornn''' takes damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}. ''Living Forge'' is disabled for 4 seconds after starting the channel.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Master Craftsman:}} '''Ornn''' uses his craftsmanship in forgery to upgrade {{tt|most|See notes}} [[Legendary item]]s that he and his teammates own into {{sbc|Masterwork}} items, increasing the [[Gold efficiency (League of Legends)|gold value]] of all {{tt|upgradeable stats|See notes}} on the item by exactly {{g|1000}}, shared equally among them. When '''Ornn''' reaches [[Experience (champion)|level]] 13, the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in his inventory is upgraded automatically. For each level after 13 and before 18 (levels 14–17, total of 4, once per ally per game), '''Ornn''' can upgrade the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in an allied champion's inventory into its {{sbc|Masterwork}} variant. He can do so by selecting the ally while within 600 range, and forges the item's upgrade by performing ''Living Forge's'' {{tip|channel}}.

Additionally, '''Ornn''' increases his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}} by 10% from all sources, further increased by 4% each time he upgrades a ''Legendary'' item into a {{sbc|Masterwork}} item, for a total increase of 30% to each stat after the maximum of 5 upgrades.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Temper:}} '''Ornn''' applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit by ''{{ai|Bellows Breath|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}''. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against enemies afflicted with ''Brittle'' are empowered to {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} a short distance over {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}. '''Ornn's''' and allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects or {{tip|silence|silences}} against ''Brittle'' enemies will consume the debuff to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|type='''Ornn's''' level|9 + (17-9)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|type=[[File:Bellows Breath.png|20px|border]] ''Bellows Breath's'' rank|200 to 500 for 6|0 to 5|formula=200 + 60 per rank of ''Bellows Breath''}} against {{tip|monsters}}, and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable).
P.description4: '''''Ornn''' will prioritize upgrading the first Legendary item eligible for a {{sbc|Masterwork}} upgrade based on its position in the inventory, detecting each slot until an eligible item is found.''
