Q.name: Volcanic Rupture
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sends a fissure in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Q.description2: The fissure stops at maximum range or 200 units behind the first enemy champion struck. After a {{fd|1.125}}-second delay, a magma pillar then erupts at the location to {{tip|airborne|knock aside}} enemies, though not through terrain, and linger as impassible terrain for 4 seconds.
Q.description3: ''The pillar will not expire during {{ais|Searing Charge|Ornn}} dash.''

W.name: Bellows Breath
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|lunge|marches}} forward in the target direction over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, gaining {{tip|displacement immunity}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration.
W.description2: Over the march he belches fire over a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.15}} seconds to enemies hit. The final gout of flame can reach slightly farther and will apply {{tip|Brittle}} for 3 seconds.
W.description3: ''Bellows Breath'' has a minimum damage threshold, which is also the damage dealt to {{tip|minion|minions}}, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|12 to 16}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|12/5 to 16/5}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.leveling3:
{{st|Total Minimum/Minion Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}}|Minimum/Minion Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/5 to 280/5}}}}
{{st|Total Monster Damage Cap|{{ap|260 to 500}}|Monster Damage Cap Per Tick|{{ap|260/5 to 500/5}}}}

E.name: Searing Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through and stopping upon colliding with terrain.
E.description2: If '''Ornn''' collides with terrain during the charge, he creates a shockwave that {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} and {{tip|stuns}} nearby enemies for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and deals the same damage if they were not already hit by the charge.
E.description3: The shockwave destroys the pillar formed by ''{{ai|Volcanic Rupture|Ornn}}'' and partially destroys [[terrain]] created by enemy {{tip|champions}}.
E.description4: '''''Ornn''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the dash ends.''

R.name: Call of the Forge God
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sounds his horn, summoning a lava elemental at maximum range from the target direction that stampedes towards his casting position at increasing speed. The elemental deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
R.description2: ''Call of the Forge God'' can be recast after {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Includes the cast time}} seconds while the elemental is active.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain. If he collides with the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the same direction. The elemental deals the same damage to enemies it passes through and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second, reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
R.description4: Each pass applies {{tip|Brittle}} to targets for 3 seconds and can affect enemies only once. The elemental briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels.

P.name: Mortal Will
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pantheon''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mortal Will'' whenever he lands a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} or casts an {{tip|ability}}, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, '''Pantheon's''' next basic ability consumes the stacks to become empowered with an additional effect.
P.description2: '''Pantheon''' gains maximum stacks of ''Mortal Will'' upon starting the game, completing a {{si|Recall}} channel, and [[death|respawning]].

Q.name: Comet Spear
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Comet Spear's'' {{sti|range}} after {{fd|0.35}} seconds of channeling. ''Comet Spear'' can be recast within the duration.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{ccs|increased|physical}} against enemies {{as|below 20% of their '''maximum''' health}} but reduced by 50% against enemies beyond the first.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Hurl Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Increased Hurl Damage|{{ap|155 to 455}} {{as|(+ 230% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Hurl Secondary Physical Damage|{{ap|70*0.5 to 190*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|115*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.5}}% AP)}}|Increased Hurl Secondary Damage|{{ap|155*0.5 to 455*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|230*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: Releasing the ability within {{fd|0.35}} seconds causes '''Pantheon''' to instead thrust his spear in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{ccs|increased|physical}} against enemies {{as|below 20% of their '''maximum''' health}}, and refunding 60% of ''Comet Spear's'' {{sti|cooldown}}. The thrust's damage is not reduced against enemies beyond the first.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Thrust Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Increased Thrust Damage|{{ap|155 to 455}} {{as|(+ 230% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description4: ''Comet Spear's'' total damage is reduced to 80% against {{tip|monsters}} and to 70% against {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description5: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Comet Spear'' is cancelled and the ability is put on full cooldown but refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|half the mana cost}}}}.
Q.description6: {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} ''Comet Spear'' deals {{as|{{pp|20 + (240-20)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, affected by the previous damage reductions. Consumes the stacks upon recasting.

W.name: Shield Vault
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the front of the target enemy's location. If the target is within 800 units upon arrival, he deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second. Against minions and monsters, ''Shield Vault'' has a minimum damage of 60 and is capped at 150.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|6 to 8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''Pantheon's''' '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} '''Pantheon''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have a {{fd|0.375}}-second cast time and strike the target 3 times over a brief period, dealing {{as|{{pp|120/3 to 165/3|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} per hit, up to {{as|{{pp|120 + (165-120)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}. Each hit is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
W.description3: ''Empowered Shield Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Pantheon's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Aegis Assault
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' braces his shield in the target direction and {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}} to non-{{tip|turret}} damage dealt by enemies from the target direction. He also continually performs strikes in a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|{{fd|8.{{recurring|3}}}}% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds to enemies hit, reduced by 50% against {{tip|minions}} and up to {{as|100% AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}.
E.description2: ''Aegis Assault'' can be recast after {{fd|0.3}} seconds, and does so automatically after the duration. ''Aegis Assault's'' channel cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pantheon''' slams with his shield in a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
E.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} After recasting, '''Pantheon''' gains {{pp|5 + (30-5)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds as well as {{sti|{{as|60% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description5: '''''Pantheon''' can move during the cast time of Aegis Assault's recast.''

R.name: Grand Starfall
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Pantheon''' gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to {{tip|vanish}} and become {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}. He continues {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} around the target location {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the channel.
R.description3: After {{tt|{{fd|0.8}}|Estimated}} seconds into the channel, '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear to the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}|Estimated}} seconds that deals {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Comet Spear.png|20px|border]] ''Comet Spear's'' rank|40 to 190 for 6|0 to 5|formula=40 + 30 per rank of ''Comet Spear''}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to enemies near the impact and {{tip|slows}} them by 50% for 2 seconds.
R.description4: Over the remaining {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Estimated}} seconds, '''Pantheon''' crashes down after {{tt|{{fd|0.55}}|Estimated}} seconds and creates a shockwave alongside himself that travels toward the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.7}}|Estimated}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced by up to 50% for those hit at the edge of the area. Upon completion of the channel, '''Pantheon''' will lose the {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and {{tip|blink|reappear}} at the target location, as well as gain maximum stacks of ''{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}''.
R.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300/2 to 700/2}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
R.description5: ''Grand Starfall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|30-second}} cooldown if the first channel is canceled.

P.name: Iron Ambassador
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Poppy's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to throw her buckler, gaining {{sti|350 '''bonus''' range}} and dealing {{pp|20 + (180-20)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. After it hits, the buckler then falls to a location near the target over 1 second, landing and remaining there for up to 4 seconds.
P.description2: '''Poppy''' can move over the buckler to retrieve it, gaining a {{tip|shield}} for {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|key=%|11 + (20-11)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of her '''maximum''' health}}}} for 3 seconds. If the buckler kills the target, or if the target is already dead when the buckler hits it, the buckler will bounce back to '''Poppy''' instead of falling. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move over the buckler to destroy it.

P.name: Iron Ambassador 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Poppy's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to throw her buckler, gaining {{sti|350 '''bonus''' range}} and dealing {{pp|20 + (180-20)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. After it hits, the buckler then falls to a location near the target over 1 second, landing and remaining there for up to 4 seconds.
P.description2: '''Poppy''' can move over the buckler to retrieve it, gaining a {{tip|shield}} for {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|key=%|11 + (20-11)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of her '''maximum''' health}}}} for 3 seconds. If the buckler kills the target, or if the target is already dead when the buckler hits it, the buckler will bounce back to '''Poppy''' instead of falling. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move over the buckler to destroy it.

Q.name: Hammer Shock
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' smashes the area in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, the damage based on their health ratio is capped.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7 to 9}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Minion/Monster Health Damage|{{ap|85 to 225}}|Maximum Minion/Monster Damage|{{ap|30+85 to 130+225}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: The impact creates a field for 1 second that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within, which then ruptures to deal the same {{as|physical damage}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 32}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}}% per 100 '''Poppy's bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7*2 to 9*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Maximum Minion/Monster Damage|{{ap|(30+85)*2 to (130+225)*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

W.name: Steadfast Presence
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Stubborn to a Fault:}} '''Poppy''' increases her {{sti|armor|{{as|'''total''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''total''' magic resistance}}}} by 16%, doubled to 32% while she is {{as|below 40% '''maximum''' health}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and creates an {{tip|aura}} around herself for 2 seconds, causing all enemies who attempt to {{tip|dash}} into or within it to be dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. If a target was successfully interrupted, they become {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for 2 seconds.
W.description3: ''Steadfast Presence'' can only block a single dash per enemy per cast.

W.name: Steadfast Presence 2
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Stubborn to a Fault:}} '''Poppy''' increases her {{sti|armor|{{as|'''total''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''total''' magic resistance}}}} by 16%, doubled to 32% while she is {{as|below 40% '''maximum''' health}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and creates an {{tip|aura}} around herself for 2 seconds, causing all enemies who attempt to {{tip|dash}} into or within it to be dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. If a target was successfully interrupted, they become {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for 2 seconds.
W.description3: ''Steadfast Presence'' can only block a single dash per enemy per cast.

E.name: Heroic Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|carries}} them along with her for up to 400 units.
E.description2: If the target hits terrain, she stops to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for a duration.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Keeper's Verdict
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' {{tip|channels|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Keeper's Verdict's'' {{sti|range}} and {{tip|airborne|knock back}} distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the channel. ''Keeper's Verdict'' can be recast within the duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Poppy''' releases the charge to launch her hammer upwards, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies nearby and in an area in front of her and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for 1 second.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 45% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: If ''Keeper's Verdict'' was charged for at least {{fd|0.5}} seconds, it deals 100% increased damage and enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} {{tt|up-to 3400 units|Scales up to this value over the first 1 second of the channel}} toward the enemy team's [[Spawn|fountain]], during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and rendered {{tip|untargetable}}. Additionally, if no enemies are hit {{tt|in front|Same as uncharged radius}} of '''Poppy''', she sends a shockwave that travels in the target direction until it collides with an enemy champion, which causes a hammer to erupt. Targets hit by the shockwave or the eruption receive the charged effects.
R.description4: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Keeper's Verdict'' is cancelled and the ability is put on a {{sti|cd|30-second}} cooldown.

P.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke's''' {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}} cannot increase except through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]], instead he gains{{ft|{{sti|{{as|1 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}} {{as|per 14 '''bonus''' health}}.|{{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{fd|7.143}}% of '''bonus''' health}}.}}
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' gains {{as|1 '''bonus''' movement speed}} while in the river.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' stores 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.2}}% per 1 Lethality)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}} as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 40% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 1 Lethality)}} while there are two or more {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 {{as|(+ 800% '''bonus''' AD)}} [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], with an upper cap of {{as|55% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description4: While '''Pyke''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to enemies, he rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.

Q.name: Bone Skewer
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Bone Skewer's'' {{sti|range}} over the first second of the channel. ''Bone Skewer'' can be recast within the duration.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pyke''' hurls his harpoon in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while it is in flight and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90% for 1 second.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: Releasing the ability within {{fd|0.4}} seconds causes '''Pyke''' to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy {{tip|champion}}, or closest enemy otherwise.
Q.description4: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Bone Skewer'' is cancelled and the ability is put on {{sti|cd|full}} cooldown but refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|75% of the mana cost}}}}. ''Bone Skewer's'' {{as|mana cost}} is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion.

W.name: Ghostwater Dive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering {{tip|camouflage}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|45%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
W.description2: ''Enemy champions within 1500 units of '''Pyke''' are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with {{ai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.''

E.name: Phantom Undertow
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Phantom''. '''Pyke''' is {{tip|ghosted}} while the ''Phantom'' is active.
E.description2: After 1 second, the ''Phantom'' homes back to '''Pyke''' to {{tip|stun}} enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for {{fd|1.25}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.1}} per 10 Lethality)}} seconds. Enemy champions hit also take {{as|physical damage}}.

R.name: Death from Below
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' marks the target location with the shape of an ''X'' before striking it, {{tip|execute|executing}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within the area that are below {{as|{{pp|250;290;330;370;400;430;450;470;490;510;530;540;550|6 to 18}}|health}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt{{ft|50% of the amount as {{as|physical damage}}.|{{as|{{pp|125;145;165;185;200;215;225;235;245;255;265;270;275|6 to 18}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|physical damage}}.}}
R.description2: If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or at least one is [[death|killed]] inside the ''X'' by the ''execution'' or an ally, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the center of the ''X''. For the latter case '''Pyke''' can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
R.description3: Each successful ''execution'' grants one ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural [[assist]] {{g|gold}}. Otherwise, '''Pyke''' is granted a ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' for each enemy champion killed inside the ''X'' by an ally during ''Death from Below's'' cast time.

R.name: Death from Below 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' marks the target location with the shape of an ''X'' before striking it, {{tip|execute|executing}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within the area that are below {{as|{{pp|250;290;330;370;400;430;450;470;490;510;530;540;550|6 to 18}}|health}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt{{ft|50% of the amount as {{as|physical damage}}.|{{as|{{pp|125;145;165;185;200;215;225;235;245;255;265;270;275|6 to 18}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|physical damage}}.}}
R.description2: If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or at least one is [[death|killed]] inside the ''X'' by the ''execution'' or an ally, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the center of the ''X''. For the latter case '''Pyke''' can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
R.description3: Each successful ''execution'' grants one ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural [[assist]] {{g|gold}}. Otherwise, '''Pyke''' is granted a ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' for each enemy champion killed inside the ''X'' by an ally during ''Death from Below's'' cast time.

P.name: Royal Privilege
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Qiyana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} deal {{pp|15 + (83-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.

This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
P.description2: Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' resets ''Royal Privilege's'' per-target {{sti|cooldown}} for enemies affected by ''Royal Privilege'' using a different {{as|Element|buzzword}} (or no {{as|Element|buzzword}}).

Q.name: Edge of Ixtal
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' slashes forward in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies in a line, reduced to 75% damage against targets beyond the first. ''Edge of Ixtal'' deals 160% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.75 to 200*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.75}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' resets ''Edge of Ixtal's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and upgrades it into ''Elemental Wrath''.
Q.description3: If cast during ''{{ais|Audacity|Qiyana}}'' dash towards an enemy {{tip|champion}} and the target is within 150 units of '''Qiyana''' at the end of the dash, ''Edge of Ixtal'' will autonomously aim at the target.

Q.name: Elemental Wrath
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' hurls her blade in the target direction that blasts in a line upon hitting an enemy or maximum range, consuming the current {{as|Element|buzzword}} to empower the blade with an additional effect.
Q.description2: Enemies hit are dealt ''Edge of Ixtal's'' damage, reduced to 75% against subsequent enemies beyond the closest. ''Elemental Wrath'' deals 160% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.75 to 200*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.75}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}:}} The blade creates a grass field around '''Qiyana''' that lasts for up to 3 seconds, granting her {{tip|invisibility}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} until she attacks, casts an ability other than ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'', or exits the field.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{as|River}}:}} The blast {{tip|root|roots}} enemies hit for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, then {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 20% for 1 second.
Q.description5: {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}:}} The blast deals {{ccs|60% increased damage|physical}} against enemies below {{as|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}. Subsequent targets beyond the closest that are below the threshold take 35% increased damage instead.

W.name: Terrashape
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While holding an {{as|Element|buzzword}}, '''Qiyana''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on her basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and basic abilities. While [[Combat status|out-of-combat]] and moving near the {{as|Element|buzzword}} currently being held, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dashes}} up to 300 units towards the target location to gather the {{as|Element|buzzword}} of the nearest {{cci|Terrashape Brush.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}}, {{cci|Terrashape River.png}} {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} she targeted.
W.description3: ''A target Element is required to cast this ability''.
W.description4: Once ''Terrashape'' has been learned, '''Qiyana''' is automatically given the {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} element upon [[Death|respawning]].
W.description5: '''''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

E.name: Audacity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals {{as|physical damage}}.
E.description2: '''''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Supreme Display of Talent
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' sweeps a windblast in the target direction that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} enemies hit by {{tt|375 units|estimated}}, though not through terrain, and stops upon hitting {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}}.
R.description2: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}} it passes through, as well as around the borders of {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} it reaches, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|changedisplay=true|type=proximity|0.5;1|0;X}} seconds, and briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 300 3}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Health Damage|{{ap|500 to 1000 3}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

P.name: Harrier
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''{{ci|Valor}}''' will periodically mark a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy if no ''Harrier'' targets exist for 1 second.
P.description2: '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
P.description3: ''Harrier'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description4: While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.
P.static: {{tt|{{pp|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|7*(0.99^((x-1)*10))|key1=%|0 to 100 by 10|formula=7*(0.99^critical strike chance %)}}|Starts after the mark expired or was consumed or overwritten by another mark.}}

Q.name: Blinding Assault
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' sends '''{{ci|Valor}}''' in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased to 200% against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description2: The primary target is {{tip|nearsight|nearsighted}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}, reducing their {{tip|sight}} radius to 350 units. Otherwise, they are {{tip|disarm|disarmed}} for the same duration.

W.name: Heightened Senses
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Quinn''' uses a basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} against a target marked by ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' or consumes their mark, she gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|28 to 80}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Valor}} grants {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area for 2 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions within for the same duration.

E.name: Vault
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'', dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} a very short distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. She then {{tip|dash|leaps back}} 525 units away from them.
E.description2: ''Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' basic attack timer {{tt|shortly after|See notes}} the initial dash. {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''

R.name: Behind Enemy Lines
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|channels}} for 2 seconds, signaling '''{{ci|Valor}}''' to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|'''total''' movement speed|Increases base movement as well as bonus movement speed}}}}}}, granting her {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}}, and allowing her to cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''. ''Behind Enemy Lines'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel.
R.description2: Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} while ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is active or while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} the ability causes her to lose the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
R.description3: Once ''Behind Enemy Lines'' has been learned, [[death|respawning]] or entering {{tt|any|see notes}} [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' instantly.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Quinn''' cancels the channel, placing ''Behind Enemy Lines'' on cooldown.

R.name: Skystrike
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' detaches from '''Valor''', ending ''{{ais|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' effects and raining arrows down around her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}''.
R.description2: Declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' or ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'' during ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' automatically activates ''Skystrike''.

P.name: Fey Feathers
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Rakan''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|30 + (225-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 95% AP)}} that lasts until broken. After being [[out of combat]] for 5 seconds, any leftover shield will be restored to '''maximum''' value.
P.description2: '''Rakan's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} <!--{{tip|on-attack}}?--> and {{tip|ability}} hits reduce ''Fey Feathers' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Rakan''' or {{ci|Xayah}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.
P.cooldown: {{pp|40 to 14.5 for 18; then -0.875*x for 2|formula=40 - 1.5 * level until level 18, then -0.875 per level}}

P.name: Lover's Leap
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Rakan''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|30 + (225-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 95% AP)}} that lasts until broken. After being [[out of combat]] for 5 seconds, any leftover shield will be restored to '''maximum''' value.
P.description2: '''Rakan's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} <!--{{tip|on-attack}}?--> and {{tip|ability}} hits reduce ''Fey Feathers' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Rakan''' or {{ci|Xayah}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.
P.cooldown: {{pp|40 to 14.5 for 18; then -0.875*x for 2|formula=40 - 1.5 * level until level 18, then -0.875 per level}}

Q.name: Gleaming Quill
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: If the target was an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}}, a radius is marked around '''Rakan'''. After 3 seconds or if an allied champion enters the radius, '''Rakan''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|40 + (210-40)*(x-1)/17|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}.

W.name: Grand Entrance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. After a {{fd|0.35}}-second delay upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for 1 second.
W.description2: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''

E.name: Battle Dance
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied champion for 3 seconds and then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to and around them. ''Battle Dance'' can be recast within 5 seconds at no additional cost.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Rakan''' mimics the first cast's effects.
E.description3: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.description4: ''If {{ci|Xayah}} is the target, Battle Dance can be cast from an increased range.''

E.name: Battle Dance 2
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied champion for 3 seconds and then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to and around them. ''Battle Dance'' can be recast within 5 seconds at no additional cost.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Rakan''' mimics the first cast's effects.
E.description3: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.description4: ''If {{ci|Xayah}} is the target, Battle Dance can be cast from an increased range.''

R.name: The Quickness
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' breaks into a captivating sprint for 4 seconds, gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration. During this time, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he collides with and {{tip|charm|charms}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 75% for a duration. This cannot affect the same enemy more than once.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
R.description2: Colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}} extends ''The Quickness' ''duration by {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which can occur once per champion. When '''Rakan''' collides with his first enemy champion, he gains an additional {{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays after {{fd|0.5}} seconds by 20% every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, then by 15% after decaying by 60% over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description4: ''During The Quickness, '''Rakan''' cannot basic attack enemy champions he did not collide with, unless the attack command was inputted before the ability was activated.''

P.name: Spiked Shell
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rammus''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to the sum of {{as|15% '''total''' armor}} and {{as|15% '''total''' magic resistance}}.

Q.name: Powerball
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' rolls into an accelerating ball, {{tip|channel|channeling}} for up to 6 seconds to gain {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|150/6 + (235/6-150/6)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}}}} per second over the duration, up to a maximum of {{pp|key=%|150 + (235-150)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=ms}}.

''Powerball'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting ''{{ai|Defensive Ball Curl|Rammus}}''.
Q.description2: '''Rammus''' stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 125 units, though not through terrain. Enemies hit are then {{tip|stun|stunned}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Estimated}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Rammus''' ends ''Powerball''.

W.name: Defensive Ball Curl
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}. While active, enemies that use a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} against '''Rammus''' are dealt {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' magic resistance)}} {{as|magic damage}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Armor|{{ap|27 to 47}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 60}}% '''total''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 60}}% '''total''' magic resistance)}}}}
W.description2: ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' or ''{{ai|Soaring Slam|Rammus}}''.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Rammus''' ends ''Defensive Ball Curl''.

E.name: Frenzying Taunt
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' {{tip|taunt|taunts}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} for a duration. Monsters are additionally dealt {{as|magic damage}} upon being affected.
E.leveling:
{{st|Taunt Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 2}} seconds}}
{{st|Monster Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

R.name: Soaring Slam
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|Cc-immunity|immunity to crowd control}}. Upon arrival, he creates an impact that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description2: If ''Soaring Slam'' was cast during ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'', enemies within the epicenter of the impact are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and are dealt ''{{ais|Powerball|Rammus}}'' damage. ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' will not collide with enemies during the dash, and its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards.
R.description3: The impact causes 3 aftershocks to burst from the area over {{fd|3.5}} seconds, each one applying and refreshing the duration of the initial {{tip|slow}}.
R.description4: ''Soaring Slam's'' damage affects {{tip|structures}} and is doubled against {{tip|turrets}}.

P.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|25 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to {{as|{{ap|25*0.16}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|minions}}, and to {{as|{{ap|25*0.2}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|ward|wards}} and [[jungle plants]]. '''Rek'Sai's''' {{tip|abilities}} other than ''{{ai|Queen's Wrath|Rek'Sai}}'' generate {{as|25 Fury}} upon hitting at least one unit. ''{{ai|Prey Seeker|Rek'Sai}}'' does not generate {{as|Fury}} against non-{{tip|champions}} hit. After 8 seconds of being [[out of combat]], she loses {{as|20 Fury}} per second.
P.description2: When '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}}, she consumes her current {{as|Fury}} over 3 seconds to {{tip|heal}} for {{pp|0 to 100|0 to 100 by 5|type=Fury|key=%|color=Fury}} of {{as|{{pp|9 + (20-9)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}}, stopping once fully consumed or she reaches {{sti|health|{{as|full health}}}}. If she starts generating {{as|Fury}} while {{sbc|Burrowed}}, the consumption occurs after 5 seconds.

Q.name: Queen's Wrath
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' gains {{sti|{{as|35% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds. Her next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the duration will have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies. ''Queen's Wrath's'' damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|30 to 50}}% AD}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|30*3 to 50*3}}% AD}}}}
Q.description2: If '''Rek'Sai''' completes an attack, the duration is refreshed, for up to 3 total empowered attacks.
Q.description3: ''Queen's Wrath {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rek'Sai's''' basic attack timer.''

Q.name: Prey Seeker
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' fires a void bolt in the target direction that detonates on the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 5 seconds.

W.name: Burrow
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|Burrowed}}, reducing her {{sti|attack range by 50}} and her {{tip|sight}} radius to 385 units, while gaining access to her {{sbc|Burrowed}} abilities. She also becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, as well as ''Tremor Sense''.
W.description2: {{sbc|Tremor Sense:}} '''Rek'Sai''' and her allies gain {{tip|obscured vision}} of non-visible, moving enemies within range at a rate of once every second.
W.description3: Once ''Burrow'' has been learned, '''Rek'Sai''' automatically becomes {{sbc|Burrowed}} upon completing a {{si|Recall}} channel or [[death|respawning]].

W.name: Unburrow
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}}, gaining access to her {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}} abilities and emerging from the ground to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} for 1 second. {{tip|Minions}} and small {{tip|monsters}} are instead {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} a short distance. Targets hit cannot be {{tip|airborne|displaced}} by ''Unburrow'' again for some time.
W.description2: '''Rek'Sai''' can also trigger ''Unburrow'' by issuing an attack command, casting the ability once she is in attack range of the target and applying the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} against them.
W.description3: '''''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack for {{fd|0.15}} seconds after hitting an enemy with Unburrow.''

E.name: Furious Bite
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' bites the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.
E.description2: At maximum {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}, ''Furious Bite'' deals {{ap|1.2*100|round=2}}% damage and is converted to {{ccs|{{as|true damage}}|true}}.

E.name: Tunnel
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Tunnel'' that has two interconnected entrances and lasts up to 10 minutes. The ''Tunnel'' can be traversed again when '''Rek'Sai''' targets either entrance, causing her to {{tip|dash}} to the selected entrance before {{tip|dash|travelling}} through the ''Tunnel'' to the opposite side. Once a ''Tunnel'' has been traversed, it is shut down for a few seconds during which '''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter it again.
E.description2: '''Rek'Sai''' can have up to 8 ''Tunnels'' active on the battlefield at once. Deploying ''Tunnels'' beyond the maximum causes the oldest one to be destroyed. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy a ''Tunnel'' by standing on either entrance for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, granting them {{g|5}} upon successfully destroying the ''Tunnel''.
E.description3: If '''Rek'Sai''' attempts to enter a ''Tunnel'' while {{sbc|{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai|Un-Burrowed}}}}, she will automatically ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' upon interacting with it, and automatically ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}}'' after exiting it. This does not place ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' on cooldown nor trigger ''{{ai|Fury of the Xer'Sai|Rek'Sai}}'', but does trigger other ''Burrow'' effects and ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}}''. If ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' is on cooldown at the time of interacting with the ''Tunnel'', the cooldown will be reset.
E.description4: '''''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter a tunnel while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.''

R.name: Void Rush
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rek'Sai''' applies ''Marked as Prey'' to enemy champions she damages, lasting for 5 seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' singles out the target enemy champion ''Marked as Prey'', becoming {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} into the ground, as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target for {{tt|{{fd|1.5}} seconds|From the start of the cast time, estimated}}. After {{tt|{{fd|0.9}} seconds|Estimated, from end of cast time}}, she {{tip|blink|blinks}} to a location {{tt|near the target|Relative to her casting position}}, becoming targetable again and emerging from the ground to {{tip|dash|pounce}} at them. Upon arrival, she slashes at the target with her claws, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} 125 units through them.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15 to 25}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
R.description3: ''If cast while in {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}} form, '''Rek'Sai''' will automatically {{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}} at the end of Void Rush's cast time, placing {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} on a 1-second cooldown without triggering Unburrow's effects. If {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} is already on cooldown, its remaining cooldown is set to 1 second.''

P.name: Break the Mold
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rell's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} equal to the sum of {{as|5% of her '''total''' armor}} and {{as|5% of her '''total''' magic resistance}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rell's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against non-{{tip|minions}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Break The Mold'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by 3% for a maximum of 15% reduction.
P.description3: '''Rell''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}} equal to the sum of resistances reduced from all afflicted enemies.
P.description4: ''Break the Mold'' will reduce the target's {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resistance}} by a minimum of {{pp|1.5 + (3-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}.

Q.name: Shattering Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' thrusts her lance in the target direction, {{tip|lunge|lunging}} forward 100 units and destroying the damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} of all enemies hit (excluding the shields of {{tip|monsters}}) before dealing them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.65}} seconds.
Q.description2: '''''Rell''' will not {{tip|lunge}} forward after the cast time if she was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} during it. She is also {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.35}} seconds after the cast time.''

W.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Mounted Alacrity:}} While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she gains {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Dismounted}} and {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location over the cast time, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} that lasts until destroyed or casting ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}''. Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She will continue {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward another 320 units over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Estimated}}, though not through terrain, affecting further enemies along her path.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|20 to 100}} {{as|(+ 11% '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
W.description3: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}''. Upon completing a {{si|Recall}} channel or respawning, '''Rell''' will automatically revert to {{sbc|Mounted}} form without casting the ability and reset ''{{ais|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
W.description4: ''This ability can be cast only while Rell is {{sbc|Mounted}}. '''Rell''' can cast {{ai|Magnet Storm|Rell}} during the dash, and is considered to be dismounted at the start of the cast time.''

W.name: Ferromancy: Mount Up
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she gains {{sti|{{as|15% '''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|15% '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Mounted}}, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds and empowering her next basic attack within {{fd|3.5}} seconds to have a {{fd|0.2}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}, and cause her to {{tip|dash|charge}} at the target's location. Upon arrival or collision of the charge, her basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for {{fd|0.6}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|flings}} them 150 units over herself, though not through terrain, over {{fd|0.4}} seconds.
W.description3: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Crash Down|Rell}}''.
W.description4: ''Ferromancy: Mount Up {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rell's''' basic attack timer. This ability can be cast only while '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}.''

E.name: Full Tilt
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' powers up herself and the target allied {{tip|champion}} for 3 seconds, both gaining {{as|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing the empowered ally or a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion.
E.description2: Additionally, '''Rell's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Shattering Strike|Rell}}'' within 5 seconds creates an explosion around {{tt|the target|See Notes}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, capped at {{pp|150 + (300-150)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|structures}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|5 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
E.description3: If cast without a valid target, or [[self-targeted|self-cast]], ''Full Tilt'' will automatically target the closest allied champion in range.

R.name: Magnet Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' erupts with magnetic fury, {{tip|airborne|pulling}} nearby enemies {{tt|inward|to a ring 225 units around Rell, but minimum 100 pull distance}} and creating a gravitational field around her for the next 2 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies and {{tip|kinematics|drags}} them towards her.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|150/8 to 350/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110/8}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}}}}

P.name: Leverage
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renata's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> are empowered to apply a mark that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, the attack also deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|1 to 2 for 9}}|health}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2: Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and {{tip|abilities}} against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|additional '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|1 to 2 for 9}}|health}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description3: ''Leverage's'' damage is capped at 150 against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Handshake
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 1 second, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

If the {{tip|root}} was applied, '''Renata''' forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and the target for the same duration, causing '''Renata''' to become unable to declare attacks and have her {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' by {{as|30%|ms}}.
Q.description2: ''Handshake'' can be recast while the tether is active.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Renata''' breaks the tether to {{tip|airborne|knock}} the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through. If the thrown target is a {{tip|champion}}, all secondary targets hit are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

W.name: Bailout
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' infuses herself or the target allied champion with a chemtech formula for 5 seconds, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while they are facing nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions or minions, with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by {{pp|key=%|type=seconds elapsed|0 to 100 for 21|0 to 5}}. ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 30*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 20*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description2:
If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} while ''Bailout'' is active, they are restored to {{as|100% of their '''maximum''' health}} but suffer a {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} burn equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} until they reach {{as|'''0''' health}}, during which ''Bailout's'' duration is reset every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This effect may occur only ''once'' per application of ''Bailout'' while the target already has the buff and is not burning.

The burn will stop once the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their {{as|'''current''' health}} to {{as|20% of their '''maximum''' health}} immediately afterwards.

E.name: Loyalty Program
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' sends out chemtech rockets from either side of her that instantly strike targets around her. After {{rutngt|0.4}} they converge and travel to the target location as a single missile, striking targets along its path and exploding upon reaching the target location.
E.description2: '''Renata''' and allies struck are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and enemies struck are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for 2 seconds.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 185}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 110}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}

R.name: Hostile Takeover
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' launches a cloud of potent chemicals that travels in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Enemy champions and minions hit become {{tip|berserk}} for a duration.
R.description2:
''Berserked'' units gain {{sti|{{as|100% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and 25% increased {{tip|size}}. Within their targeting radius, they prioritize attacking the closest unit by the following categories in descending order:
# Their allied champions 
# Allied non-champions
# Allied {{tip|wards}}
# Enemy units (including {{tip|monster|monsters}})

P.name: Reign of Anger
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renekton's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|5 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses {{as|1 Fury}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

Entering combat or using an attack will stop the {{as|Fury}} loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while ''{{ai|Dominus|Renekton}}'' is active, the timer is continuously refreshed.
P.description2: While '''Renekton''' has at least {{as|50 Fury}}, his next {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, excluding ''{{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton|Slice}}'', consumes {{as|50 Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate {{as|Fury}}.
P.description3: '''Renekton''' generates {{as|50% '''bonus''' Fury}} from all sources while {{as|below 50% of his '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Cull the Meek
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' cleaves around himself, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for each enemy hit, up to a cap.
Q.description2: Against {{tip|champion|champions}}, the healing is increased.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Champion Healing|{{ap|12 to 44}} {{as|(+ 17% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Enhanced Champion Healing|{{ap|36 to 132}} {{as|(+ 51% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: '''Renekton''' generates {{tip|fury|{{as|{{fd|2.5}} Fury}}}} for each non-champion hit and {{as|10 Fury}} for each champion hit, up to {{as|30|Fury}} total per cast.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Cull the Meek'' has increased damage, tripled '''total''' healing, and a quadrupled healing cap.
Q.description5: '''''Renekton''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} or {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.''

W.name: Ruthless Predator
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have a {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second cast time|(Estimated)}}, have {{sti|range|175 range}} and strike the target twice, dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and generates {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates {{as|10 '''bonus''' Fury}}.
W.leveling: {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5*2 to 65*2}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}}|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 75% AD)}}}}
W.description2: ''Ruthless Predator's'' first strike can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Renekton|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target upon the first strike if they are not a {{tip|monster}}, as well as increasing the {{tip|stun}} duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Ruthless Predator {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Renekton's''' basic attack timer. After Ruthless Predator's standard and empowered attack cast time, '''Renekton''' cannot move nor cast {{ai|Cull the Meek|Renekton}} or {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} for {{rutngt|0.525}}. Casting {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} ends this lockout prematurely.''

E.name: Slice and Dice
E.description: {{sbc|Active - Slice:}} '''Renekton''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through.
E.description2: If '''Renekton''' hits an enemy, he can recast ''Slice and Dice'' within the next 4 seconds.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Dice:}} '''Renekton''' repeats the first cast's effects.
E.description4: Both casts generate {{tip|fury|{{as|2 Fury}}}} for each non-champion hit and {{as|10 Fury}} for each champion hit, up to {{as|30|fury}} total per cast.
E.description5: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Dice'', the recast, deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and inflicts {{sti|arpen|{{as|armor reduction}}}} to enemies hit for 4 seconds.
E.leveling5:
{{st|Enhanced Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 250}} {{as|(+ 135% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Enhanced Damage|{{ap|40+70 to 160+250}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:90+135}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|25 to 35}}%|armor}}}}

R.name: Dominus
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}}, 20% increased [[size]], {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and {{tip|fury|{{as|20 Fury}}}}, as well as increasing ''{{ais|Cull the Meek|Renekton}}'' effect radius.
R.description2: During this time, he deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies and generates {{as|5 Fury}} per second, up to a maximum of {{as|75 Fury}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30 to 120}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30*30 to 120*30}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}

P.name: Unseen Predator
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon casting a {{tip|Champion ability|basic ability}} or using ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' first attack, '''Rengar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} for {{tt|1 second|counting from the end of attack windup or cast time}}, stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers {{bug|2}}. At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|30 to 50 for 3|1 to 13|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Generated {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} is prevented from expiring for 10 seconds after dealing or taking damage, excluding damage dealt by [[damage over time]] or [[Damage#Engine_level|proc]] effects.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Rengar''' gains ''Unseen Predator'', which lingers for {{fd|0.35}} seconds upon exiting brush. ''Unseen Predator'' is lost immediately if '''Rengar''' exits the brush using {{si|Flash}} or {{si|Hexflash}}.
P.description3:
{{sbc|Unseen Predator:}} '''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} generates {{as|1 Ferocity|buzzword3}} if none of his {{tt|{{as|current Ferocity|buzzword3}} was generated this way|The next use of Unseen Predator after consuming all Ferocity from an empowered ability will count for this effect}}. The attack also has massively increased range and causes him to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond his normal basic attack range, attacking the target upon arrival and landing 50 units in front of them.

'''''Rengar''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash. The start of the leap is the end of '''Rengar's''' {{tip|attack windup}}, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects and additionally refreshing the {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} duration.''
P.description4: {{Anchor|Bonetooth Necklace}}{{sbc|Innate - Bonetooth Necklace:}} Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them grants '''Rengar''' a ''Trophy'', once per unique champion and up to 5. An additional ''Trophy'' is made available through the event ''[[The Hunt is On!]]'' with the [[File:Head of Kha'Zix.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Head of Kha'Zix''. ''Trophies'' grant {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|border|adjustsize|link=]] Trophies|key=%|x^2 for 6|x;Head of Kha'Zix|formula=(Number of Trophies) * (Number of Trophies)}} '''bonus''' AD}}.

Q.name: Savagery
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' gains {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} within 3 seconds.
Q.description2: His first attack {{tip|on-hit}} is empowered to stab the target, having an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gaining {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, and dealing {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 160}} {{as|(+ 5% AD)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Savagery's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|35 to 140 for 8; 150 + (240-150)/9*(x-1) for 12|formula = 20 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 10 per level|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. In addition to gaining another instance of the base attack speed on-cast, consuming the attack also grants {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 + (101-50)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' attack speed}} for 5 seconds.
Q.description4: ''Savagery {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rengar's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Battle Roar
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rengar''' stores 50% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he has taken in the last {{fd|1.5}} seconds as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 100% of damage taken from {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' roars, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{as|{{pp|65 + (130-65)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}, and consuming his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
W.description3: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Battle Roar's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (220-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. '''Rengar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}}.

E.name: Bola Strike
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' throws a bola in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of a 150-unit radius around them for the same duration.
E.description2: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Bola Strike's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (305-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}}. The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
E.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|While not leaping with Unseen Predator}}|{{tt|None|While leaping with Unseen Predator}}}}

R.name: Thrill of the Hunt
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rengar''' also gains ''{{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}'' while {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} from any source.
R.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' prowls for a duration, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. After a 2-second delay, he also becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} and gains ''{{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}''.
The camouflage can only last up to 14 seconds. {{bug|2}}
R.leveling2: {{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|12 to 20}} seconds}}{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
R.description3: During this time, '''Rengar''' will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} and gaining {{tip|sight}} of a 100-unit radius around them. Enemies detected are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for the remaining full duration.
R.description4: The nearest detected enemy within 1600 range is also marked, alerting all of their allies within 1200 range about '''Rengar's''' presence.
R.description5:
'''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{sti|range|icononly=true}} {{ccd|Rengar|range}} range against any enemy or with ''Unseen Predator'' to the marked enemy deals {{as|100% AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}, then inflicts {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
The target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}} until the leap has finished.
R.description6: [[Basic attack|Attacking]] or casting [[champion ability|abilities]] other than ''{{ai|Savagery|Rengar}}'' ends ''Thrill of the Hunt'' immediately.

P.name: Runic Blade
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Riven's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Charge'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. '''Riven's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> are empowered to each consume a stack to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} AD}}, reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pp|key=%|(30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1))*0.5 for 20|formula=50% of non-structure damage}} AD}}}}against {{tip|structures}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, it also deals {{as|50 '''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
P.description2: The '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

Q.name: Broken Wings
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' can activate ''Broken Wings'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a {{fd|0.3125}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Riven''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
Q.description2: '''Riven''' slashes with her sword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies struck within an area, {{tip|Basic attack reset|resetting}} her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of ''Broken Wings'' if there are any.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*3 to 165*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*3 to 80*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects.
Q.description5: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit 75 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. This cast can cross terrain.

W.name: Ki Burst
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' emits a flash of runic energy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

E.name: Valor
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: '''''Riven''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash. Valor will cast at max range if cast beyond that.''

R.name: Blade of the Exile
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' empowers her blade for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased range on ''{{ai|Broken Wings|Riven}}'' and ''{{ai|Ki Burst|Riven}}''.

After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, she can cast ''{{ai|Wind Slash|Riven}}'' within the duration.

R.name: Wind Slash
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type= target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=2.667% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 200% bonus damage at 75% missing health.''}}|health}}.
R.leveling: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|100*3 to 200*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

P.name: Junkyard Titan
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rumble's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or ''{{ai|The Equalizer|Rumble}}'' within 2 seconds. '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'' when at or above {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}, and becomes ''Overheated'' while at {{tip|Heat|150 Heat}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Danger Zone:}} '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'', empowering his basic abilities.
P.description3: {{sbc|Overheated:}} '''Rumble's''' mech becomes ''Overheated'', disabling his {{tip|abilities}} as his {{tip|Heat}} decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds. During this time, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|50+((130-50)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers his {{tip|basic attacks}} to deal {{pp|5 + (40-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{pp|65+((150-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rumble's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or ''{{ai|The Equalizer|Rumble}}'' within 2 seconds. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{pp|65+((150-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Flamespitter
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to activate his flamethrower for 3 seconds, spewing forth flames in a {{tt|frontal|In his facing direction}} cone every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Enemies hit by the flame are scorched for {{ap|0.5 + 0.1}} seconds, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently scorched, refreshing on subsequent inflictions.

''Flamespitter's'' damage is reduced to {{ap|0.7*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description2:
{{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Flamespitter's'' damage is increased by 50%.

''Flamespitter's'' total damage based on the target's health is capped at {{pp|65+((300-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|formula=Uses stat growth interpolation; 65 base, 300 maximum}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Scrap Shield
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description2: '''Rumble''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{tt|1 to {{fd|1.32}} seconds.|See notes}}
W.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Scrap Shield's'' shield strength and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} are increased in effectiveness by 50%.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Enhanced Shield Strength|{{ap|25*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*1.5}}% of '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Enhanced Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*1.5 to 30*1.5}}%}}

E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to shoot a harpoon in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, inflicting them with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. These effects {{tip|stacks additively|stack additively}} with multiple harpoons, refreshing their duration and stacking up to 2 times.
E.description2: '''Rumble''' periodically [[stocks]] an ''Electro Harpoon'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Electro Harpoon's'' effects are increased by 50%.
E.description4: ''If '''Rumble''' casts Electro Harpoon before his mech becomes {{ai|Junkyard Titan 3|Rumble|Overheated}}, he may still use another charge within 3 seconds of the initial cast.''

E.description4: ''If '''Rumble''' casts Electro Harpoon before his mech becomes {{ai|Junkyard Titan 3|Rumble|Overheated}}, he may still use another charge within 3 seconds of the initial cast.''

R.name: The Equalizer
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' deploys a barrage of rockets from the sky along the target path in a line over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each rocket impacts the ground to create a field of fire that lasts {{fd|4.5}} seconds.
R.description2: Enemies struck by the impact or within the field are marked ''Burning'' for 1 second, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds and being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%, refreshing while in the area. Enemies may be ''Burning'' for up to 5 seconds, for a total of 20 instances of its effect.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|120/4 to 280/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|120 to 280}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|120*5 to 280*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*5}}% AP)}}}}
