P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ryze''' increases his {{as|{{sti|mana|'''maximum''' mana}}}} by {{as|(10% per 100 AP)}}.

Q.name: Overload
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ryze's''' other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts reset ''Overload's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and charge a [[File:Overload 3.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' {{tip|stack}} for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 2 times.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' unleashes a runic blast in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all [[File:Overload 4.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' stacks.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 155}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}} {{as|(+ 2% '''bonus''' mana)}}}}
Q.description3: If '''Ryze''' consumed 2 stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Overload'' deals {{pp|type=[[File:Realm Warp.png|20px|border]] ''Realm Warp's'' Rank|key=%|25 to 100 for 4|0 to 3}} {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} and spreads to surrounding ''Fluxed'' enemies.

W.name: Rune Prison
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' seizes the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.

E.name: Spell Flux
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' projects an orb upon the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.

The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with ''Flux'' for 4 seconds. '''Ryze's''' basic abilities against ''Flux'' targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.
E.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Spell Flux'' spreads farther.

R.name: Realm Warp
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Overload|Ryze}}'' ''{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}}'' empowered damage is increased.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 2 seconds to open a portal beneath him, marking the target location as its destination and granting {{tip|sight}} of the target area. '''Ryze''' is able to act while channeling, but the portal will cancel if he is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
R.description3: Upon completion, '''Ryze''' and all allied units within the portal will {{tip|blink}} to the location and become {{tip|root|rooted}}, {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}, {{tip|silence|silenced}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.75}}|Estimated}} seconds.

P.name: Daredevil Impulse
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Style'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 6 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Style:}} For each stack, '''Samira''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|2.75 to 3.5 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|16.5 to 21 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}}|ms}}. At maximum stacks, '''Samira''' can cast ''{{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}}''.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' basic attacks against targets within {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 200 units of her use her blade, becoming {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}. Blade attacks, ''{{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}'', ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', and the slash and explosives of ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}}'' deal {{as|{{pp|2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD)}} '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 100 by 5|formula=1% for every 1% missing health|key=%|key1=%|label1=target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, up to {{as|{{pp|(2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|(3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20|key=%}} AD)}}|magic damage}}.
P.description4: '''Samira's''' basic attack against an {{tip|immobilized}} target is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and fire {{tt|6 bolts over {{fd|0.5}} seconds|First bolt at the time of cast then once every 0.1 seconds thereafter.}}, each dealing {{as|17% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applying}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. If the target is a {{tip|monster}} or is {{tip|airborne}}, the attack also {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
P.description5: The empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Samira's''' basic attack timer, is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, and cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
P.description6: If the target is further away from '''Samira's''' {{sti|attack range}}, initiating an attack against the immobilized target while within valid range of them will first cause her to {{tip|dash}} toward them up to her {{sti|attack range}}, then automatically cast the bolts.

Q.name: Flair
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: If a targetable enemy is in front of '''Samira''' at the time of cast, she will instead slash with her blade in a cone, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
Q.description3: If ''Flair'' is cast during ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', '''Samira''' deploys explosives in her wake that detonate upon the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
Q.description4: ''Flair'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage and will {{tip|applies lifesteal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

W.name: Blade Whirl
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' spins her blade over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, destroying all hostile non-{{tip|turret}} {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} within the area for the duration.
W.description2: '''Samira''' slashes twice during ''Blade Whirl'', each one dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies. The first slash occurs immediately and the second one occurs after the duration.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*2 to 80*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
W.description3: '''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} during Blade Whirl. Casting {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} will end Blade Whirl early.''

E.name: Wild Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy or enemy {{tip|turret|structure}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. She also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 90}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
E.description2: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them resets ''Wild Rush's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} can be cast during the dash. Casting {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} will buffer it to cast at the end of the dash.''

R.name: Inferno Trigger
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' unleashes a torrent of shots for {{rutngt|2.25}}, '''reducing''' her {{as|movement speed}} by {{as|30%|ms}} and rapidly shooting at  nearby enemies over {{rutngt|2}} at sporadic times in {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second intervals|on average; total of 5 intervals of 0.231 and 5 of 0.198 seconds}} each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each shot, reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*10 to 60*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*10}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20*0.25 to 60*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25}}% AD)}}|Total Minion Damage|{{ap|20*0.25*10 to 60*0.25*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25*10}}% AD)}}}}
R.description2: ''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to cast this ability, and targets do not have to be visible to be shot at. {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style|image= Samira Rank S.png}} stacks are consumed at the end of the effect.''
R.description3: '''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} during Inferno Trigger, but she can still move. Inferno Trigger will end prematurely if '''Samira''' is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} as well as {{tip|disarm}}. Inferno Trigger cannot be cast while '''Samira''' is {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}.''

P.name: Fury of the North
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Icebreaker:}} Enemies {{tip|stun|stunned}} by '''Sejuani''' are marked ''Frozen'' for the disable's duration. '''Sejuani's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} against a ''Frozen'' enemy will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at 250 against epic monsters.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains ''Frost Armor'', which lingers for 3 seconds after taking damage from enemy {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|turrets}}, or large {{tip|monsters}}. She restores it after {{pp|12 - (12-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} seconds without taking damage from them.
P.description3: {{sbc|Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}}, {{tip|cripple-immune|cripple immunity}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|10 (+ 75% '''bonus''' armor) '''bonus''' armor}}}}, and {{sti|mr|{{as|10 (+ 75% '''bonus''' magic resistance) '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.

Q.name: Arctic Assault
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Bristle|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he collides with an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
Q.description3: ''Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''

W.name: Winter's Wrath
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After {{fd|0.25}} seconds into the cast time, '''Sejuani''' swings her flail in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} hit, though not through terrain.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 45}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of her '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description2: After the cast time, '''Sejuani''' lashes out with her flail in a line in the same direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 85}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 8% of her '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5+5 to 45+85}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30+60}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8+4}}% of her '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description3: '''''Sejuani''' can move during Winter's Wrath's cast time.''

E.name: Permafrost
E.description:
{{sbc|Passive - Frostbrand:}} ''{{ai|Winter's Wrath|Sejuani}}'' and both '''Sejuani's''' and nearby allied {{tip|melee}} champions' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} apply {{tip|stacks}} of ''Frost'' to enemy {{tip|champions}}, medium or large {{tip|monsters}}, and large {{tip|minions}} for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times, though not applying if the target is ''{{ai|Fury of the North|Sejuani|Frozen}}''. Enemies hit by ''Permafrost'' or ''{{ais|Glacial Prison|Sejuani}}'' bola have all of their ''Frost'' stacks consumed. Enemy champions cannot be affected by ''Frost'' for 8 seconds after having it consumed.

'''Sejuani''' can cast ''Permafrost'' against an enemy with 4 stacks.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' hurls a trap at the {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy with 4 stacks of ''Frost'' closest to the cursor, which deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{tt|displaces|Does not apply airborne nor is a knockdown. Applies a move block (forced movement) which can interrupt dashes and other displacements.}} them slightly, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second.
E.description3: ''Permafrost {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sejuani's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Glacial Prison
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
R.description2: If the bola travels at least 425 units, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching maximum range or hitting an enemy champion, dealing increased {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds instead. For the same duration, a frost storm is created around the location of the detonation that {{tip|slows}} enemies within by 30% and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area in a smaller radius.
R.leveling2: {{st|Increased Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
R.description3: After 2 seconds, the storm shatters to deal the increased {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|slow}} them by 80% for 1 second, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
R.description4: The enemy hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm's effects.

P.name: Absolution
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Weakened Soul}}: '''Senna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|abilities}} mark enemy champions hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent attacks or ability hits against marked targets will consume the mark to grant '''Senna''' a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Mist}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1 to 10 for 10|formula=1% * level, capped at level 10|key=%}} of the target's '''current''' health}}, rendering the target immune to being marked again for a few seconds. This damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Enemies that die near '''Senna''' may spawn a ''Mist Wraith'' from their corpse. A ''Mist Wraith'' lasts 8 seconds and '''Senna''' can basic attack or hit it with ''{{ai|Piercing Darkness|Senna}}'' or ''{{ai|Dawning Shadow|Senna}}'' to kill it instantly, granting her {{g|8}} and a stack of {{as|Mist}}.
* Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} will spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Epic {{tip|monsters}} will spawn 2 ''Mist Wraiths''.
* {{tip|Minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' kills have a 5% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Large {{tip|minions}} that '''Senna''' does not kill will always spawn a ''Mist Wraith'', while lesser {{tip|minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' does not kill have a 32% chance to spawn one.
* Lesser minions executed by an allied champion's {{nie|Support Quest}} item have a {{fd|8.4}}% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
P.description3: {{sbc|Mist}}: For each stack of {{as|Mist}}, '''Senna''' gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|{{fd|0.75}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}. For every 20 stacks, she also gains {{sti|attack range|20 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{sti|critical strike chance|{{as|10% critical strike chance}}}}. Additionally, every {{tt|{{as|1% critical strike chance}}|Counts critical strike chance from items and Mist stacks}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{fd|0.35}}% {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Relic Cannon}}: '''Senna's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|20% AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and grant her {{as|{{pp|key=%|10 to 20 for 3|1;6;9}} of the target's movement speed|ms}} as {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

Q.name: Piercing Darkness
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a beam in the direction of the target unit. The beam consists of a wider ray of light, and a narrower ray of shadow at the center.

The shadow ray deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 15% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} for a duration. The damage dealt to enemy champions {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
Q.description2: The light ray {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Senna''' and allied {{tip|champions}} hit.
Q.description3: ''Piercing Darkness'' is {{tt|considered|Piercing Darkness doesn't actually apply basic damage}} to trigger a single {{tip|basic attack}} against {{tip|turrets}}, {{tip|wards}}, [[jungle plants]], {{ai|Absolution 3|Senna|Mist Wraiths}} and [[Champion_summoned_units#Targetable|any other attack-interactive units]] hit. It also applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|turrets}} hit, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects against {{tt|one champion hit|see notes}}.
Q.description4: ''Piercing Darkness' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second {{tip|on-attack}}.
Q.cast time: {{as|80% of '''Senna's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:0.8*{{ccd|Senna|windup}}*(1/{{ccd|Senna|as_base}})round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

W.name: Last Embrace
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' throws a globule of Black Mist in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and attaches to them for 1 second.
W.description2: After the duration or when the target dies, the Black Mist spreads out of the target, {{tip|root|rooting}} them and surrounding enemies for a few seconds.

E.name: Curse of the Black Mist
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' shrouds herself in an {{tip|aura}} of Black Mist and gains {{tip|camouflage}} for a duration. If '''Senna''' {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the camouflage}}, she regains it after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth.
E.description2: Allied champions who enter the mist gain ''Wraith Form'' for a duration equal to the aura's remaining duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Wraith Form:}} Gain {{tip|camouflage}}. Enemies are granted {{tip|obscured vision}} of camouflaged ''Wraiths'' moving outside the mist within their line of {{tip|sight}}. ''Wraith Form'' can be regained if lost by breaking the camouflage after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth. ''Wraith Form'' ends immediately upon '''Senna's''' {{tip|death}}.
E.description4: '''Senna''' and allies camouflaged by ''Curse of the Black Mist'' also gain {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
E.description5: '''''Senna''' can move during Curse of the Black Mist's cast time.''

R.name: Dawning Shadow
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a massive beam in the target direction. The beam consists of a broad wave of light, and a narrow wave of shadow at the center.
R.description2: The shadow wave deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 3 seconds, as well as hits all ''{{ai|Absolution|Senna|Mist Wraiths}}''.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|250 to 550}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
R.description3: The light wave grants a {{tip|shield}} to '''Senna''' and allied champions hit for 3 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of {{tt|the area|Can see through brush and terrain.}} along the path for 2 seconds.

P.name: Stage Presence
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Echo:}} '''Seraphine's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts each generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Echo'', stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, the next basic ability cast consumes them all to cast an additional time at no cost after a {{rutngt|0.01}} delay. '''Seraphine''' gains maximum stacks of ''Echo'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Harmony:}} '''Seraphine's''' ability casts grant a ''Note'' to herself and nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent ''Notes'' and stacks up to 4 times on each unit.
P.description3: While any amount of ''Notes'' are active, '''Seraphine's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} per ''Note'', and fire all ''Notes'' at the target, with each one dealing {{as|{{pp|4 + (25-4)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced by 75% for ''Notes'' from allies.

Q.name: High Note
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' hurls a soundwave to the target location that upon arrival expands in a radius over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
Q.description2: Against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, the damage is {{ccs|increased|magic}} by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 75 for 11|0 to 75|formula=7.5% per 7.5% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 75% '''missing''' health|color=health}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Enhanced Damage|{{ap|60*1.75 to 160*1.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.75}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Surround Sound
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to herself and nearby allied champions for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. For the same duration, she also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|decaying '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and grants other allies {{as|{{ap|20*0.4}}%|ms}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.4}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
W.description2: If '''Seraphine''' already had a {{tip|shield}} at the time of cast, ''Surround Sound'' will pulse after the duration, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and nearby allied champions.
W.description3: ''Surround Sound's shield and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} can stack up to 2 times. '''Seraphine''' can move during Surround Sound's cast time.''

E.name: Beat Drop
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' fires a heavy soundwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for a few seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.7 to 190*0.7}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.7}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
E.description2: Enemies that are already {{tip|slow|slowed}} are also {{tip|root|rooted}} for the same duration.
E.description3: Enemies that are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration.

R.name: Encore
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' projects a captivating force in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|charm|charms}} them, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for a duration, increasing by 15% every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration up to 99%.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 250}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 1.75}} seconds}}
R.description2: ''Encore's'' projectile resets its remaining travel distance whenever it hits an allied or enemy {{tip|champion}}, excluding '''Seraphine'''. Allied champions hit gain 4 ''{{ai|Stage Presence|Seraphine|Notes}}''.

P.name: Pit Grit
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast:}} '''Sett''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}}{{ft|an additional {{as|{{pp|0.075;0.25;0.5;1;1.025;1.05|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|changedisplay=true|round=3}} health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per {{sti|{{as|5% of his '''missing''' health}}}}.|up-to an additional {{as|{{pp|0.075*19;0.25*19;0.5*19;1*19;1.025*19;1.05*19|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|changedisplay=true|round=3}} health}} per {{fd|0.5}} seconds, with the maximum reached at the threshold of {{sti|{{as|95% '''missing''' health}}}}.}}
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Heavy Hands:}} '''Sett's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} alternate between his {{as|Left Punch|armor}} and a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}}. '''Sett''' begins attacking with his {{as|Left Punch|armor}}, and will reset back to it after 2 seconds of not performing a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.
P.description3: '''Sett's''' {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} is empowered to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} (unless ''{{ai|Knuckle Down|Sett}}'' is active), attack at 8 times the {{as|Left Punch's|armor}} {{as|attack speed}}, and deal {{as|{{pp|5 + (90-5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

Q.name: Knuckle Down
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 3}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*2 to 50*2}} {{as|(+ 2% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2 to 3*2}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: For {{fd|1.5}} seconds, '''Sett''' also gains {{sti|movement speed|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
Q.description3: ''Knuckle Down {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sett's''' basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a {{as|Left Punch|Armor}} followed by a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}, resetting '''Sett's''' current {{ai|Pit Grit|Sett}} state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.''

Q.name: Looking for a Fight
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 3}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*2 to 50*2}} {{as|(+ 2% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2 to 3*2}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: For {{fd|1.5}} seconds, '''Sett''' also gains {{sti|movement speed|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
Q.description3: ''Knuckle Down {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sett's''' basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a {{as|Left Punch|Armor}} followed by a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}, resetting '''Sett's''' current {{ai|Pit Grit|Sett}} state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.''

W.name: Haymaker
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Sett''' stores 100% of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} taken as ''Grit'' on his resource bar, up to a cap of {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}}. Each instance of stored ''Grit'' decays in value by 30% every second after 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' charges up a strike over the cast time. Additionally, he immediately consumes all of his stored ''Grit'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} at the start of the cast time that is equal to the expended ''Grit'' for 3 seconds, decaying in strength over the duration after {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
W.description3: After the cast time, he unleashes a massive blast in an area in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit; those hit in a line in the middle are dealt {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}|true}} instead.

E.name: Facebreaker
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' {{tip|airborne|pulls in}} enemies at his front and back along the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 70% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. ''Facebreaker'' deals {{as|{{pp|125 to 250}} '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
E.description2: If ''Facebreaker'' affects at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for 1 second upon landing.
E.description3: '''''Sett''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Facebreaker's cast time.''

R.name: The Show Stopper
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' {{tip|suppression|suppresses}} and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} while {{tip|dash|dashing}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to their location and {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself upon arrival. He leaps another 600 units in the same direction to slam the target into the ground, creating a massive shockwave and quickly {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward 250 units beyond the impact.
R.description2: Enemies within {{tt|the epicenter|125 unit radius around the target's landing location, but not the true center of the area of effect}} take {{ccs|{{as|physical damage}}|physical}}, and other enemies hit by the shockwave take {{as|physical damage}} that is reduced by up to 75% based on proximity. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 99% for 1 second.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40 to 60}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|200*0.25 to 400*0.25}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.25 to 60*0.25}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: ''The leap will end and create the impact prematurely upon encountering terrain that cannot be dashed through, whether by distance or invalid space.''

P.name: Backstab
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Shaco's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|20 + (35-25)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} when hitting an enemy from behind. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description2: ''{{ai|Deceive|Shaco}}'' and ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'' have additional effects when they hit an enemy from behind.

Q.name: Deceive
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a duration, and after a {{fd|0.125}}-second delay, he {{tip|blinks}} to the target location.
Q.description2: ''Deceive's'' {{tip|invisibility}} breaks when '''Shaco''' uses a basic attack or casts ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'', but not from casting ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' or ''{{ai|Hallucinate|Shaco}}''.
Q.description3: After breaking the invisibility, '''Shaco''' empowers his next basic attack within {{fd|0.25}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The attack will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|160|60}}|critical damage}} damage, increased to {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} if a critical strike was {{tt|rolled|See notes}}.

W.name: Jack in the Box
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' summons a ''box'' at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 2 seconds, lasting for up to 40 {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} seconds. The ''box'' is {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies while stealthed.
W.description2: The ''box'' will spring out upon enemy contact, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for a duration, modified to {{fd|2.2}} seconds against non-champions, and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration, modified to a 1 second root against non-champions. After a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay of the ''box's'' activation, enemies hit also have their {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} reduced. Enemy champions have their {{as|movement speed}} set to a {{as|static 100|ms}}, while non-champions are set to a {{as|static 60|ms}}. The {{as|movement speed}} reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus {{fd|0.3}} seconds.
W.description3: Once sprung, the ''box'' will remain for 5 seconds, during which it will automatically fire at nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each attack. If the ''box'' attacks only one target, it deals increased damage. ''Boxes'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}} and 50% reduced damage to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Increased Damage|{{ap|25 to 85}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20 to 80}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|10+20 to 30+80}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Increased Monster Damage|{{ap|25+20 to 85+80}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}}}
W.description4: ''See [[Shaco#Pets|Pets]] for more details about boxes.''

E.name: Two-Shiv Poison
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Shaco's''' basic attacks {{tip|slow}} enemies for 2 seconds while ''Two-Shiv Poison'' is not on cooldown.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' throws a dagger at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{ccs|increased by 50%|magic}} if they are {{as|'''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health}}, and {{tip|slows}} them for 3 seconds.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The dagger deals an additional {{as|{{pp|15 + (50-15)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, increased to {{as|{{pp|15*1.5 + (50*1.5-15*1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*1.5}}% AP)}} if the target is {{as|'''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health}}.

R.name: Hallucinate
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|blinks}} in the {{tt|target direction|150 units}} while creating a {{tip|clone}} of himself that is summoned in the {{tt|opposite direction|150 units}}, remaining within {{tt|control range|1125 units}} of him as a controllable {{tip|clone}} for up to 18 seconds.

''Hallucinate'' can be recast at any time while the clone is alive, and can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Shaco''' commands the {{tip|clone}} to move to the target location.
R.description3: The clone will explode upon dying or expiring to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and deploy three ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco|mini-boxes}}'' that activate instantly, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for 1 second, increased to {{fd|2.2}} seconds against non-champions, and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated}} against monsters and {{tt|1 second|Estimated}} against minions. After a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay of the ''boxes' '' activation, enemies hit also have their {{as|movement speed}} reduced. Enemy champions have their {{as|movement speed}} set to a {{as|static 100|ms}}, while non-champions are set to a {{as|static 60|ms}}. The {{as|movement speed}} reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus {{fd|0.3}} seconds.
R.description4: The ''boxes'' possess ''{{ais|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' effects, except they have a doubled, but shared {{sti|{{as|health}}}}, and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} with each attack, increased when attacking a single unit. They are also {{tip|invulnerable}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|estimated}} seconds after deployment.
R.leveling4: {{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Increased Modified Damage|{{ap|25 to 75}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
R.description5: ''See [[Shaco#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Shaco's''' clone.''

R.leveling4: {{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Increased Modified Damage|{{ap|25 to 75}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
R.description5: ''See [[Shaco#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Shaco's''' clone.''

P.name: Ki Barrier
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After completing an {{tip|champion ability|ability's}} effects, '''Shen''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|47 + (120-47)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 13% '''bonus''' health)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. If '''Shen''' affects at least one other {{tip|champion}} with an ability, ''Ki Barrier's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 8 for 18; then +0.125*x for 2|formula=4 + 4 / 17 * (level - 1) until level 18, then +0.125 per level}} seconds.
P.description2: '''Shen''' manifests a {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} that he can control with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' and ''{{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}}''.

Q.name: Twilight Assault
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' recalls his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} to him. Enemy champions hit by the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} along its path are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for the next 2 seconds while moving away from '''Shen'''.
Q.description2: Once it arrives, '''Shen''' empowers his next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. Against {{tip|structures}}, only the flat damage portion is applied.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{pp|10 to 40 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}|Total Magic Damage|{{pp|10*3 to 40*3 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*3 to 4*3}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|4.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}}}
Q.description3: If the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal {{ccs|{{as|'''increased bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and additionally grant '''Shen''' {{sti|as|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Increased Bonus Damage|{{pp|10 to 40 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}|Total Increased Damage|{{pp|10*3 to 40*3 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*3 to 7*3}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}}}
Q.description4: Empowered attacks against {{tip|monsters}} deal 100% '''bonus''' damage, but their '''total''' damage is capped.

Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' recalls his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} to him. Enemy champions hit by the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} along its path are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for the next 2 seconds while moving away from '''Shen'''.

Q.description3: If the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal {{ccs|{{as|'''increased bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and additionally grant '''Shen''' {{sti|as|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.

W.name: Spirit's Refuge
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' primes his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}}, creating an area around it. After 2 seconds, or when '''Shen''' or an allied champion enters the area, the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} generates a protective zone for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, {{tip|block|blocking}} all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks that hit '''Shen''' or allied champions in the area.

E.name: Shadow Dash
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' or ''Shadow Dash'' restores {{sti|energy|{{as|{{pp|30 to 50 for 3|1;4;12}} energy}}}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} he passes through and {{tip|taunt|taunting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}} and {{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Stand United
