W.description3: ''Ricochet {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sivir's''' basic attack timer if it was {{tt|not already active|See notes}}. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be bounced to.''

E.name: Spell Shield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, she {{tip|heals}} herself and activates ''{{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}}'' after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

R.name: On the Hunt
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains ''On the Hunt'' for a duration and grants it to nearby allied champions for the remaining duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|On the Hunt:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
R.description3: While active, '''Sivir's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} reduce her basic abilities' {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} by {{fd|0.5}} seconds each.
R.description4: '''Sivir''' can refresh the duration of her ''On the Hunt'' buff whenever she scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them.

P.name: Threads of Vibration
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Skarner's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}, ''{{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}'', ''{{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}}'', and ''{{ai|Impale|Skarner}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Quaking'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. Enemies afflicted with 3 stacks take {{as|magic damage}} equal to {{ft|{{as|{{pp|5 + (9-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} of their '''maximum''' health}} over the duration, capped at {{pp|100 + (300-100)/17*(x-1) for 20|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} against {{tip|monsters}}.|{{as|{{pp|5*0.125 + (9*0.125-5*0.125)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%|round=3|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration, capped at {{pp|100/8 + (300/8-100/8)/17*(x-1) for 20|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} per tick against {{tip|monsters}}.}}

Q.name: Shattered Earth
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' rips a boulder from the ground, empowering up to three of his next {{tip|basic attacks}} within 5 seconds of each other. These attacks gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies, including {{tip|structures}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 3% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 50*3}} {{as|(+{{ap|90*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*3}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
Q.description2: The final attack slams the boulder, dealing an additional {{as|11% of each target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} afflicted enemies by 40% for 1 second. The additional damage is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}} and is not applied against structures.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Monster Percent Health Damage Cap|{{ap|150 to 350}}}}
Q.description3: After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the cast, '''Skarner''' gains the ability to use ''Upheaval'' during ''Shattered Earth''.
Q.description4: ''Casting Shattered Earth {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Skarner's''' basic attack timer. Shattered Earth's duration is paused during {{ai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}.''

Q.name: Upheaval
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' ends ''{{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}'' by throwing his boulder in the target direction. It explodes upon colliding with the first enemy hit, applying the same damage and slow to the target and surrounding enemies as ''Shattered Earth's'' final empowered attack would.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 3% of his '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 11% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Monster Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 3% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Normal cast}}|{{tt|none|When cast automatically from Impale's cast}}}}

W.name: Seismic Bastion
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' slams his claws into the ground, {{tip|shield|shielding}} himself equal to {{as|8% of his '''maximum''' health}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and releasing a shockwave that {{tt|quickly|~0.25 seconds}} expands in a radius around him to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them by 20% for 1 second.
W.description2: '''''Skarner''' can move during Seismic Bastion's cast time.''

E.name: Ixtal's Impact
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' charges forward in the direction of the cursor for up to {{fd|2.75}} seconds, during which he gains {{tip|slow immunity}}, becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, ignores [[terrain]]  collision, and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} of the surrounding 650 units. He automatically navigates his movement along the way and is able to steer himself with a slow turn rate that increases over time, resetting upon changing direction. ''Ixtal's Impact'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description2: '''Skarner''' begins the charge at a {{tt|static amount|Cannot be modified by any means}} of {{sti|{{as|150 movement speed}}}} that increases by {{as|100|ms}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}, up to {{as|950 '''total''' movement speed}} by the end of the duration. If '''Skarner''' collides with an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he grabs them with his claws for the time of the remaining charge, {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} them, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, increasing the charge's turn rate to the maximum, and gaining {{as|300 '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}, with a minimum total of {{as|650|ms}} and a maximum total of {{as|1150|ms}}. If a target has been grabbed before the first {{fd|1.75}} seconds of the charge, the remaining duration is set to 1 second, and set to {{fd|0.5}} seconds otherwise. The charge does not ramp up in speed while a target is grabbed.
E.description3: If '''Skarner's''' attached target collides with terrain, the charge ends, detaching them from him, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.1}} seconds, and reducing ''Ixtal's Impact's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 35%.
E.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 150}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% of his '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Skarner''' ends ''Ixtal's Impact''. If a target has been grabbed, he detaches them from himself.
E.description5: ''Ixtal's Impact ends immediately if '''Skarner''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}, during the charge. The grabbed target is detached if this occurs. While the target is grabbed, they are attached to '''Skarner''' 200 units in front of him.''

R.name: Impale
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' winds up his stingers over the cast time, then lashes them forward in an isosceles trapezoid in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and impaling up to 3 of the closest enemy champions within the area to {{tip|suppression|suppress}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While suppressed, the targets are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|attach|attached}} to '''Skarner'''. If he successfully impales at least one enemy champion, '''Skarner''' gains {{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for the same duration.
R.description2: ''If Impale is cast during {{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}, '''Skarner''' {{tt|automatically casts|Without incurring Upheaval's cast time}} {{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}} in the direction of Impale's cast. '''Skarner''' is unable to basic attack, cast {{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}} or {{ai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}, or use {{si|Flash}} during Impale. While the targets are impaled, they are attached to '''Skarner''' 300 units {{tt|in front of him|In the direction he cast Impale}}. Targets are placed 200 units in the same direction at the end of the effect.''

P.name: Dragon Practice
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Smolder''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|''Dragon Practice''|buzzword3}} each time he hits an enemy champion with an {{tip|ability}}, or whenever ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. His basic abilities deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.
* ''{{ai|Q|Smolder}}'': Deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|25 to 55|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|W|Smolder}}'': Explosions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|55% of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|E|Smolder}}'': Attacks each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|8 to 12.8|0 to 4.8|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.

Q.name: Super Scorcher Breath
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' spits a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 75|critScaling=true}}; applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects; applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness; and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' kills at least one target, '''Smolder''' restores {{sti|{{as|15 mana}}}}.
Q.description2: ''Super Scorcher Breath'' becomes empowered with new effects based on the number of ''{{as|{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks|buzzword3}}'':
Q.description3: {{sbc|Tier 1 - 25 stacks:}} The fireball explodes upon collision to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. The explosion benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Tier 2 - 125 stacks:}} The fireball sends forth 2 {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}} per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts of fire in an arc upon collision that explode at maximum range, dealing {{ap|0.5*100}}% of the same damage to enemies hit. The bolts benefit from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description5: {{sbc|Tier 3 - 225 stacks:}} Enemies hit are set on fire for 3 seconds, causing them to take {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|{{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}} over the duration, capped at 300 against monsters.|{{as|{{ap|2.5/3|round=2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5/3|round=2}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as| of their '''maximum''' health}} each second, capped at {{ap|300/3}} per tick against monsters.}}Subsequent applications of the burn stack, though not refreshing the duration of the previous burn. Enemy {{tip|champions}} afflicted with the burn are also {{tip|execute|executed}} once '''Smolder''' deals damage to them that would leave them below {{as|{{fd|6.5}}% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
Q.cast time: {{as|100% of '''Smolder's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|(1/{{ccd|Smolder|as_base}})*{{ccd|Smolder|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

W.name: Achooo!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' sneezes a fiery glob in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 35% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, slowing down in missile speed after travelling {{tt|1200|estimated}} units. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} creates an explosion that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, with subsequent explosions against the same target dealing 75% damage of the previous explosion's damage.

E.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' takes flight for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|unobstructed vision}}, and the ability to ignore terrain collision. While in flight, he automatically fires up to 5 {{as|(+ 1 per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts at the nearest and {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each hit and prioritizing enemy champions.
E.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|10*5 to 30*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AD)}}}}
E.description2: ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' ends immediately if '''Smolder''' casts another ability or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.

R.name: MMOOOMMMM!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' shouts for his mother to attack from above, causing her to exhale a wave of fire starting from behind him and towards the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the center part goes through that brush}} as it travels. The wave {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Smolder''' and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, with those in the center taking {{ccs|50% increased damage|physical}} and becoming {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% for 2 seconds.
R.description2: ''MMOOOMMMM!'' deals 50% damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

P.name: Power Chord
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate - Accelerando:}} '''Sona''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'', stacking up to 120 times. At maximum stacks, she instead reduces the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} of ''{{ai|Crescendo|Sona}}'' by {{fd|1.5}} seconds each time.

[[File:Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Accelerando:}} For each stack, '''Sona''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} basic ability haste}}}}, up to {{as|60|ah}} at maximum stacks.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Melody:}} Whenever '''Sona''' casts a {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, her other basic abilities incur a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} global cooldown and she generates a unique {{tip|aura}} for 3 seconds that empowers herself and nearby allied champions. Only one aura can be active at a time.
P.description3:
{{sbc|Innate - Power Chord:}} '''Sona's''' basic abilities generate a stack of ''Power Chord'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, her next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> is empowered to consume them all to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|{{pp|20 to 80 for 7;90 + (240-90)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=10 + 10 per level until level 8, then + 15 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast:
* ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Staccato:}} '''Bonus''' damage is modified to {{as|{{pp|20*1.5 to 80*1.5 for 7;90*1.5 + (240*1.5-90*1.5)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=15 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 22.5 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.
* ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Diminuendo:}} Reduces the target's {{tip|size}} by 8% and damage dealt by 25% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 3 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Song of Celerity|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Tempo:}} {{tip|Slows}} the target by 50% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
P.description4: ''Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sona's''' basic attack timer.''

Q.name: Hymn of Valor
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' sends out bolts of sound to the two nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, prioritizing champions. Each bolt deals {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area around the target for 1 second.

'''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% of '''Sona's''' AP)}}}}

W.name: Aria of Perseverance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' {{tip|heals}} herself and sends out a tone to heal the {{tt|most wounded|Based on greatest % missing health}} allied champion nearby.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description3: '''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' whenever she {{tip|heals}} a wounded ally or {{tip|shields}} a minimum amount of damage for an ally with ''Aria of Perseverance''.

E.name: Song of Celerity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 7 seconds. If she takes damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed.
E.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} Tagged allied champions gain {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 18}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 of '''Sona's''' AP)}}}}

R.name: Crescendo
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' strikes an irresistible chord in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

P.name: Salvation
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Soraka''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|90% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that are {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Starcall
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' calls down a star upon the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area before landing after {{pp|type=target range|0.25 to 1 for 16|50 to 800}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, star dust returns to '''Soraka''', granting her ''Rejuvenation'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. While '''Soraka''' has ''Rejuvenation'', casting ''{{ai|Astral Infusion|Soraka}}'' will also grant ''Rejuvenation'' to the target for the same duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Rejuvenation}}: {{tip|Heal}} every {{fd|0.2}} seconds and gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Total Heal|{{ap|60 to 120}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Heal per Tick|{{ap|60/12 to 120/12}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/12}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}

W.name: Astral Infusion
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' {{tip|heals}} the target allied champion.
W.description2: If cast while under ''{{ai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}}'', the {{as|health cost}} will be reduced by a percentage.
W.leveling2: {{st|Health Cost Reduction|{{ap|80 to 100}}%|Reduced Health Cost|{{as|{{ap|2 to 0}}% of '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description3: ''Astral Infusion'' cannot be cast if '''Soraka''' is below {{as|{{sti|5% of her '''maximum''' health}}}}.

E.name: Equinox
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' creates a celestial zone at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemy champions within at the time of cast. The zone then persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|silence|silences}} enemies within.
E.description2: Afterwards, the zone erupts to deal the same damage to enemy champions within and {{tip|root}} them for a duration.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70*2 to 170*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}

R.name: Wish
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' calls upon the stars, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and all allied champions, increased by 50% on targets {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}.

P.name: Ravenous Flock
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Enemy champions that {{tip|death|die}} will leave behind a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} for 16 seconds. '''Swain's''' ravens will collect nearby dropped {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}}, as well as rip the {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}} out of champions hit by ''{{ai|Vision of Empire|Swain}}'' or ''{{ai|Nevermove 2|Swain|Nevermove's}}'' recast. Once a raven has collected a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}}, it will fly towards '''Swain''' to grant it to him, while also granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings during the travel.

{{sbc|Soul Fragment:}} For each stack, '''Swain''' gains {{as|15 '''bonus''' health}} permanently. Upon claiming a fragment, he will {{tip|heal}} for {{as|6% of his '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Death's Hand
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' unleashes five bolts of eldritch power over {{rutngt|0.25}} in a cone in the target direction that deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal 25% '''bonus''' damage.
Q.description2: '''''Swain''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion nearby''.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Bolt|{{ap|60*0.25 to 180*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45*0.25}}% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45*2}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Vision of Empire
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' summons a demonic eye at the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds and explodes after {{fd|1.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within, halved against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70/2 to 210/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 6 seconds and have a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} collected from them.

E.name: Nevermove
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' launches a demonic wave in the target direction.
E.description2: At maximum range, the wave homes back to '''Swain''' and detonates upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. ''Nevermove'' can be recast while {{tip|champions}} hit are rooted.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Swain''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the rooted champions over 290 units and collects a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} from each of them, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself for {{tt|{{fd|5 seconds}}|approximate}}. If the targets would be pulled past '''Swain''', they rebound off of him instead, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} the excess distance.

R.name: Demonic Ascension
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' frees the demon within himself, gaining ''Demonic Ascension'' and generating {{as|50 Demonic Energy|azakana}}. ''Demonic Ascension'' is maintained with {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}}, which decays by {{as|5|azakana}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to {{as|{{fd|7.5}}|azakana}} after 5 seconds have elapsed. ''Demonic Ascension'' is lost once all {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}} is depleted to {{as|0|azakana}}. '''Swain''' generates {{as|10 Demonic Energy|azakana}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while draining from at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, and fully restores it to the maximum of {{as|50|azakana}} upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Demonic Ascension:}} '''Swain''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, both dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|healing}} himself every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per target affected. The heal is reduced by 90% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|15/2 to 35/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|15/2 to 45/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5/2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5/2}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Reduced Heal per Tick|{{ap|15*0.5*0.1 to 45*0.5*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.5*0.1}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*0.5*0.1}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: After 2 seconds, '''Swain''' gains the ability to cast ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'', up to 100 times, and does so automatically when ''Demonic Ascension'' expires if ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'' is not on cooldown at the time of expiration.
R.description4: ''The targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
R.description5: '''''Swain''' can move during Demonic Ascension's cast time.''

R.name: Demonflare
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' releases a nova of soulfire that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 50%, decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description2: '''''Swain''' can move during Demonflare's cast time.''

P.name: Petricite Burst
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Sylas''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unshackled'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Unshackled:}} '''Sylas'''' next {{tip|basic attack}} gains {{as|{{sti|125% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and consume a stack to whirl his chains around him, dealing {{as|130% AD}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to the primary target and {{as|40% AD}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
P.description3: ''Unshackled'' deals 115% damage to {{tip|monsters}}, and executes {{tip|minions}} that are secondary targets and would be left below {{sti|{{as|25 health}}}}.
P.description4: ''Petricite Burst'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|175|100}}|critical damage}} damage only against the primary target.

Q.name: Chain Lash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' lashes out two chains that converge to the target location and extend beyond it up to a maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: After a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, the chains' intersection explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within, reduced to 40% against {{tip|minions}}.

W.name: Kingslayer
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' {{tip|dashes}} to the front of the target enemy's location then strikes them to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
W.description2: If this damages a {{tip|champion}}, '''Sylas''' is also {{tip|heal|healed}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=his '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=1% per 0.6% of '''Sylas'''' '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|20 to 100}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|20*2 to 100*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*2}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}

E.name: Abscond
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. Within {{fd|3.5}} seconds, he can cast ''{{ai|Abduct|Sylas}}'' after a {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second delay|Starts on-cast, not after completing the dash}} from casting ''Abscond''.
E.description2: ''{{ai|Kingslayer|Sylas}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Abduct
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' whips out his chains in the target direction that deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} and {{tip|stun|stun}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon hitting the target, '''Sylas''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to their location and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds upon arrival.
E.description2: '''''Sylas''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to cast {{ai|Chain Lash|Sylas}} while the chains are in flight.''

R.name: Hijack
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sylas''' launches his chains at the target enemy champion, gaining a copy of their {{tip|champion ability|ultimate ability}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for {{tt|{{fd|0.825}} seconds|Estimated, from start of cast time}}. '''Sylas''' cannot select the same champion again for a set duration, and can hold the ''hijacked'' ultimate for up to 90 seconds, during which he can recast ''Hijack''.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Sylas''' casts his hijacked ultimate ability at no cost, scaling based on ''Hijack's'' rank and his own [[Champion statistic|statistics]].
R.description3: ''Hijacked'' ultimates and abilities that do not scale with {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} have their {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} ratios converted to {{as|ability power}} ratios, scaling with {{as|{{fd|0.6}}% AP}} per {{as|1% '''total''' AD}}, and {{as|{{fd|0.4}}% AP}} per {{as|1% '''bonus''' AD}} respectively.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|80 to 30}}|Starts on cast and restarts on recast or when hold duration ends}}

P.name: Transcendent
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Syndra''' collects {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 120 times. She gains {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} from the following:
* Dealing two instances of {{tip|champion ability|ability}} damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants {{as|{{pp|1;2;3|1;11;18}} Splinters|buzzword}}. This cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
* Ranking up an ability with any skill points beyond level 1 grants {{as|5 Splinters|buzzword}}, up to {{as|85|buzzword}}.
* Killing a large minion grants {{as|1 Splinter|buzzword}}.
P.description2: Collecting a {{as|Splinter of Wrath|buzzword}} from an enemy restores {{sti|mana|{{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +6*x for 4; then +15*x for 5; then +20*x for 5|formula=15 + 4 per level until level 6, then + 6 per level until level 10, then + 15 per level until level 15, then + 20 per level.}} mana}}}}. {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} are brought to '''Syndra''' from enemies over {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
P.description3: At {{as|120 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}}, '''Syndra''' achieves ''Transcendence'', increasing her {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} by 15%.
P.description4: '''''Syndra''' can collect {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} from enemies even if she is at maximum stacks. These {{as|Splinters|buzzword}} do not grant any stacks, but will still restore {{as|mana}} for '''Syndra'''.''

Q.name: Dark Sphere
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' conjures a ''Dark Sphere'' at the target location that appears after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. The ''Dark Sphere'' then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|40 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} causes '''Syndra''' to periodically [[stock]] a ''Dark Sphere'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Q.recharge: {{tt|7|Recharge timer for Dark Sphere with the Transcendent bonus}}
Q.static: {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Cooldown between casts for Dark Sphere with the Transcendent bonus}}

W.name: Force of Will
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' telekinetically grabs the nearest ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra}}'', enemy {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}} within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds. If a ''Dark Sphere'' is grabbed, its duration is refreshed; if a minion or monster is grabbed, it is put in {{tip|stasis}}. She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}''.
W.description2: ''Force of Will'' can be recast while the target is being held.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Syndra''' throws the grabbed target towards the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings as they fall and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|60 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Force of Will'' to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|12%|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.

W.name: Force of Will 2
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' telekinetically grabs the nearest ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra}}'', enemy {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}} within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds. If a ''Dark Sphere'' is grabbed, its duration is refreshed; if a minion or monster is grabbed, it is put in {{tip|stasis}}. She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}''.
W.description2: ''Force of Will'' can be recast while the target is being held.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Syndra''' throws the grabbed target towards the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings as they fall and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|60 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Force of Will'' to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|12%|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.

E.name: Scatter the Weak
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} for 400 units and up to 800 units away from '''Syndra''' based on proximity, though not through terrain.
E.description2: ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from '''Syndra''' based on proximity, {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and dealt ''Scatter the Weak's'' damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|80 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Scatter the Weak'' to have an increased scatter angle and {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 70% for {{fd|1.25}} seconds starting after the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} ends or if the target was hit by a pushed ''Dark Sphere'', after the {{tip|stun}} has ended.

R.name: Unleashed Power
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Dark Sphere|Syndra}}'' cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' conjures 3 ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected ''Dark Spheres'', each dealing {{as|magic damage}} upon hit.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Sphere|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|80*3 to 160*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*3}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|80*7 to 160*7}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*7}}% AP)}}}}
R.description3: The ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|100 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Unleashed Power'' to {{tip|execute}} the target if it would damage them to below {{sti|{{as|15% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.

P.name: An Acquired Taste
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tahm Kench's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|5 to 60 for 12}}|magic damage}} ({{as|+ {{fd|1.25}}% AP}} {{as|per 100 '''bonus''' health}}) {{as|(+ 4% of his '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''An Acquired Taste'' against enemy {{tip|champions}} for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.67}} seconds when the duration ends.
P.description2: ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' and ''{{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}}'' gain additional effects against enemies with 3 stacks, consuming them all.

Q.name: Tongue Lash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' lashes his tongue in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slows}} them by 50% for 2 seconds. If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Tahm Kench''' also {{tip|heals}} himself.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 255}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} + [ {{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench|icononly=true}} {{pp|5 to 60 for 12}} {{as|({{as|+ {{fd|1.25}}% AP}} {{as|per 100 '''bonus''' health)|hp}} {{as|(+ 4% '''bonus''' health)}}}} ]}}
{{st|Heal|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5 to 7}}% of '''missing''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. ''{{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}}'' can be cast during ''Tongue Lash'' at no cost to pull the target to '''Tahm Kench''' before swallowing them.
Q.description4: '''''Tahm Kench''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move, attack, or cast {{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}} or {{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} on a different target while his tongue is in flight. Tongue Lash's range and travel speed can be increased by '''Tahm Kench's''' {{tip|size}}.''

W.name: Abyssal Dive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|1.35}} seconds as he dives into the waters to emerge at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area during the channel.
W.description2: Upon completion of the channel, '''Tahm Kench''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location after a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. If at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} is hit, 40% of ''Abyssal Dive's'' {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost as well as a percentage of its {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.
W.description3: ''Enemies can see the indicator for '''Tahm Kench's''' destination after he has channeled for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, if they have {{tip|sight}} of the area. '''Tahm Kench''' remains {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.65}} seconds after the blink.''

E.name: Thick Skin
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tahm Kench''' stores a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased while there are at least 2 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions either dead or alive. He can store up to {{as|300% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
E.leveling:
{{st|Damage Stored into Grey Health|{{ap|15 to 47}}%}}
{{st|Increased Damage Stored into Grey Health|{{ap|42 to 50}}%}}
E.description2: While ''Thick Skin'' is not on cooldown, and after 4 seconds without taking damage, '''Tahm Kench''' rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to restore {{pp|key=%|60 to 100}} of the amount, {{tip|healing}} for {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}.
E.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' converts his current [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

R.name: Devour
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' abducts the target {{tip|champion}}, {{tt|pulling them|See notes}} to him over the cast time and then swallowing them to carry them in his belly for up to 3 seconds. While inside, the target is {{tip|attach|attached}} to '''Tahm Kench''' and is rendered {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|displacement immune}}. ''Devour'' can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of ''{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}}''.
R.description2: If the target is an ally, they become {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and are granted a {{tip|shield}}, which decays in strength by 50 every {{fd|0.25}} seconds after they are ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench|Regurgitated}}''. '''Tahm Kench''' will also gain {{sti|{{as|60% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 3 seconds and is unable to cast movement spells besides ''{{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}'' while an ally is inside of his belly.
R.leveling2: {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|650 to 950}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
R.description3: After 1 second, '''Tahm Kench''' can cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' while a target is inside of his belly, and automatically does so after the duration. The swallowed ally can also {{tt|input a movement command|RMB}} to force '''Tahm Kench''' to cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' in a target direction of their choice, unless they are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} during ''Devour's'' cast time and while attached. '''Tahm Kench''' will also be {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% under those same conditions.
R.description5: ''If '''Tahm Kench''' is performing {{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}, {{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}} will not automatically cast until after he finishes {{ais|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}} effects.''

R.name: Regurgitate
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' detaches the swallowed champion from himself and {{tip|airborne|spits}} them out in the target direction. If they are an enemy, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to them at the end of the displacement.
R.description2: '''''Tahm Kench''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after casting Regurgitate. If Regurgitate was cast automatically, '''Tahm Kench''' spits the target out in his facing direction.''
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 400}} {{as|(+ 15% {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}

P.name: Rock Surfing
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} While near [[terrain]], '''Taliyah''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10;15;25;40|1;9;12;15|key=%}}|ms}}}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, which builds up over 1 second while in range for at least {{fd|0.4}} seconds, and decays {{tt|at the same rate|See notes}} once out of range for at least 3 seconds.
P.description2: If '''Taliyah''' is casting an {{tip|ability}} or enters [[combat status|champion combat]], ''Rock Surfing'' cannot occur again for a few seconds.

Q.name: Threaded Volley
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' barrages 5 ''Stone Shards'' in the target direction over {{fd|1.5}} seconds that each shatter upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Subsequent hits deal 40% damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 125}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|55*0.4 to 125*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|55*2.6 to 125*2.6}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: '''Taliyah''' can move and cast other abilities while launching ''Stone Shards'', and is unable to basic attack until she launches the third ''Stone Shard''.
Q.description3: Casting ''Threaded Volley'' creates an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}} at '''Taliyah's''' cast location that has a radius of 400 units and lasts 30 seconds. While '''Taliyah''' is within an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}}, ''Threaded Volley's'' cast consumes the area to become empowered with a new effect, costing {{sti|{{as|10 mana}}}} and having {{sti|cd|50%}} reduced cooldown, though not below {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Empowered Active:}} '''Taliyah''' hurls a ''Boulder'' that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{ccs|180%|magic}} damage to them and normal damage to nearby enemies, {{tip|slow|slowing}} all targets hit for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. {{tip|Monsters}} hit are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for 3 seconds.
Q.leveling4:
{{st|Empowered Damage|{{ap|55*1.8 to 125*1.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.8}}% AP)}}|Secondary Target Damage|{{ap|55 to 125}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
Q.description5: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Threaded Volley'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} per ''Stone Shard'', and the ''Boulder'' from the empowered cast deals 80% '''bonus''' damage against the primary target. This '''bonus''' damage is unaffected by the damage modifier from subsequent hits.
Q.leveling5: {{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}|Boulder Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20*1.8 to 40*1.8}}}}

Q.name: Threaded Volley 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' barrages 5 ''Stone Shards'' in the target direction over {{fd|1.5}} seconds that each shatter upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Subsequent hits deal 40% damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 125}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|55*0.4 to 125*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|55*2.6 to 125*2.6}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: '''Taliyah''' can move and cast other abilities while launching ''Stone Shards'', and is unable to basic attack until she launches the third ''Stone Shard''.
Q.description3: Casting ''Threaded Volley'' creates an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}} at '''Taliyah's''' cast location that has a radius of 400 units and lasts 30 seconds. While '''Taliyah''' is within an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}}, ''Threaded Volley's'' cast consumes the area to become empowered with a new effect, costing {{sti|{{as|10 mana}}}} and having {{sti|cd|50%}} reduced cooldown, though not below {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Empowered Active:}} '''Taliyah''' hurls a ''Boulder'' that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{ccs|180%|magic}} damage to them and normal damage to nearby enemies, {{tip|slow|slowing}} all targets hit for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. {{tip|Monsters}} hit are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for 3 seconds.
Q.leveling4:
{{st|Empowered Damage|{{ap|55*1.8 to 125*1.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.8}}% AP)}}|Secondary Target Damage|{{ap|55 to 125}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
Q.description5: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Threaded Volley'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} per ''Stone Shard'', and the ''Boulder'' from the empowered cast deals 80% '''bonus''' damage against the primary target. This '''bonus''' damage is unaffected by the damage modifier from subsequent hits.
Q.leveling5: {{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}|Boulder Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20*1.8 to 40*1.8}}}}

W.name: Seismic Shove
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' marks the target location and selects a direction. After {{tt|{{fd|0.792 seconds}}|Under normal tick interval circumstances, both cast time and 0.5s delay are rounding up}}, a ledge erupts from the area that {{tip|airborne|knocks}} enemies hit 400 units in the target direction over 1 second.

E.name: Unraveled Earth
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' scatters a field of 22 stones across the ground in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit while they erupt. The stones then remain for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 20%.
E.description2: Enemies that {{tip|dash}} or are {{tip|airborne|knocked}} over a stone will detonate it, taking {{as|magic damage}} and becoming {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, increased to 2 seconds if they are a {{tip|monster}}. The stun is applied once the displacement ends.
E.description3: An enemy can detonate up to 4 stones, but the damage is reduced by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|type=stones detonated|0 to 75 for 4}}. ''Unraveled Earth'' can affect targets only once per cast; the stones will still detonate but not apply their effects.
E.description4: ''Unraveled Earth'' deals 225% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.

R.name: Weaver's Wall
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' summons a torrent of spiraling rocks that cascades in the target direction, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} champions hit and erecting a wall of [[terrain]] in its wake. The wall lasts for 4 seconds after completion, then slowly disintegrates from its starting point.
R.description2: '''Taliyah''' also {{tip|channels}} for 1 second, during which ''Weaver's Wall'' can be recast and she {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself.
R.description3:
{{sbc|Recast:}} Upon completing the {{tip|channel}}, '''Taliyah''' {{tip|dash|surfs}} on the wall as it emerges, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process. After {{fd|0.75}} seconds, she may input a movement command to {{tip|dash|jump}} off the wall {{tt|to the target location|Will cast at maximum range (clamped) if ordered location is beyond this jump off command's range}}, and automatically does so upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|silence|silenced}} or reaching maximum range.

Once the wall has fully formed, '''Taliyah''' can recast to destroy the wall instantly.
R.description4: ''Weaver's Wall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second}} {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} upon taking {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|turret}} damage.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|180 to 120}}|Starts after wall expires or is destroyed}}

R.name: Weaver's Wall 2
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' summons a torrent of spiraling rocks that cascades in the target direction, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} champions hit and erecting a wall of [[terrain]] in its wake. The wall lasts for 4 seconds after completion, then slowly disintegrates from its starting point.
R.description2: '''Taliyah''' also {{tip|channels}} for 1 second, during which ''Weaver's Wall'' can be recast and she {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself.
R.description3:
{{sbc|Recast:}} Upon completing the {{tip|channel}}, '''Taliyah''' {{tip|dash|surfs}} on the wall as it emerges, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process. After {{fd|0.75}} seconds, she may input a movement command to {{tip|dash|jump}} off the wall {{tt|to the target location|Will cast at maximum range (clamped) if ordered location is beyond this jump off command's range}}, and automatically does so upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|silence|silenced}} or reaching maximum range.

Once the wall has fully formed, '''Taliyah''' can recast to destroy the wall instantly.
R.description4: ''Weaver's Wall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second}} {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} upon taking {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|turret}} damage.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|180 to 120}}|Starts after wall expires or is destroyed}}

P.name: Blade's End
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Talon's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Wound'' to enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: '''Talon's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against an enemy with 3 ''Wound'' stacks is empowered to consume them all to cause the target to bleed, dealing{{ft|{{as|{{pp|80 + (280-80)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 210% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}|{{as|{{pp|80/16 + (280/16-80/16)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|210/16}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds}}over 2 seconds. The target cannot gain ''Wound'' stacks during this time.

Q.name: Noxian Diplomacy
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' {{tip|dashes}} toward the target enemy, stabbing the target upon arrival to deal {{as|physical damage}}. If cast within close range, '''Talon''' {{tt|{{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target|to within 150 units, if Talon is not closer already}} over the cast time instead and ''Noxian Diplomacy'' {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|100}}|critical damage}} damage, as well as grants him {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}} on his next basic attack within 1 second.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Critical Physical Damage|{{ap|65*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: If ''Noxian Diplomacy'' kills the target, '''Talon''' {{tip|heals}} for {{pp|9 + (55-9)*(x-1)/17|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} and the ability's {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 50%.
Q.description3: ''Noxian Diplomacy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Talon's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Shadow Assault|Talon}} can be cast during the dash.''
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|None|Ranged dash attack}}|{{tt|{{as|100% of '''Talon's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|(1/{{ccd|Talon|as_base}})*{{ccd|Talon|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})|Close dash attack}}}}

W.name: Rake
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' throws a fan of daggers in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description2: At maximum range, the daggers linger for {{fd|0.7}} seconds before homing back to '''Talon''', dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 1 second.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|50+60 to 90+180}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+90}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
W.description3: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

E.name: Assassin's Path
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' {{tip|dashes}} up to 800 units over the target area of [[terrain]] while within proximity of it, during which he gains {{tip|unobstructed vision}}.
E.description2: '''Talon''' cannot cast ''Assassin's Path'' on the same area of terrain for a set duration.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Shadow Assault|Talon}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Shadow Assault
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' disperses a ring of blades around him that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and lingers at maximum range for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, during which he gains {{tip|invisibility}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|90 to 180}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 70}}%}}
R.description2: ''Shadow Assault'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or if '''Talon''' {{tip|breaks stealth}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Talon''' breaks stealth and converges the blades to him, dealing the same {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Breaking stealth with a basic attack or ''{{ai|Noxian Diplomacy|Talon}}'' will converge the blades to the target instead.

P.name: Bravado
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Taric''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} within 5 seconds to each gain {{sti|as|{{as|100% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|{{pp|25 + (93-25)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-attack}}, and reduce the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldowns}} of his basic abilities by {{pp|1;( 1 + ( ( x * 10 ) / ( ( x * 10 ) + 100 ) ) );2|0;10 to 100 for 10;∞|label1= AH|type=ability haste|formula= 1 + ( Haste / ( Haste + 100 ) )}}
 seconds.

Q.name: Starlight's Touch
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{as|25|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% of his '''maximum''' health)}} per charge of ''Starlight's Touch'' that he periodically [[ammunition|stocks]], up to a maximum amount. ''{{ais|Bravado|Taric}}'' empowered attacks each grant one charge.
Q.description2: ''Starlight's Touch'' can heal up to a maximum of {{as|125|heal}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% of '''Taric's''' '''maximum''' health)}} at 5 charges.

W.name: Bastion
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Taric''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} between him and the ally bound by ''Bastion''. While the tether persists, the ally also gains the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and '''Taric's''' abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' grants himself and the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, binding them with ''Bastion''.
W.description3: '''Taric''' can also [[self-targeted|self-cast]] to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

W.name: Bastion 2
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Taric''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} between him and the ally bound by ''Bastion''. While the tether persists, the ally also gains the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and '''Taric's''' abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' grants himself and the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, binding them with ''Bastion''.
W.description3: '''Taric''' can also [[self-targeted|self-cast]] to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

E.name: Dazzle
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' winds up over 1 second, granting {{tip|ghosting}} to nearby units, then projects a beam of starlight in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: '''''Taric''' can move during Dazzle.''

R.name: Cosmic Radiance
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' calls down a star from above that descends to him over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become {{tip|invulnerable}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

P.name: Guerrilla Warfare
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} after {{fd|1.5}} seconds without moving, taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage, performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}}, {{tip|channel|channeling}}, or being in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}. '''Teemo''' will maintain stealth so long as he remains idle and is not {{tip|airborne|displaced}}. While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Teemo''' gains the stealth even while moving and can move without breaking stealth, but will lose the stealth in this case if he is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Element of Surprise:}} When '''Teemo''' breaks the stealth, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|key=%|20 to 80 for 4|1;5;10;15}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.

Q.name: Blinding Dart
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' shoots a dart at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|blind|blinds}} them for a duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Blind Duration|{{ap|2 to 3}} seconds}}
Q.description2: The duration of the {{tip|blind}} is doubled against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Increased Blind Duration|{{ap|2*2 to 3*2}} seconds}}

W.name: Move Quick
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 5 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' doubles the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds, preventing it from being removed for the duration.
W.description3: ''Casting Move Quick does not interrupt {{ai|Guerrilla Warfare|Teemo}}.''

E.name: Toxic Shot
E.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Teemo's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and inflict {{tip|poison}}.

{{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage On-Hit|{{ap|9 to 65}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|6 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Poison Damage|{{ap|6*4.0 to 30*4.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*4.0}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*4.0}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: ''Toxic Shot'' deals {{ap|1.6*100}}% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.

R.name: Noxious Trap
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can {{tt|happen repeatedly|In-flight mushrooms can chain into further bounces if they keep landing on subsequent placed mushrooms}}.
R.description2: '''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Noxious Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount.
R.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Charges|{{ap|3 to 5}}}}
R.description3: The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting {{tip|poison}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 4 seconds, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them.
R.description4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
R.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|200/4 to 450/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
R.description5: A mushroom has {{sti|health|{{as|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by {{tip|champion}} basic attacks (2 damage from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 from {{tip|melee}}).
R.description6: ''See [[Teemo#Pets|Pets]] for more details about mushroom traps.''

P.name: Damnation
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Thresh's''' {{as|armor}} does not increase through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} that die near '''Thresh''' drop a ''Soul'' for 8 seconds. Epic monsters drop 2 ''Souls'' while lesser minions and monsters have a {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}}}% chance to drop a ''Soul''.
P.description3: '''Thresh''' automatically collects ''Souls'' near him or a placed ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}''.
P.description4: {{sbc|Soul:}} For each {{tip|stack}}, '''Thresh''' gains {{sti|ap|{{as|1 ability power}}}} and {{sti|armor|{{as|1 '''bonus''' armor}}}}.

Q.name: Death Sentence
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while it is in flight.
Q.description2: The scythe catches the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and render them {{tip|airborne}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}, as well as reduce ''Death Sentence's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 2 seconds. '''Thresh''' will also mark the target ''Shackled'' for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he is unable to declare basic attacks, and is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for 1 second.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: While the target is {{tip|stun|stunned}}, '''Thresh''' tugs his hook towards him twice, once after a {{tt|{{fd|0.1}}-second delay|Estimated}} and again {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated, starting from the end of the initial delay}} after that. With each tug, the target is pulled a short distance towards '''Thresh'''. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of hitting an enemy, or instantly after hitting a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Thresh''' can recast the ability while the target is ''Shackled''.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Deathly Leap:}} '''Thresh''' stops tugging his hook and {{tip|dashes}} to the ''Shackled'' enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}'' and ''{{ai|Flay|Thresh}}'' during the dash.

Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while it is in flight.

W.name: Dark Passage
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws his lantern to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lasting for 6 seconds while he remains nearby and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If '''Thresh''' moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.
W.description2: '''Thresh''' and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds. An ally can select the lantern while in proximity of it, {{tip|dash|dashing}} to '''Thresh''' and gaining the shield.
W.description3: ''An ally cannot select the lantern while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}. The lantern will not expire from '''Thresh''' moving too far away if he is dashing with {{ai|Deathly Leap|Thresh}}.''

E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Thresh's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, with the {{sti|{{as|AD}}}} ratio increasing over 10 seconds without basic attacking enemies.
E.leveling:

R.name: The Box
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' erects a pentagon of spectral walls around him that each last for 5 seconds. A wall will break upon enemy champion contact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for 2 seconds. After the first wall breaks, the rest will deal no damage and {{tip|slow}} for only 1 second.
R.description2: Enemies that break a wall cannot do so again for 1 second.

P.name: Draw a Bead
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' and ''{{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}}'' gain {{sti|attack range|{{pp|0 + (150-0)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' range}}, for a total of {{pp|{{ccd|Tristana|range}}+0 + ({{ccd|Tristana|range}}+150-{{ccd|Tristana|range}})/17*(x-1) for 20}}.

Q.name: Rapid Fire
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' empowers her cannon, gaining {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 7 seconds.

W.name: Rocket Jump
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' {{tip|dash|jumps}} to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
W.description2: Scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonating ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at maximum stacks on a champion will reset ''Rocket Jump's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
W.description3: '''''Tristana''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

E.name: Explosive Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tristana's''' basic attacks are empowered to trigger an explosion when they kill the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' tosses an explosive charge at the target enemy that attaches to them for 4 seconds. The charge then detonates, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. ''Explosive Charge'' can target and damage {{tip|turrets}}, and explodes in a larger radius on a turret.
E.description3: '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target increase ''Explosive Charge's'' damage by {{ap|0.25*100}}%, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 4 times for a maximum {{ap|0.25*400}}% increase, upon which the charge also detonates instantly. The charge's '''total''' damage is additionally increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
E.description4: ''If {{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}} is used to apply the last stack, the detonation will instead be delayed until the end of the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} or the 4 seconds expire.''
E.cast time: {{as|100% of '''Tristana's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:(1/{{ccd|Tristana|as_base}})*{{ccd|Tristana|windup}}round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

R.name: Buster Shot
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' fires a massive cannonball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. They and surrounding enemies are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration, during which all targets are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.

P.name: King's Tribute
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby enemy dies, '''Trundle''' {{tip|heal|heals}} himself for {{as|{{pp|key=%|1.8 + (5.5-1.8)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of their '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Chomp
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 7 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 75% for {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
Q.description2: After using the empowered attack, '''Trundle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for 5 seconds and reduces the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} by half that amount for the same duration.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}}}
{{st|Attack Damage Reduction|{{ap|20/2 to 40/2}}}}
Q.description3: ''Chomp {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Trundle's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Frozen Domain
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' coats the target location in ice for 8 seconds. While he is within the area, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and 25% increased {{tip|healing}} from all sources.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 110}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 52}}%}}

E.name: Pillar of Ice
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as [[terrain]] and {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies.

R.name: Subjugate
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for the same amount. He also reduces 40% of their '''current''' {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}, while gaining the same amount reduced as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, respectively, for himself. Additionally, he increases in {{tip|size}} by 18% while reducing the target's size by {{fd|9.9}}%.
R.leveling:
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Total Healing|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}

{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Twisted Fate''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Stacked Deck'', stacking up to 3 times. P.name: Deadly Venom

P.description2: {{sbc|Deadly Venom:}} For each stack, the target is dealt{{ft|{{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|1 to 5 for 5|1 to 17|formula=1 every 4 levels}}|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} {{as|true damage}} per second over the duration,|{{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|1*6 to 5*6 for 5|1 to 17|formula=1, +1 every 4 levels}}|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:3*6}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total''' true damage}} over the duration,}}for a maximum of{{ft|{{as|{{pp|1*6 to 5*6 for 5|1 to 17|formula=6 every 4 levels}}|true damage}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:3*6}}% AP)}} {{as|true damage}} with each tick.|{{as|{{pp|1*6*6 to 5*6*6 for 5|1 to 17|formula=6 every 4 levels}}|true damage}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:3*6*6}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total''' true damage}} over the duration.}}This effect is considered a {{tip|poison}}.

Q.name: Ambush
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a 1-second delay, '''Twitch''' becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} for a duration. Attacking or casting ''{{ai|Venom Cask|Twitch}}'' or ''{{ai|Contaminate|Twitch}}'' ends ''Ambush'' immediately.
Q.description2: During this time, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing enemy {{tip|champions}} within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.
Q.description3: Upon breaking stealth, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.
Q.description4: When an enemy {{tip|champion}} dies while afflicted with ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'', ''Ambush's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reset.

W.name: Venom Cask
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' hurls a cask of corrosive mixture at the target location that breaks upon landing, applying ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' to enemies in the area and granting {{tip|sight}} of it.
W.description2: The area then becomes contaminated for 3 seconds, applying a ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' stack each second to enemies within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.

E.name: Contaminate
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' sends out a lethal toxin to each nearby enemy afflicted by ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'', dealing them {{as|physical damage}}.
E.description2: ''Contaminate'' deals additional {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|35% AP}} {{as|magic damage}} for each stack of ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' on the target.

E.description3: ''A nearby enemy with {{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}} is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be targeted by this ability.''

R.name: Spray and Pray
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' attack range}} for 6 seconds, during which his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} are replaced by ''bolts'' that travel slightly further than his attack range in a straight line, dealing damage to {{tt|every enemy unit|non-champions and champions, wards and plants, turrets and structures}} hit.
R.description2: The ''bolts'' deal {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|110-10*x|0 to 4 for 5|formula=100% - 10% per enemy hit. ''This is capped at 60% damage.''|changedisplay=true}} of the triggering {{as|attack's damage|AD}}, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Twitch|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.

P.name: Bridge Between
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Awakened Spirit:}} '''Udyr''' has no {{tip|ability|ultimate ability}} and instead has 4 {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} that each incur a {{sti|cd|{{tt|{{fd|1.5}}-second global cooldown|Affected by ability haste}}}} when cast. Each ability grants a ''Stance'' that empowers his basic attacks, and switching ''Stances'' will replace the empowered attacks of the previous ''Stance''.
P.description2:
Periodically, after '''Udyr''' enters a ''Stance'', he can cast it again at no cost after {{fd|0.25}} seconds and within the following 5 seconds to ''Awaken'' it, empowering the ''Stance'' with an additional effect and placing the effect on cooldown.
If '''Udyr''' does not consume the ''Awaken'' cast within the duration and has not switched ''Stances'', his current ''Stance's'' respective ability incurs a {{fd|0.25}}-second cooldown. ''Awakened Spirit'' is placed on full cooldown at the start of the game.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Monk Training:}} After casting an ability, '''Udyr''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|{{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and refund 5% of ''Awakened Spirit's'' '''total''' cooldown, though not if the remaining cooldown is less than 1 second.

Q.name: Wilding Claw
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Claw Stance'', empowering his next two basic attacks to gain {{sti|range|50}} '''bonus''' range and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, capped at 15 {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 8 6}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3*2 to 8*2 6}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5*2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
Q.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for 4 seconds.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 80 6}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage On-Hit|{{ap|6 to 36 6}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 2 6}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' gains an additional {{as|{{pp|20 + (70-20)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed|attack speed}}. The empowered attacks deal an additional {{as|{{pp|2 + (4-2)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} if used within 4 seconds. '''Udyr's''' next two basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} in any ''Stance'' within 4 seconds are each empowered to strike with lightning{{ft|6 times over 1 second,|every {{tt|{{fd|0.2}} seconds|First strike is applied instantly, while the remaining 5 are applied every 0.2 seconds thereafter}} over 1 second,}}dealing {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1.5 + (3-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.6}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} per hit, chaining to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies and being able to hit the same target multiple times, for a total of {{as|{{pp|1.5*6 + (3*6-1.5*6)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*6}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}. Each lightning strike deals a minimum of {{pp|40 + (160-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|minions}} and is capped at 15 {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.cooldown: {{tt|6|Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown}}

W.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Mantle Stance'', empowering his next two basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} to gain {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{fd|1.2}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}}.
W.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 145 6}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 3.5 6}}% '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' increases the {{tip|shield|shield's}} strength, stacking with the remaining shield from the first cast, and {{tip|heals}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the next 4 seconds, as well as causes the empowered attacks to instead gain doubled {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{fd|{{ap|1.2*2}}}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*2}}% AP)}}.
W.description4: Healing {{tip|on-hit}} is reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.cooldown: {{tt|6|Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown}}

E.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Awaken:}} '''Udyr''' gains {{sti|range|75}} '''bonus''' attack range and an additional {{as|{{pp|30 + (40-30)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|ms}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}. He also gains {{tip|cc-immune|immunity to crowd control}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
