R.name: Wingborne Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Active - Stance:}} '''Udyr''' enters ''Storm Stance'', empowering his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} to deal {{as|{{pp|10 + (40-10)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
R.description2: Additionally, '''Udyr''' summons a blizzard around himself for 4 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them while they remain within. {{tip|Minions}} take {{pp|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}} damage.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|10 to 50 6}} {{as|(+ {{fd|17.5}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*8 to 50*8 6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|17.5*8}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|15 to 30 6}}%}}

The storm applies the same effects as the blizzard but deals {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} equal to{{ft|{{as|{{pp|8/8 + (14/8-8/8)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5/8}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} per tick|{{as|{{pp|8 + (14-8)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} over the duration}}and {{tip|slow|slows}} by an additional 5%. Against {{tip|monsters}}, the{{ft|storm's per-tick damage deals a minimum of {{pp|40/8 + (280/8-40/8)/17*(x-1) for 20}} and is capped at {{pp|80/8 + (400/8-80/8)/17*(x-1) for 20}}.|storm deals a minimum '''total''' damage of {{pp|40 + (280-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} and is capped at {{pp|80 + (400-80)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''total''' damage.}}

The storm can only follow {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies.

P.name: Echoing Flames
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Urgot's''' six legs each conceal a shotgun that covers an arc, together forming a full circle of cover around him. Each shotgun can fire once before incurring a unique {{sti|cooldown}}.
P.description2: '''Urgot's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the arc of a shotgun will cause it to fire in a cone, dealing {{as|{{pp|key=%|40 to 100 for 6|1;6;9;11;13;15}} AD}} {{as|(+ {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|2 to 6 for 5|1 to 13}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, capped at {{pp|100 + (360-100)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Corrosive Charge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' launches a canister at the target location. Upon landing, it explodes after {{fd|0.3}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

W.name: Purge
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Urgot's''' other abilities ''mark'' enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for 5 seconds. Only one enemy can be ''marked'' at a time.

Additionally, at maximum rank, ''Purge'' lasts indefinitely and becomes a toggled ability.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' equips his machine gun for 4 seconds, granting {{tip|ghosting}} to minions and non-epic monsters around him and autonomously firing at the nearest enemy at a '''fixed''' {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{fd|3.0}} attack speed}}}}, prioritizing ''marked'' enemy champions and refreshing the ''mark'' with every attack. While firing, '''Urgot''' is able to move and gains 40% {{tip|slow resist}}, but his {{as|movement speed}} is reduced by {{as|125|ms}}.
W.description3: Attacks with ''Purge'' deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}, with a minimum threshold of 50 against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|minions}}, and cannot {{tip|critically strike}}. Each attack applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to 50% effectiveness. '''Urgot''' cannot perform attacks while affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}}.
W.description4: ''Purge'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Urgot''' ends ''Purge''.

E.name: Disdain
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
E.description2: After the cast time, '''Urgot''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through, {{tip|airborne|knocking them aside}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
E.description3: '''Urgot''' will stop upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and, after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, also {{tip|airborne|flinging}} them to the location {{tt|100 units behind him|This destination is a fixed location and is unaffected by size modifiers on Urgot or the target moving away before the displacement started}}, though not through terrain.
E.description4: ''{{ai|Purge|Urgot}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Fear Beyond Death
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' fires a chem-drill in the target direction that impales the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and leashing the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 75 for 11|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=1% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 75%''}}|health}}.
R.description2: ''Fear Beyond Death'' can be recast if the leashed target is below {{as|{{sti|health|25% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}, and does so automatically if the chem-drill {{tt|would kill the target|Damage instance does not reduce their health below 1 in this case}}, the ability is cast again while the target was above the threshold and is then brought within it, or the target is within the threshold at the end of the duration.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Mercy:}} '''Urgot''' launches chains at the leashed target, then {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once they latch on. During this time, he reels them toward him, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} them, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, rendering them {{tip|untargetable}}, and preventing them from taking damage from {{tt|other sources|Negates application of damage from any source that is not the execution}}. If the target is near '''Urgot''' when the chains connect, they are pushed up to {{tt|1000|Estimated}} units away based on their proximity to him. This channel cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
R.description4: Upon completing the channel, the target is {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executed}}|true}}. If the execution is successful, he {{tip|fear|fears}} nearby enemies for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 75%.
R.description5: ''Fear Beyond Death's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. '''Urgot''' can move while channeling Fear Beyond Death's recast.''

P.name: Living Vengeance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Varus''' kills an enemy, he gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{pp|10 to 20|1;7;13|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} equal to {{as|11% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}} for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.
P.description2: '''Varus''' also gains ''Living Vengeance's'' bonuses upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}, which empowers it for the same duration to grant him {{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}} as well as {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} and {{as|ability power}} equal to {{as|33% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}}, and an increased attack speed cap of {{fd|3.33}}. ''Living Vengeance's'' empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.

Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Varus''' fires a piercing arrow in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage of the arrow as well as any detonated ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}'' stacks are both increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 50 for 6|0 to 1.25|formula=2% per 0.05 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}, and the arrow's damage is reduced by {{pp|type=number of enemies hit|key=%|0 to 60 for 5;67|0 to 5|formula=0% + (15% per enemy hit). ''This is capped at a maximum of 67%.''}}.

{{st|Minimum Reduced Damage|{{ap|80/1.5*0.33 to 360/1.5*0.33|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(120/1.5)*0.33|round=2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.33 to 360*0.33}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.33|round=2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

If the stacks were consumed with ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', the cooldown reduction is increased by {{#var:q_mod}}, up to a {{pp|13*3 to 13*3*1.5|0 to 1.25 by 0.125|key=%|type=[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border]] Piercing Arrow's charge time|formula=39% + 1.95% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''|round1=3|showtype=false}} cooldown reduction per target from consuming maximum stacks against them.

R.name: Chain of Corruption

If a target does not leave the area within 2 seconds, they subsequently become infected as well, taking the same damage and effects. A new tendril is then spread out from the infected target that is closest to a nearby uninfected enemy champion. The infection can spread repeatedly until there are no new targets.

{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|40 to 100}}}}

{{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|8 to 12}} seconds}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|35 to 65 3}}}}

P.name: Phenomenal Evil Power

W.name: Dark Matter

R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.2}}-second delay, '''Vel'Koz''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.6}} seconds to project an energy beam, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. ''Life Form Disintegration Ray'' can be recast after 1 second during the channel, and does so automatically after the duration.
R.description3: The beam deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit every {{fd|0.2}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 20%, lingering for 1 second. ''{{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|Deconstruction}}'' is applied every {{fd|0.7}} seconds to enemies hit. {{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz|''Researched''}} enemies take {{as|true damage}} instead.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vel'Koz''' ends ''Life Form Disintegration Ray''.

P.name: Doom 'n Gloom
P.description:
{{sbc|Passive - Doom:}} Periodically, '''Vex''' empowers her next {{tip|ability|basic ability}} to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|fear}} enemies hit for {{pp|0.75 to 1.5 for 4|1;6;9;13}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{pp|type=distance from '''Vex'''|60 to 99 for 11|250 to 800|key=%|formula=60% + 3.9% for every 55 units away from Vex}}. If ''{{ai|Looming Darkness 2|Vex|Looming Darkness}}'' triggers ''Doom'', enemies hit will {{tip|flee}} from the epicenter instead.
''Doom's'' {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon [[death|respawning]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Gloom:}} Nearby enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} that {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} will be marked with ''Gloom'' for 6 seconds. '''Vex's''' next {{tip|basic attack}}, which becomes {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, or basic ability hit against an enemy with ''Gloom'' will detonate the mark. ''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it.
P.description3: ''Gloom's'' detonation deals {{pp|40 + (150-40)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and refunds 25% of ''Doom's'' cooldown. Against non-champions, this instead deals {{pp|40 to 60 for 5|1;6;9;13;16|key=%}} damage and refunds 10% of ''Doom's'' cooldown.

Q.name: Mistral Bolt
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' launches a wave of mist in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. After travelling 500 units, the wave accelerates but also narrows itself.

W.name: Personal Space
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' emits a deafening scream around her before the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

The scream's radius is slightly increased against enemies that are {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
W.description2: '''''Vex''' can move during Personal Space's cast time.''

E.name: Looming Darkness
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' tosses her ''Shadow'' to explode at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The explosion's radius increases based on cast distance.
E.description2: Killing an enemy with ''Looming Darkness'' refunds 10% of ''{{ai|Doom 'n Gloom|Vex|Doom's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}, increased to 25% for champion kills.

R.name: Shadow Surge
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' sends her ''Shadow'' in the target direction, which grants {{tip|sight}} around its {{tt|trajectory|Does not see into brush or across terrain}} and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
R.description2: ''Shadow'' stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} to mark them for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Shadow Surge'' can be recast while the target is marked.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vex''' {{tip|dashes}} towards the marked target with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she consumes their mark and deals {{as|magic damage}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|75+150 to 175+350}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20+50}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: If '''Vex''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against ''Shadow Surge's'' marked target within 8 seconds of its application, '''Vex''' can cast ''Shadow Surge'' again within 12 seconds at no cost after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, repeating the effects.

P.name: Blast Shield
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Vi's''' next {{tip|ability}} hit grants her a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|12% of her '''maximum''' health}} for 3 seconds.
P.description2: ''Blast Shield's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds each time ''{{ai|Denting Blows|Vi}}'' is consumed.
P.static: {{pp|16 to 12 for 9|formula=16.5 - 0.5 * level, capped at level 9}}

Q.name: Vault Breaker
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Vault Breaker's'' {{sti|range}}, speed, and damage over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
Q.description2: ''Vault Breaker'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Vault Breaker'' is cancelled, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded, and it is placed on {{sti|cd|full cooldown}}. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded and it is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second cooldown}}.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vi''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within her path, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 150 for 11|0 to 1.25|round1=3|formula=15% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}, and {{tip|airborne|pull}} all non-champions hit towards her.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|40*2.5 to 120*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*2.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description4: She stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} over {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description5: ''{{ai|Relentless Force|Vi}} and {{ai|Cease and Desist|Vi}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Denting Blows
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vi's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Denting Blows'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description2: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.

W.name: Denting Blows 2
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vi's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Denting Blows'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description2: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.

E.name: Relentless Force
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit in a cone.

''Relentless Force'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Vi|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} against the primary target. Secondary targets take the same damage but do not count as being critically struck.
E.description2: '''Vi''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Relentless Force'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: ''Relentless Force {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Vi's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Relentless Force 2
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit in a cone.

''Relentless Force'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Vi|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} against the primary target. Secondary targets take the same damage but do not count as being critically struck.
E.description2: '''Vi''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Relentless Force'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: ''Relentless Force {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Vi's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Cease and Desist
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' singles out the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|dash|dashing}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} towards them and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them. Upon approaching within 300 units of the target, she {{tip|dashes}} through and grabs them over {{tt|{{fd|1.05}} seconds|Estimated}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{fd|1.3}} seconds and dealing {{as|physical damage}} after {{fd|0.75}} seconds into the grab duration.
R.description2: Enemies she dashes through are dealt the same damage, {{tip|airborne|knocked aside}} by 350 units over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

P.name: Sovereign's Domination
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Viego''' scores an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, a ''Mist Wraith'' spawns from that champion's corpse for 8 seconds. '''Viego''' can basic attack a ''Mist Wraith'' to consume it: causing him to {{tip|blink}} to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is {{tip|untargetable}} (except to {{tip|turrets}}) and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. He then gains ''Possession'' and {{tip|heals}} himself for {{as|2%|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Possession:}} For 10 seconds, '''Viego''' assumes the enemy champion's form and gains their {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}}, [[item]]s (excluding [[trinket item]]s), and base [[champion statistic|stats]] (based on '''Viego's''' [[Experience (champion)|level]]). He also gains a free cast of ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'', which is initially placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown, and {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing enemy champions within 2500 units.
P.description3: '''Viego''' cannot use the possessed champion's [[Active ability items|item actives]] or [[consumable item]]s, and is unable to use the [[shop]] during ''Possession''. Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' ends ''Possession'' immediately.
P.description4: '''''Viego''' will preserve his {{as|'''current''' health percentage}} between transformations.''

Q.name: Blade of the Ruined King
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Viego's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|170|50}}|critical damage}} damage, has a minimum threshold and is capped at 80 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|2 to 6}}% of target's '''current''' health}}|Critical Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|2*1.7 to 6*1.7}}% of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}}}}
Q.description2: Additionally, his damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for 4 seconds. '''Viego's''' next basic attack against a marked target is empowered to consume the mark {{tip|on-hit}} to strike a second time, dealing {{tt|{{as|20% AD}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Scales on current AD and AP}} {{as|physical damage}}. He also {{tip|heal|heals}} himself for a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by the second strike: 100% against {{tip|minions}}, 125% against monsters, and 150% against other targets.
Q.description3: The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Viego|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' stabs in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 60|critScaling=true}}.
Q.description5: ''Blade of the Ruined King's passive remains under {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}}, and while transformed, the second strike is instead converted to '''bonus''' damage on-hit which no longer applies on-hit effects but can still {{tip|critically strike}} (based on the Possession's stats, abilities and/or item effects).''
Q.cast time: {{as|{{ap|1.4*100}}% of '''Viego's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|1.4*(1/{{ccd|Viego|as_base}})*{{ccd|Viego|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

W.name: Spectral Maw
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Spectral Maw's'' missile range and {{tip|stun}} duration over the first second of the channel.
W.description2: ''Spectral Maw'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Spectral Maw'' is cancelled and placed on {{sti|full cooldown}}. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, it will be placed on a 3-second cooldown.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Viego''' hurls a blast of mist in the target direction and {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the same direction, though not through terrain. The mist deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|0.25 to 1.25 for 5|0 to 1|formula=0.25 + (0.25 per 0.25 seconds channeled).|changedisplay = true}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Spectral Maw {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Viego's''' basic attack timer. '''Viego''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

E.name: Harrowed Path
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. If it hits [[terrain]], the mist will spread further around either side.
E.description2: While inside the mist, '''Viego''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|camouflage}}.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}}}}
E.description3: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, preventing '''Viego''' from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large {{tip|monster}}. This duration refreshes on subsequent attacks and ability casts.
E.description4: ''Harrowed Path can be cast during any of '''Viego's''' abilities. '''Viego''' cannot gain the camouflage nor {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from Harrowed Path for 1 second if he casts it during {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} channel or starts the channel while the mist was active.''

R.name: Heartbreaker
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he strikes the {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} enemy champion {{tt|nearby|Alternatively the closest one if all targets have the same percent health}}, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. Other nearby enemies are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|12 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
R.description2: All targets hit are dealt {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}.
R.description3: ''If a {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}} is discarded, Heartbreaker will be placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.''

P.name: Glorious Evolution
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Viktor''' can augment each of his {{tip|abilities}} at the cost of 100 ''Hex Fragments'', which he gains from killing enemies:
* {{tip|Minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} generate 1 ''Hex Fragment''.
* Siege minions, super minions, and epic monsters generate 10 ''Hex Fragments''.
* Enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} generate 20 ''Hex Fragments''.
P.description2: ''{{ai|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' can be augmented after all of '''Viktor's''' basic abilities have been augmented.

Q.name: Siphon Power
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' throws a draining device at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and gains ''Discharge'' for 4 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Discharge:}} '''Viktor's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60+20 to 120+120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+50}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: {{Anchor|Augment: Turbocharge}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Turbocharge}} — }} After the device hits, '''Viktor''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and the shield's strength is increased{{ft|by 60%.|to {{pp|40*1.6 to 140*1.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*1.6}}% AP)}}.}}

Q.name: Discharge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' throws a draining device at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and gains ''Discharge'' for 4 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Discharge:}} '''Viktor's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60+20 to 120+120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+50}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: {{Anchor|Augment: Turbocharge}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Turbocharge}} — }} After the device hits, '''Viktor''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and the shield's strength is increased{{ft|by 60%.|to {{pp|40*1.6 to 140*1.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*1.6}}% AP)}}.}}

W.name: Gravity Field
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' deploys a gravity field at the target location for {{fd|4.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, it activates to {{tip|slow}} enemies within for 1 second, refreshing every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while they remain inside.
W.description2: The field applies a {{tip|stack}} of ''Heavy Gravity'' to enemies within every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, stacking up to 5 times. The fifth stack consumes them all to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The knockdown and stun can be triggered only once per cast per enemy.
W.description3: {{Anchor|Augment: Magnetize}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Magnetize}} — }} '''Viktor's''' other abilities, excluding ''{{ais|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' persistent damage, {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 20% for 1 second.

E.name: Hextech Ray
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' fires an energy beam along the target path that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area.
E.description2: {{Anchor|Augment: Aftershock}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Aftershock}} — }} The path explodes along the beam's wake after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 140}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70+20 to 230+140}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}

R.name: Arcane Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' conjures an arcane singularity at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|disrupt|disrupting}} their {{tip|channel|channeled abilities}}.
R.description2: The singularity then remains active as a moving storm for {{fd|6.5}} seconds, striking a bolt of electricity onto enemies within it every second to deal {{as|magic damage}}, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area within its radius and the {{tt|surrounding area|If radius is below 700 units}}. The singularity will target the nearest champion hit by its initial damage and will follow them. The singularity moves faster based on its proximity to '''Viktor'''.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|100+65*6 to 250+145*6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+35*6}}% AP)}}}}
R.description3: ''Arcane Storm'' can be recast at any time while the singularity is active.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Viktor''' directs the singularity to the target location, or to follow the target enemy champion or himself for its remaining duration.
R.description5: {{Anchor|Augment: Perfect Storm}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Perfect Storm}} — }} The singularity moves 25% faster. Additionally, whenever an enemy champion is {{tip|takedown|taken down}} after being damaged by ''Arcane Storm'', the storm's size is increased by 40% and its duration is extended by 3 seconds. The storm's radius can be increased up to 6 times and the duration can be extended only up to the original duration.
R.description6: ''Arcane Storm's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

P.name: Crimson Pact
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Vladimir''' gains {{as|({{fd|3.333}}% '''bonus''' health)}} as {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}} and {{as|(160% AP)}} as {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}. These two bonuses do not stack with each other.

Q.name: Transfusion
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' drains blood from the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself. He then generates 1 point of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' over the {{sti|cooldown}}.
Q.description2: At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10%;20%;30%;40%|1;6;11;16}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}|ms}} decaying over {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes 75% slower during ''{{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}}'', ''{{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}}'', or {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
Q.description3: Casting ''Transfusion'' during the surge consumes all ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' to deal {{ccs|85% increased damage|magic}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for an additional {{pp|30 + (200-30)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}. The additional healing is reduced to{{ft|35%|{{pp|30*0.35 + (200*0.35-30*0.35)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.35}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|4*0.35}}% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}.

Q.name: Crimson Rush
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' drains blood from the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself. He then generates 1 point of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' over the {{sti|cooldown}}.
Q.description2: At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10%;20%;30%;40%|1;6;11;16}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}|ms}} decaying over {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes 75% slower during ''{{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}}'', ''{{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}}'', or {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
Q.description3: Casting ''Transfusion'' during the surge consumes all ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' to deal {{ccs|85% increased damage|magic}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for an additional {{pp|30 + (200-30)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}. The additional healing is reduced to{{ft|35%|{{pp|30*0.35 + (200*0.35-30*0.35)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.35}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|4*0.35}}% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}.

W.name: Sanguine Pool
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' sinks into a pool of blood, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for 2 seconds. He also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{fd|37.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays exponentially over 1 second.
W.description2:
Enemies within the pool are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40%.
'''Vladimir''' {{tip|heals}} himself for 30% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|30*0.6}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|20 to 75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|3.75}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*4 to 75*4}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description3: '''''Vladimir''' cannot use basic attacks nor abilities during Sanguine Pool, but he can still move. If {{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}} is charging at the time of Sanguine Pool's activation, that ability may still be recast.''

E.name: Tides of Blood
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he increases ''Tides of Blood's'' damage over the first second of the channel, and becomes {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% afterwards for the remaining duration. ''Tides of Blood'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vladimir''' unleashes a nova of 15 blood bolts around himself that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased based on charge time up to the first second.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
E.description3: If ''Tides of Blood'' was charged for at least 1 second, enemies hit are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
E.description4: ''Enemies can intercept multiple bolts, but can be damaged only once.''
E.description5: ''If '''Vladimir''' is below {{as|12% of his '''maximum''' health}}, Tides of Blood will not cost any {{as|health}}.''

R.name: Hemoplague
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' spreads a virulent plague at the target location that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.
R.description2: After the duration, the infection bursts to deal {{as|magic damage}} to all affected targets and, after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay, {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for each infected champion, reduced to 40% for champions beyond the first.

P.name: The Relentless Storm
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Volibear''' damages at least one enemy with a {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''The Relentless Storm'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, '''Volibear''' gains ''Lightning Claws''.
P.description2: {{sbc|The Relentless Storm:}} For each stack, '''Volibear''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|5%|attack speed}} {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to {{as|25%|attack speed}} {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Lightning Claws:}} '''Volibear's''' claws ignite with lightning, empowering his basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} to deal {{as|{{pp|10+1*x for 3; then + 2*x for 3; then + 3*x for 7; then + 4*x for 7|formula=10+1 per level until lvl 3, then+2 until lvl 6, then+3 per level until lvl 13, then+4 per level}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}} '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} to the target and the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 450 units of the target, chaining up to 4 subsequent targets.

Q.name: Thundering Smash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' drops on all fours, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 4 seconds, doubled while facing a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|12 to 26}}%|Increased Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|12*2 to 26*2}}%}}
Q.description2: During this time, '''Volibear's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} has a modified {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time and is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{as|{{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}}}, and {{tt|{{tip|dash|pounce}} on the target|to 25 to 150 units closer than attack range, if Volibear is not closer already}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. This damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 160% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: If '''Volibear''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} by an enemy during ''Thundering Smash'', the effect ends prematurely and the {{sti|cooldown}} is reset.
Q.description4: ''Thundering Smash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Volibear's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Frenzied Maul
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' slashes the target enemy with his claws to deal {{as|physical damage}}, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and mark the target ''Wounded'' for 8 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 105}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Wounded Bonus:}} If the target is already ''Wounded'', '''Volibear''' takes a bite out of them instead, dealing {{ccs|50% {{as|(+ 25% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} increased damage|physical}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself. The heal is halved against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Heal|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8 to 20}}% of his '''missing''' health)}}|Minion Heal|{{ap|20*0.5 to 80*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.5 to 20*0.5}}% of his '''missing''' health)}}}}
W.description3: ''Frenzied Maul'' {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

E.name: Sky Splitter
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' summons a lightning bolt to strike at the target location after a 2-second delay, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second after the first second of the delay. If '''Volibear''' is within the strike, he gains a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|14% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} for 3 seconds.
E.description2: The bolt deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, capped against non-{{tip|champions}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|11 to 15}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Non-Champion Capped Damage|{{ap|150 to 610}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

R.name: Stormbringer
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' gains ''Stormbringer'' for 12 seconds and {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over 1 second, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area in a 500 radius during the travel.
R.description2: {{sbc|Stormbringer:}} '''Volibear''' gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{as|{{sti|50 '''bonus''' attack range}}}}, 25 increased range on ''{{ai|Frenzied Maul|Volibear}}'', and 35% increased {{tip|size}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Health|{{ap|175 to 525}}}}
R.description3: '''Volibear''' {{tt|impacts|centered on Volibear's location when the dash ends in any way}} after 1 second, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by 50% decaying over 1 second. Enemies within the epicenter are also dealt {{ccs|{{as|physical damage}}|physical}}.
R.description4: '''Volibear''' also disables enemy {{tip|turrets}} in an area for a duration, rendering them unable to attack, as well as dealing them the {{ccs|same damage|physical}}.
R.leveling4: {{st|Turret Disable Duration|{{ap|2 to 4}} seconds}}
R.description5: ''{{ais|Thundering Smash|Volibear}} duration will be paused for the {{tip|dash|leap}}.''

P.name: Eternal Hunger
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Warwick''' deals {{as|{{pp|6 + (55-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

While {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}}, '''Warwick''' also {{tip|heal|heals}} for 100% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} dealt by ''Eternal Hunger'', increased to 250% while {{as|below 25% '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Jaws of the Beast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' {{tip|lunge|lunges}} at the target enemy over {{rutngt|0.2475}} and bites them, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and most modifiers.}} dealt, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.description2: While ''Jaws of the Beast'' is active, '''Warwick''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} and clamps his jaw on the target, following '''all''' of their movement. The ability can be held for additional effects.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Hold:}} '''Warwick''' performs the bite, and then begins to {{tip|channel|charge}} for {{fd|0.5 seconds}}, extended if the target is under effects of a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|airborne|displacement}}. During the charge, he {{tip|dash|leaps}} behind the target.

W.name: Blood Hunt
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Warwick''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds upon damaging a target to or while they are below {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}}} with a basic attack or {{tip|ability damage}}, refreshing with subsequent damaging basic attacks or ability damage to enemies below the threshold. If '''Warwick''' does not have the {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} already, he also gains it upon initiating an {{tip|attack windup}} against an enemy below the threshold.
W.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Warwick''' senses all enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} on the map who are damaged below {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}}} by him or an allied source, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' until they {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerate}}}} or {{tip|heal|heal}} above this threshold again. He sees trails leading toward them and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while following a trail. This bonus is lost for {{fd|0.5}} seconds upon [[Combat status|entering champion combat]], but will build up again over {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
W.description3: The {{as|attack speed|attack speed}} and {{as|movement speed}} bonuses granted by both passives are doubled against enemies who are below {{as|{{sti|health|25% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Increased Attack Speed|{{ap|70*2 to 110*2}}%}}
{{st|Increased Movement Speed|{{ap|35*2 to 65*2}}%}}
W.description4: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' senses the nearest enemy champion in the area at the start of the cast time, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' for 8 seconds, gaining both passive bonuses against them regardless of their {{as|{{sti|health|'''current''' health}}}}.
W.description5: ''Blood Hunt's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 30% if no enemy champions are found within range.

E.name: Primal Howl
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' gains damage reduction for up to {{fd|2.75}} seconds. ''Primal Howl'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Warwick''' howls, ending ''Primal Howl's'' effects and {{tip|fear|fearing}} nearby enemies for 1 second, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90%.
E.description4: Starting ''{{ais|Infinite Duress|Warwick}}'' channel while ''Primal Howl'' is active will initiate the recast without ending the damage reduction buff prematurely.
E.description5: ''Primal Howl's recast {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Warwick's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Infinite Duress
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} in the target direction with {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}, stopping upon hitting an enemy champion. He then {{tip|knockdown|knocks them down}} and {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds to {{tip|suppression|suppress}}, {{tip|true sight|reveal}}, and deal {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process. This damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
R.description3: '''Warwick''' {{tip|heals}} for 100% of all {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} he deals to the target during ''Infinite Duress''.
R.description4: ''Infinite Duress'' both applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects 3 times over its duration.
R.description5: ''{{ai|Primal Howl|Warwick}} can be cast during the dash.''

P.name: Stone Skin
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{pp|6 + (10-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' armor}}|armor}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{fd|{{ap|0.35/10}}}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}

Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} with his {{tip|basic attacks}} or {{tip|abilities}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
P.description2: {{sbc|Strength of Stone:}} For each stack,{{ft|''Stone Skin's'' effects are increased by 100%,|'''Wukong''' gains {{as|{{pp|6 to 10}} '''additional bonus''' armor|armor}} and further regenerates an additional {{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds,}}up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|6*(1+1*5) + (10*(1+1*5)-6*(1+1*5))/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' armor}} and total additional regeneration of{{ft|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6}}% '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6/10}}% '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}

Q.name: Crushing Blow
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and then inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Crushing Blow's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy.
Q.description3: ''Crushing Blow {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Wukong's''' and his {{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone's}} basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.''

W.name: Warrior Trickster
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' enters {{tip|invisibility}} for 1 second and {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
W.description2: The clone is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy '''Wukong''' damaged. It can also gain the effects of ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}'' and ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, and casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' whenever '''Wukong''' does.
W.description3: The clone deals reduced damage.
W.description4: ''See [[Wukong#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Wukong's''' clone. '''Wukong''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

E.name: Nimbus Strike
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location and sends out {{tip|untargetable}} ''clones'' to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
E.description2: Upon arrival, '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Cyclone
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}. The staff deals {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies hit, and can {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} once for {{fd|0.6}} seconds. ''Cyclone'' will not {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies who were already hit by either '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' within the same cast.
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|8/8 to 16/8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275/8}}% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 16}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 275% AD)}}}}
R.description2: ''Cyclone'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or by casting another {{tip|ability}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Wukong''' ends ''Cyclone''. After 1 second, he can cast ''Cyclone'' a second time within 8 seconds of the first cast.
R.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8*2 to 16*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275*2}}% AD)}}}}
R.description4: ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} duration is continuously refreshed while spinning.
R.description5: ''Cyclone's'' damage is capped at {{pp|200 to 600 for 3|6;11;16}} per second against {{tip|monsters}}.

P.name: Clean Cuts
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} shot by '''Xayah''' will linger and be planted in the ground at maximum range for 6 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xayah's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate 3 {{tip|stacks}} of ''Clean Cuts'', lasting for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts, and stacking up to 5 times. '''Xayah's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to each consume a stack {{tip|on-attack}} to instead shoot a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} that deals the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} to the primary target and {{as|{{pp|key=%|35 to 55 for 3|1 to 13}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to other enemies hit. The secondary target damage can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Xayah|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage if the triggering attack does.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Xayah''' or {{ci|Rakan}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.

P.name: Lover's Leap
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} shot by '''Xayah''' will linger and be planted in the ground at maximum range for 6 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xayah's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate 3 {{tip|stacks}} of ''Clean Cuts'', lasting for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts, and stacking up to 5 times. '''Xayah's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to each consume a stack {{tip|on-attack}} to instead shoot a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} that deals the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} to the primary target and {{as|{{pp|key=%|35 to 55 for 3|1 to 13}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to other enemies hit. The secondary target damage can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Xayah|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage if the triggering attack does.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Xayah''' or {{ci|Rakan}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.

Q.name: Double Daggers
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' barrages two {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in the target direction that each deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*2 to 105*2}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: Targets hit after the first take 50% reduced damage.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Reduced Damage per Hit|{{ap|45/2 to 105/2}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Reduced Damage|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.cast time: {{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.25;0.033*7;0.033*6;0.033*5;0.033*4;0.1|key1=%|0;27.15;74.29;121.43;168.58;214.3|formula=0.25-(0.07 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed). ''This is capped at 60% reduction at 214.3% '''bonus''' attack speed.''|color=attack speed}}

W.name: Deadly Plumage
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' enters a frenzy for 4 seconds, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and causing her {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} to be empowered to fire an additional smaller feather at the target {{tip|on-hit}} that deals 25% damage of the triggering {{as|attack's damage}}.
W.description2: Whenever '''Xayah''' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with the strike, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description3: ''If {{ci|Rakan}} is nearby upon cast, he also becomes empowered, and gains the {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} at the same time as '''Xayah'''.''

E.name: Bladecaller
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' recalls all planted {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} to shoot back to her, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 50|critScaling=true}}. ''Bladecaller'' deals 50% damage to {{tip|minions}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Feather|{{ap|50 to 110}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion Damage Per Feather|{{ap|50/2 to 110/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40/2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
E.description2: An enemy takes {{pp|type=previous feathers hit|key=%|100 to 10 by 5|x-1|formula=100%-(5% per previous feather hit). ''This is capped at 10% damage.''}} damage from a {{as|Feather|buzzword}}.
E.description3: A target hit by at least three {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} is {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
E.description4: ''A planted {{as|Feather|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Enemies can be hit by an individual {{as|Feather|buzzword}} only once per pass.''

R.name: Featherstorm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' leaps into the air, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. After 1 second, she shoots 5 {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in a cone in the target direction that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
R.description2: '''''Xayah''' is unable to basic attack or cast abilities during Featherstorm, but can still move.''

P.name: Mana Surge
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Xerath''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} to restore {{sti|mana|{{pp|27 + 3*x for 3; then +6*x for 3; then +9*x for 4; then +12*x for 5; then +15*x for 5|formula=27 + 3 at each level up to 3, then + 6 at each level up to 6, then + 9 at each level up to 10, 12 at each level up to 15, then + 15 at each level|color=mana}} {{as|mana}}}}, doubled to {{pp|54 + 6*x for 3; then +12*x for 3; then +18*x for 4; then +24*x for 5; then +30*x for 5|formula=54 + 6 at each level up to 3, then + 12 at each level up to 6, then + 18 at each level up to 10, then + 24 at each level up to 15, then + 30 at each level|color=mana}} against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
P.description2: ''Mana Surge's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|3.5}} seconds whenever '''Xerath''' kills an enemy.
P.description3: ''Mana Surge does not trigger if '''Xerath''' would restore above {{as|his '''maximum''' mana}}.''

Q.name: Arcanopulse
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|0;10;15;20;25;30;35;40|0 to 1.75|formula=10% after 0 to 0.25 seconds, then {{plus}}5% per 0.25 seconds channeled, capped at 40%}} for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Arcanopulse's'' {{sti|range}} over the first {{fd|1.5}} to {{fd|1.75}} seconds of the channel.
Q.description2: ''Arcanopulse'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Arcanopulse'' is cancelled and refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|half the mana cost}}}}.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Xerath''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{rutngt|0.5}} and afterwards fires a beam of energy in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Mana Refunded|{{as|{{ap|80/2 to 120/2}}|mana}}}}

W.name: Eye of Destruction
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' casts down a blast of arcane energy that strikes the target location after {{rutngt|0.5}}, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 25% for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
W.description2: Enemies in the epicenter take {{fd|66.7}}% increased damage and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by a greater amount, decaying to 25% over the duration.

E.name: Shocking Orb
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' fires an orb of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{pp|type=orb travel distance|0.75 to 2.25 for 11|0 to 1050|formula=0.75+(0.15 per 105 units). ''This is capped at 1050 units traveled.''}} seconds.

R.name: Rite of the Arcane

W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' extends his glaive in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. E.name: Aureate Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he flourishes his glaive to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: Enemies hit by the outer edge are dealt {{ccs|{{as|50% increased physical damage}}|physical}} and {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}}, with the latter capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 6}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
E.description3: ''Aureate Rush'' deals {{as|50 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against monsters.

R.name: Grim Deliverance
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Zaahen''' gains {{as|{{sti|armor penetration}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' gains {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|launches}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} into the air to the target location. He then slams his glaive down after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, unleashing a shockwave that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|heals}} him for each {{tip|champion}} hit.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|250 to 550}} {{as|(+ 200% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Healing per Champion hit|{{ap|250*0.33 to 550*0.33}} {{as|(+ {{ap|200*0.33}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: '''Zaahen''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains 50% [[damage reduction]] from the start of the cast time. He retains these effects as well as the {{tip|displacement immunity}} during the delay before the slam and for {{tt|up-to an additional {{fd|0.25}} seconds|See notes}} afterwards.

P.name: Cell Division
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - The Secret Weapon:}} '''Zac''' gains increased percentage {{tip|size}} equal to {{as|{{fd|1.5}}% of his '''bonus''' health}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|{{#expr:35/0.015 round 1}}{{recurring|3}}}} '''bonus''' health}}. '''Zac's''' size also reduces based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}}, down to 70% '''total''' size while at {{as|0% health}}.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Goo:}} Whenever '''Zac''' hits enemies with an {{tip|ability}}, he sheds a number of chunks of himself to a nearby location, landing towards nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} and lasting for 6 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for the initial hit, and 1 chunk if the second hits a different enemy
* ''{{ai|Unstable Matter|Zac}}'': 1 chunk if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Elastic Slingshot|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each enemy champion hit, with a minimum of 1 if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each bounce that hits at least one enemy
P.description3: Both '''Zac''' and enemy champions can interact with a chunk by being within 50 units of it: an enemy will destroy it, while '''Zac''' will consume it to {{tip|heal}} for {{as|{{pp|key=%|4 + (8-4)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of his '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Cell Division:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Zac''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for {{pp|8 to 4 for 5|1;6;10;13;17}} seconds, instantly restoring {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}} and becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. '''Zac''' then splits into four uncontrollable [[File:Cell_Division.png|20px|link=Zac#Pets]] ''[[Zac#Pets|bloblets]]'' away from his location, though stopping at terrain. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of the ''bloblets'' being {{tip|untargetable}}, they start moving toward '''Zac's''' location over the {{tt|remaining duration|Regardless of distance}}. Any damage the ''bloblets'' receive, excluding damage dealt in excess of each ''bloblet's'' {{as|'''total maximum''' health}}, is also echoed to '''Zac''' as {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. While in resurrection, '''Zac''' cannot take damage from sources other than the echoed damage from his ''bloblets''.
P.description5: After the duration, '''Zac''' is revived with {{as|{{tt|10 – 50%|Based on his bloblets' total remaining health. Reaches the maximum amount at full health on all bloblets}} '''maximum''' health}}. '''Zac''' will be {{tip|execute|executed}} once all bloblets are killed.
P.description6: ''See [[Zac#Pets|Pets]] for stats and details for bloblets.''

Q.name: Stretching Strikes
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' stretches his left arm in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Zac''' and the target for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 3% of '''Zac's''' '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% of '''Zac's''' '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: While the tether persists, '''Zac's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a second ''Stretching Strike'', empowering it to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time and gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' attack range}}. This attack triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but cannot {{tip|critically strike}} nor apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

After a {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}-second delay|After the attack's cast time}}, '''Zac''' {{tt|displaces|Only move block, does not stun the target's actions (disables attacking and movement only)}} them toward each other over 300 units, though not through terrain.
Q.description4: If the two targets are within 700 units of each other, they are instead slammed together through the displacement. Upon impact of each other, both targets are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds and all enemies within the impact are dealt the initial {{as|magic damage}} and applied the same {{tip|slow}}.
Q.description5: ''Both Stretching Strikes (the cast and the empowered attack) {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zac's''' basic attack timer. '''Zac''' is unable to move or attack while his left arm is in flight.''

W.name: Unstable Matter
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. The damage based on the target's max health ratio is capped at 200 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 80}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|200+40 to 200+80}}}}
W.description2: '''Zac''' grants {{tip|ghost|ghosting}} to aggroed monsters hit for 5 seconds.
W.description3: ''Unstable Matter's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second whenever '''Zac''' collects a ''{{ai|Cell Division|Zac}}'' chunk.

E.name: Elastic Slingshot
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|4.5}} seconds to increase ''Elastic Slingshot's'' range over a cone in the target direction.
E.description2: ''Elastic Slingshot'' can be recast within the duration. If '''Zac''' {{tt|cancels|See notes}} the channel himself, or the charge completes without reactivation, 50% of ''Elastic Slingshot's'' {{sti|{{as|health cost}}}} and {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location within the boundaries of the cone. Upon landing, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to 1 second if ''Elastic Slingshot'' was charged for more than 1 second.

R.name: Let's Bounce!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' bounces after the cast time, then bounces 3 additional times each second over 3 seconds. Each bounce deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} over 1 second, and {{tip|slows}} them by 20% for the same duration. An enemy can be hit by multiple bounces, but ones beyond the first deal 50% damage to them and do not apply the {{tip|airborne|knock back}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Hit|{{ap|120 to 260}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Reduced Damage Per Hit|{{ap|120/2 to 260/2}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|120*2.5 to 260*2.5}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
R.description2: '''Zac''' can move while ''Let's Bounce!'' is active, gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|type=duration|key=%|20 to 50 for 7|0 to 3}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, but becomes unable to declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}}'', and ''{{ai|Elastic Slingshot|Zac}}''. He also automatically consumes all ''{{ai|Cell Division|Zac|chunks}}'' within the bounce radius.

P.name: Contempt for the Weak
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zed's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against targets {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|5 to 10 for 3|1;7;17}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} as {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
P.description2: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Contempt for the Weak'' deals 75% damage and is capped at 175.
P.description3: ''Contempt for the Weak'' cannot occur on the same {{tip|champion}} more than once every few seconds.

Q.name: Razor Shuriken
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 60% against targets beyond the first.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.6 to 240*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

W.name: Living Shadow
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Zed''' restores {{sti|{{as|energy}}}} whenever he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' or multiple ''Shadows'' hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' creates a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' that dashes to the target location and remains there for {{fd|5.25}} seconds, being able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range. ''Living Shadow'' can be recast while within range of the ''Shadow''.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Shadow Swap:}} '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' {{tip|blink}} to swap places.
W.description4: ''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''

W.name: Living Shadow 2

W.description4: ''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''

E.description2: Enemies hit by a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow's'' slash are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, with {{tt|multiple slashes|See notes}} dealing no additional damage but the slow's effectiveness being increased by 50%.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Living Shadow|Zed|Living Shadow's}}'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by '''Zed's''' slash.

R.name: Death Mark
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and, after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, he {{tip|dashes}} to 125 units beyond the target enemy champion from his position at the end of the delay over {{fd|0.35}} seconds. Afterwards, he becomes targetable again, renders the target ''Marked for Death'' for 3 seconds, and gains {{tip|ghost|ghosting}} for the same duration.
R.description2: '''Zed''' also spawns a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' at his casting position for 9 seconds which is able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range. ''Death Mark'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his reappearance while the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is active, though not in the last {{fd|1.25}} seconds of its duration.
R.description3: {{sbc|Marked for Death:}} '''Zed''' stores a portion of all {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}} he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' deal to the target, detonating at the end of the duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Shadow Swap:}} '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' {{tip|blink}} to swap places.
R.description5: ''If the target dies or is 1950 or more units away before the dash begins, Death Mark is cancelled, causing the ability to go on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} cooldown, '''Zed''' to reappear at the cast location, and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Shadow he spawned to disappear.''
