P.name: Living Battery
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zeri''' generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', up to a maximum of 100 charge. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} consume charge to deal '''modified''' damage.
'''Zeri''' gains maximum charge when the game starts and upon [[respawn]]ing.
P.description2: {{tip|Basic Attack|{{sbc|Basic Attack:}}}} '''Zeri''' zaps the target, dealing {{as|{{pp|10+(15/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, applying {{tip|spell effects}} as {{tip|spell damage}}, triggering on-cast effects and {{ccs|executing|magic}} the target if they are below {{pp|70 + (160-70)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=hp}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. This cannot {{tip|critically strike}} and does not apply nor trigger {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
P.description3: At full charge, '''Zeri's''' next attack is empowered to consume all charge to deal {{as|{{pp|75 + (160-75)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|1 + (11-1)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Burst Fire
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' fires a burst of 7 rounds in the target direction over the cast time, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|22 to 38}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102 to 110}}% AD)}}|Total Critical Strike Damage|{{ap|22*{{#var:crit}} to 38*{{#var:crit}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*{{#var:crit}} to 110*{{#var:crit}}}}% AD)}}|Total Infinity Edge Damage|{{ap|22*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}}) to 38*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}}) to 110*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|22/7 to 38/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102/7 to 110/7|round=2}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike per Hit|{{ap|22*{{#var:crit}}/7 to 38*{{#var:crit}}/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*{{#var:crit}}/7 to 110*{{#var:crit}}/7|round=2}}% AD)}}|Infinity Edge Damage per Hit|{{ap|22*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7 to 38*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7 to 110*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7|round=2}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description2: ''Burst Fire's'' projectile is treated as a {{tip|basic attack}}: it hits any enemy unit a typical basic attack can; deals {{tip|basic damage}}; can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Zeri|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage; and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit. ''Burst Fire's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and cast time are reduced with {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}, with the maximum of {{as|{{fd|1.5}}|attack speed}} attacks per second. {{#expr: 0.6 * 100 }}% of {{as|attack speed}} in excess of the cap is converted into {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
Q.description3: '''''Zeri''' can cast Burst Fire even while {{tip|silence|silenced}}.''

W.name: Ultrashock Laser
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' fires an electric pulse in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slows}} them for 2 seconds.

If the pulse hits [[terrain]], it transforms into a laser in a line that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.75}} seconds and fires after {{fd|0.85}} seconds, applying the same effects to enemies hit and {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

E.name: Spark Surge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction. She will dash farther across [[terrain]] if ''Spark Surge'' was cast within 50 units of any, gaining {{tip|unobstructed vision}} of the surrounding 800 units and {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself while there are enemy champions within 1500 units of her.
E.description2: Afterwards, she gains ''Lightning Rounds'' for 5 seconds, empowering ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}, and pierce through enemies. Targets after the first take modified damage which does not apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects or {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} nor trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.leveling2:
{{st|{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}} Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|22 to 30}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
{{st|{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}} Secondary Target Damage|{{ap|80 to 100}}%}}
E.description3: ''Spark Surge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Zeri''' hits at least one enemy with a ''{{ai|Basic Attack 2|Zeri|charged}}'' basic attack or ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', increased to {{fd|1.5}} seconds if the latter {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}.
E.description4: ''Spark Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zeri's''' basic attack timer and {{ais|Burst Fire|Zeri}} cooldown. {{ai|Ultrashock Laser|Zeri}} and {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Lightning Crash
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' discharges an electric nova that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters ''Overcharged'' for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack will extend the duration by {{fd|2.5}} seconds, up to its original duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Overcharged:}} '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and an increased attack speed cap of {{as|{{ap|1.5+({{ccd|Zeri|as_ratio}}*0.3)}}|as}}. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' is empowered to have a 20% shorter cast time and a decreased spread angle, and instead fires 3 rounds that travel with increased speed. The first round to hit an enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} chains electricity to the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal {{as|40% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|40}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
R.description3: During ''Overcharged'', '''Zeri''' can generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Hypercharged'' from enemy champions that last {{fd|2.5}} seconds. She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack, increased to 3 on abilities that {{tip|critically strike}}. Subsequent hits refresh the duration of ''Hypercharged''. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' grants stacks only against the first target hit.
R.description4: {{sbc|Hypercharged:}} For each stack, '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|{{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description5: '''''Zeri''' can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.''

P.name: Short Fuse
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Ziggs''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to deal {{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +8*x for 6; then +12*x for 8|formula = 16 + 4 per level up to 6, then + 8 per level up to 12, then + 12 per level up to 18}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}},{{ft|increased by 75% against {{tip|structures}}.|increased to {{as|{{pp|1.75*(20+4*(x-1)) for 6;then +1.75*8*x for 6;then +1.75*12*x for 8|formula={{ap|20*1.75}} + {{ap|4*1.75}} per level up to 6, then + {{ap|8*1.75}} per level up to level 12, then + {{ap|12*1.75}} per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.75}}% AP)}} against {{tip|structures}}.}}
P.description2: ''Short Fuse's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 6 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an {{tip|ability}}.

Q.name: Bouncing Bomb
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' throws a bomb to the target location that bounces forward up to two times, with the distance traveled each time being based on how far it was originally thrown and each bounce occurring over {{fd|0.495}} seconds regardless of distance.
Q.description2: The bomb explodes upon landing near an enemy, within terrain, or the final bounce, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 80}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Satchel Charge
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.
W.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ziggs''' detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} up to 825 units away from the center.
W.description3: {{cci|Satchel Charge Turret Explosion Indicator.png|border=false||{{sbc|Turret Explosion:}}}} The explosion also {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executes}}|magic}} enemy {{tip|turrets}} within that are below a {{as|'''maximum''' health}} threshold.
W.description4: '''''Ziggs''' will not {{tip|dash}} from the explosion if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

E.name: Hexplosive Minefield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds, {{tt|arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds|travel time of the mines spreading out plus a brief delay}} and lasting for up to 10 seconds.
E.description2: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.

R.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' catapults the ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 4 seconds.
R.description2: The bomb explodes upon arrival to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 65% against those outside of the epicenter.
R.leveling2: {{st|Epicenter Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700|round=2}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300*0.65 to 700*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.65}}% AP)}}}}

P.name: Time in a Bottle
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zilean''' generates {{sti|Experience|{{as|{{pp|2;3.5;5;6;12|1;6;11;16;18}} experience}}}} (does not count towards his own [[Experience (champion)|level up]]) every 5 seconds. ''Time in a Bottle'' is on cooldown when the game starts and becomes disabled when '''Zilean''' and his allied champions have reached their {{tt|maximum level|On Summoner's Rift, level 20 for the champion in the top lane role and 18 for Zilean and all other allies.}}.
P.description2:
When he has stored enough {{as|experience}} to level up an allied {{tip|champion}} to their next level, he can {{tt|select them|Default MB2/right-click}} to {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|1.2}} seconds after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]].

The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} and disabled upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions or taking damage from {{tip|turret|turrets}}, placing it on a {{sti|10-second cooldown}}. If '''Zilean''' interrupts it himself, it is placed on a 1-second cooldown, increased to 2 if he used a [[basic attack]] against a turret to do so. Additionally, if '''Zilean''' becomes affected by any form of {{tip|crowd control}}, the channel is placed on a 10-second cooldown.
P.description3: A successful channel will grant an equal amount of {{as|experience}} to the ally for them to level up as well as to '''Zilean''', with a combined minimum of 15% of the stored {{as|experience}}.
P.description4: '''''Zilean''' cannot initiate the channel while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''

Q.name: Time Bomb
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels as well as while lingering in the area. The bomb will attach itself to units that move within the epicenter, or those hit directly at the time of the bomb's landing, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and their surroundings.
Q.description2: {{tt|After 3 seconds|From when the bomb lands}}, or when the attached unit dies, the bomb explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.description3: The bomb detonates immediately if another bomb attaches itself to the same unit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} nearby enemies for a duration.

W.name: Rewind
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' reduces the {{sti|cd|'''remaining'''}} cooldowns of ''{{ai|Time Bomb|Zilean}}'' and ''{{ai|Time Warp|Zilean}}'' by 10 seconds each.
W.description2: ''Either {{ai|Time Bomb|Zilean}} or {{ai|Time Warp|Zilean}} must be on cooldown to cast this ability''.

E.name: Time Warp
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' applies ''Time Warp'' to the target champion which lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
E.description2: {{sbc|Time Warp:}} If the target is an ally, they gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. If the target is an enemy, they are {{tip|slow|slowed}}.

R.name: Chronoshift
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' places a protective time rune on the target allied {{tip|champion}} or himself for 5 seconds.
R.description2: If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} within the duration, they enter {{tip|resurrection}} for 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. Afterwards, they revive while being {{tip|heal|healed}}.

P.name: More Sparkles!
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Zoe''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit?--> or ''{{ai|Spell Thief|Zoe}}'' bolt within 5 seconds to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{pp|16; then +4*x for 5; then +6*x for 5; then +8*x for 3; then +10*x for 6|color=magic damage|formula=16 base, then +4 per level until level 6, then +6 per level until level 11, then +8 per level until level 14, then +10 per level}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Paddle Star!
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' shoots a star in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies hit. The '''total''' damage is increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 150 for 7|800;950;1350;1650;1950;2250;2550}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{pp|2; then +2*x for 8; then +3*x for 4; then +4*x for 7|formula=2 base, then +2 per level until 9, then +3 per level until 13, then +4 per level}} (+ {{ap|50 to 170}}) {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{pp|2*2.5; then +(2*2.5)*x for 8; then +(3*2.5)*x for 4; then +(4*2.5)*x for 7|formula=250% of minimum}} (+ {{ap|50*2.5 to 170*2.5}}) {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: The star lingers at maximum range for 1 second, during which ''Paddle Star!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds in the duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zoe''' redirects the star in the target path, empowering it with increased speed and radius, and resetting its damage modifier on cast. The redirected star can travel until it reaches 800-units outbound from '''Zoe'''.
Q.description4: ''Paddle Star!'s recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

Q.name: Paddle Star! 2
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' shoots a star in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies hit. The '''total''' damage is increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 150 for 7|800;950;1350;1650;1950;2250;2550}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{pp|2; then +2*x for 8; then +3*x for 4; then +4*x for 7|formula=2 base, then +2 per level until 9, then +3 per level until 13, then +4 per level}} (+ {{ap|50 to 170}}) {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{pp|2*2.5; then +(2*2.5)*x for 8; then +(3*2.5)*x for 4; then +(4*2.5)*x for 7|formula=250% of minimum}} (+ {{ap|50*2.5 to 170*2.5}}) {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: The star lingers at maximum range for 1 second, during which ''Paddle Star!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds in the duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zoe''' redirects the star in the target path, empowering it with increased speed and radius, and resetting its damage modifier on cast. The redirected star can travel until it reaches 800-units outbound from '''Zoe'''.
Q.description4: ''Paddle Star!'s recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

W.name: Spell Thief
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Wheeeee:}} Whenever '''Zoe''' casts ''Spell Thief'' or a summoner spell, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration, and summons three bolts that orbit her for the next 10 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 70}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed Duration|{{ap|2 to 3}} seconds}}
W.description2: If '''Zoe''' is not affected by {{tip|complete crowd control}}, she shoots one bolt at a time at the nearest non-{{tip|sleep|sleeping}} enemy in range, prioritizing her attack target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each bolt.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Bolt|{{ap|15 to 55}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 55*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever an enemy champion casts a {{tt|specific|See notes for applicable spells/item actives}} {{ccib|Summoner spell icon.png|summoner spell}} or {{ccib|Active ability item icon.svg|Active ability items|item active}}, regardless of distance, they drop the corresponding ''{{as|{{ccib|Spell Thief Minimap.png||Spell Shard}}|armor}}'' onto the ground that grants {{tip|sight}} over a 100-radius area and remains for 40 seconds. Enemy {{tip|minions}} have a 10% chance to spawn with a {{tt|random ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}''|See notes for applicable spells/actives}} that drops and remains for 20 seconds if '''Zoe''' kills them. Allied champions that kill them will cause the ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' to drop only if '''Zoe''' is nearby.
W.description4: '''Zoe''' can collect a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' by moving directly onto it, holding it for up to 60 seconds. Collecting a new ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' replaces the current one.
W.description5: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' mimics the active effect of the collected ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}''.

E.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit, otherwise lingering at maximum range while slightly bouncing forward over 1 second, then becoming a trap for 5 seconds that bursts upon contact with an enemy. The bubble can move through [[terrain]] only once, but travels the entire distance as '''bonus''' range, and will fall short if it would enter terrain again.
E.description2: The burst deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target and inflicts them with {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.4}} seconds, which gradually {{tip|slows}} them until they fall {{tip|sleep|asleep}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds. While the target is {{tip|sleep|asleep}}, they are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|30% magic resistance reduction}}}}.
E.description3: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} against the {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target consumes the debuff to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, capped at ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble's'' damage. This '''bonus''' damage may also be applied within 1 second of the {{tip|sleep}} ending, if the debuff was not consumed.
E.leveling3: {{st|Bonus Damage Cap|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Maximum Mixed Damage|{{ap|140 to 460}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
E.description4: ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' refunds a percentage of its cooldown if the bubble hits an enemy champion.

R.name: Portal Jump
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{tt|{{fd|0.15}}-second delay|From the end of the cast time, blink occurs after 0.4 seconds from the start of cast}}, '''Zoe''' {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction and remains there for {{tt|{{fd|0.95}} seconds to {{fd|1.25}} seconds|See notes}}, during which she sets her {{as|movement speed}} to a {{as|static 0|ms}} and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}}. Afterwards, she {{tip|blinks}} back to her casting position.
R.description2: ''Portal Jump {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zoe's''' basic attack timer. '''Zoe''' {{tt|briefly|See notes}} becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} after casting Portal Jump as well as after blinking back.''

P.name: Garden of Thorns
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' spawns one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area for 1 second.
P.description2: After 1 second, enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy ''Seeds'' by moving on top of them.
P.description3: '''Zyra''' can only have a total of 8 ''Seeds'' planted at a time, preserving {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} spawned by ''{{ai|Rampant Growth|Zyra}}'' over {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} spawned by ''Garden of Thorns''.

Q.name: Deadly Spines
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' sprouts thorny spines at the target location that appear after a {{fd|0.625}}-seconds delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.description2: If ''Deadly Spine'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a [[File:Zyra Deadly Spines Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Thorn Spitter]]'' that lasts for 8 seconds.

W.name: Rampant Growth
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' plants a {{as|Seed|buzzword}} at the target location that remains for 60 seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area, though decreasing in radius after 1 second. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds, enemy champions can destroy the {{as|Seed|buzzword}} by stepping on it, which {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 2 seconds.
W.description2: '''Zyra''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Seed'' charge, up to a maximum of 2. Killing an enemy generates 35% charge toward a ''Seed'', increased to 100% for large enemies and whenever scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.

E.name: Grasping Roots
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' shoots a surge of vines in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
E.description2: If ''Grasping Roots'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a [[File:Zyra Grasping Roots Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Vine Lasher]]'' that lasts for 8 seconds.

R.name: Stranglethorns
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit as it expands.
R.description2: After 2 seconds, the thicket snaps upward to {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies within for 1 second.
R.description3: ''{{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}}'' hit by the thicket become enraged, restoring {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''current''' health}}}}, increasing their {{as|'''maximum''' health by 50%}}, gaining 25% increased [[size]] and refreshing their duration while the thicket expands. Additionally they attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack, dealing {{ft|150% damage per flurry.|75% damage per shot.}}
